It changes appearance and decoration rather than DSH functionality, and follows the system light/dark mode.

description.zh: 把运行中的状态行换成 1550 条按思考 / 运行 / 长任务阶段轮换的梗文案，支持打字机输出、昼夜渐变、滚动/顶部/底部弹幕和可选鲸尾动画，保留宿主运行时长时钟；14 个主题词库包可分别启用，也能用设置页或外部词库替换。
description.en: Replaces the running status text with 1,550 phrases rotating per thinking/running/long-task phase, with typewriter output, day/night gradients, scroll/top/bottom danmaku and an optional animated whale tail, while keeping the host's elapsed-time clock; 14 phrase packs toggle separately, and the bank can be edited from settings or an external file.

description.zh: 在设置里新增「界面皮肤」栏目，用卡片管理 7 款原创皮肤，可以先试穿再应用、免重启，并带 0–100% 不透明度滑块。还能选本机图片做对话区背景，按画幅框选裁剪后固定不随对话滚动，对话区背景会自动保存。
description.en: Adds an Interface Skins section to DSH settings with cards for seven original skins: try one on, apply it without a restart, and adjust overall opacity from 0 to 100%. It also lets you pick a local image as a fixed chat background, crop it to the chat frame, and saves the setup automatically.

description.zh: 新粗野主义客户端主题，内置「蓝统治」与「做旧报纸」两套方案，可在设置中实时切换；使用硬偏移阴影、直角和 2px 边框，并适配 `dsh-voice-input` 的弹层、按钮与状态色。支持浅色/深色/跟随系统，方案选择和开关保存在 `localStorage`。
description.en: A neo-brutalist client skin with live-switchable Blue Command and Aged Newspaper schemes. It adds hard offset shadows, sharp corners, 2px borders, and themed `dsh-voice-input` popovers, buttons, and states. Light/dark/system modes remain available, and the scheme plus master toggle persist in `localStorage`.

description.zh: 以太极道君背景图、黛青强调色和楷体界面组成的 DSH Web 主题，提供宣纸/墨色罩层、半透明面板及自动跟随宿主明暗模式的边框、文字和滚动条配色。停用插件会移除 `--dsw-*` token 覆盖并还原官方外观。
description.en: A Guofeng Taiji theme for DSH Web with a Taiji-master background, dark-cyan accents, and a KaiTi-first interface. It adds paper/ink overlays, translucent panels, and scheme-aware borders, text, and scrollbar colors; disabling the plugin removes its `--dsw-*` token overrides and restores the stock UI.

description.zh: 提供 Aurora、Night Flight、Nordfjord 和 Sakura 四套精选配色，另有 Default 原生外观；每套都含浅/深色方案，自动跟随 DSH 外观设置，选择会保存并可一键恢复默认。
description.en: Ships four curated color skins—Aurora, Night Flight, Nordfjord, and Sakura—plus the Default stock look. Each skin has light and dark palettes that follow DSH's Appearance setting; the choice is persisted and Default restores the native UI.

description.zh: DSH Web 桌宠插件，提供 106 个手绘透明动画、桌面漫步和点击回应；可通过本地 Ollama 或 DSH 会话模型聊天，也可选择开启屏幕观察与一句话吐槽。
description.en: A DSH Web pet with 106 hand-drawn transparent animations, desktop wandering and click reactions. Chat through a local Ollama model or the DSH session model, with optional screen watching and one-line quips.

description.zh: 夕小瑶皮肤合集中的黑鲸实验室子包，以黑鲸轮廓、石墨黑工作台和樱粉点缀构成研究风格界面；通过真实 bundle 接入 Web profile，仅修改表现层，不读取会话或发起网络请求。
description.en: A skin subpackage from the Xiaoyao collection, with a black-whale silhouette, graphite workspace, and cherry-pink accents; it connects to the Web profile through a real bundle and changes only the presentation layer, without reading sessions or making network requests.

description.zh: 长城三境中的深色 DSH Web 主题，以炭黑、中国红和古金构成视觉配色；通过合集安装器切换，定位为表现层皮肤，不替换会话、模型、工具或沙箱。
description.en: A dark DSH Web theme in the Great Wall trio, using charcoal, Chinese red, and antique gold; it is switched through the collection installer and stays in the presentation layer without replacing sessions, models, tools, or the sandbox.

description.zh: 长城三境中的清冷浅色 DSH Web 主题，以雪白、墨灰和正红披风构成配色；通过合集安装器切换，定位为表现层皮肤，不替换会话、模型、工具或沙箱。
description.en: A cool, light DSH Web theme in the Great Wall trio, using snow white, ink gray, and a red cape; it is switched through the collection installer and stays in the presentation layer without replacing sessions, models, tools, or the sandbox.

description.zh: 长城三境中的暖色浅色 DSH Web 主题，以米白宣纸、朱红和朝霞金构成配色；通过合集安装器切换，定位为表现层皮肤，不替换会话、模型、工具或沙箱。
description.en: A warm, light DSH Web theme in the Great Wall trio, using rice-paper white, vermilion, and sunrise gold; it is switched through the collection installer and stays in the presentation layer without replacing sessions, models, tools, or the sandbox.

description.zh: 深海蓝、夕小瑶粉发猫娘和鲸鱼光效组成的沉浸式 DSH Web 皮肤；素材在构建阶段内嵌，样式隔离，停用时恢复背景、标题、favicon 和注入组件，不修改会话、模型、工具或沙箱。
description.en: An immersive DSH Web skin built from deep-sea blue, Xiaoyao's pink-haired catgirl, and whale light effects. Assets are embedded at build time; styles are isolated, teardown restores the background, title, favicon, and injected components, and it does not alter sessions, models, tools, or the sandbox.

description.zh: 蓝鲸女仆与夕小瑶并肩工作的明亮云端研究所主题，以珍珠玻璃、蓝粉晶体和晴空白昼构成轻盈工作台；样式隔离，停用后清理运行期状态，不替换 DSH 后端或功能服务。
description.en: A bright cloud-lab theme where a blue-whale maid and Xiaoyao work side by side, using pearl glass, blue-pink crystals, and a clear-sky palette; styles are isolated, runtime state is cleaned up on disposal, and it does not replace DSH back-end or feature services.

description.zh: 边对话边听歌的悬浮播放器，可隐藏或重新打开；默认收缩为吸附在边缘的小唱片圈，支持双击下一首、三击上一首。接入 QQ 音乐，支持扫码登录、断点续播、音质切换、重启续播、歌单导入和搜索。
description.en: A floating player for listening while you chat. It can be hidden and reopened, and collapses to a small edge-docked record. Supports double-click for next track, triple-click for previous track, QQ Music with QR sign-in, resume playback, quality switching, playlist import, and search.

description.zh: 在 DSH 中提供可视化外观编辑：用「检查元素」逐项选中文字并调整颜色、字号、字重、阴影与背景；另可切换预设配色、设置分区背景图、界面/代码字体、聊天宽度，并导出 JSON/CSS、导入 JSON 设置。修改实时生效，保存于 DSH 数据目录。
description.en: Provides a visual appearance editor for DSH: use Inspect Element to select individual pieces of text and adjust color, size, weight, shadow, and background. It also offers preset palettes, per-region background images, UI/code fonts, chat-width controls, JSON import/export, and CSS export. Changes apply live and are saved in DSH's data directory.

description.zh: Synthwave Theme 提供霓虹 hover/focus 发光、半透明面板、图片轮播或本地/HTTP(S) 视频背景、0–40px 渲染层模糊和 `fontScale` 根字号缩放，并在插件详情页编辑 `config.dsh-theme-synthwave.jsonc`。背景视频默认静音；移动端默认不自动播放，缓存或用户点击后才播放，配置解析失败会暂用默认值且不改原文件。v0.3.0 适配 DSH `0.1.6-alpha.2`，更早版本需使用 v0.2.1。
description.en: Synthwave Theme adds neon hover/focus glow, translucent panels, image rotation or local/HTTP(S) video backgrounds, 0–40px render-layer blur, and root `fontScale` control. Its plugin-details page edits `config.dsh-theme-synthwave.jsonc`. Background video is muted by default; mobile autoplay is off until cached or explicitly started, and parse failures temporarily use defaults without changing the original file. Version 0.3.0 targets DSH `0.1.6-alpha.2`; use v0.2.1 for earlier releases.

description.zh: 报纸衬线 · Newsprint Serif 用纯 CSS 把 Typora `newsprint` 的报纸排版带进 DSH Web：亮色暖白纸张、暖调暗色 `#1a1815`、衬线正文（Georgia → PT Serif → Noto Serif SC → SimSun），并重做标题细线、引用块、表头大写、斑马行、链接悬停下划线和代码块分隔线。它不使用 hooks、图片资产或任何 `@deepseek-ai/*` client peer，只向 DOM 注入 `dsh-newsprint-active` 作用域的 `style#dsh-theme-newsprint-styles`，依据 `body[data-ds-dark-theme]` 自行分流亮暗档；代价是不能由主题运行时的亮暗选择器驱动。字体按系统字族引用，不内嵌字体文件；多个主题同时启用会叠加，建议只保留一个。MIT 许可。
description.en: Newsprint Serif brings the newspaper typography of Typora’s `newsprint` theme to DSH Web with pure CSS: warm-white paper in light mode, a warm brown-black `#1a1815` dark scheme, and a serif stack of Georgia → PT Serif → Noto Serif SC → SimSun. It adds newspaper-style heading rules, blockquotes, uppercase table headers, zebra rows, hover underlines, and code-block separators. It uses no hooks, image assets, or `@deepseek-ai/*` client peer; it injects a scoped `style#dsh-theme-newsprint-styles` under `dsh-newsprint-active` and branches on `body[data-ds-dark-theme]` instead of the theme runtime. The trade-off is that the runtime theme picker cannot drive its schemes. Fonts are referenced by system family, not bundled; enabling multiple themes makes them stack, so keep one enabled. MIT licensed.

description.zh: 「底特律：变人」风格主题：用 theme.overrideTokens 覆盖 14 个主题令牌，深色为深蓝黑底加冷蓝高光，浅色为冷灰白底加藏蓝强调；空白会话页头像位换成带四个刻度点的断口圆环品牌标记，卸载后恢复宿主主题。
description.en: Detroit-inspired theme that overrides 14 theme tokens: deep blue-black with cool blue highlights in dark mode, cool grey-white with navy accents in light mode, plus a split-ring brand mark on the empty conversation page; removing the plugin restores the host theme.

name.zh: Codefall 数字雨与绿色主题

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加黑客帝国风格的绿色数字雨开屏和向两侧展开的矩形光门，并提供可调色相的绿色界面主题。可设置雨密度、速度、画质、明暗模式和重播时机；动画用 Canvas2D 绘制，不加载视频或在线动画素材，支持减少动态效果。目标为 Harness 0.2.0-rc.2 及以上；桌面恢复重播和 macOS/Linux 实机兼容性仍需按环境验证。MIT 许可。
description.en: Adds a Matrix-inspired green digital-rain startup screen, a rectangular light portal that opens in both directions, and a hue-adjustable green UI theme to DeepSeek Harness. Rain density, speed, quality, light/dark appearance, and replay timing are configurable; the animation uses Canvas2D without video or online animation assets and respects reduced-motion preferences. It targets Harness 0.2.0-rc.2 and newer; desktop-restore replay and real-device compatibility on macOS/Linux still depend on the environment. MIT licensed.

description.zh: 《崩坏：星穹铁道》卡芙卡主题皮肤，以深紫、洋红与幽黑为主色，提供浅色/深色玻璃卡片、角色立绘、粒子、蛛网和彼岸花装饰；设置中可调背景可见度并选择“卡芙卡·星核猎手”配色。
description.en: A Kafka (Honkai: Star Rail) theme skin with a deep-purple, magenta, and black palette. It adds light/dark glass cards, character artwork, particles, spider-web and spider-lily accents, plus a settings palette and background-visibility control.

description.zh: 可切换四套启动画面与背景皮肤：NEON GRID、ABYSS PROTOCOL、VERMILION DAWN 和 VELVET MUSE；支持视频/静态图背景、右下角切换器和重播启动画面。
description.en: Switch among four boot-and-background skins—NEON GRID, ABYSS PROTOCOL, VERMILION DAWN and VELVET MUSE—with video/still backgrounds, a corner switcher and replayable boot sequences.

description.zh: Hiyuki Frost Sakura（绯雪霜樱）为 DSH Web 提供常态/战斗态两套本地背景与霜樱玻璃材质：当前可见会话首次调用工具时切入战斗态，任务结束、停止或失败后恢复常态，也可手动锁定形态。设置可调视觉强度、输入框透明度（0–90%）和动态效果，支持 `prefers-reduced-motion`，不代理会话操作或调用删除/归档等会话管理 API；固定版本列出 DSH `0.1.0-rc.6`、`0.1.0-rc.7` 和 `0.1.1-rc.2` 兼容/验证范围，后续客户端钩子变化仍需重新适配。
description.en: Hiyuki Frost Sakura gives DSH Web two local backgrounds and a frost-sakura glass treatment: the visible session enters Combat when its agent makes the first tool call, then returns to Calm after completion, stop, or failure; either form can also be locked manually. Settings cover visual intensity, composer opacity from 0–90%, and motion effects, with `prefers-reduced-motion` support. It does not proxy session operations or call session-management APIs. The pinned documentation lists DSH `0.1.0-rc.6`, `0.1.0-rc.7`, and `0.1.1-rc.2` in its compatibility/verification range; later client-hook changes may require adaptation.

description.zh: 六幕启动动画依次经过 DeepSeek 标识、过曝转场、暖白「技术档案」底板、交互式访问授权和故障揭幕；支持暖白/暗色主题、确认步骤与跳过。
description.en: A six-stage startup animation moves through the DeepSeek mark, an overexposure transition, a warm-white “technical file” panel, interactive access authorization and a glitch reveal, with light/dark themes, confirmations and skip controls.

description.zh: 推理一开始，就有球从屏幕边缘飞入并持续弹跳，思考结束后缩小消失；另有不受状态影响的常驻球，可拍走、拖拽扔出，重力、初速度、碰撞损耗和大小都能实时调。
description.en: A ball launches in from a random screen edge when a reasoning step starts and bounces until the step ends, while a constant ball keeps bouncing regardless of state; both can be poked or flung, with live gravity, launch speed, bounce loss and size settings.

description.zh: Gandalf 主题为 DSH Web 加入中土风视觉：甘道夫背景图、霞鹭文楷等宽字体、羊皮纸色调和定制控件；浅色使用半透明面板，深色保留 DSH 深色实色表面并透出背景，消息流和发送按钮也有专属样式。字体需要先在本机安装，未安装时回退系统字体；霞鹭文楷按 OFL 1.1 分发，插件主要覆盖视觉层，卸载可恢复默认外观。
description.en: Gandalf Theme brings a Middle-earth look to DSH Web with a Gandalf backdrop, Lxgw WenKai monospaced type, parchment tones, and customized controls. Light mode uses translucent panels; dark mode keeps solid DSH dark surfaces while letting the backdrop show through, with additional styling for the message stream and send button. The font must be installed locally and falls back to the system font otherwise; Lxgw WenKai is distributed under OFL 1.1, and the plugin restores the default appearance when removed.

description.zh: 完整且可逆的 DSH Web 樱花视觉系统，提供浅色“晴樱”和深色“夜樱”，跟随 Light / Dark / System 自动切换。它统一调整品牌、色彩、字体、图标、卡片和交互状态，内置霞鹜文楷屏幕阅读版 GB，并保留提交、导航和模型交互行为；目标兼容 DSH Web `0.1.1-rc.2` 系列，需 Node.js 20+。
description.en: A complete, reversible cherry-blossom visual system for DSH Web with airy Day Sakura and immersive Night Sakura themes that follow Light, Dark or System. It coordinates branding, colors, typography, icons, surfaces and interaction states, bundles LXGW WenKai GB Screen, and leaves submission, navigation and model behavior unchanged. It targets the DSH Web `0.1.1-rc.2` series and requires Node.js 20+.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 与 Web 的 Arcaea 视觉主题，提供浅色选曲场景、深色侧栏、斜切输入/新会话表面，以及随包提供的 Exo 可变字体和 Noto Sans CJK SC 字体。启用时固定使用 `arcaea-light` 配色，停用后恢复底层主题偏好；运行时资源内嵌，不发起网络请求，也不修改会话数据。当前实机验证为 Windows Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3，macOS/Linux 未实测。
description.en: An Arcaea visual theme for DeepSeek Harness Desktop and Web, with a light song-selection scene, dark sidebar, angular composer and new-session surfaces, and bundled Exo variable plus Noto Sans CJK SC fonts. It pins the `arcaea-light` palette while enabled and restores the underlying theme preference when disabled; runtime assets are embedded, with no network requests or session-data changes. Verified on Windows Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3; macOS/Linux were not device-tested.

description.zh: 《原神》梦见月瑞希同人展示层主题，提供「暖梦纸灯」亮态与「夜樱月见」暗态，包含主题背景图、樱花玻璃气泡、半透明滑杆、对话细节配色和落瓣氛围层。素材来自作者本地资源；作品为非商用同人创作，与 HoYoverse 无关联，且仅运行在展示层，不读取或修改会话与模型请求。
description.en: A fan-made display-layer skin themed after Yumemizuki Mizuki from Genshin Impact, with the light “Paper-Lamp Daydream” and dark “Night-Sakura Moon” states, themed backgrounds, sakura-glass bubbles, opacity controls, chat-detail styling, and falling-petal ambience. Assets come from the author's local material library; it is a non-commercial fan work unaffiliated with HoYoverse and stays presentation-only, without reading or modifying sessions or model requests.

description.zh: 把助手 Markdown 中符合规范的 `> [!NOTE]`、`TIP`、`IMPORTANT`、`WARNING` 和 `CAUTION` 引用块渲染为主题感知的提示卡片，不修改会话内容或 DSH 核心渲染器；格式错误或未知标记会保留为普通文本。
description.en: Turns qualifying assistant-Markdown blockquotes—`> [!NOTE]`, `TIP`, `IMPORTANT`, `WARNING`, and `CAUTION`—into theme-aware callout cards without changing stored session content or DSH's core renderer. Malformed or unknown markers remain ordinary text.

description.zh: 提供五套浅色与五套深色主题，按系统或时间表切换；可调强调色、背景、字体、字号、内容宽度和对比度，并重配语法高亮与 diff 色彩，支持纸张颗粒和 JSON 导入导出。
description.en: Provides five light and five dark themes with system or scheduled switching; adjusts accent/background colors, fonts, type sizes, content width and contrast, retunes syntax and diff colors, and supports paper grain plus JSON import/export.

name.zh: 面板底色控制 · Panel Tint

description.zh: 为侧边栏、正文框和输入框提供 0–100% 独立底色不透明度滑块，实时生效并持久化；会读取当前皮肤的真实颜色、渐变和面板格式，普通皮肤与 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸模式都能用，关闭后恢复原样。复杂的多层背景在正文框上可能退化为单层纯色缩放。
description.en: Adds independent 0–100% background-opacity sliders for the sidebar, message panels and composer, with live application and persistent settings. It reads the active skin’s colors, gradients and panel styling, and also works over Wallpaper Engine backgrounds; disabling it restores the original UI. Complex multi-layer backgrounds may be reduced to a single scaled-color layer in message panels.

description.zh: 把 Web 界面改成《绝区零》风格，并在背景叠加跟随鼠标、按下缩放的动态「空洞」光圈；设置里可切换印品鸿蒙体/思源黑体字体，并单独开关强制思源黑体。
description.en: A Zenless Zone Zero-style Web skin with a dynamic Hollow ring that follows the cursor and scales on press; the settings page switches between Inpin Hongmeng and Source Han Sans fonts, with a forced-fallback toggle.

description.zh: 透明玻璃皮肤以极光或自选图片为背景，在侧栏、弹层、输入框、消息气泡等控件上加入半透明磨砂片，同时保留清晰壁纸；支持整站浓度、左右侧栏强度、明暗主题和减少动效/减少透明度偏好。纯客户端、零依赖、无需构建，背景图与设置保存在浏览器本地，卸载可还原外观。目标 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2，MIT 许可。
description.en: Clear Glass Skin uses an aurora or chosen image as the canvas and adds translucent frosted panes to sidebars, overlays, the composer, message bubbles, and other controls while keeping the wallpaper clear. It provides whole-site opacity, separate sidebar strength, light/dark themes, and reduced-motion/reduced-transparency handling. It is client-only, dependency-free, and build-free; wallpaper and settings stay in browser storage, and unloading restores the appearance. It targets DSH 0.2.1-rc.2. MIT licensed.

description.zh: 蓝发鲸鱼女仆桌宠，支持待机、工作、完成、出错和撒娇等状态动画，以及戳一戳、摸头、静音、拖动和音量控制；Web/桌面形态可附带会话余额徽章。
description.en: A blue-haired whale-girl pet with idle, work, completion, error, and coquetry animations, plus poke, head-pat, mute, drag, and volume controls; the Web and desktop forms can also include a session balance badge.

description.zh: 互动深海鲸鱼女仆桌宠，按大模型调用切换 8 种心情动画，并用 30,000 Token 饱腹池、长驻气泡和任务手账组织陪伴；支持移动端储物橱柜、拖拽与休眠开关。
description.en: An interactive deep-sea whale-maid pet whose eight mood animations follow LLM calls, with a 30,000-token satiety pool, persistent speech bubbles and a task ledger; includes a mobile-responsive cupboard, dragging and a sleep toggle.

description.zh: 8-bit/CRT 像素皮肤，提供 retro、cyberpunk、sunset 和 mono 四套浅/深配色、Fusion Pixel 字体、像素化表格/代码/骨架屏、可调扫描线/暗角/像素光标与字体模式；设置持久化于 `localStorage`，尊重减少动态效果。构建必须针对相邻 `deepseek-harness` checkout 运行，更新 Harness 后需重建以适配 CSS Module 哈希。
description.en: An 8-bit/CRT pixel skin with retro, cyberpunk, sunset, and mono palettes for light and dark modes, Fusion Pixel fonts, pixel-styled tables/code/skeletons, adjustable scanlines, vignette, pixel cursor, and font modes. Settings persist in `localStorage`, and animations respect reduced-motion preferences. The build must target an adjacent `deepseek-harness` checkout and be rerun after Harness updates to refresh CSS-Module hashes.

description.zh: 落雪音乐（LX Music）内嵌歌词与播放控制插件：歌词显示在 DSH 右侧壁纸带，胶囊控件提供上一首、播放/暂停和下一首。播放器未启动时点击播放会自动在托盘启动，不弹出窗口；不接管播放。
description.en: A Luoxue Music (LX Music) lyrics and playback-control plugin. Lyrics appear in the DSH right-side wallpaper strip, while a capsule provides previous, play/pause, and next controls. If the player is not running, Play starts it from the tray without opening a window. It does not take over playback.

name.zh: Bliss Glass 怀旧玻璃主题

description.zh: Bliss Glass 将 Windows XP 时代的阳光风景壁纸与现代磨砂玻璃结合，覆盖聊天框、菜单、对话框、气泡和侧栏，并随宿主明暗主题切换。内置 4 张风景，也可从本地导入图片或选择纯玻璃模式；桌面与移动 Web 均支持，零依赖、无需构建、不修改宿主文件，图片在浏览器内处理且不离开本机。部分精细样式按 DSH 0.2.0-rc.x 的面板类名匹配，其他构建上壁纸和主题令牌仍可工作，但细节可能需要更新；MIT 许可。
description.en: Bliss Glass pairs sunny Windows XP-era scenery wallpapers with modern frosted glass across the composer, menus, dialogs, bubbles, and sidebars, following the host’s light/dark appearance. It includes four sceneries, accepts local image imports, and offers a glass-only mode; desktop and mobile Web are supported with no dependencies, no build step, and no host-file changes. Images are processed in the browser and stay on the machine. Fine-grained panel styling targets DSH 0.2.0-rc.x class names; the wallpaper and theme-token layer still work on other builds, but details may need selector updates. MIT licensed.

description.zh: 独立桌宠插件：宠爱页面分角色、桌宠配置、发现三栏，可同时显示多只宠物；每只都能开关、改名、调尺寸和角落位置。页面右下角有陪伴浮层，Windows 上还能开无边框透明桌面窗；透明 WebM 动作在发现页按需下载，数据写在 DSH_HOME/pamper。
description.en: An independent pet plugin whose Pamper page splits into characters, pet settings and discovery tabs. Show several pets at once, rename, resize and pin each one, use a corner overlay on any platform or a borderless transparent desktop window on Windows, and download WebM actions on demand.

description.zh: 《赛博朋克 2077》夜之城风格的深度定制主题：霓虹配色、CRT 氛围、流动彩带、故障闪烁、全局切角界面、输入框下方实时状态条，并提供独立设置页和主题总开关。
description.en: A deeply customized Cyberpunk 2077 / Night City theme with neon palettes, CRT atmosphere, flowing ribbons, glitch flashes, globally squared UI, a live status bar below the composer, and a dedicated settings page with a master toggle.

description.zh: 实时读取会话 reasoning 块中的 we / let's / let me 指纹，显示思考强度、三波段状态和心电图式曲线；可选在轨迹偏离时进行分级干预，其他模型建议保持只监控。
description.en: Reads the we / let's / let me fingerprints in session reasoning blocks and shows thinking intensity, three-band state, and an ECG-style curve. Optional tiered interventions can respond to trajectory drift; the README recommends monitor-only mode for other models.

description.zh: 仅在 DSH 新建会话页显示的字形背景：固定中文字形以雾状明暗流动，点击空白区域会荡开涟漪，并带稀疏蓝色字形点缀；进入已有会话或插件页后自动卸载。当前仅验证 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 的 Windows 桌面版，其他版本、平台、深色模式与 Web profile 未验证；README 预览 GIF 是两张截图轮播，不是连续录屏。
description.en: A glyph background that appears only on DSH's new-conversation screen: fixed Chinese glyphs flow in mist-like opacity, blank-area clicks create ripples, and sparse blue glyph clusters add accents. It unloads when you enter an existing conversation or the Plugins page. Only the DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 Windows desktop build is verified; other versions, platforms, dark mode, and the Web profile are unverified, and the README GIF is a two-screenshot slideshow rather than a continuous recording.

name.zh: AIR-pixel Liquid Glass 液态玻璃

description.zh: AIR-pixel Liquid Glass 提供可配置的半透明界面：磨砂表面、壁纸、强度/模糊/色调、Windows 桌面透明与窗口模糊、自定义光标、点击涟漪，以及人类消息和助手消息的独立对比度设置，并提供中英文设置界面。桌面透明和窗口模糊需要显式运行 `tools/asarpatch.py` 的 Host 端补丁；补丁会修改已安装客户端的 `lib/main.js`（封装在 `app.asar` 时也会修改其中文件），会保留备份且客户端更新后会丢失，需要重新应用。插件不发起外部网络请求。它刻意不声明 `engines.dsh` 或 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer，而用 `node tools/compat.mjs` 检查已安装核心、`settings.section`/`slots.register` 契约和补丁状态；`0.1.x` 核心不支持，应使用插件 `0.1.0`。MIT 许可。
description.en: AIR-pixel Liquid Glass provides configurable translucent surfaces, wallpaper, strength/blur/tint controls, Windows desktop transparency and window blur, custom cursors, click ripples, and separate contrast controls for human and assistant messages, with English and Chinese settings UI. Desktop transparency and window blur require the explicit host-side `tools/asarpatch.py` patch; it modifies the installed client’s `lib/main.js` (including inside `app.asar` when sealed), keeps a backup, and is lost after each client update. The plugin makes no external network requests. It deliberately declares no `engines.dsh` or `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer range; `node tools/compat.mjs` checks the installed core, the `settings.section`/`slots.register` contract, and patch status at runtime. `0.1.x` cores are unsupported; use plugin `0.1.0` there. MIT licensed.

description.zh: SIDOR 星野控制台皮肤，包含开屏粒子动画（含 1/50 红色太阳风暴彩蛋）、可跟随鼠标或固定方向的常驻星野、SIDOR 品牌徽记、侧栏余额徽章、设置页星光效果、低余额四重红色警告和输入框拉伸手柄。还向设置 → 插件列表加入关闭/启用/卸载与红色流光二次确认；输入框按钮区保持官方原版，仅保留拉伸手柄。
description.en: The SIDOR Starfield Console Skin adds an intro particle animation with a 1-in-50 red solar-storm easter egg, a persistent starfield that can follow the pointer or use a fixed direction, SIDOR branding, a sidebar balance badge, star effects and a dark base in Settings, four red low-balance warnings, and a composer resize handle. It also adds close/enable/uninstall actions with a red flowing-light confirmation to the Settings → Plugins list; the composer button area stays official, with only the resize handle added.

description.zh: 把侧栏的鲸鱼标记与字标换成 Claude 风格的放射星芒和文字字标，并改写浏览器标签标题、换成星芒标签页图标。侧栏底部弹层里可以就地改显示名字、副标题和头像，头像只保存在本机浏览器。
description.en: Replaces the sidebar whale mark and wordmark with a Claude-style starburst and text mark, and switches the browser tab title and favicon to match. Name, subtitle and avatar can be edited from a small bar in the sidebar footer, with the identity kept in this browser's local storage.

description.zh: Dock Media 音视频插件：音频和视频都支持一键全屏，并通过 HTTP Range 流式读取文件。
description.en: Dock Media plays audio and video, supports one-click fullscreen for both, and streams files through HTTP Range.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面添加动态粒子网络背景。
description.en: A dynamic particle-network background plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web interface.

description.zh: IKUN 应援主题，包含全屏壁纸轮播、基尼太美音乐盒，以及发送时自动播放“你干嘛~哎哟”。
description.en: An IKUN theme with a full-screen wallpaper carousel, the 基尼太美 music box, and automatic playback of “你干嘛~哎哟” when sending.

description.zh: 把 JPG/PNG 图片在页面内抠图，生成带白色贴纸描边、呼吸/摇摆待机动画的浮动桌宠；可调背景容差，复杂照片背景也可关闭去背而保留整图。桌宠上方可显示当前账户余额（未登录时给出提示），位置会随窗口尺寸保持；图片只在浏览器本地处理，处理后的图像才保存到本地 DSH 数据中。每个 profile 只支持一只桌宠；MIT 许可。
description.en: Turns a JPG or PNG into a floating pet by removing the background in the page, adding a white sticker outline, and giving it breathing and swaying idle motion. Background tolerance is adjustable, and background removal can be disabled for complex photos so the whole image is kept. A bubble can show the current account balance and explains when no account is signed in; the pet position follows window resizing. Images are processed in the browser and only the finished artwork is saved in local DSH data. One pet is supported per profile. MIT licensed.

description.zh: 以皇家马德里为主题的双模式皮肤：暗色采用深蓝与浅金的伯纳乌夜场，亮色采用暖白、金边与黑色条纹，并加入“1902”水印、队徽和字标。装饰位于内容后方，不遮挡输入框或文字；仅支持 DSH Web profile，属于非官方、个人非商业球迷作品。
description.en: A Real Madrid dual-mode skin: a navy-and-pale-gold Bernabéu night scene in dark mode, and warm white, gold trim, and black stripes in light mode, with “1902,” crest, and wordmark layers. Decorations stay behind content so inputs and text remain unobstructed. Web profile only; unofficial fan work for personal, non-commercial use.

description.zh: 一套 DSH Web 个性化与效率工具：提供背景、天气和玻璃效果、项目文件夹、提示词库、会话导出与搜索、Mermaid 渲染、引用回复、批量归档、Ctrl/Cmd+K 快捷面板，以及本地用量分析、预算和备份。
description.en: A DSH Web suite for personalization and productivity: backgrounds, weather and glass effects, project folders, a prompt library, conversation export/search, Mermaid rendering, quote reply, batch archiving, a Ctrl/Cmd+K command palette, plus local usage analytics, budgets, and backups.

description.zh: DSH UI Enhancer 组合桌面式工作区、壁纸、桌面宠物和文件引用：支持本地图片/URL 壁纸及模糊、遮罩、透明度调节，宠物可命名、拖动、缩放、隐藏并管理最多 12 个本地形象，输入 `@` 可插入工作区文件引用，右侧可预览 Markdown、代码/Diff、CSV、PDF、图片、HTML 和 URL。文件读取限制在 Harness 工作区并做 realpath 校验，宠物与素材留在浏览器本地。
description.en: DSH UI Enhancer combines a desktop-style workspace, wallpaper controls, a customizable desktop pet, and file references. It supports local or URL wallpapers with blur, mask, and opacity controls; named, draggable pets with up to 12 locally stored appearances; `@` file references; and right-pane previews for Markdown, code/Diff, CSV, PDF, images, HTML, and URLs. File access is restricted to Harness workspace roots with realpath checks, and pet assets stay in the browser.

name.zh: 灰姑娘女孩多角色主题

description.zh: 以《偶像大师 灰姑娘女孩》角色为核心的多角色主题与 Windows 桌宠，默认佐城雪美；可搜索并收藏角色，按角色印象色适配界面，并提供卡面/背景素材与沉浸阅读模式。
description.en: A multi-character THE IDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls theme and Windows companion, defaulting to Yukimi Sajo; search and favorite idols, adapt the UI to each idol’s image color, and use card/background assets with immersive reading.

description.zh: 侧栏短视频插件：提供原生播放器、系列导航、直链解析和精确回放历史记录。
description.en: A sidebar short-video plugin with a native player, series navigation, direct-link parsing, and precise playback-history replay.

description.zh: 把 DSH 高对比工程界面换成暖白纸面、燕麦暖灰侧栏、炭黑文字与陶土色焦点，配合中西文阅读字体栈和纯白输入卡片；只注入主题变量，不轮询后台或增加动效。
description.en: Replaces DSH’s high-contrast engineering UI with warm paper, oat-gray sidebars, charcoal text and terracotta accents, plus bilingual reading fonts and a white input card; it only injects theme tokens, with no background polling or added motion.

description.zh: 把 Live2D 鲸鱼娘挂在 DSH Web 界面角落，按 agent 的真实状态切换表情与动作：思考低头、工具调用换装、流式输出动嘴、报错变脸、完成时庆祝；支持 44 个表情、8 个动作。
description.en: A Live2D Whale Girl companion for the DSH Web UI reacts to the agent’s real state: head-down thinking, tool-specific actions, mouth movement during streaming, an error reaction and a celebration on completion, with 44 expressions and 8 motions.

description.zh: 受《碧蓝航线》金狮启发的非官方主题，把 Web 界面构成深墨绿月泉圣所：森林、月亮、遗迹与水面围合工作区，输入框呈月泉玻璃，清晰角色立绘作为独立图层显示。素材随插件内置，支持昼夜背景、响应式布局与减少动态效果；当前面向 HTTP `web` profile，已在 Host 0.1.0-rc.7 / Web UI 0.1.0-rc.8 验证。
description.en: An unofficial Azur Lane–inspired theme that turns the Web UI into a dark-emerald moonwell sanctuary: forest, moon, ruins, and water surround the workspace, the composer becomes moonwell glass, and clear character art remains a separate layer. Assets are bundled, with day/night backgrounds, responsive layout, and reduced-motion safeguards. It targets the HTTP `web` profile and was verified with Host 0.1.0-rc.7 and Web UI 0.1.0-rc.8.

description.zh: 提供暖色浅色、暖色暗色和跟随系统的护眼主题。
description.en: Warm light, warm dark, and system-aware eye-care themes.

description.zh: 在 Web GUI 侧栏以抖音式竖屏浏览视频，窗口随视频宽高比自适应，支持 Range 流式播放和 SMB NAS。
description.en: A Douyin-style vertical video player in the Web GUI sidebar, with aspect-ratio-based window sizing, Range streaming, and SMB NAS support.

description.zh: 置顶的 DSH 桌面宠物窗口，默认是鲸鱼，提供四套皮肤和四种静默状态；网页中只显示同步镜像，不是页面内挂件。使用系统 Python，无额外依赖。
description.en: An always-on-top DSH desk-pet window with a default whale, four skins, and four silent states; the Web UI shows a synchronized mirror rather than an in-page widget. Uses system Python with no extra dependencies.

description.zh: 把界面排成每天出的刊物：纸纹与光照做材质、发丝线与页码组织版面、宋体正文配 Georgia 数字，零圆角零阴影；含浅色纸与深色炭纸两套。
description.en: A print-style layout: paper grain and lighting as material, hairline rules and folio numbers, Song-style body text with Georgia numerals, no rounded corners or shadows; paper and charcoal-paper variants.

description.zh: 个人、非商业的非官方《明日方舟》P.R.T.S. 同人 UI 主题，将 DSH Web 的工作区、会话与对话组织成罗德岛设施终端；提供日夜模式、三套预设、四档材质、响应式与减少动效适配，且无运行时网络请求。
description.en: A personal, non-commercial, unofficial Arknights P.R.T.S. fan UI theme that presents DSH Web workspaces, sessions, and conversations as a Rhodes Island facility terminal. It includes day/night modes, three presets, four material levels, responsive and reduced-motion support, and no runtime network requests.

description.zh: 灯光剧场只改 DSH Web 的输入框：三层纯 CSS 动效让青/紫光束在内部扩散，青→蓝→紫的线段沿圆角边框巡游并呼吸；动画参数包括 24s 大周期、16s 绕行和 4s 变色循环。可在「设置 → 通用 → 输入框皮肤」开关，设置写入浏览器 `localStorage`；依赖支持 `@property` 的 Chromium（Chrome/Edge 105+），不影响 TUI 或其他前端。
description.en: Light Theater changes only the DSH Web composer. Three CSS-only layers spread cyan and purple beams inside the field while cyan-to-blue-to-purple segments travel and breathe around its rounded border; the documented timings include a 24s color cycle, a 16s lap, and a 4s segment-color loop. It can be toggled under Settings → General → Composer Skin and stores its settings in browser `localStorage`. It requires a Chromium engine with `@property` support, such as Chrome or Edge 105+, and does not affect TUI or other frontends.

description.zh: 将 DSH Web 对话输入栏的主发送按钮图标替换为鲸鱼图形，使用 CSS mask 并随按钮文字色适配亮暗主题。只改外观，不改变发送行为，也不会替换停止或队列按钮；零依赖。
description.en: Replaces the main send-button icon in the DSH Web composer with a whale graphic using a CSS mask that follows the button text color in light and dark themes. It changes appearance only, leaving send behavior, the stop button, and queue controls untouched; no dependencies.

description.zh: 把 DSH Web 界面换成《绝区零》Fairy 的 H.D.D 终端，包含带音效的开机动画、按时段问候、可拖动且随 agent 状态变化的眼徽、Fairy 模式预设，以及可选的本地 GPT-SoVITS 朗读。
description.en: A Zenless Zone Zero Fairy H.D.D skin for the DSH Web UI with a sound-enabled boot animation, time-of-day greeting, draggable status eye, Fairy mode preset and optional local GPT-SoVITS voice.

description.zh: 为 DSH 提供可分别配置的任务与 Artifact 卡片、输入栏和侧栏材质，另有全图/粒子背景、日夜主题、开屏与对话动效；支持导入导出本机配置与素材。
description.en: Adds separately configurable materials for task and Artifact cards, the composer and the sidebar, plus full-page/particle backgrounds, light/dark themes, intro and conversation motion; supports importing and exporting local settings and assets.

name.zh: 魔法使之夜视觉小说皮肤
name.en: Witch on the Holy Night Visual-Novel Skin

description.zh: 把 DSH Web 界面改造成《魔法使之夜》视觉小说式画面，提供昼夜场景、三名角色的立绘与表情、原作风格菜单、BGM、人格 skill 和固定 78% 上下文片尾彩蛋；支持角色切换与紧急关闭。非官方项目。
description.en: Transforms the DSH Web interface into a Witch on the Holy Night visual-novel scene with day/night backgrounds, three characters with portraits and expressions, an original-style menu, BGM, persona skills, and a fixed 78% context end-credit easter egg. Supports character switching and an emergency shutoff. Unofficial project.

description.zh: 在会话标签栏加入 GAL视窗，将会话区转换为 16:9 Galgame 舞台，提供占位立绘、大对话框、打字机台词、玩家输入和可视化编辑模式；场景编辑会实时同步到游戏模式。
description.en: Adds a GAL View tab to the session tabs and turns the conversation area into a 16:9 galgame stage with placeholder portraits, a large dialogue box, typewriter lines, player input, and a visual editor whose changes sync to game mode in real time.

name.zh: VS Code 滚动条与缩略图

description.zh: 将 DSH 会话区滚动条改为 14px 常显、扁平半透明的 VS Code 风格，并在右侧加入可拖动视口滑块的整段会话缩略图；菜单、代码块、侧栏和输入框滚动条保持原样。
description.en: Restyles the DSH conversation scrollbar as a 14px always-visible, flat translucent VS Code bar and adds a full-conversation minimap with a draggable viewport slider; menus, code blocks, sidebars and the composer keep their stock scrollbars.

description.zh: Leafy 在 DSH Web GUI 上叠加浅色翡翠绿与深色薄荷绿两套调色板，提供分层背景、深色侧栏、柔和圆角、绿色阴影、薄荷色选区、细滚动条和克制动效，并跟随亮色、暗色或系统外观切换。组件字号与布局保持宿主原样；Windows 上的半透明菜单是颜色分层，不是真正的透窗模糊。
description.en: Leafy overlays the DSH Web GUI with light emerald and dark mint palettes, layered surfaces, softer corners, green-tinted shadows, mint selection, slim scrollbars, and restrained motion. It follows light, dark, or system appearance. Component sizing and layout remain unchanged; on Windows, translucent menus are color layering rather than true see-through blur.

description.zh: 自定义壁纸引擎，为 DSH Web GUI 提供官方、深蓝渐变和浅蓝渐变预设，以及本地图片上传；客户端自动压缩 WebP/JPEG，支持 0–20px 背景模糊、30%–100% 面板不透明度、按壁纸亮度联动字体颜色和独立的浅/深主题配置。图片只在浏览器本地处理与保存；余额显示需手动开启。
description.en: A custom wallpaper engine for the DSH Web GUI with official, deep-blue gradient, and light-blue gradient presets plus local image upload. It compresses images client-side to WebP/JPEG, offers 0–20px blur, 30–100% pane opacity, wallpaper-brightness-linked font colors, and separate light/dark settings. Images stay local in the browser; balance display is opt-in.

description.zh: Doro 粉丝向展示皮肤：全屏背景、自动避让侧栏与聊天文字的左右下角立绘、粉橙主题色和自定义 favicon；Agent 回合完成时播放 Doro 提示音，也可换成本地 `chime.mp3`。插件不注册服务、不触达模型请求，支持热切换；仓库是个人/非商用作品，公开包的素材说明要求使用或替换自己的 Doro 美术资源。
description.en: A presentation-only Doro fan skin with a full-screen background, pink-and-orange accents, a custom favicon, and lower-corner character art that adapts around the sidebar and chat text. It plays a Doro completion chime after an agent turn and can use a local `chime.mp3`; it registers no service and does not touch model requests. The repository is a personal, non-commercial fan work, and its asset notes require using or replacing the Doro artwork yourself.

description.zh: 一只活泼好奇的女儿形象桌宠，停在 DSH Web UI 窗口底部，会走动、眨眼、被拖动和抛接，并对点击、指针和长时间忽略作出反应；支持中文语音、字幕、音效和背景音乐，均可独立开关。资源全部随包提供、无需联网；安装「梁子」后还可触发父女互动场景。
description.en: A cheerful, curious daughter character that lives at the bottom of the DSH Web UI. It walks, blinks, can be picked up and dropped, and reacts to clicks, the pointer, and being ignored; Chinese voice lines, subtitles, sound effects, and background music each have their own switch. All assets ship locally with the package, with no network required; installing Liangzi adds father-and-daughter scenes.

description.zh: 以 DeepSeek 创始人为原型的沉稳父亲形象桌宠，会走动、眨眼、拖动、睡眠，并对点击与指针作出反应；支持中文语音、字幕、音效和背景音乐，均可独立开关。资源全部随包提供、无需联网；与「大肥鱼」同时安装时可演出六段父女小剧场。
description.en: A calm father character based on DeepSeek's founder that walks, blinks, sleeps, can be dragged, and reacts to clicks and the pointer. Chinese voice lines, subtitles, sound effects, and background music each have their own switch. All assets ship locally with the package, with no network required; installing Dafeiyu enables six father-and-daughter playlets.

description.zh: 把随插件附带的奶蛙照片铺成整块界面背景，再在「奶蛙美化 Nai」设置页调整界面不透明度（25–100%）、壁纸模糊（0–24px）、遮罩（0–90%）和壁纸位置。侧栏与会话标题的品牌标识、浏览器标签页图标会同步换成同一张方形头像，保存后即时生效。
description.en: Wears the bundled Nai photo as a fixed full-window background, with live controls for surface opacity (25–100%), wallpaper blur (0–24 px), scrim (0–90%), and position. The same square avatar replaces the sidebar and conversation brand marks and the tab icon.

description.zh: 把唐三插画铺成聊天背景，界面表面色按不透明度淡出，背景才透出来；可调界面不透明度、背景模糊、暗色遮罩和壁纸位置。侧栏与会话标题的 logo、浏览器标签页图标也换成唐三头像，可在「设置 → 唐三美化」里关闭并恢复默认图标。
description.en: Wears a generated TangSan portrait as the chat background, with controls for surface opacity, wallpaper blur, a readability scrim and background position. The same avatar replaces the sidebar and conversation-hero logos plus the tab icon, all from a TangSan settings page.

description.zh: 以奥黛塔 / 至冬为主题的 DSH Web 深色皮肤，包含冬季背景、雪花/芭蕾舞鞋鼠标样式、Agent 思考时的奥黛塔 Q 版芭蕾舞者旋转动画、冰蓝配色与标签页图标。安装后自动启用 `odette` 深色主题，无需手动切换；需要重启 `dsh web` 才能加载。
description.en: An Odette/Snezhnaya dark skin for DSH Web with winter backgrounds, a snowflake-and-ballet-shoe cursor, an Odette chibi ballerina spinner while the agent is thinking, an ice-blue palette, and a custom tab icon. Installing it automatically enables the `odette` dark theme; no manual switch is needed, but `dsh web` must be restarted to load it.

description.zh: 主题工作室，提供 5 套预设、70+ 个派生令牌，并通过官方插件 API 即时应用。
description.en: A theme studio with 5 presets, 70+ derived tokens, and live application through the official plugin API.

name.zh: 昔涟 · 粉白毛玻璃主题

description.zh: 以《崩坏：星穹铁道》昔涟为主题的 DSH 粉白渐变毛玻璃皮肤，支持在侧栏编辑人格、管理表情包与长期记忆，并提供可上传、轮换且可绑定深色模式的整页背景。非官方同人项目。
description.en: An unofficial DSH frosted-glass skin themed around Cyrene from Honkai: Star Rail, with a pink-and-white gradient UI, sidebar persona editing, sticker and long-term-memory management, and full-page backgrounds that can be uploaded, rotated, and bound to dark mode.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供安洁莉娜亮色与暗色磨砂玻璃主题，并支持视差效果。
description.en: Angelina light and dark glass themes with parallax for DeepSeek Harness.

description.zh: 兼容 MusicFree 协议的音乐伴侣，提供侧栏音乐入口和搜索/播放能力，支持多个公开音乐与电台来源；生成的源插件需经过审核并显式安装。
description.en: A MusicFree-compatible music companion with a sidebar entry, search, and playback across multiple public music and radio sources. Generated source plugins require review and explicit installation.

description.zh: BestUI 是壁纸与外观工作室：上传图片或使用预设，按图像亮度生成浅/深配色，分别调节表面透明度、元素颜色、字体、圆角、模糊和界面缩放，并可导入/导出完整 JSON 方案。设置保存在 localStorage；超限图片会自动压缩，停用时移除覆盖层。
description.en: BestUI is a wallpaper and appearance studio: upload an image or use a preset, derive light/dark palettes from the image, tune surface opacity, element colors, fonts, radius, blur, and UI scale, and import/export a complete JSON scheme. Settings live in localStorage; oversized images are compressed automatically, and disabling the plugin removes its overrides.

description.zh: Aurora Skins 提供三套手工调校配色：Aurora（深夜蓝、电光青、暖珊瑚）、Paper（冷白纸面、深青）和 Hologram（近黑、青柠青）。它只覆盖 `--dsw-alias-*` token，不修改 DSH 核心；选择保存在 localStorage，可用“Follow system”恢复内置外观。
description.en: Aurora Skins provides three hand-tuned palettes: Aurora (midnight navy, electric cyan, warm coral), Paper (cool paper white, deep teal), and Hologram (near-black, lime-cyan). It uses only `--dsw-alias-*` tokens, persists the selection in localStorage, and offers “Follow system” to restore the built-in appearance.

description.zh: 独立于宿主源码的 DSH 皮肤中心，提供 35 套内置皮肤（21 套 ACG/角色主题与 14 套开发者经典配色）、一张图自动取色的自定义皮肤，以及 JSON 皮肤包导入/导出。选择持久化在 `~/.dsh/skins/selection.json`，支持多标签实时同步、首屏无闪屏和保留 DSH 原生浅色/深色/跟随系统外观；项目是社区插件，并非 DeepSeek 官方插件。
description.en: An out-of-tree DSH skin center with 35 built-in skins—21 ACG/character themes plus 14 developer classics—alongside one-image auto-colored custom skins and JSON skin-package import/export. Selection persists in `~/.dsh/skins/selection.json`, with cross-tab synchronization, no first-paint flash, and the native DSH Light/Dark/Follow System appearance left intact. It is a community plugin, not an official DeepSeek plugin.

description.zh: 由实时会话状态驱动的浮层桌宠，提供 14 个内置形象、自定义图片和 Codex/通用精灵图导入；可在独立宠物页面管理外观与成长，并记录亲密度、等级、经验、成就和任务统计。
description.en: A session-driven floating pet with 14 built-in looks, custom images, and Codex or generic spritesheet imports. Manage appearance and growth in a standalone Pet page, with intimacy, levels, EXP, achievements and task statistics.

name.zh: 网易云音乐 · 右侧栏

description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧边栏使用网易云音乐。
description.en: Use NetEase Cloud Music from the DSH right sidebar.

description.zh: 全页面网易云音乐播放器插件，为 DSH 提供以音乐为中心的播放界面。
description.en: A full-page NetEase Cloud Music player plugin with a music-focused interface for DSH.

description.zh: 道奇 17 主题以道奇蓝 `#005A9C` 和棒球缝线红打造“白昼场”与“夜场”两套配色，在设置中一键切换并跨启动记忆选择；可随时恢复系统默认，不含队标或球员肖像。
description.en: Dodger 17 offers Day Game and Night Game palettes built around Dodger blue (`#005A9C`) with baseball-stitch red accents. Switch them from Settings, keep the choice across launches, or return to the system default; the fan design uses no team logos or player imagery.

name.zh: 内置皮肤与自定义背景

description.zh: 换肤插件，提供 4 套内置皮肤，以及可自定义的图片和视频皮肤。
description.en: A skin plugin with four built-in skins plus customizable image and video skins.

description.zh: 四档“图片 + 配色 + 人设”一体化推理滑块皮肤：off 为灰色，low 为蓝色（原版观感），high 为亮青色，max 为粉色。
description.en: A four-level reasoning-slider skin combining image, color scheme, and persona: gray for off, blue for low (original-style appearance), bright cyan for high, and pink for max.

description.zh: 受 Warp 启发的图片转主题插件：上传背景、提取配色并应用磨砂玻璃界面。
description.en: Warp-inspired image-to-theme plugin: upload a background, extract a palette, and apply a glass UI.

description.zh: 让每次短按在星光涟漪、蕾丝花绽、流星轻雨、星环回旋和星蝶轻舞五种 Canvas 动效间轮换；五次有效点击会完整走完一轮且相邻轮次不连播同一种。效果每次读取当前皮肤的配色，约 0.72–0.9 秒消散，支持 Reduce Motion；不联网、不采集遥测，也不拦截输入。
description.en: Cycles short clicks through five Canvas effects—star ripples, lace blossoms, comet showers, star orbits, and butterfly flutter. Each set of five accepted clicks uses every effect once without repeating across the boundary; colors are sampled from the active skin, effects last about 0.72–0.9 s, respect Reduce Motion, and make no network calls, collect telemetry, or intercept input.

description.zh: 维什戴尔风格的爆破终端主题，采用黑灰信息层、细线框、编号、警示切角与红色状态轨；在此基础上提供任务看板、工作区目录选择、Git 图谱、可选右侧工作台和设置中心。任务看板支持真实 DSH Agent 执行、失败重跑与 cron；右侧工作台默认关闭，且新版本 DSH 的原生文件/终端/工作台会优先承接相应功能。已针对 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 验证并兼容列出的旧版，所有素材内嵌、不访问远程资源。
description.en: A Wishadel demolition-terminal theme with black-gray information layers, fine rules, numbered elements, warning cut corners, and red status tracks. It also provides a task board, workspace directory picker, Git graph, optional right-side workbench, and settings center. The task board runs real DSH Agent sessions with retries and cron scheduling; the workbench is off by default, and newer DSH builds take over the native file, terminal, and workbench functions. Verified on DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 with the listed older versions; all assets are embedded and no remote resources are accessed.

description.zh: Cerrda 暗色主题采用 rose/purple OKLCH 配色与 Sora、Fraunces、JetBrains Mono 字体，加入 Liquid Glass 输入栏/主视觉面板/回到底部按钮、Silk WebGL2 动态背景，以及 CardSpotlight、Ripple、ShimmerBorder 等效果。它是静态 Web bundle，安装后需重启 DSH；卸载后恢复默认外观。
description.en: Cerrda is a dark re-theme with rose/purple OKLCH colors and Sora, Fraunces, and JetBrains Mono fonts. It adds Liquid Glass composer, hero panel, and back-to-bottom controls, a Silk WebGL2 animated background, and CardSpotlight, Ripple, and ShimmerBorder effects. It ships as a static web bundle, so activation requires a DSH restart; uninstall restores the default appearance.

description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 插件的浏览器端 `codeRenderer` 服务：将 `ctx.syntaxHighlighter` 的结构化 token 转为经过转义、响应主题的 HTML 代码块，颜色跟随 DSH 的 `--shiki-*` CSS 变量，并保留 LF、CRLF 和 CR 换行。源码文本与 HTML 属性都会转义；它提供可复用服务，不自带页面、面板或 ChatView 前端。
description.en: A browser-side `codeRenderer` service for DSH Web plugins. It converts `ctx.syntaxHighlighter` tokens into escaped, theme-aware HTML code blocks, follows DSH `--shiki-*` CSS variables for color, and preserves LF, CRLF, and CR line endings. Source text and HTML attributes are escaped; the package provides a reusable service rather than a page, panel, or ChatView frontend.

description.zh: 在空白对话区展示可调的 ASCII、汉字和 Kanji 鲸鱼、鱼群与尾迹，配套中性磨砂玻璃输入框；支持座头鲸/虎鲸切换、明暗主题、颜色、字体、数量和速度等设置，已有对话后装饰自动退场。
description.en: An adjustable ASCII, Hanzi and Kanji whale scene with schools of fish and wakes in empty chats, paired with a neutral frosted-glass composer. Switch humpback or orca and tune themes, colors, fonts, count and speed; the scene leaves once a conversation exists.

description.zh: Claude 风格界面主题，提供象牙白背景、赤陶色主色和暖灰文字的浅暗配色，并可选、可逆地将 DeepSeek 的 logo、词标、标题、favicon 和品牌文本替换为 Claude。
description.en: A Claude-style interface theme with ivory surfaces, terracotta accents, and warm-gray text in light and dark palettes. An optional reversible disguise replaces DeepSeek branding—logo, wordmark, title, favicon, and brand text—with Claude.

description.zh: FGO 迦勒底风格的五套主题包：迦勒底·夜、迦勒底·晨、阿尔托莉雅·蓝金、摩根·黑紫和玛修·白紫；使用程序生成的原创星图/魔术回路 SVG、金色刻线与随主题变化的边框装饰。皮肤选择在设置中持久化于 `localStorage`，仅修改展示层；不包含 FGO 官方美术素材，且为非官方粉丝项目。
description.en: A five-theme FGO Chaldea-inspired pack: Chaldea Night, Chaldea Dawn, Artoria Blue/Gold, Morgan Black/Purple, and Mash White/Purple. It uses procedurally generated star-chart/magic-circuit SVG backdrops, gold trim, and theme-specific border decorations. Skin selection persists in `localStorage`, the plugin changes only presentation, and it contains no official FGO artwork; this is an unofficial fan project.

description.zh: DeepSeek 便签提供可拖动的文字待办和图片便签，支持勾选、双击编辑、隐藏/展开、自定义标题和每张便签独立的 9 套皮肤。它在 Host 的 `~/.dsh/sticky-notes.json` 持久化；模型工具 `sticky_notes_read` 可读取便签，`sticky_notes_add` 只能新建或追加，不能修改或删除已有内容，图片便签只暴露元数据。
description.en: Sticky Notes for DSH provides draggable text to-dos and image notes with check-off, double-click editing, hide/show, custom titles, and nine per-note skins. Data persists on the Host at `~/.dsh/sticky-notes.json`. The `sticky_notes_read` model tool can read notes, while `sticky_notes_add` can only create or append and cannot modify or delete existing content; image notes expose metadata only.

description.zh: 绿色黑底的 DSH 黑客终端外观，包含仅由 `A-Z`、`0-9` 和终端符号组成的字符雨、玻璃输入框、HUD 状态栏、扫描效果，以及 Share Tech Mono / JetBrains Mono 字体（中文回退苹方）。支持系统减少动态效果；不发送统计或网络请求，卸载会清理样式、DOM、监听器、观察器和定时器。面向当前 DSH Web UI 布局，开发者预览版升级后可能需要适配。
description.en: A green-on-black hacker-terminal treatment for DSH with matrix rain made only from `A-Z`, `0-9`, and terminal symbols, plus a glass composer, HUD bars, scan effects, and Share Tech Mono/JetBrains Mono fonts with PingFang SC fallback for Chinese. It supports system reduced-motion preferences, sends no analytics or network requests, and removes its styles, DOM, listeners, observers, and timers on unload. It targets the current DSH Web UI layout, so developer-preview upgrades may require compatibility updates.

description.zh: 宝蓝色像素鲸停在输入框上沿，跟随会话的思考、输出、审批、完成和错误状态变换表情；输入草稿非空时会停止巡游并注视你。空闲时每 30 秒进行一次去程与返程各 6 秒的下潜巡游，可改名字、大小和位置；纯 Canvas，无网络请求或宿主服务，要求 DSH `>= 0.2.0 < 0.3.0`。
description.en: A royal-blue pixel whale perches above the composer and changes expression with thinking, streaming, approvals, completed turns, and errors; a non-empty draft cancels its cruise and switches to an expectant pose. When idle, it makes a 30-second cruise with a 6-second outbound leg and a 6-second return, and its name, size, and position are configurable. It uses Canvas only, makes no network requests or host-side service calls, and requires DSH `>= 0.2.0 < 0.3.0`.

description.zh: 一只悬浮在 Web 界面上的 Q 版宠物，只认一个会话：它在思考、调用工具、等待授权、完成、出错和打瞌睡时换姿势。可以拖动、点一下摸头、右键送回角落；在气泡里输入请求会排队送进它绑定的会话。
description.en: A chibi pet that floats over the Web UI and follows a single session, changing pose as that session thinks, calls tools, waits for approval, finishes, fails or dozes off. Drag it, pat its head, send it back to its corner, or type a request into its bubble to queue it into the bound session.

description.zh: 海洋幻想蓝玻璃主题包，提供海洋背景、玻璃气泡、海洋侧栏、鲸鱼设置按钮、渐变模型文字和会话页明/暗主题切换；作为 profile bundle 自动加载并在重启后保留。
description.en: An ocean-fantasy blue-glass theme package with an ocean background, glass bubbles, an ocean-styled sidebar, a whale settings button, gradient model text, and a light/dark conversation toggle; it loads as a profile bundle and persists across restarts.

description.zh: Tidy Chat 将正常完成回合的中间工作折叠到可展开的回合标题中，同时保留最终答案、实时回合计时、紧凑排版和 Markdown 表格样式；表格支持圆角框、主题表头、行列分隔线，以及在 748px 阅读栏内横向滚动。插件通过 `Session.chat` 和原生语义锚点添加展示控件，不替换、移动或复制 React 节点，不改写模型输出或会话日志；它不发网络请求、不写浏览器存储，展开选择只保存在内存中，刷新即重置。当前活动分组支持 `bash`、`pwsh`、`read`、`write`、`edit`、`glob`、`grep`、`web_search`、`web_fetch` 等工具，其他工具保持原生展示；独立 Chat store 的宿主由 Harness 自己负责工作过程显示。目标版本为 DSH `>=0.1.0-rc.6`，已在 `0.2.1-rc.2` 验证；与其他排版插件的样式可能冲突。MIT 许可。
description.en: Tidy Chat folds the intermediate work of normally completed turns into an expandable header while keeping the final answer visible, and adds live turn timing, compact typography, and styled Markdown tables. Tables get rounded frames, themed headers, row and column rules, and horizontal scrolling inside DSH’s existing 748px reading column. It attaches presentation controls through `Session.chat` and native semantic anchors; it does not replace, move, or clone React nodes, rewrite model output, or modify session logs. It makes no network requests and writes no browser storage; expansion choices live in memory and reset on reload. Grouping currently covers `bash`, `pwsh`, `read`, `write`, `edit`, `glob`, `grep`, `web_search`, and `web_fetch`; other tools keep their native presentation. Hosts with a separate Chat store keep Harness’s own work disclosure. Targets DSH `>=0.1.0-rc.6` and is verified with `0.2.1-rc.2`; other layout plugins may compete for the same styles. MIT licensed.

description.zh: 以鲸鱼娘为核心的全界面皮肤包，内置女仆工坊、夜庭银饰、深海、雪夜庭和桂月夜庭五套场景；每套包含壁纸、金银描边、蕾丝蝴蝶结、角落立绘和环境粒子，可选择覆盖全界面或仅工作区。它支持跟随主题或按时段切换明暗、遮罩/暗角/景深控制、`prefers-reduced-motion` 粒子，以及随审批等待、生成中、出错和完成状态变化的角落立绘；也支持用目录加 `skin.json` 安装第三方皮肤包和导入/导出自包含 JSON 设置。资源由插件自己的只读路由提供，不发外部请求、不做遥测。目标运行时为 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`；皮肤依赖 CSS-module 类名后缀和 `--dsw-*` 令牌，宿主改名后效果可能静默失效并回到出厂外观。代码 MIT；壁纸与立绘衍生自 `dsh-whale-musume`，README 要求按其许可仅作本地使用并查看第三方声明。
description.en: A full-interface whale skin pack with five built-in scenes—Maid Atelier, Silver Night Garden, Abyss, Snow Night Garden, and Moonlit Osmanthus Night Garden. Each combines wallpaper, metallic trim, lace and bows, a corner illustration, and ambient particles; the pack can cover the whole interface or only the workspace. It supports theme-following or time-based light/dark selection, occlusion/vignette/depth-of-field controls, `prefers-reduced-motion` particles, and a corner illustration that changes for approval waiting, generation, errors, and completion. Third-party packs use a directory plus `skin.json`, and settings can be exported or imported as self-contained JSON. Assets are served by the plugin’s read-only routes with no external requests or telemetry. The target runtime is DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`; it depends on CSS-module class-name suffixes and `--dsw-*` tokens, so host renames can silently disable the effects and restore the stock appearance. The code is MIT-licensed, while wallpaper and illustrations are derived from `dsh-whale-musume` and must follow its local-use terms and the repository’s third-party notices.

description.zh: 以 Nothing Phone 设计语言重做 DSH Web：16px 点阵背景、Space Grotesk/Space Mono 字体、黑白层级、零圆角/无阴影和 `#D71921` 信号红；同时提供 OLED 黑与米白纸面两套外观。可在 Settings → Nothing Skin 中逐项开关点阵、字体、壁纸、透明度、模糊和状态时钟等功能，配置保存在 `localStorage` 与 `$DSH_HOME/nothing-skin.json`。
description.en: Recasts the DSH Web UI in the Nothing Phone design language with a 16px dot-matrix background, Space Grotesk/Space Mono typography, monochrome hierarchy, zero-radius flat surfaces, and `#D71921` signal red, with OLED-black and off-white paper modes. Settings → Nothing Skin provides individual toggles for the grid, fonts, wallpaper, translucency, blur, status clock, and other features; configuration is saved in `localStorage` and `$DSH_HOME/nothing-skin.json`.

name.zh: 初音未来 · 玫瑰女王

description.zh: 一个安装包装两款主题：初音未来星光舞台与原创玫瑰女王花房，在「设置 → Ekko 皮肤」里切换，各自记住外观与视频设置，支持浅色、深色和两种手机导航。可分别上传电脑端与手机端启动视频（MP4/WebM，单个不超过 96 MiB），调节声音与最长播放时间，随时跳过。
description.en: Two themes in one package — Miku Starlight Studio and the original Rose Queen — switched from Settings → Ekko Skin, each remembering its own appearance and video settings across light, dark, and two mobile layouts. Desktop and phone startup videos (MP4/WebM up to 96 MiB each) can be uploaded separately with sound, volume, duration, and skip controls.

description.zh: 简洁的 DSH 背景插件，支持在设置中选择本地或网络图片/视频并调节透明度。它以独立 bundle 提供背景设置行，安装后在下一次进程启动时生效；与已包含 `ui-background` 行的宿主构建同时安装会因重复 loader id 冲突。
description.en: A focused DSH background plugin for choosing a local or online image/video and adjusting its opacity from settings. It installs as a standalone bundle with a background settings row and takes effect on the next process boot; installing it on a host build that already contains a `ui-background` row causes a duplicate-loader-id conflict.

description.zh: 一只住在 DeepSeek Harness 或独立桌面中的养成小猪，会成长、上学、打工、旅行，也会生病并需要照料；支持鼠标完成玩法，忙碌时可用背包物品自理，且不注册模型工具或向对话注入宠物状态。
description.en: A raising-style pig that lives in DeepSeek Harness or on the standalone desktop: it grows, studies, works, travels, gets sick, and needs care. It is mouse-driven, can care for itself with backpack items while you are busy, and does not register model tools or inject pet state into chats.

description.zh: 把 DSH Web UI 换成保护伞公司风格：暗色为黑红页面配终端绿正文，浅色为灰白页面；完整覆盖 113 个 `--dsw-*` 别名 token 与 9 个 `--shiki-token-*`，并把白红伞标记放入侧栏、会话页、账号行和 HUD。720px 水印绕自身竖直中线自转，`prefers-reduced-motion` 下停止；标志由几何图形绘制，不含 Capcom 素材，是非官方粉丝作品。
description.en: Gives the DSH Web UI an Umbrella Corporation treatment: a black-and-red dark scheme with terminal-green prose, a grey-and-white light scheme, 113 `--dsw-*` alias tokens, and 9 `--shiki-token-*` syntax tokens. A white-and-red umbrella mark appears in the sidebar, conversation page, account row, and HUD; its 720 px watermark spins around its own vertical axis and stops under `prefers-reduced-motion`. The mark is geometry-drawn with no Capcom assets; this is unofficial fan work.

description.zh: 像素风 INFJ Sage 桌宠会根据 DSH 会话状态切换静观、阅读、共情、充电和受挫等姿态；可点击对话、拖拽并记住位置，右键打开设置。支持会话范围、尺寸、休息延迟、配色和动效选项，跟随 DSH 语言与明暗主题；只读取会话身份和状态，不调用模型、不联网或上传遥测。
description.en: INFJ Sage is a pixel-art companion that changes between observing, reading, empathy, recharging, and setback poses as DSH sessions change. Click for characterful lines, drag it to a remembered position, and right-click for settings such as session scope, size, nap delay, palette, and motion. It follows DSH language and appearance, reads session identity and status only, and makes no model calls, network requests, or telemetry.

description.zh: 将 Web 界面变成暖米色宣纸水墨画：右上竹枝、左下远山、右下老梅与朱砂“墨”印，配合覆盖浅/深模式的米白/墨色/朱红色板和全屏飘落竹叶动画。使用内联 SVG 与 Web Animations API，卸载后可完整恢复默认外观；需要 Chromium 浏览器（含 Electron）。
description.en: A warm rice-paper ink-wash skin with a bamboo branch in the upper right, distant mountains in the lower left, an old plum twig and vermilion “墨” seal in the lower right, plus falling bamboo leaves across the screen. It uses inline SVG and the Web Animations API, restores the default appearance on unload, and requires a Chromium-based browser, including Electron.

description.zh: 使用 Anime2.5DRig 将一张干净背景的角色图或 PSD 自动装配为 WebGL 2.5D 桌宠，提供发丝物理、眨眼与表情动画，并映射思考、空闲、出错、完成和等待审批等 DSH 状态。支持自定义 PSD、人设、34 个参数、帧率、透明度、拖拽和左右翻转；需要支持 WebGL 的浏览器，当前版本面向 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2。
description.en: Turns a clean-background character image or PSD into a WebGL 2.5D pet with Anime2.5DRig auto-rigging, hair physics, blinking, expressions, and DSH state mirroring for thinking, idle, errors, completion, and approval waits. Supports custom PSDs, personas, 34 live parameters, FPS and opacity controls, dragging, and horizontal flipping. Requires a WebGL-capable browser and targets DSH 0.2.0-rc.2.

name.zh: 哥伦比娅 · 月隐银蓝

description.zh: 将 DSH Web GUI 换成哥伦比娅的月隐银蓝渐变毛玻璃主题，附可编辑人格、12 张高清表情包和星眸欢迎页；背景可从用户自备图片中选择、轮换和调淡，不改 DSH 本体。
description.en: A Columbina moonlit silver-blue glassmorphism theme for the DSH Web GUI with editable persona settings, 12 high-resolution stickers and a starry-eye welcome page; it can select, rotate and fade user-supplied backgrounds without modifying DSH.

description.zh: 基于 dsh-music-player 的修改版：移除 QQ、酷狗、讲书和歌词功能，加入播客与网络电台，支持 CC0 电台库、分类浏览和自定义电台源。
description.en: A dsh-music-player fork that removes QQ Music, Kugou, audiobook, and lyrics features and adds podcasts plus internet radio, with a CC0 station library, genre browsing, and custom station sources.

description.zh: 像素鲸鱼桌宠：agent 干活时游泳、调工具时吐泡泡、等待批准时贴屏敲玻璃并闪烁标签页标题，任务结束用真实数字汇报；含成长系统、可自制状态精灵与可选 Agent 语音。
description.en: A pixel-art whale companion that swims while agents work, blows bubbles on tool calls, taps the glass and flashes the tab title when an approval waits, and reports finished turns with real numbers; it adds a growth system, make-your-own state sprites and optional agent voice.

description.zh: 提供 34 款同时适配浅色与深色外观的预设主题，支持跟随系统；可调 macOS 侧边栏透明度，并能创建、导入和分享带背景图片或视频的自定义主题。
description.en: Provides 34 preset themes adapted to both light and dark appearance, with a system-following option. It also controls macOS sidebar transparency and lets users create, import, and share custom themes with image or video backgrounds.

description.zh: 提供只影响用户消息气泡的可切换皮肤库：内置「幸运草坡」「锦鲤跃潮」「DS鲸鱼娘·白瓷蓝」、QQ 蓝、装饰、毛玻璃、像素和极简等样式，亮/暗变体可热切换并自动保存。默认仍是 DSH 气泡；当前版本隐藏尾巴、背景和装饰设置，也不开放用户上传，只命中用户消息、pending steering 与 submission echo，不改助手、目标或问答气泡。
description.en: A switchable skin library for user-message bubbles, including Clover Meadow, Koi Rising, DS Whale Girl in Porcelain Blue, QQ Blue, QQ Deco, Glass, Pixel, and Minimal. Light and dark variants switch instantly and the stock DSH bubble remains available as the default. The current release hides tail, background, and decoration controls, does not accept user uploads, and targets user rows, pending steering, and submission echoes—not assistant, goal, or question bubbles.

name.zh: Bloom Glass 国色玻璃主题

description.zh: 提供十套中国传统色配色，每套含明暗两态；可叠加本地图片或动图壁纸与磨砂玻璃，并覆盖侧栏、会话区、设置弹窗及 DS Bot 面板，支持调节玻璃浓度、模糊、饱和度和压暗。
description.en: Ten Chinese traditional-color palettes, each with light and dark variants, can be combined with local image/GIF wallpapers under frosted glass. The effect covers the sidebar, conversations, settings dialogs, and DS Bot panels, with glass strength, blur, saturation, and dimming controls.

description.zh: 陪伴 DSH Web 会话的动态宠物，按接收、思考、检索、编码、回复、审批和错误等状态切换 Emotion Ball 的 32 种表情；支持拖动、点击、投喂、玩耍，并可缩小到会话状态行旁。
description.en: A dynamic companion for DSH Web sessions that switches among 32 Emotion Ball expressions for receiving, thinking, retrieval, coding, replies, approvals, and errors. Drag, pet, feed, or play with it, or shrink it beside the conversation status row.

description.zh: 《鸣潮》爱弥斯非官方同人像素桌宠，随 Agent 空闲、运行、等待输入、出错和任务完成切换动作；支持随机表演、点击回应、拖拽、停靠或自由摆放，并持久化位置。
description.en: An unofficial Wuthering Waves Aemeath fan pet that changes actions for idle, running, input waits, errors and task completion; supports random performances, click reactions, dragging, docked or free placement, and saved positioning.

description.zh: Live2D 看板娘悬浮在界面一角，实时镜像 agent 的思考、空闲、出错、完成、交付与待审批状态；内置 5 条模型和 6 种人设，支持分部位触摸、拖动停靠、换模型与人设热切换。
description.en: A Live2D mascot in the corner mirrors agent states (thinking, idle, error, done, delivered, awaiting approval) with 5 bundled models and 6 personas, per-part touch reactions, drag-to-dock and hot-swappable models and personas.

description.zh: 落雪音乐增强控制插件，提供侧边栏播放卡片、播放与音源管理界面，以及 LLM 点歌能力。不需要外部服务。
description.en: Enhanced control for Luoxue Music, with a sidebar playback card, playback and audio-source management, and LLM song requests. No external service is required.

description.zh: 为 macOS 与 Windows 11 x64 提供对应系统风格的 DSH 设置界面、主题配色、壁纸和字体配置，含 27 个浅深色主题、从壁纸生成配色和可选蓝鲸桌宠；外观与桌宠可分别开关。
description.en: A DSH customization suite for macOS and Windows 11 x64 with platform-styled settings, themes, wallpapers, and fonts, including 27 light/dark themes, wallpaper-based palette generation, and an optional blue-whale pet. Appearance and pet features can be toggled separately.

description.zh: 实时 WebGPU 海洋背景，支持在左下角调节波浪、日光和玻璃不透明度，并启用自动昼夜循环。
description.en: A real-time WebGPU ocean background with controls for waves, sunlight, and glass opacity in the lower-left corner, plus an automatic day-night cycle.

name.zh: 渡劫飞升 · 王林修炼伙伴

description.zh: 把《仙逆》王林做成悬浮修炼伙伴，读取 `ctx.on('session/event')` 把等待、思考、工具调用、流式回复、完成和失败映射为动作，并随完成回合积累修为，在凝气至问鼎七重境界间升境换皮肤。点击可论道、喂丹药或拖动，隐藏时缩入天逆珠；`ascension_status` 可返回境界、修为与当前动画。
description.en: Turns Wang Lin from *Renegade Immortal* into a floating cultivation companion. It reads `ctx.on('session/event')` and maps waiting, thinking, tool calls, streaming replies, completion, and failure to animations; completed turns, pet clicks, and pill feeding build cultivation across seven realms from Qi Refining to Ascension, with a new skin at each breakthrough. Click, feed, or drag the pet, hide it inside the Tianni Pearl, or query `ascension_status` for the realm, cultivation, and current animation.

description.zh: 把 CSDN 博文排版带进 DSH：品牌色 `#fc5531`、16/24 正文、标题层级、引用块、实线网格表格、粉底红字行内代码，以及 Atom One Light/Dark 代码高亮；浅色/深色值各一套。它只注入 token 覆盖与一层可撤销 `<style>`，不改 DOM、不联网、不读写文件；`compact` 小字号区域不覆盖，深色方案则是按语义调出的非官方 CSDN 深色值。
description.en: Brings CSDN article typography to DSH with the `#fc5531` brand color, 16/24 body text, heading hierarchy, quote blocks, solid-grid tables, pink-backed red inline code, and Atom One Light/Dark code highlighting in paired light and dark values. It only adds a token override and a disposable `<style>` layer—no DOM changes, network calls, or file access—and leaves `compact` small-text regions untouched. The dark palette is an original semantic interpretation, not an official CSDN dark theme.

description.zh: 主题中心提供按浅色/深色分组的 11 款内置主题和一键切换，支持自定义图片壁纸的裁剪、平移、缩放、遮罩与表面透明度调节，以及 `dsh-theme` 文件导入导出；选择和壁纸参数会持久化。未列入内置目录的 14 款主题以可恢复的归档 `dsh-theme` 文件保留。
description.en: A theme center with 11 built-in themes grouped by light and dark appearance, one-click switching, custom-image wallpaper cropping/panning/zooming, overlay and surface-translucency controls, and `dsh-theme` import/export. Theme choices and wallpaper parameters persist, while 14 themes outside the built-in catalog remain available as restorable archived `dsh-theme` files.

description.zh: Q 版芙莉莲桌宠会跟随 Agent 的空闲、思考、工具调用、流式输出、等待审批、计划评审和报错状态切换动画与气泡。支持单击挥手、双击跳跃、拖拽定位、隐藏/恢复，并记住位置；开启减少动态效果时显示静态状态帧。素材为个人非商业同人作品。
description.en: A chibi Frieren pet follows Agent idle, thinking, tool-call, streaming, approval, plan-review, and error states with matching animations and speech bubbles. Click to wave, double-click to jump, drag to reposition, or hide and restore it; the position is remembered, and reduced-motion mode uses static state frames. The artwork is personal, non-commercial fan art.

description.zh: 卡通像素皮肤插件，保持原始界面不变，并加入会散步、眨眼和跳跃的像素宠物。
description.en: Cartoon pixel skin plugin that leaves the original interface unchanged and adds pixel pets that stroll, blink, and hop.

description.zh: 「神里印象」以《原神》神里绫华的青蓝、靛蓝与金色为灵感，提供浅色与深色两套配色，并用汉仪文黑作为标题字体。它只覆盖颜色、标题字体和少量视觉样式，不改变页面结构；汉仪文黑需由用户自行安装，水印图片默认不随包提供。
description.en: Kamisato Impression draws on Kamisato Ayaka’s cyan, indigo, ice-blue and gold palette for light and dark modes, with 汉仪文黑 used for headings. It only changes colors, heading typography and a small amount of styling; the font must be installed separately, and watermark images are not bundled by default.

description.zh: macOS 风格的明暗双主题，配套水中鲸鱼动态背景与点阵鲸鱼发送按钮；包含毛玻璃菜单、水母发光输入框、轨迹徽章和 Desktop 窗口适配。背景在失焦或隐藏时自动暂停，动画约 24fps，并响应 `prefers-reduced-motion` 与 `forced-colors`；支持 DSH Web 和 Desktop，但作者注明鲸鱼图形为 DeepSeek 官方资产，仅供个人主题美化、请勿商用。
description.en: A macOS-style light/dark skin with an underwater whale background and a dot-matrix whale send button. It also styles frosted menus, the glowing input field, trajectory badges, and the Desktop window shell; the background pauses when hidden or unfocused and the effects honor `prefers-reduced-motion` and `forced-colors` at about 24 fps. It supports DSH Web and Desktop; the author says the DeepSeek whale graphic is an official asset for personal theming only and not for commercial use.

description.zh: 双世界背景皮肤：暗色是月读夜水、鸟居朱红与月轮金，亮色是东京白昼的纸感街景；两套原创背景含分层景深，暗色另有流星群与水面涟漪。支持明暗主题切换、90+ 主题令牌和可选自备立绘槽位；公开构建不附带角色立绘，动效可按减少动态效果停用。
description.en: A two-world backdrop skin: moonlit Tsukuyomi night water with vermilion torii and gold moonlight in dark mode, and a paper-like Tokyo daytime scene in light mode. Original layered backgrounds add depth; dark mode also renders meteors and water ripples. It includes light/dark token mapping and optional slots for your own standees. The public build ships without character art, and reduced-motion mode disables the effects.

description.zh: 用暖白纸底、墨黑强调色和 3.5% 牛皮纸颗粒，把 DSH Web UI 变成纸墨素描；叠加马克笔轻描边、铅笔细线和楷体标题，但保留宿主布局、圆角、字号与状态色。只覆盖公开 `--dsw-alias-*` 设计令牌，浅/深色均适配，停用后可完整还原，不使用实心边框。
description.en: Turns the DSH Web UI into an ink-on-paper sketch with a warm off-white paper base, ink-black accents, and 3.5% kraft-paper grain. Marker-like edge strokes, pencil hairlines, and KaiTi headings add texture while the host keeps its layout, radii, type scale, and semantic status colors. It only overrides public `--dsw-alias-*` tokens, supports light and dark modes, restores cleanly when disabled, and uses no solid borders.

description.zh: 顺顺壁纸为 DSH Web 提供全屏 GIF 壁纸与侧栏迷你播放器：壁纸支持主题融合遮罩和 0–100% 突出度，播放器支持从 B 站链接添加歌曲、歌单管理、音量/进度控制、单曲/列表/随机循环，并持久化设置与播放列表。仅支持 DSH Web；B 站音乐需联网，作者提醒分发时自行确认音乐版权。
description.en: Shunshun Wallpaper adds a full-screen GIF wallpaper and a sidebar mini-player to DSH Web. It provides a theme-aware veil and a 0–100% prominence slider, Bilibili-link music import, playlist management, volume and seek controls, single/list/shuffle repeat, and persisted settings and playlists. It requires DSH Web and network access for Bilibili audio; the author asks users to verify music rights before redistribution.

description.zh: 图片与视频壁纸皮肤可将本地 JPG/PNG/WebP 或静音循环 MP4/WebM 作为应用背景，并把面板变为半透明；右下角面板支持预览、启用/关闭和实时切换，路径可在 Settings → Plugins 中修改，配置改动无需重启。壁纸素材不随仓库提供，需要用户使用本地文件。
description.en: Image & Video Wallpaper Skin uses a local JPG, PNG, or WebP image—or a muted looping MP4/WebM—as the application background and makes panels translucent. A bottom-right panel previews, enables, disables, and switches wallpapers live; the path is editable in Settings → Plugins without a restart. Wallpaper media is not bundled, so users provide their own local files.

description.zh: 奶黄、奶油白与嫩绿色的奶蛙主题，支持浅色与深色模式；为空会话加入半颗奶蛙背景、标题/图标与发送按钮替换，并在顶层会话开始和完成时播放提示音。尊重系统的“减少动态效果”设置；空状态标题修改依赖当前 Web UI 结构。
description.en: A cream, ivory, and fresh-green frog theme for light and dark modes. It adds a half-frog empty-state backdrop, frog title, icon, and send-button treatments, and plays short sounds when a top-level session starts and completes. It respects system reduced-motion settings; the empty-state title change depends on the current Web UI structure.

description.zh: 将 DSH Web UI 重塑为 Mineradio「私人视觉电台」风格：近黑演播室上的香槟金玻璃面板，支持流体或图片/视频壁纸、云母与兼容双模式、粒子装饰和鼠标辉光。
description.en: A cinematic Mineradio glassmorphism theme for the DSH Web UI: champagne-glass panels over a near-black studio, with fluid or image/video wallpapers, Mica and Compatibility modes, particle decor and pointer glow.

description.zh: 把真实会话事件变成一眼可见的状态宠物：空闲慢飘，思考加速，工具执行显示紫色连线，错误显示红环并抖动，运行超过 10 秒的回合完成时跳跃庆祝。它会在五个候选角落避开输入框和焦点元素，`prefers-reduced-motion` 时退化为保留颜色/文字的静态角标；不会阻断工具 waterfall，也没有物理引擎或设置页。
description.en: Turns live session events into a status pet you can read at a glance: it drifts when idle, speeds up while thinking, draws purple tethers for active tools, shakes with a red ring on errors, and celebrates turns that ran for more than 10 seconds. It chooses among five corners to avoid text inputs and the focused element, degrades to a static badge with its status color and label under `prefers-reduced-motion`, never blocks the tool waterfall, and deliberately has no physics engine or settings page.

description.zh: 公社（Atom Commune）是静态的原子朋克/苏式宏伟建筑主题：对话区使用金色穹顶、红色星标、石柱与雕像的蓝天背景，界面采用玫瑰红主色，并以黄色锤镰与原子核点缀 favicon 和侧栏品牌位。背景图以 base64 内置于 `lib/client.js`，不依赖外部文件或网络；没有标语或音效动画。
description.en: Atom Commune is a static atompunk theme built around a Soviet monumental-building backdrop: blue sky, golden domes, red stars, columns, and statues. The UI uses rose red, with yellow hammer-and-sickle and atom accents in the favicon and sidebar brand area. The background is embedded as base64 in `lib/client.js`, so it needs no external file or network; there are no slogans, sound effects, or continuous animation.

description.zh: Gemini 风格主题只通过一张叠加在 `--dsw-*` token 上的样式表改变 DSH Web 外观，覆盖对话区/侧栏、胶囊行、按钮、新建会话、欢迎页、输入框和滚动渐隐，并同时适配明暗主题。它不新增 DOM、插槽或服务，卸载可恢复原生界面；会话头部、欢迎语轮换、侧栏启动状态和生成中的顶部进度条保持 DSH 原样。
description.en: Gemini-Style Theme changes the DSH Web client through one stylesheet layered over its `--dsw-*` tokens. It restyles the conversation ground and sidebar, capsule rows, buttons, new-chat pill, hero greeting, composer, and scroll fades in both light and dark modes. It adds no DOM, slot occupant, or service and restores the stock appearance when removed; the session header, rotating greeting, sidebar boot posture, and top progress bar during turns remain unchanged.

description.zh: 把 DSH Web GUI 换成拜仁慕尼黑主题：主场红/客场白两套画布，5 种背景（19 名一线队球员的内嵌赛场照、球衣、阵容号码墙、安联球场、纯色）和拜仁红、深红、拜仁蓝、冠军金四种强调色。设置即时保存并支持自定义图片 URL；照片缺失会回退到球衣插画。照片来自公开图片索引与报道，项目声明仅供个人非商业使用，非官方授权。
description.en: Recasts the DSH Web GUI in an FC Bayern München theme with home-red and away-white canvases, five backdrops—embedded match photos for 19 first-team players, drawn jerseys, a squad-number wall, Allianz Arena, and plain—and four accents: Bayern red, dark red, Bayern blue, and champion gold. Settings save immediately and accept a custom image URL; missing player photos fall back to jersey art. The project says its public-source photos are for personal, non-commercial theming only and are not official club material.

description.zh: 将 DeepSeek-Refined 的 Obsidian Border 风格移植到 DSH Web，提供 Border、Nord、Twilight、GitHub 和 Atom One 五套主题，亮暗外观跟随系统；同时美化 Markdown、代码块、工具卡片与 diff，并支持行内代码点击复制和会话头部主题切换。主题不联网、不改 DSH 源码；少数依赖哈希类名的细化规则可能在宿主升级后回退。
description.en: A DeepSeek-Refined port for the DSH Web GUI with five Obsidian Border-style themes—Border, Nord, Twilight, GitHub, and Atom One—that follow light and dark system appearance. It also refines Markdown, code, tool, and diff cards, adds click-to-copy for inline code, and provides a header theme switcher. It makes no network requests or source changes; a few hashed-class refinements may fall back after host upgrades.

description.zh: 赛博朋克外观，提供流动 RGB 霓虹、CRT 扫描线、暗色霓虹城市背景和可自定义背景图库；右上角可拖动、可收起的 HUD 集成外观切换与本地音乐播放器。歌单和播放状态持久化，刷新后恢复进度但不会自动播放；系统开启减少动态效果时自动关闭动效。
description.en: A cyberpunk appearance with flowing RGB neon, CRT scanlines, a dark neon-city backdrop, and a customizable background gallery. Its draggable, collapsible top-right HUD includes a theme toggle and local music player. Playlists and playback state persist across refreshes, restoring position without autoplay; animations disable automatically when the OS requests reduced motion.

description.zh: 明日方舟同人皮肤“初雪和小羊”，包含昼夜星海庭园背景与双角色布局。
description.en: An Arknights fan skin featuring Pramanix and Eyjafjalla, with day-and-night starry garden backgrounds and a two-character layout.

description.zh: 网易云音乐（music.163.com）播放器与 AI DJ 组合插件，提供侧栏页面、应用内播放、二维码登录，以及由 agent 工具管理播放队列。
description.en: A NetEase Cloud Music (music.163.com) player and AI DJ bundle with a sidebar page, in-app playback, QR sign-in, and agent tools for curating the queue.

name.zh: 月宝儿 Moony 音乐播放器

description.zh: 将音乐播放器接入 DSH 对话框：可用自然语言搜索、点歌、整理歌单、查看歌词、推荐播放、切歌、暂停和收藏；右下角的月宝儿 Moony 浮窗会随播放律动并显示工作状态。支持十种 Moony 形象、拖拽/折叠/隐藏和本地推荐记忆；音乐服务只监听 127.0.0.1，授权的本地音乐路径不会上传。
description.en: An integrated music player built into the DSH conversation: search, play, organize playlists, view lyrics, get recommendations, skip, pause, and save tracks with natural-language requests. A floating Moony pet moves with playback and reflects DSH work status; it offers ten forms plus drag, collapse, hide, and local preference memory. The music service listens on 127.0.0.1, and explicitly authorized local music paths stay local.

description.zh: 把 DSH Web 的会话列表改造成像素办公室：6×4 共 24 个工位对应工作区，便利贴计划板对应会话，CRT 显示器承载真实对话与工具调用；支持拖拽换位、归档/恢复、分叉、活跃度排序和 `CALM`/`OVERDRIVE` 动效档位。插件界面强制深色，布局偏好保存在当前浏览器；仅支持 DSH `>=0.1.2-alpha.1` 的最新基座，升级宿主后需要重新挂载插件，超过 24 个工作区仍需从原生界面访问。
description.en: Turns the DSH Web session list into a pixel office: a 6×4 grid of 24 desks for workspaces, sticky-note planning boards for sessions, and a CRT monitor containing the real conversation and tool calls. It supports drag-to-rearrange, archive/restore, forking, activity sorting and `CALM`/`OVERDRIVE` motion modes. The plugin surface is forced dark and layout preferences stay in the current browser; it supports only the latest DSH base (`>=0.1.2-alpha.1`), must be remounted after a host upgrade, and leaves workspaces beyond 24 accessible from the native UI.

description.zh: 提供 22 套仅浅色配色（4 套 Pantone、14 套中国传统色、4 套莫兰迪色），可与 14 种单选表面效果组合成 308 种搭配；还支持十二时辰/定时轮换、工作区绑定、会话颜色标记，以及可选的账号昵称与内联头像编辑。没有深色模式；安全模式可停绘并恢复出厂。
description.en: Provides 22 light-only palettes—4 Pantone, 14 Chinese traditional, and 4 Morandi—plus 14 single-select surface effects for 308 combinations. It also supports shichen or timed rotation, workspace bindings, per-session color marks, and optional nickname and inline-avatar editing in the account row. There is no dark mode; Safe Mode can stop drawing and restore the factory appearance.

description.zh: 以 Nachoneko（甘城猫猫）为主题的 Web GUI 皮肤。
description.en: A Nachoneko-themed skin for the Web GUI.

description.zh: 随任务状态活动的 VRM 3D 桌宠：可在应用内显示，也能在 Desktop 上开独立透明悬浮窗，任务进行、等待确认、完成或出错时播放对应动作；自带两款模型与 VRMA 动作包，可导入自己的模型并配置表情、视线和物理（早期版本，3D 渲染会占用 GPU 与内存）。
description.en: A VRM 3D pet that reacts to task state in-app or in a separate transparent floating window on Desktop, playing matching actions for running, waiting, done and error; two models and a VRMA action pack ship ready, and you can import your own with expressions, gaze and physics (early version; 3D rendering uses GPU and memory).

description.zh: 在“Deep diving...”状态提示前放置 GrokBot 风格动态头像，状态文字同步以打字机效果变化。
description.en: Places a GrokBot-style animated avatar before the “Deep diving...” indicator, with a synchronized typewriter effect for the status text.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供 8 个皮肤家族、15 套明暗主题：Glass、Claude、Nord、Coffee、Matrix、Ocean、Mono 和 Sakura。设置页内置皮肤中心，可在浅色、深色与系统默认之间一键切换并即时恢复；主题只覆盖官方 `--dsw-*` 令牌，不读写会话、请求或工作区数据。一次只应启用一个皮肤插件。
description.en: A DSH Web skin family with eight groups and 15 light/dark themes: Glass, Claude, Nord, Coffee, Matrix, Ocean, Mono, and Sakura. Its built-in skin center switches between light, dark, and the system default, with immediate restoration. It overrides only the official `--dsw-*` tokens and does not read or modify session, request, or workspace data. Use only one skin plugin at a time.

description.zh: 提供覆盖 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 的完整越南语界面（58 个命名空间、2,615 个字符串）、三套越南主题（Sơn mài、Hạ Long sương、Lụa Hội An，各有浅/深/跟随系统）和来自 Wikimedia Commons 的越南风景轮换背景。照片支持透明度、模糊、Ken Burns 与离线缓存，并显示作者/许可证；开启背景会直接请求 `commons.wikimedia.org` 和 `upload.wikimedia.org`，不发送 DSH 数据。要求 DSH `>= 0.2.0-rc.1`。
description.en: Adds a complete Vietnamese UI for DSH 0.2.0-rc.2—2,615 strings across 58 namespaces—three Vietnamese themes (Sơn mài, Hạ Long mist, and Hoi An silk, each with light, dark, and system modes), and a rotating Vietnam-landscape backdrop sourced from Wikimedia Commons. Backgrounds support opacity, blur, Ken Burns motion, offline caching, and per-photo attribution; enabling them makes direct requests to `commons.wikimedia.org` and `upload.wikimedia.org` but sends no DSH data. Requires DSH `>= 0.2.0-rc.1`.

description.zh: 鸣潮爱弥斯像素风主题：像素小爱弥斯默认坐在输入框上方，可拖到任意位置，并随 Agent 工作、出错、完成换动作；空闲会伸懒腰、打哈欠，摸头会记好感度。星夜背景可调暗度与模糊、也能换成自定义图，另有四套配色、像素按键与通讯卡式回复，设置页是频段柱样式。
description.en: A pixel Aemeath theme for the DSH web UI. The pixel companion sits above the composer, can be dragged anywhere and changes animation as the agent works, errors out or finishes; the starry background has dim and blur controls plus a custom image, and four palettes, pixel buttons and comms-card replies are included.

description.zh: 蓝色大肥鱼主题插件，包含海洋配色、鱼群、气泡、吉祥物和品牌替换。
description.en: A blue big-fish theme plugin with ocean colors, fish schools, bubbles, a mascot, and branding replacements.

description.zh: 右下角的 Fritia 小人会在 Agent 工作时左右走动，待机时在两种姿态间切换，并可通过点击、连击、右键、长按和拖动触发高兴、困惑、生气、抓取与余额面板等状态；右键可读取 DeepSeek 账户余额并显示在举起的板子上。素材随包提供 20 张透明立绘，拖动后位置保留；这是基于同源 Host 路由的 Web 插件，安装或更新 Host 代码需要重启 DSH。
description.en: Fritia walks back and forth while an agent is working, alternates between two idle poses, and reacts to clicks, rapid clicks, right-clicks, long-presses, and dragging with happy, confused, angry, grab, and balance-panel states. Right-click can read the DeepSeek account balance and display it on the raised sign. The package includes 20 transparent portraits and preserves a dragged position; it uses same-origin host routes, so installing or updating host code requires a DSH restart.

description.zh: 面向 DSH Desktop 和 Web UI 的非官方马里奥风像素皮肤，替换背景、标题栏、侧栏、输入区、设置页和常用控件，并覆盖任务看板、SSH、文件树、Trajectory 与 Todo 的视觉层。支持字体缩放、0–16px 背景模糊和亮暗主题，同时保持会话、模型、权限与工具行为不变；当前适配 DSH `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.6`，Node.js 要求 `>=22.19.0`。
description.en: An unofficial Mario-inspired pixel skin for DSH Desktop and Web UI, restyling the background, title bar, sidebar, composer, settings, and common controls, including the task board, SSH, file tree, Trajectory, and Todo surfaces. It supports font scaling, 0–16px background blur, and light/dark themes while leaving sessions, models, permissions, and tool behavior unchanged. The documented target is DSH `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.6` with Node.js `>=22.19.0`.

name.zh: DSH 春日山谷像素皮肤

description.zh: 春日山谷像素皮肤把原创农场像素背景、木质侧栏、羊皮纸面板、金色选中态和绿色主操作带入 DSH Desktop 与 Web UI；发送按钮采用浇水壶轮廓，支持字体缩放、0–16px 背景模糊及浅/深主题。当前 README 标注适配 DSH `0.1.0-rc.6`、Node.js `>=22.19.0`。
description.en: An original spring-farm pixel skin for DSH Desktop and Web UI, with a farm backdrop, wood sidebar, parchment surfaces, gold selection states, and green primary actions. The send button uses a watering-can outline; font scaling, 0–16px background blur, and light/dark themes are supported. The README targets DSH `0.1.0-rc.6` and Node.js `>=22.19.0`.

description.zh: 把 Web 界面改成 Minecraft 启动器风格：草方块绿、泥土棕、木板与石材配色，方块边框、像素化背景、像素按钮和侧栏装饰，暗色与亮色模式各有一套配色。
description.en: A Minecraft Launcher-style skin in grass green, dirt brown, wood and stone, with blocky borders, pixelated backgrounds, pixel buttons and sidebar decoration. Both dark and light palettes are included.

description.zh: Material Design 3 毛玻璃主题，为侧栏、顶栏、输入卡、聊天、设置面板和菜单提供半透明表面与 10px `backdrop-filter` 模糊，并支持本地图片或 HTTP/HTTPS 壁纸、裁切方式、位置和可读性遮罩。壁纸默认关闭，图片存浏览器 IndexedDB、偏好存 `localStorage`，不会上传到 DSH 服务；主题跟随 DSH 的浅色/深色外观。
description.en: A Material Design 3 glassmorphism layer for DSH, applying translucent surfaces and 10px `backdrop-filter` blur to the sidebar, top bar, composer, chat, settings, and menus. It supports local images or HTTP/HTTPS wallpapers with fill mode, position, and readability-overlay controls. Wallpapers are off by default, images stay in browser IndexedDB, preferences use `localStorage`, and nothing is uploaded to DSH services; the palette follows DSH light/dark appearance.

description.zh: 粒子鲸鱼主题在 DSH Web 中以 WebGL2 重建 DeepSeek 官网 hero 鲸鱼：从 `hero-whale.svg` 采样点云，支持鼠标扭曲、光线跟随和入场组装，WebGL2 不可用时回退 2D canvas。它跟随 DSH 明/暗/系统外观，不改官方主题、没有设置按钮，默认开启；固定包声明仅面向 Web profile。
description.en: Particle Whale Theme recreates the DeepSeek website hero whale in DSH Web with WebGL2: it samples a point cloud from `hero-whale.svg` and adds pointer distortion, light following, and an eased assembly entrance, with a 2D canvas fallback when WebGL2 is unavailable. It follows DSH light, dark, or system appearance without changing the official theme, has no settings button, and is enabled by default. The fixed package targets the Web profile.
