description.zh: 许愿屋用原创 SVG 小屋替换侧栏与首屏品牌，并以灯火琥珀令牌、暖纸/靛夜双主题和动态许愿星空覆盖界面：今日真实月相、月相呼吸与轨迹、流星和星群视差、鼠标拖尾、回车许愿、标题 `heroHeadline` 场景化、启动揭幕、点月亮彩蛋、输入萤火、AI 生成时窗灯联动、Web Audio 合成风铃/微风声、时辰氛围、每日签语和 `localStorage` 快捷手札。大多数层都可在 `cordis.patch.yml` 中独立开关（如 `brand`、`theme`、`background`、`bgMoon`、`moonWish`、`heroStyle`），尊重 `prefers-reduced-motion`；卸载或关闭时会清理副作用并还原官方外观。`ecoMode` 依赖 `navigator.getBattery`，而其他皮肤的 token 覆盖可能叠加冲突，建议一次只启用一个皮肤。代码 MIT 许可。
description.en: Xuyuanwu Wish House replaces the sidebar and hero branding with original SVG house artwork, then layers an amber-lantern token theme over warm-paper and indigo-night variants. Its living sky includes the current lunar phase, moon breathing and orbit, meteors, parallax star fields, mouse wish trails, Enter-triggered wishes, the `heroHeadline` treatment, a boot reveal, a clickable-moon easter egg, typing sparks, AI-streaming lamp feedback, Web Audio wind-chime/breeze synthesis, time-of-day ambience, daily fortune toasts, and a `localStorage` quick panel. Most layers can be toggled independently in `cordis.patch.yml`—including `brand`, `theme`, `background`, `bgMoon`, `moonWish`, and `heroStyle`—and the effects respect `prefers-reduced-motion`; unload or disable cleanup restores the stock appearance. `ecoMode` depends on `navigator.getBattery`, and token layers from other skins can overlap, so the README recommends enabling one skin at a time. MIT licensed.

description.zh: 手机优先的外观编辑器：在「设置 → 气泡与背景」中分别调用户/AI 气泡底色、渐变、描边、毛玻璃与文字/代码色，也可设置输入框、顶栏、侧栏和对话背景（图片支持定位、缩放、铺满/拉伸/适应/平铺）。纯前端、不改对话、不联网，配置和预设保存在 `localStorage`；≤700px 窄屏有专门适配，大图可能触发存储配额。
description.en: A phone-first appearance editor for separately tuning user and AI bubble colors, gradients, borders, frosted glass, and prose/code text from Settings → Bubbles & Backgrounds. It also styles the composer, top bar, sidebar, and conversation background, with image positioning, scaling, fill/stretch/fit/tile modes, and blur. The frontend-only plugin does not alter conversations or make network calls; settings and presets live in `localStorage`, narrow layouts ≤700 px receive dedicated tuning, and large images can hit browser storage limits.

description.zh: 将本机 Wallpaper Engine 的场景、网页与视频壁纸放到对话背景中，并提供液态玻璃、字体和外观预设。场景与网页支持实时渲染，部分效果可能降级；应用型壁纸不支持。
description.en: Bring local Wallpaper Engine scene, web, and video wallpapers into the chat background, with liquid glass, typography controls, and appearance presets. Scene and web wallpapers render live with possible fallbacks; application wallpapers are not supported.

name.zh: 刀剑神域 HUD 皮肤

description.zh: 把 DSH 主界面、DS Bot 与节点模式统一改成刀剑神域 Aincrad 风格的 HUD：深空底色、冷青全息描边、四角括号、扫描带与等宽数字。圆角归零，输入区做成带刻线的命令行窗，彩色位图统一压成青色，三套界面换用同一套配色与字体。
description.en: Repaints the main UI, DS Bot, and node mode in a Sword Art Online / Aincrad HUD language: deep-space ground, cyan holographic outlines, corner brackets, scanlines, and monospace numerals. Corners are squared, the composer becomes a ruled command window, and coloured bitmaps are flattened to cyan.

description.zh: 弗糯糯（nuonuo）客户端皮肤，为侧栏、中区、输入卡、主页标题与聊天区套用透明玻璃风格，并在中区循环播放静音视频壁纸。公开仓库是无素材骨架：不包含作者的私人壁纸和图标，安装后需要提供自己的素材；缺失时回退为空视频或透明占位，目标 Harness `0.1.0-rc.5`。
description.en: A nuonuo/Luvian client skin that applies a transparent-glass treatment to the sidebar, center column, composer card, home title, and chat area, with a looping muted video wallpaper in the center. The public repository is intentionally a no-asset skeleton: the author's private wallpapers and icons are not included, so you must provide your own; missing media falls back to an empty video or transparent placeholder. It targets Harness `0.1.0-rc.5`.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供 Dracula 深色配色，并通过 `--dsw-*`、`--shiki-*` 和 `--json-tree-*` 令牌统一代码块、语法高亮、JSON 树、差异视图及界面元素。另调优编程字体、正文列宽、代码块横向滚动和工具输出高度；切回浅色外观即恢复宿主配色。
description.en: A Dracula dark theme for the DSH Web GUI that maps `--dsw-*`, `--shiki-*`, and `--json-tree-*` tokens across code blocks, syntax highlighting, the JSON tree, diff views, and interface surfaces. It also tunes programming fonts, reading-column width, horizontal code scrolling, and tool-output height; switching back to light appearance restores the host palette.

description.zh: 在深潜状态行下方用 ikun 桌宠显示估算进度，每 20% 切换动作和文案，回答完成时播放系统级语音提示。
description.en: An ikun pet shows estimated progress below the deep-diving status line, changing animation and text every 20% and playing a system-level voice cue when the reply finishes.

description.zh: 徒步山野风格的 DSH 皮肤，内置“山野向导”亮暗配色、右侧路标工作进度面板和可恢复默认的设置入口；纯 CSS 换皮，不改界面逻辑。
description.en: A hiking and mountain-wilderness reskin with the “Trail Guide” light/dark palette, a right-side Waypoints progress panel, and a reversible settings entry. It changes the CSS layer without altering interface logic.

description.zh: 提供内置配色与背景、图片导入和视频背景三种互斥模式；视频可按鼠标横向位置做 360° 环绕跟随，或循环播放。主题面板可调透明度并持久化设置，默认图片和视频不可删除；跟随 `prefers-reduced-motion` 时停帧，插件仅支持 DSH Web，安装后需重启生效。
description.en: Offers three mutually exclusive modes: built-in color and backdrop themes, imported images, and video backgrounds. Video can follow the mouse around a 360° orbit or loop as a background. The theme panel persists adjustable opacity settings, while the default image and video cannot be deleted; follow-mouse playback stops under `prefers-reduced-motion`. The plugin targets DSH Web and requires a restart after installation.

description.zh: 一只可配置的智子悬浮桌宠，提供 11 款动态眼睛皮肤、瞳孔跟随鼠标、眨眼/东张西望、幽灵模式，以及头顶目标进度与短标题。支持拖拽、尺寸、台词、人设、动效和 AI 模式设置，并包含面向产品设计任务的五步流程与质量闸。语音实时交互和摄像头跟随在固定 README 中仍标为规划中。
description.en: A configurable floating Sophon pet with 11 animated eye skins, mouse-following pupils, blinking and idle glances, ghost mode, and a goal-progress/title display. It supports dragging, size, dialogue, persona, motion, and AI-mode settings, and includes a five-step product-design workflow with a verification gate. Real-time voice and camera tracking are still listed as planned features in the fixed README.

description.zh: 提供 Solid、Glass、Volume、Neon 四套明暗配色；Neon 深色仅在模型运行时显示青色扫描线，并配有 HUD 侧栏，选择保存在 profile 中，可跨重启和 profile 切换保留。
description.en: Provides light and dark variants of four palettes—Solid, Glass, Volume, and Neon. The Neon dark half adds a cyan scanline only while the model is working, plus a HUD sidebar; the choice persists across restarts and profile switches.

name.zh: 角色插画与纯色主题集

description.zh: 角色壁纸、场景横幅和侧栏伙伴组成的主题集，也可只保留配色；支持浅色、深色、跟随系统、收藏和定时轮换。
description.en: A collection of character wallpapers, scene banners and sidebar companions, with color-only variants, light/dark/system modes, favorites and timed theme rotation.

description.zh: 鸣潮达妮娅主题界面，提供亮/暗双形态、玻璃卡片、虹彩泡泡粒子、深紫锁链边框、侧栏立绘与动态 Q 版吉祥物，并支持调色板设置。
description.en: A Wuthering Waves Denia interface with light and dark forms, glass panels, iridescent bubble particles, deep-purple chain borders, sidebar character art, and an animated chibi mascot, plus a palette panel.

description.zh: E-Ink Retro 以纸面、近黑文字、硬边偏移阴影和黑白选中态重塑 DSH 客户端，提供 Balanced、Immersive 和 Off 三种模式；Immersive 只将已适配的表面与 token 映射为灰阶，图片、视频、Canvas 和 iframe 内容保持原样。主题跟随页面中英界面语言，遇到其他第三方主题会暂停；固定版本兼容 DSH `0.1.7-rc.1` 与 `0.2.0-rc.2`，不声明完整 WCAG 认证，硬编码颜色或 Shadow DOM 组件只能部分继承。
description.en: E-Ink Retro reshapes the DSH client with paper surfaces, near-black type, hard offset shadows, and black-and-white selection states. It offers Balanced, Immersive, and Off modes; Immersive maps only supported surfaces and tokens to grayscale, while images, video, Canvas output, and iframe content remain unchanged. The theme follows English or Simplified Chinese page language and pauses when another third-party theme is selected. The pinned release lists DSH `0.1.7-rc.1` and `0.2.0-rc.2` as compatible, does not claim full WCAG certification, and can only partially theme hard-coded-color or Shadow DOM components.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面中自由游动的原创 3D 鲸鱼桌宠。任务完成、出错或等待批准时播放 attention 动画，并在浏览器允许时播放鲸吟；支持单击、双击、拖拽、自由游动、隐藏，以及原地睡觉或回到右下角睡 5 分钟。
description.en: An original 3D whale pet that swims freely in the DSH Web interface. It plays an attention animation for task completion, errors, or approval waits, with whale-call audio when the browser allows it. Click, double-click, drag, hide it, or send it to the lower-right corner to sleep for five minutes.

description.zh: 将 DSH Web 与桌面界面改成磨砂玻璃风格，提供 SVG 边缘折射、实时可调玻璃参数和多种壁纸来源；桌面端还把会话栏并入系统标题栏并提供全屏按钮，网页版同样支持单行顶栏。
description.en: A frosted-glass skin for DSH Web and Desktop with SVG edge refraction, live glass controls, and multiple wallpaper sources. Desktop also merges the session bar into the system title bar and adds a fullscreen button; the web UI gets a one-row header as well.

description.zh: 为界面提供 38 款 OpenCode 配色主题，按色系分组并支持搜索、即时切换与重启后保留；另提供可独立调整的字体设置。
description.en: Provides 38 OpenCode color themes grouped by color family, with search, instant switching, and persistence across restarts; font settings can be adjusted independently.

description.zh: 十三动态背景为 DSH Web 提供实时壁纸，支持 GIF、动图 WebP/APNG、PNG/JPG 及 MP4/WebM/MOV；按扩展名或 MIME 自动识别，视频静音循环并在切后台时暂停，图片存为 CSS 背景。上传内容保存于 IndexedDB；远程媒体使用 HTTP(S) URL，本地文件路径不能直接作为 URL。
description.en: Thirteen Live Wallpaper adds live backgrounds to DSH Web, accepting GIF, animated WebP/APNG, PNG/JPG, and MP4/WebM/MOV. It detects formats by extension or MIME; videos loop muted and pause when the page is backgrounded, while images use a CSS background. Uploaded media is stored in IndexedDB; remote media uses HTTP(S) URLs, and local file paths cannot be entered as URLs.

description.zh: 鎏金主题：oklch 金粉双色层、24px 点阵画布和浮动卡片侧栏，接管会话栏、会话流、输入坞与工具卡。使用 theme.overrideTokens 常驻 {light,dark} 双色，priority:-1；停用后完整还原，采用零构建纯 loader 格式。
description.en: The Aurum theme uses oklch gold-and-pink layers, a 24px dotted canvas, and a floating card sidebar covering the session bar, stream, input dock, and tool cards. It keeps {light,dark} variants in theme.overrideTokens with priority:-1; disabling it fully restores the original interface. Zero-build loader format.

description.zh: 经典麦金塔 Macintosh 主题，采用 System 7 像素复古风格，包含像素字体、桌面噪点画布、Finder 式会话侧栏、黑白方角控件和 HappyMac 空态。零构建纯 loader 格式，附 Kit 组件检视页。
description.en: A Classic Macintosh theme in a System 7 pixel-retro style, with pixel fonts, a noisy desktop canvas, Finder-style session sidebar, black-and-white square controls, and a HappyMac empty state. Zero-build loader format with a Kit component inspection page.

description.zh: 在 DSH 全窗口后铺设本地照片，让侧栏、会话区和输入框表面透出玻璃质感；设置页可选择图片并调遮罩、模糊、饱和度和透明度，浅/深色随宿主切换而不影响文字、代码高亮和对话框。图片存于 `$DSH_HOME/wallpaper`（默认 `~/.dsh/wallpaper`），上传上限 40 MB；关闭壁纸会移除图层与样式。
description.en: Places a local photo behind the entire DSH GUI and makes the sidebar, conversation, and composer surfaces translucent so the image shows through. The settings page controls the scrim, blur, saturation, and translucency; light and dark follow the host without changing text, syntax highlighting, or dialogs. Images live in `$DSH_HOME/wallpaper` (default `~/.dsh/wallpaper`), uploads are capped at 40 MB, and disabling the wallpaper removes its layer and style.

description.zh: 在 DSH 页面里放一个可拖动的透明人物：点一下打开独立输入框，把任务直接发给当前会话，并显示最终输出、运行状态和公开思考摘要。人物有六档称呼与表达风格（小梁到梁祖）、四种任务模式，回复可用浏览器系统语音朗读。
description.en: An unofficial character companion inside the DSH page. Click the draggable figure to open a separate composer, send tasks to the current session, and read the final output, run status and public thinking summary; six character styles, four task modes and browser speech playback are included.

description.zh: 暮色调粉紫皮肤：33 个 design token（深紫半透明表面、蝶粉强调色、粉紫渐变滚动条）、整页暗紫壁纸与暗角、聊天卡与气泡圆角；全部挂在插件 fiber 上，卸载后页面干净还原。
description.en: A dusk-toned theme with 33 design tokens (deep-purple translucent surfaces, butterfly-pink accents, pink-purple gradient scrollbars), a full-page dark-purple wallpaper with vignette, and rounded chat cards and bubbles; everything binds to the plugin fiber and uninstalls cleanly.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web 与桌面端提供 Everforest 森林色主题，包含深浅两套基调、Soft/Medium/Hard 三档强度；聊天标题、代码、链接、表格和会话状态行按配色重绘，设置可即时生效并跨重启保存。
description.en: An Everforest forest-toned theme for DSH Web and desktop, with dark and light bases in Soft, Medium, and Hard strengths. It recolors headings, code, links, tables, and session-status rows, with instant application and persisted settings.

description.zh: 将 DSH Web 换成 Windows 98 风格：青绿桌面、深蓝标题栏、银灰 3D 控件、MS Sans Serif 字体、带箭头的复古滚动条和 Win98 设置对话框；桌面模式默认开启，也可关闭仅保留换肤。
description.en: A Windows 98–style DSH Web skin with a teal desktop, navy title bar, silver 3D controls, MS Sans Serif, arrowed retro scrollbars, and a Win98 settings dialog. Desktop mode is enabled by default and can be turned off to keep only the skin.

name.zh: 自定义 CSS 编辑器

description.zh: 在 DSH Web 设置中编辑并即时应用保存于宿主磁盘的 CSS 文件，提供语法高亮、补全、规则面板、元素拾取、查找替换、撤销重做和多文件管理；另提供无需编写 CSS 的壁纸面板。
description.en: Edit CSS files stored on the host disk from DSH Web settings and apply changes immediately, with syntax highlighting, completion, rule panels, element picking, search/replace, undo/redo, and multi-file management; a wallpaper panel works without writing CSS.

description.zh: 把 F1 赛事控制中心搬进 Web 界面：红牛、法拉利、迈凯伦、梅奔四支车队主题各有品牌色、对比文字和赛车摄影背景。设置页可切换车队、调背景强度、文字衬底与模糊，也能按车队上传自定义壁纸，并跟随明暗与跟随系统。
description.en: An F1 race-control skin with four team themes — Red Bull, Ferrari, McLaren and Mercedes — each with its own brand colours, readable text backing and broadcast photo backdrop. The native settings panel switches teams, tunes photo strength, text backing and blur, and accepts per-team custom wallpapers while following light, dark or system.

description.zh: 以《鸣潮》角色爱弥斯为主题的配色皮肤：角色立绘背景与同色系强调色，浅色/深色各一套，可从右下角主题中心与其他角色主题互斥切换，随时恢复官方外观。
description.en: An Aemeath (Wuthering Waves) character skin: character artwork background and matching accents in light and dark variants, switchable from the corner theme center and reversible to the default look.

description.zh: 把自有照片变成 DSH Web GUI 皮肤：支持文件选择、拖放或粘贴导入 PNG/JPG/WebP/GIF（单张 ≤25MB），自动提取主色作为强调色，并提供 `cover/contain`、0–100px 模糊、0–100% 压暗和分区渲染控制。照片保存在 `<DSH_HOME>/photo-skins/`，不上传或分享；同一插件还内置 Web-Reach 工具 `web_search`、`web_fetch` 与 `rss_fetch`，启用后查询和网址会发往选定的第三方服务。
description.en: Turn your own photos into DSH Web GUI skins by importing PNG/JPG/WebP/GIF files through a picker, drag-and-drop, or paste, with a 25 MB limit per image. The plugin extracts a dominant accent color and provides `cover/contain`, 0–100px blur, 0–100% dimming, and split rendering controls. Photos stay under `<DSH_HOME>/photo-skins/` and are not uploaded or shared; the same plugin also bundles Web-Reach tools—`web_search`, `web_fetch`, and `rss_fetch`—which send queries or URLs to selected third-party services when enabled.

description.zh: `Prompt Vault` 在输入框工具行加入 📚 按钮和提示词面板：可搜索、展开、创建、编辑、删除条目，并将整条提示词填入或追加到草稿。数据默认保存在 `~/.dsh/prompt-library.json`，可用 `DSH_PROMPT_VAULT_FILE` 覆盖；它是 DSH Web 插件，安装后需硬刷新，删除插件不会删除数据文件。
description.en: `Prompt Vault` adds a 📚 button and prompt library above the composer. Users can search, expand, create, edit, and delete entries, then insert a full prompt into the draft or append it to existing text. Data is stored at `~/.dsh/prompt-library.json` by default and can be redirected with `DSH_PROMPT_VAULT_FILE`; it is a DSH Web plugin, needs a hard refresh after installation, and leaves the data file in place when removed.

description.zh: 藏在聊天输入框里的摸鱼播放器：支持 B 站、YouTube、Vimeo 和 mp4 直链；鼠标移出输入框时播放，移回时自动暂停并从原位置继续。
description.en: A low-profile video player hidden in the chat composer. It supports Bilibili, YouTube, Vimeo, and direct MP4 links, playing when the pointer leaves the composer and pausing to resume at the same position when it returns.

description.zh: 给侧栏「外观」开关加入先滑动、后切换主题的三秒紫金时停波纹、反色转场和音效；动效层实时叠加且不拦截输入，音频预加载失败可在下次点击重试。系统启用 `prefers-reduced-motion` 时直接切换，不播放转场；需要 `sidebar.footer.action` 与主题服务，声明兼容 DSH `0.1.0-rc.7` 以上。
description.en: Adds a switch-first, theme-second transition to the sidebar Appearance control: a three-second purple-and-gold time-stop wave, color inversion, and sound play before the light/dark change. The live overlay does not block input, and failed audio preloading can retry on the next click. With `prefers-reduced-motion`, it switches immediately without the transition; it requires the `sidebar.footer.action` slot and theme service and declares compatibility with DSH `0.1.0-rc.7` and later.

description.zh: 开机时叠一段全窗口启动画面（默认渐变底），片尾交叉溶解进界面；可切换成启动状态窗，逐行回放实测的宿主模块加载、外壳进度与资源耗时，配置走纯 JSON 文件。
description.en: Overlays a full-window boot screen (a gradient by default) that cross-dissolves into the interface, and can switch to a boot status window that replays measured host module loads, shell progress and resource timings; configuration is a plain JSON file.

description.zh: Kun Like 桌宠以静态 Host + Client bundle 运行在 DSH Web 或桌面客户端右下角，提供 9 种精灵动画、拖动和点击互动，并监听 `agent/status`、`tools/execute`、`approval/request`、`agent/request-error` 以及 `agents.list()` 轮询来显示工作、思考、等待、失败、完成和空闲状态。任务完成时 Host 按平台播放提示音：Windows 用 `System.Media.SoundPlayer`，macOS 用 `afplay`，Linux 需要 `ffplay`；可用 `kun_pet_debug` 和 `/kun-pet/state` 检查状态。当前 `2.2.0` 面向 DSH 0.2.x（`engines.dsh: ^0.2.0-rc.2`），需要 Node ≥22.19，Web 与 desktop 是独立 profile，安装后必须重启；Linux 还需可用音频播放程序。代码按 MIT 许可，但 `spritesheet.webp` 是粉丝二创像素素材，语音是网络二创梗片段，仅供个人学习交流，不能从 MIT 代码许可推得商业授权。README 还警告裸包名 `dsh-kun-like-pet` 已被另一发布者占用，建议使用该仓库的 `github:` 安装入口。
description.en: Kun Like Desktop Pet runs as a static Host + Client bundle in the bottom-right of DSH Web or the desktop client. It ships nine sprite animations, dragging and click interactions, and listens to `agent/status`, `tools/execute`, `approval/request`, `agent/request-error`, plus an `agents.list()` polling fallback to show working, thinking, waiting, failed, completed, and idle states. The Host plays a completion sound per platform—`System.Media.SoundPlayer` on Windows, `afplay` on macOS, and `ffplay` on Linux—and exposes `kun_pet_debug` and `/kun-pet/state` for inspection. Version `2.2.0` targets DSH 0.2.x (`engines.dsh: ^0.2.0-rc.2`), requires Node ≥22.19, treats Web and desktop as separate profiles, and needs a restart after installation; Linux also needs a usable audio player. The code is MIT-licensed, but `spritesheet.webp` is fan-made pixel artwork and the voice is an internet meme remix for personal learning and exchange only, so commercial rights do not follow from the code license. The README warns that the bare `dsh-kun-like-pet` package name is occupied by another publisher and recommends the repository’s `github:` install spec.

description.zh: 昼夜角色界面主题：白昼水晶工坊与黑夜月潮观测室同步切换场景、色板、角色、侧栏伙伴与控件；仅修改展示层，不读取会话、模型请求、凭据或工作区数据。
description.en: A day/night character interface that switches the crystal workshop and moon-tide observatory scenes together with palettes, characters, sidebar companion, and controls; it only changes the presentation layer and does not read sessions, model requests, credentials, or workspace data.

description.zh: 由真实会话事件驱动的蕾米埃尔贴纸桌宠：随任务阶段切换贴纸与状态气泡，汇报项目、阶段、待办和进度，支持 SSE 实时推送与可选的透明置顶桌面悬浮窗。
description.en: A Remielle sticker pet driven by real session events: changes stickers and status bubbles with the task phase, reports project, stage, to-dos and progress, with SSE live updates and an optional transparent always-on-top desktop window.

description.zh: 在设置中选择无背景、纯色或本地图片，并调整背景不透明度。图片会自动压缩，配置保存在浏览器中，刷新后恢复并在多个标签页间同步。
description.en: Choose no background, a solid color, or a local image, and adjust background opacity. Images are compressed automatically; preferences are stored in the browser, restored after refresh, and synchronized across tabs.

description.zh: dsh-moyu 的抖音摸鱼模块：悬停即可显示推荐流播放器，滚轮切换视频，移开后自动暂停；宿主侧完成请求签名和媒体反代，不需要抖音账号登录。首次使用需要匿名 ttwid，可由插件自动获取。
description.en: The Douyin module of dsh-moyu: hover to open a recommendation-feed player, use the wheel to switch videos, and move away to pause. The host handles request signing and media proxying; no Douyin account is required, but the first use needs an anonymous ttwid that the plugin can obtain.

description.zh: 粒子鲸鱼背景将 DeepSeek 鱼形轮廓由不同尺寸粒子重建：入场组装、待机游动、鼠标径向推力与随光标移动的手电筒照明，适配浅色/深色主题。装饰层以 30 FPS 渲染，固定在 DSH `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.6` Web profile 验证，后续版本可能需要调整。
description.en: Particle Whale Background rebuilds the DeepSeek fish silhouette from varied-size particles, with an entrance assembly, idle swimming, radial mouse push, and cursor-following flashlight effect. It supports light and dark themes and renders the decorative layer at 30 FPS; the fixed README lists validation against the DSH `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.6` Web profile, and later releases may require updates.

description.zh: 住在 Web 界面里的可拖动大肥鱼：升级后共 101 类动作（新增 72 段动画）和 18 种举牌演出，会敲键盘、翻书、举牌等你，任务结束开心收工；支持替换角色、制作动作和自定义台词。
description.en: A draggable big fish living in the Web UI with 101 action types after the upgrade (72 new animations) and 18 sign-board skits — typing, reading, holding signs while you wait and celebrating when the task ends — plus replaceable characters, custom actions and lines.

description.zh: StyleVault 提供 30 套深浅色经典配色，并在 Style Settings 面板中实时调整颜色、UI/代码字体、字号和圆角；当前方案可保存、导入、导出和分享。它只覆盖 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题令牌，不改布局；DSH 预览版升级后，部分内部 class 可能需要适配，在线字体离线时会回退。
description.en: StyleVault provides 30 classic light and dark palettes with live controls for colors, UI and code fonts, font scale, and corner radius. Save, import, export, and share your schemes from the Style Settings panel. It overrides `--dsw-alias-*` theme tokens without changing layout; DSH preview updates may require adaptation, and online fonts fall back to the system stack offline.

description.zh: 在 DSH 新会话 Hero 背后以 ASCII 字符渲染会动的鲨鱼与鱼群海洋，作为纯浏览器端背景装饰；宿主侧没有额外逻辑。
description.en: A living ASCII backdrop for the DSH New Session Hero, rendering sharks and schools of fish behind the interface as a browser-only decoration with no host-side logic.

description.zh: 刀剑神域主题：原生还原 Link Start，提供桐人／亚丝娜语音、NerveGear 音效、音量调节与手动预览；GUI 自适应宽屏、超宽屏、竖屏及播放中窗口缩放与设备旋转；可选全部功能或仅限启动动画，启动白底以真实透明通道自然透出已加载界面；明暗主题色独立记忆、界面底色、本机字体与完整设置主题；液态玻璃边缘折射与方向反光，亦可选磨砂，浮层采样当前页面实际可见的背景与壁纸；分组件透明度、连续右栏与上下文玻璃、紧凑会话标签与单行状态读数；九张壁纸、本地图片或 4K／5K 循环视频及静态省电；支持键盘操作的模型思考强度控件与设置重置。
description.en: A Sword Art Online theme: a native Link Start sequence with Kirito/Asuna voice lines, NerveGear sound, volume control and manual preview; the GUI adapts to widescreen, ultrawide and portrait layouts, including window resizing and device rotation during playback; choose the full feature set or startup animation only, with the startup's true-alpha transition revealing the loaded interface; independent light/dark theme colours, interface background, local fonts and a complete settings theme; liquid-glass edge refraction and directional reflections, or frosted glass, with overlays sampling the currently visible page background and wallpaper; per-component transparency, a continuous right rail and contextual glass, compact conversation tabs and single-line status readouts; nine wallpapers, local images or 4K/5K looping video with a static power-saving mode; keyboard-accessible model thinking-intensity controls and settings reset.

description.zh: DSH BG Tool 是本地 `rembg`/BiRefNet 去背景工具：Agent 调用 `remove_background` 后，可用 `general`、`portrait` 或 `fast` 模式生成透明 PNG，结果写入工作区输出目录。图片不上传、不需要 API Key；运行依赖 Windows + NVIDIA GPU，以及预先准备的 `.bg-tools/` 本地环境。
description.en: DSH BG Tool is a local `rembg`/BiRefNet background-removal tool. The Agent can call `remove_background` in `general`, `portrait`, or `fast` mode to write transparent PNGs to the workspace output directory. Images stay on the machine and no API key is needed; it requires Windows with an NVIDIA GPU and a prepared local `.bg-tools/` environment.

name.zh: 爱弥斯主题与像素桌宠

description.zh: 爱弥斯主题界面配 4K 壁纸、冰蓝/粉紫/深空蓝配色和 15 帧像素桌宠；桌宠会随对话状态切换动画，可拖动、点击互动并持久化位置。
description.en: An Aemeath-themed interface with a 4K wallpaper, ice-blue/pink-violet/deep-space-blue colors, and a 15-frame pixel pet; the pet changes animation with conversation state and supports dragging, interactive clicks, and saved positioning.

description.zh: 把 DSH Desktop 界面换成 Windows 7 Aero 风格：约 50 个设计令牌改为玻璃配色，面板、侧栏与标题栏半透明并叠一层细噪点，会话标题栏保持平整、按钮去底色。标题栏有 Aero 开关，设置 → 通用里也有一行；原生模糊补丁为可选步骤。
description.en: Turns the DSH Desktop UI into a Windows 7 Aero-style glass surface: about 50 design tokens get glass palettes for light and dark, while panels, sidebar, and titlebar turn translucent under a fine noise layer and the conversation header stays flat with ghosted controls. An Aero pill in the titlebar and a Settings → General row switch it, and an optional Windows 10 native blur patch is documented separately.

description.zh: 月升 Moonrise 是一套深夜写代码风格的暗色主题，以深蓝夜色为底、琥珀色为强调；通过 `ctx.theme.register()` 覆盖 DSH 文档化的 `--dsw-alias-*` 语义 token，安装后可在设置 → 外观选择。
description.en: Moonrise is a late-night coding theme with an amber-on-midnight palette. It registers a dark `ThemeDefinition` through `ctx.theme.register()`, overriding DSH's documented `--dsw-alias-*` semantic tokens; select it in Settings → Appearance after installation.

description.zh: 原生 WebGPU 实时渲染的紫蓝星云皮肤：银河尘带斜贯视野，远近星点带视差与轻微闪烁，并有随机流星；深空配色适配 light/dark/system，无运行时 CDN、图片或额外依赖。
description.en: A purple-blue nebula skin rendered live with native WebGPU: a Milky Way dust band crosses the view, near and far stars have parallax and a slight twinkle, and meteors appear at random. Its deep-space colors adapt to light, dark, and system mode, with no runtime CDN, images, or extra dependencies.

description.zh: 纸墨金配色的 DSH 主题，月华白与玄夜两套色板跟随系统外观。每次启动或刷新先播五秒开场：中央先天八卦盘转动，四向行书依次扫入，可点击跳过；回车发送时闪一记太极。侧栏有太极印、占卜令牌与今日一签，另带紫微命盘对话框与每日神明画像。
description.en: A paper-ink-gold skin with Moonlight and Night palettes that follow the system appearance. Each load opens with a five-second bagua plate and four calligraphy lines; Enter sends with a taiji flash, the sidebar holds a taiji seal, a divination token and a daily hexagram, and a Zi Wei chart dialog is included.

description.zh: 可在 DSH Web 中上传本地 JPG/PNG/WebP/GIF 或粘贴 `http(s)` 图片 URL，实时调节图片不透明度、主题自适应遮罩、面板透明度、毛玻璃模糊、壁纸模糊和 `cover/contain` 填充。还提供可开关的会话时间线轨道，支持按会话书签与点击跳转；设置持久化到 `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml`，清除或卸载可恢复默认外观。
description.en: Upload a local JPG/PNG/WebP/GIF or paste an `http(s)` image URL into DSH Web, then tune image opacity, a theme-aware readability scrim, panel opacity, glass blur, wallpaper blur, and `cover/contain` fit. It also adds an optional conversation timeline rail with per-session bookmarks and click-to-jump navigation. Settings persist in `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml`, and clearing or uninstalling restores the default appearance.

name.zh: 按模型切换的背景规则

description.zh: 按当前模型名称匹配有序规则并切换背景；每条规则可配置多张图片，每张图片可独立设置布局、裁切、主题色、不透明度、亮度、模糊和轮换。支持规则集导入导出与本机存储。
description.en: Match ordered rules against the current model and switch backgrounds accordingly. Each rule can hold multiple images, with per-image layout, framing, theme color, opacity, brightness, blur, and rotation settings. Rule sets can be imported, exported, and stored locally.

description.zh: 让角落桌宠按 Agent 的具体活动切换姿态：思考、`web_fetch`、`web_search`/`skill`、`read`/`grep`、`bash`/`pwsh`、编辑、计划、子代理、审批和错误都有独立状态，还会显示命令/子代理徽标与 30 秒空闲睡眠。把图片与 `manifest.json` 放进 `assets/` 即可热更新，无需改代码；支持拖动、100–320px 缩放和点击状态气泡。素材服务只限配置目录且宠物为进程级共享，安装后需重启 `dsh web`。
description.en: Switches a corner pet to activity-specific poses for thinking, `web_fetch`, `web_search`/`skill`, `read`/`grep`, `bash`/`pwsh`, editing, planning, subagents, approvals, and errors, with command and subagent badges plus sleep after 30 seconds of idle time. Put images and `manifest.json` in `assets/` for hot reloads without code changes; the pet is draggable, resizable from 100–320 px, and opens a status bubble on click. Assets are served only from the configured directory, the pet is process-wide across sessions, and installation requires restarting `dsh web`.

description.zh: 在独立透明桌面窗口中显示会随 DSH agent 事件切换的宠物，内置 Lokki 科技狐狸与 Professor Leo 狮子科学家；支持 idle/working/waiting/review/error 姿态、悬停控制，以及可导入的动画图集或透明头像。宠物库从文件夹自动发现，可无需重装插件；首次启动会下载固定 Electron runtime，需要图形桌面（WSL2 需 WSLg），宠物文件、偏好和会话 ID 保存在本机。
description.en: Shows an activity-aware pet in a separate transparent desktop window, with Lokki the tech fox and Professor Leo the scientist lion included. It supports idle, working, waiting/review, and error poses, hover controls, and additional pets supplied as animation atlases or transparent portraits; new folders are discovered without reinstalling. The first launch downloads a pinned Electron runtime and requires a graphical desktop (WSLg for WSL2); pet files, preferences, and session IDs stay local.

description.zh: 在 Settings → General → Color Scheme 提供 7 套配色：Catppuccin Latte/Frappe/Macchiato/Mocha、Everforest Dark/Light 和 Nord；选择跨刷新与重启保存在 `localStorage`，tooltip 与 hover card 也跟随当前主题。新增配色需在 `./schemes` 添加数据文件、在 `schemes/index.ts` 注册并重新构建；当前未发布到 npm，需从 GitHub 或 tarball 安装。
description.en: Adds seven schemes to Settings → General → Color Scheme: Catppuccin Latte, Frappe, Macchiato, and Mocha; Everforest Dark and Light; and Nord. The choice persists across refreshes and restarts in `localStorage`, and tooltips and hover cards follow the active scheme. Add a scheme by creating a data file in `./schemes`, registering it in `schemes/index.ts`, and rebuilding; the package is not yet published to npm and must be installed from GitHub or a tarball.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面后方播放单个全屏循环视频，默认静音；右下角控件可还原原背景、播放/停止、切换静音和调节音量，并用“背景遮挡”滑杆同步控制 `--dsh-video-bg-scale` 与 `--dsw-skin-scrim`。标签页隐藏时暂停解码，`prefers-reduced-motion` 用户只显示静态遮罩，也可配合皮肤中心的模糊和遮挡控制。默认素材为 1440p/30fps，可替换 `assets/background.mp4`，但每次安装只支持一个视频，持续解码会占用 GPU。Host 通过仅允许 GET/HEAD 的同源隔离路由 `/api/video-bg/video.mp4` 提供包内固定文件，不接受路径输入，不涉及凭据、用户数据或远程执行。Apache-2.0 许可。
description.en: Plays one full-screen looping video behind DSH Web, muted by default. A bottom-right control provides restore-original, play/stop, mute, volume, and a background-occlusion slider that synchronizes `--dsh-video-bg-scale` with `--dsw-skin-scrim`; it also works with the skin center’s blur and occlusion controls. Playback pauses while the tab is hidden, and `prefers-reduced-motion` users get a static veil. The shipped asset is 1440p/30fps and can be replaced at `assets/background.mp4`, but each installation supports only one video and continuous decoding uses GPU resources. The Host serves the fixed packaged file through the GET/HEAD-only, same-origin-fenced `/api/video-bg/video.mp4` route with no path input, credentials, user data, or remote execution. Apache-2.0 licensed.

description.zh: 为 DSH 工作台加入一次性工业风入场：等待外壳就绪后逐笔写出 `DEEPSEEK HARNESS`，再用反色整屏色块扫场退场；同时提供深/浅两套官方 token 皮肤。默认每个浏览器会话只播放一次，可分别关闭过渡层或主题，减少动效会缩短时长；皮肤不驱动 Fullscreen API，并在就绪异常时使用超时退场。
description.en: Adds a one-shot industrial entrance to the DSH workspace: after the shell is ready, it writes `DEEPSEEK HARNESS` stroke by stroke, then exits with an inverted full-screen color block. It also supplies light and dark official-token skins. By default it plays once per browser session; the overlay and theme can be disabled separately, reduced motion shortens the timing, the skin never drives the Fullscreen API, and a timeout lets it exit if readiness fails.

description.zh: 翻到页面背面的悬浮毛玻璃任务控制台，实时展示当前会话的后台任务、子代理、工作区、插件状态和会话概览。内置卡片与用户卡片均可拖拽、缩放、折叠、全屏并持久化；对话中的 `[taskcard]` 块可生成卡片，卡片还能发布到无限画布并通过内置 WebSocket relay 协作。兼容范围为 DSH `>=0.1.5-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`。
description.en: Flip the page to a floating frosted-glass task console showing the current session’s background jobs, subagents, workspace, plugin state, and session overview. Built-in and user cards can be dragged, resized, collapsed, fullscreened, and persisted; conversation `[taskcard]` blocks can author cards, which can also be published to an infinite canvas and shared through the bundled WebSocket relay. The declared DSH range is `>=0.1.5-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`.

description.zh: 内置十款明暗配色，可在设置页内新建、编辑、改名和删除主题，支持玻璃质感与逐项主题令牌覆盖。
description.en: Choose from ten light and dark palettes, or create, edit, rename and delete themes in an inline settings editor, with optional glass effects and per-token overrides.

description.zh: Argentina · Messi 皮肤使用 celeste/navy/gold 色板，按明暗模式分别覆盖主题 token，并在侧栏与主区放置金色和 Messi 照片背景；页面还会显示不拦截点击的漫游 #10 徽章和缓慢旋转金环。它是纯前端、无配置插件，依赖当前 GUI 的左右栏结构；结构变化时会退化为仅保留配色主题。
description.en: Argentina · Messi uses a celeste/navy/gold palette with separate light and dark token overrides, gold and Messi photo backdrops for the sidebar and main area, a roaming non-interactive #10 badge, and a slowly rotating gold ring. It is a front-end-only, configuration-free plugin that relies on the current GUI’s left/right column structure; if that structure changes, it degrades to the color theme alone.

description.zh: 把 DSH Web 装扮成 macOS 桌面：毛玻璃菜单栏、实时钟、红黄绿窗口按钮、底部 Dock 与悬停放大，并自动跟随系统明暗主题。按 `⌘L` 或 Dock 日志图标可查看浏览器错误、Cordis 客户端加载失败以及 `~/.dsh/logs/web.log` / `install.log`，支持级别过滤、自动滚动、清空和导出 `.log`；服务端日志需要由启动命令用 `tee` 写入对应文件。
description.en: Turns DSH Web into a macOS-style desktop with a frosted menu bar and live clock, red/yellow/green window controls, a bottom Dock with hover magnification, and automatic system light/dark following. Press `⌘L` or the Dock log icon to inspect browser errors, Cordis client-load failures, and `~/.dsh/logs/web.log`/`install.log`, with level filtering, auto-scroll, clearing, and `.log` export; server-side entries appear only when the launch command writes those files with `tee`.

description.zh: Harness Whale Wallpaper 将约 1,750 个 WebGL2 粒子组成的点阵鲸鱼放在 DSH Web 应用框架下方，支持呼吸、缓慢转身、指针液态涡流和浅/深色主题。配置项含质量、亮度、比例、交互强度和运行时调暗；页面隐藏或 `prefers-reduced-motion` 时暂停，缺少 WebGL2 时回退静态 Canvas2D。固定版本目标为 `@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.1-rc.2`，`shell.overlay` 或主题协议变化后需重新核验。
description.en: Harness Whale Wallpaper places an approximately 1,750-particle WebGL2 whale beneath the DSH Web app frame, with breathing, slow turning, a pointer-driven liquid vortex, and light/dark themes. Configuration covers quality, brightness, scale, interaction strength, and activity dimming; it pauses when the page is hidden or under `prefers-reduced-motion`, and falls back to a static Canvas2D whale without WebGL2. The pinned release targets `@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.1-rc.2`, so changes to `shell.overlay` or the theme protocol require a compatibility review.

description.zh: 本地音乐播放器插件，在会话视图的“音乐”标签页中播放 flac、mp3 等常见格式，支持单曲/列表循环，并采用 macOS Music 风格界面。
description.en: A local music player in the session view’s Music tab. It supports common formats such as flac and mp3, single-track or list looping, and a macOS Music-style interface.

description.zh: 本地音乐播放器插件：通过 /music 打开全屏场景，扫描本地目录并使用 ffplay/afplay 播放；退出场景后音乐不中断。
description.en: A local music player with a fullscreen /music scene. It scans local directories, plays through ffplay/afplay, and keeps the music playing after you exit the scene.

description.zh: 把动态背景接进 Web 界面：实时海洋可调波浪、日光和自动昼夜；黑洞有地平线、吸积涡旋两个视角，各场景单独保存参数与玻璃浓度。另有本地视频库（单个上限 32 MiB、30 秒、1080p）和在线壁纸市场，下载后可显式应用。
description.en: Animated backgrounds for the Web UI: a live ocean with adjustable waves, sunlight and auto day-night, plus a black hole in event-horizon or accretion-vortex view, each scene keeping its own parameters and glass opacity. A local video library (up to 32 MiB / 30 s / 1080p per clip) and an online wallpaper market let you import or download clips and apply them explicitly.

description.zh: 音乐播放器插件：搜索并播放 Audius 免费曲库，支持收藏、迷你播放条和 agent 对话遥控。
description.en: A music player plugin for searching and streaming Audius’s free catalog, with favorites, a mini player, and agent chat control.

description.zh: 将照片铺满 DSH Web GUI，并把面板、边框和品牌色变成配套的玻璃质感主题。提供浅/深两套 token、0–100% 浓淡滑块、五套配色、自定义强调色、可替换图片，以及右下角可拖动胶囊和完整设置页；图片无法加载时插件不介入。自定义图片保存在浏览器本地，安装或更新后需重启 Web profile 并强制刷新页面。
description.en: Paints a photo across the DSH Web GUI and turns panels, borders, and brand colors into matching glass-like surfaces. It provides light and dark token sets, a 0–100% density slider, five palettes, a custom accent color, image replacement, and both a draggable corner pill and a full settings page; if the image cannot load, the plugin does nothing. Custom images stay in the browser, and installation or updates require restarting the Web profile and hard-reloading the page.

description.zh: DSH Enhanced 是一套综合插件：提供带自动回退的多引擎 `web_search`、`web_fetch`、技能与 MCP 管理、按 profile 的插件开关、受保护的会话移入系统废纸篓、自动压缩调节、重启/关机控制，以及 Matrix/Cyberpunk 主题。它把界面操作与 `manage_skills_mcps` 模型工具接到同一套处理器；无遥测，凭据按权限保存且不会回显，搜索和用户主动的 URL 抓取才会访问外部服务。
description.en: DSH Enhanced is a multi-purpose plugin with fallback-based multi-engine `web_search`, `web_fetch`, skill and MCP management, per-profile plugin toggles, guarded moves of sessions to the system trash, auto-compact tuning, restart/shutdown controls, and Matrix/Cyberpunk themes. Its UI and the `manage_skills_mcps` model tool share the same action handlers. It has no telemetry; credentials are permission-protected and never echoed, while external access is limited to searches and user-requested URL fetching.

description.zh: 余额血量条把 DeepSeek 余额显示成游戏式 HP：HP 为当前余额，上限为余额加今日消耗（可估算，也可在界面同步平台值），每 5 分钟刷新并记录今日消耗。设置中提供默认进度条、Minecraft 红心、暗黑破坏神血球、守望先锋分格条和三国杀勾玉五种样式；数据写入工作区 `.dsh-balance-history.json`，余额查询之外不外发网络请求。充值会使当前上限口径同步抬高，README 将其列为待优化项。
description.en: Balance HP turns DeepSeek balance into a game-style health display: HP is the current balance, while the cap is balance plus today's estimated spend, with an option to sync the platform value. It refreshes every five minutes and records daily usage. Choose among a default bar, Minecraft hearts, Diablo blood orb, Overwatch segmented bar, or Sanguosha taiji jades; state is stored in `.dsh-balance-history.json`, with no outbound requests beyond the balance query. The README notes that top-ups currently raise the cap under this accounting model.

name.zh: Frutiger Aero 玻璃水感皮肤

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面换上 Frutiger Aero 风格：天空与水面动态壁纸、磨砂玻璃面板、水感高光，以及可跟随宿主的明暗方案。桌面端保留三栏、弹窗、菜单和键盘交互；窄屏则提供覆盖式抽屉、拇指可达的浮动 dock、边缘手势、感知键盘的输入框和 44px 触控目标。浏览器端零依赖、无需构建，运行时不发网络请求；MIT 许可。
description.en: Reskins the DeepSeek Harness Web UI in Frutiger Aero with sky-and-water wallpaper, frosted panes, aqua highlights, and light/dark palettes. Desktop keeps the three-column layout, dialogs, menus, and keyboard interaction; narrow screens get an overlay drawer, thumb-reachable glass dock, edge gestures, a keyboard-aware composer, and 44px touch targets. The browser half has no dependencies or build requirement and makes no runtime network requests. MIT licensed.

name.zh: DSH 毛玻璃 UI 皮肤

description.zh: 在 DSH UI 下方放置图片或视频背景，并让包含侧栏在内的界面表面透出可调毛玻璃；支持拖动裁剪、缩放、历史皮肤记录和可拖动悬浮快捷面板。自定义素材可来自网络 URL 或本地文件，图片压缩后存 `localStorage`、视频存 IndexedDB；插件本身不发外部网络请求，视频在 `prefers-reduced-motion` 下暂停。聊天框还可调用 `skin_list` 查看皮肤清单。
description.en: Places an image or video behind the DSH UI and makes surfaces—including the sidebar—translucent so the adjustable frosted-glass treatment shows through. It supports drag-to-crop and zoom, skin history, and a draggable floating shortcut panel; custom media can come from a URL or local file, with compressed images in `localStorage` and videos in IndexedDB. The plugin itself makes no external network requests, pauses video under `prefers-reduced-motion`, and exposes a read-only `skin_list` tool for the catalog.

description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 的音频预览：支持缩放波形、实时频谱和全曲频谱图，并提供支持 HTTP Range 的流式媒体路由。
description.en: Audio preview for dsh-better-sidebar with a zoomable waveform, live spectrum, whole-file spectrogram, and an HTTP Range-capable streaming media route.

description.zh: 给 DSH 套上二次元外观：13 张全屏动漫壁纸（也可自行添加），六套全局配色，玻璃质感的侧栏、输入框与弹层；樱花、萤火、落雪三种粒子特效可开关，右下角随机动图挂件预置 8 套。还能上传 mp4/webm 动态壁纸（≤30 MB），主题面板可一键切回原生界面。
description.en: An anime appearance pack for DSH: 13 full-screen wallpapers plus your own, six global colour themes, and glass sidebars, composer, and popovers. Sakura, firefly, and snow particles can be toggled, eight random corner-widget sets ship in the box, and mp4/webm animated wallpapers up to 30 MB can be uploaded.

description.zh: 六幕全屏启动序列：黑幕徽章 → 过曝 → 暗色「技术档案」底板 → 五步交互授权 → 色散故障揭幕；自带五个真声音色与五款赛博电子立绘，可给「身份资料确认」设访问密码，并可选择是否在片尾弹出「降世」事件窗口。
description.en: A six-act full-screen boot sequence — emblem, overexposure, dossier panel, five-step authorization and a glitch-dissolve reveal — with five built-in real-voice tracks, five cyber portraits, an optional access password on the identity step and an optional “Descent” event window after the intro.

description.zh: 将 DSH 的设计令牌映射为 Claude Design System 风格的暖灰表面、陶土橙强调色、圆角、阴影和排印，提供明暗两套配色。组件细化覆盖输入框、侧栏、Markdown、表格、代码块、工具卡片与 diff，并支持主题模式、强调色、表面暖度、圆角、阴影和组件精修等设置；默认代码块自动换行。可选的宿主补丁用于恢复 edit/write 卡片的真实文件行号，缺少宿主起点时显示“—”。
description.en: Maps DSH design tokens to a Claude Design System look with warm-gray surfaces, a clay-orange accent, rounded shapes, shadows, and typography in light and dark modes. Component refinement covers the composer, sidebar, Markdown, tables, code blocks, tool cards, and diffs, with settings for theme mode, accent, surface warmth, radius, shadow, and component polish. Code blocks wrap by default; an optional host patch restores real file line numbers for edit/write cards, which otherwise show “—” when the host has no source offsets.

description.zh: 可淡化的 JPG/PNG/WebP 自定义图片背景与 FLAC/MP3/WAV/M4A 背景音乐播放器，支持 0–200% 音量、播放列表、循环、随机播放和 10 段均衡器；右下角悬浮条可展开控制面板。
description.en: Fadable custom JPG/PNG/WebP image backgrounds and a FLAC/MP3/WAV/M4A music player with 0–200% volume, playlists, loop, shuffle, and a 10-band equalizer; expand the control panel from the floating bar at bottom right.

description.zh: 提供浅/深两套背景与配色、可调蒙版、自定义背景、玻璃消息面板和当前会话标题特效，并同时支持 Web 与官方桌面端。
description.en: Provides light and dark backgrounds and palettes, an adjustable mask, custom backgrounds, glass message panels, and an active-conversation title effect for both the Web and official desktop client.

description.zh: 右下角的「核动力草泥马」会读取当前会话状态：空闲时慢走、50 秒后打盹，工作时快步巡逻并播报工具，等待审批时急跳提示，回合结束三连跳庆祝；点按、拖动还能触发语录、粒子和重力回弹。支持 DSH `v0.1.5+`，使用 CSS 与 `requestAnimationFrame`，卸载时清理节点和样式。
description.en: The bottom-right Nuclear Alpaca reads the current session: it strolls while idle, naps after 50 seconds, patrols briskly and announces tools while working, jumps anxiously for approval, and triple-jumps when a turn ends. Poke or drag it for quotes, particles, and gravity-like bounce-back. It supports DSH `v0.1.5+`, uses CSS and `requestAnimationFrame`, and removes its nodes and styles on unload.

description.zh: 「深海世界 / 浅海世界」双模式主题：深色以亮度、浅色以清澈度区分信息层级，并让界面随系统明暗切换；对话栏加入轻量浮游生物动画，生成中的 “Deep diving…” 状态会触发上涌与柔光增强，右上角水母按钮可实时调整粒子参数。开启减少动态效果时退化为静态帧；插件只做主题与颜色，不改变布局。
description.en: A Deep Sea / Shallow Sea theme with dark mode using brightness and light mode using clarity to express hierarchy, while following the system appearance. A lightweight plankton animation fills the conversation area; the “Deep diving…” state adds upward motion and soft glow, and a jellyfish button exposes live particle controls. Reduced-motion mode falls back to a static frame; the plugin changes theme and color, not layout.

description.zh: 给界面加一层很薄的天气：右下角 28px 按钮切换雨、雪、炉火或关闭，强度分轻中暴。雨滴落地会溅开水花并随风倾斜，闪电先在分叉处亮起、隔一会儿才响雷；雪会在窗口底边长出积雪，炉火有暖光与上升的火星。雨声和火声是录音，雪风由代码合成，另有夜间配色。
description.en: A thin layer of weather over the DSH web GUI: a 28 px corner button switches rain, snow, hearth or off at three intensities. Raindrops splash and lean with the wind, lightning flashes before delayed thunder, snow builds a bank along the window, and the hearth glows from below; recorded rain and fire audio, a generated wind and a night palette are included.

description.zh: 把唐僧、孙悟空、猪八戒、沙僧和白龙马做成无边框、透明、置顶的悬浮窗；点击循环换人，拖动移动，悬停可收起，静止 6 秒自动播放师徒赶路追逐动画。角色由内联 SVG 绘制，无外部图片依赖，可安装到 DSH Web 或 Desktop profile。
description.en: Presents Tang Monk, Sun Wukong, Zhu Bajie, Sha Seng, and the White Dragon Horse in a frameless, transparent, always-on-top widget. Click to cycle characters, drag to move, hover to collapse, and leave it still for six seconds to start the group-chasing animation. The characters are inline SVG with no external image dependencies, and the plugin can run in DSH Web or Desktop profiles.

description.zh: 面向 Web GUI 与桌面端的外观套件，提供 32 款莫兰迪、马卡龙和中国传统色主题，支持视频/静态壁纸、7 种东方纸纹、分区透明度与文字深浅调节，并附带可拖动、缩放的键盘桌宠。支持跟随系统/浅色/深色；分区样式与桌宠依赖宿主 shell 结构，升级后可能需要适配。
description.en: An appearance kit for Web and Desktop with 32 Morandi, Macaron, and Chinese-traditional presets, video and still wallpapers, seven adjustable East-Asian paper textures, per-zone opacity and text depth, and a draggable, resizable keyboard pet. It supports system/light/dark modes; per-zone styling and the pet depend on the host shell structure and may need adjustment after upgrades.

description.zh: 可浮动、拖动和调整大小的视频播放器。
description.en: A floating, draggable, resizable video player.

description.zh: Studio 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 18 套主题、按工作区分配主题，以及从心情、颜色、文字或图片生成主题的编辑器；还包括液态玻璃、壁纸、字体、外观定时切换、布局与专注模式、AI 模式、任务提醒、用量与成本面板、聊天导出、无障碍、保存提示词、Ctrl+K 快速切换和 19 种语言。默认设置留在本机；只有主动开启同步时才会上传所选设置，上传图片默认不离开本机。固定版本要求 DSH 0.2 Web profile 和 Node 22.5+；MIT 许可。
description.en: Studio adds 18 themes, per-workspace themes, and an editor that can generate themes from a mood, colour, word, or image to DeepSeek Harness. It also includes liquid glass, wallpapers, fonts, scheduled looks, layout and focus mode, AI modes, task alerts, usage and cost views, chat export, accessibility options, saved prompts, a Ctrl+K quick switcher, and 19 languages. Settings stay on the machine by default; only selected settings are uploaded when sync is enabled, and uploaded images remain local unless explicitly included. The fixed version requires DSH 0.2 on the Web profile and Node 22.5+. MIT licensed.

description.zh: 从设置中导入 PNG/JPG/WebP 图片，使用 k-means 提取主色、辅色和强调色，自动生成明暗主题令牌，并将图片作为可调浓度/模糊的背景；另提供独立的桌面宠物窗口，含 5 种形象、拖拽定位和 Agent 忙闲联动。宠物窗口通过 Windows WPF/PowerShell 启动，位置使用 Win32 坐标；插件设置保存在浏览器 `localStorage`。
description.en: Import PNG/JPG/WebP images from Settings and use k-means to derive primary, secondary, and accent colors for light and dark theme tokens, with adjustable background intensity and blur. It also provides a separate desktop pet window with five character options, drag positioning, and agent-busy linkage. The pet uses Windows WPF/PowerShell and Win32 coordinates; plugin settings are stored in browser `localStorage`.

description.zh: 全站换成豆包蓝主色配中性灰的观感：大圆角气泡、卡片与输入框、快捷胶囊，亮暗两套完整色板跟随宿主主题切换。侧栏与首页换成自绘的对话气泡标记和四个快捷入口，另加一页「关于」设置。
description.en: A Doubao-inspired full-site skin: blue brand accent on neutral greys, large rounded bubbles, cards and input, pill-shaped quick actions, and complete light and dark palettes that follow the host. The sidebar and hero get a hand-drawn chat-bubble mark plus four quick entries, with an About settings page.

description.zh: 右下角可拖拽的 Foxbell 多宠物系统：按项目显示待审批、运行、完成未读和错误断联状态卡，提供语音提醒、拖拽物理、五场景动作绑定和一键显隐；内置 Foxbell，并可从本地文件夹、ZIP、`~/.codex/pets/` 或 Petdex 导入宠物后即时热切换。外部导入有 100MB/200 文件安全限制和 8 秒在线请求超时；用量看板按 token 统计，不换算金额。
description.en: A draggable Foxbell multi-pet system with per-project cards for approval, running, done-unread, and error/disconnected states, plus voice alerts, drag physics, five action bindings, and a show/hide control. Foxbell is built in; additional pets can be imported from a local folder, ZIP, `~/.codex/pets/`, or Petdex and hot-swapped immediately. External imports enforce a 100 MB/200-file safety limit and an 8-second online-request timeout; the usage dashboard counts tokens and never converts them to money.

name.zh: 网易云 AI 控制台

description.zh: 网页版网易云音乐播放器：顶部条迷你播放器可展开为控制面板，支持扫码登录和 AI 对话控制。
description.en: A web NetEase Cloud Music player with a mini player in the top bar and an expandable control panel, plus QR-code login and AI conversation control.

name.zh: Fate / Twin Contract · 赤钢契约

description.zh: 非官方 Fate 灵感皮肤，以 Archer × Rin 为中心，随 DSH Light、Dark 和 System 模式切换，完全离线运行。它是纯展示层，不读取会话、工作区或模型配置，不改主题偏好或 `localStorage`；窄屏和移动端会隐藏人物背景，人物美术不属于代码的 MIT 授权范围。
description.en: An unofficial Fate-inspired skin centered on Archer × Rin that follows DSH Light, Dark, and System modes and runs fully offline. It is presentation-only: it does not read conversations, workspaces, or model configuration, and does not change theme preferences or `localStorage`. Character artwork is hidden on narrow and mobile layouts and is outside the code’s MIT grant.

description.zh: 葫芦娃 HULUWA EDITION 把 DSH Web UI 变成暖色宣纸与七彩葫芦娃风格：会话、文件夹和状态条使用七兄弟配色，并提供“葫芦宝匣”开关、山中时钟、修炼中状态和主题彩蛋。打字、消息与通知音效由 Web Audio 实时合成；小屏会隐藏装饰，减少动态效果会停用循环动画。
description.en: HULUWA EDITION turns the DSH Web UI into a warm rice-paper and Calabash Brothers setting: conversations, folders, and status elements use the seven-color palette, with a control chest, mountain clock, “cultivating” state, and themed easter eggs. Typing, message, and notification sounds are synthesized in real time with Web Audio; small screens hide decoration and reduced-motion settings stop looping animation.

description.zh: “深夜农场”星露谷物语风格深色主题：暖棕土壤背景、麦金主色、奶油文字和草绿状态色。通过 `stardew` 主题 token 即时切换且可逆，选择跨页面重启保留，卸载后恢复原生外观。
description.en: A Stardew Valley–style “late-night farmhouse” dark theme with warm soil browns, harvest gold, cream text and grass-green status colors. It registers the `stardew` token theme for instant, reversible switching, persists the active choice across restarts, and restores the native appearance on uninstall.

description.zh: 在设置 → Wallpaper 中上传本地图片、裁切并设为 DSH Web 工作台背景；支持拖动/八向手柄裁切、可选导出模糊、`cover/contain/center/stretch` 填充，以及面板不透明度和遮罩调节，修改即时生效并跨刷新恢复。浏览器端裁切压缩为 WebP（最长边 ≤2560px），写入仅信任 localhost/loopback，配置存 `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml`。
description.en: Upload a local image from Settings → Wallpaper, crop it, and apply it as the DSH Web workspace background. It supports drag and eight-handle cropping, optional export blur, `cover/contain/center/stretch` fit modes, panel opacity, and overlay dimming, with immediate application and refresh persistence. The browser crops and compresses to WebP with a longest edge of ≤2560px; writes trust only localhost/loopback, and configuration lives in `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml`.

description.zh: 在对话中渲染可交互的音乐播放器，支持网易云音乐和 QQ 音乐双后端、玻璃拟态悬浮歌词、节拍气泡特效和多种主题。
description.en: Renders an interactive music player in conversations with NetEase Cloud Music and QQ Music backends, glass-style floating lyrics, beat bubble effects, and multiple themes.

description.zh: 侧栏列表下方的几何风「小蓝」会跟随真实会话进入待机、思考、工具、等待确认、完成或异常状态，并提供三段连贯点击动画、任务提醒、拖动/键盘定位和独立外观设置。支持 100–220px 大小、25–100% 透明度、安静模式与 `prefers-reduced-motion`；不发声音或 Windows 通知，也不会自动确认授权、回答问题、发送消息或调用模型。
description.en: Little Blue, a geometric sidebar companion, follows real sessions through idle, thinking, tool, approval, completed, and error states. It adds three complete click animations, task reminders, drag and keyboard positioning, and independent appearance settings with 100–220 px sizing, 25–100% opacity, quiet mode, and `prefers-reduced-motion` support. It makes no sound or Windows notifications and never approves requests, answers questions, sends messages, or calls a model automatically.

description.zh: 提供 25 套《终端美学》配色、中文优先等宽字体、紧凑对话布局，以及可折叠的思考块与工具链胶囊；还可显示官方账户余额、本轮成本和近 30 天用量图表。
description.en: Provides 25 Terminal Aesthetics palettes, Chinese-first monospaced font options, a compact conversation layout, and collapsible thinking/tool-chain capsules. It can also show official account balance, per-turn cost, and a 30-day usage chart.

description.zh: 以 WebGL 实时光线追踪的史瓦西黑洞为背景，渲染引力透镜、吸积盘与光子环，并以深空玻璃面板和吸积盘琥珀强调色覆盖 DSH Web。插件加载即启用，没有设置开关；半分辨率、30fps、`prefers-reduced-motion` 和 WebGL 不可用时的纯黑深空回退用于控制性能，禁用或卸载会恢复原主题。仅适用于含 webServer 的 profile，要求 dsh ≥ `0.1.0-rc.7`。
description.en: A WebGL real-time ray-traced Schwarzschild black hole forms the background, with gravitational lensing, an accretion disk, and a photon ring beneath deep-space glass panels and accretion-disk amber accents. The theme is enabled on load with no settings toggle. Half-resolution rendering, a 30fps cap, `prefers-reduced-motion`, and a pure-black fallback when WebGL is unavailable keep it graceful; disabling or uninstalling restores the original theme. It requires a webServer profile and dsh ≥ `0.1.0-rc.7`.

description.zh: 语音与主题音乐插件：在 agent 会话生命周期事件上播放随机语音提示，并按主题播放网易云音乐背景乐。
description.en: A voice and theme-music plugin that plays random voice prompts on agent session lifecycle events and NetEase Cloud Music background tracks by theme.

description.zh: 把请求、工具调用、上下文压缩和提示词增强等 DSH 事件转成桌宠状态，并在浮窗显示上下文占用、Token 分类、跨会话累计与趋势；支持主题、皮肤导入和可选完成提示音。
description.en: A floating pet that turns DSH events such as requests, tool calls, context compaction, and prompt enhancement into status animations, while showing context usage, token categories, cross-session lifetime totals, and trends; it also supports themes, skin imports, and optional completion sounds.

description.zh: 把 DSH 网页端改成墨纸配色的浅色界面：暖奶油与墨色、磨砂玻璃面板、楷体感的会话正文与等宽代码。聊天上方新增最近会话页签栏，用状态点区分运行、等待、完成与空闲；会话/追踪切换收进同一行做成分段控件，侧栏品牌换成手写「jimmy」与小狗头像。
description.en: Restyles the DSH web client as a light ink-and-paper surface: warm cream and ink colours, frosted-glass panels, Kai-style conversation text, and monospace code. A recent-conversation tab rail with live status dots sits above the chat, the Conversation/Trace switch becomes a compact segmented control, and the sidebar brand is a handwritten “jimmy” wordmark with a dog avatar.

description.zh: 魈主题以青玉/翠青配色、吉祥物徽章和磨砂背景为默认，支持自定义主色、头像、背景、透明度、GIF/MP4/WebM/MOV/M4V 视频、背景轮播和主题导入导出；还可为工作会话注入仅改变语气的魈式提示，并提供独立的娱乐角色预设。角色预设默认不挂文件、命令或任务工具；自定义工作提示会原样加入每个会话，作者建议只写语气。当前版本建议 DSH `v0.1.5-alpha.1`+，更早版本应使用 `0.11.x`；可选的 `better-sidebar` 仅按 `0.19.x` 路线适配，旧版 `<=0.18` 不保证。魈/《原神》素材不随 MIT 代码许可，作者禁止未经授权的商用或再分发。
description.en: Xiao Theme starts with a jade/emerald palette, mascot badge, and frosted background, then lets users customize the accent, avatar, backgrounds, opacity, GIF/MP4/WebM/MOV/M4V video, background rotation, and theme import/export. It can add a tone-only Xiao-style prompt to work sessions and provides a separate entertainment roleplay preset. The roleplay preset mounts no file, command, or task tools by default; custom work prompts are inserted verbatim into every session, so the author recommends using tone instructions only. The current release targets DSH `v0.1.5-alpha.1` and newer, with `0.11.x` for older DSH; optional `better-sidebar` support follows the `0.19.x` path, while `<=0.18` is not adapted. Xiao/Genshin assets are not covered by the MIT code license and are not for unauthorized commercial use or redistribution.

description.zh: 暖调像素主题：亮色为暖米白纸面与深褐墨字，暗色为街机琥珀磷光；提供像素字体、方角/硬描边、CRT 扫描线、开屏自检和流式输出状态动效。可在设置中调整强度、动效、扫描线和字体，开启减少动态效果时关闭动效；需要 DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 及以上。
description.en: A warm pixel theme with cream paper and dark-brown ink in light mode, and arcade amber phosphor in dark mode. It adds pixel fonts, square hard-edged surfaces, CRT scanlines, a startup self-test, and streaming/state effects. Configure intensity, motion, scanlines, and fonts in Settings; reduced-motion mode disables the effects. Requires DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 or newer.

description.zh: 直播电台播放器，提供主题化播放器、情绪频道和本地收听历史。
description.en: Live radio with themed players, mood channels, and local listening history.

description.zh: 把整个 DSH Web GUI 换成可跟随宿主明暗的终端/蓝图主题：覆盖会话、侧栏、代码、工具卡、弹窗、输入框与设置页，并在空白首页提供字符雨、旋转 DSH-chan、等高线场、Boot 自检和真实 SYS/WORKSPACE/MODEL HUD；进入会话后保留遥测条，显示上下文压力、输入/输出/缓存命中与解码速度。模型账本来自 DSH 的 `storages/session_projcache`，时间窗按会话最近活动近似统计；CPU/温度/网络等系统指标按平台提供，缺失行会隐藏，全部数据只读本机。
description.en: Reskins the entire DSH Web GUI in a host-following terminal/blueprint style, covering sessions, sidebar, code, tool cards, dialogs, composer, and settings. The blank home screen adds sparse character rain, a rotating DSH-chan, contour fields, a boot self-test, and live SYS/WORKSPACE/MODEL HUD panels; sessions retain a telemetry strip for context pressure, input/output/cache hits, and decode speed. The model ledger reads DSH's `storages/session_projcache` and buckets time windows approximately by last session activity; platform-dependent CPU, temperature, and network rows are hidden when unavailable, and all data stays read-only on the machine.

description.zh: 以 DeepSeek 首页为灵感的 DSH Web 主题：深蓝渐变、半透明玻璃、程序化流体背景、鼠标弹性网格和两条会避让指针的小鱼；效果可开关，并适配减少动态效果。
description.en: A DSH Web theme inspired by the DeepSeek homepage, with a deep-blue gradient, translucent glass, a procedural fluid background, a mouse-reactive elastic grid, and two fish that avoid the pointer. Effects are toggleable and respect reduced-motion preferences.

description.zh: 深海男仆工坊是鲸鱼男仆主题皮肤，加入少年鲸鱼男仆与成年鲸鱼管家两张左右立绘、Q 版侧栏吉祥物、日夜宫殿背景及深海蓝金 UI；支持响应式着陆页、对话页、工作区和窄侧栏，素材以内嵌 data URI 提供。项目为衍生创作，采用 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0，仅限非商业使用。
description.en: A deep-sea butler skin with two original male whale characters—a young whale butler and an adult whale steward—plus a Q-version sidebar mascot, day/night palace backdrops, and navy-and-gold UI. It adapts across the landing, conversation, workspace, and narrow-sidebar views, with artwork embedded as data URIs. This derivative work is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and non-commercial.

description.zh: 星露谷主题把 DSH Web UI 换成温暖的像素农场风，包含聊天气泡、侧栏 Logo、农舍配色和昼夜场景；在设置 → 通用 → 主题风格中手动开启，默认关闭，浅/深外观对应白天/黑夜。主题只改视觉且内嵌图片；插件代码为 MIT，但随包美术素材不在 MIT 范围内，仅供非商业同人使用。
description.en: Stardew Valley Theme turns the DSH Web UI into a warm pixel-art farm with themed chat bubbles, sidebar logo, farmhouse palette, and day/night scenes. Enable it manually in Settings → General → Theme Style; it is off by default, with Light and Dark mapped to day and night. The theme is visual-only and embeds its images. The plugin code is MIT, but the bundled artwork is not and is intended for non-commercial fan use.

description.zh: ZCode 风格的侧栏与工作区会话树，支持置顶、分组、拖动排序、全局搜索和对话轮次跳转，明暗配色跟随宿主。
description.en: A ZCode-style sidebar and workspace session tree with pinning, grouping, drag-to-reorder, global search and turn navigation, in light and dark palettes that follow the host.

description.zh: 我的主题管理器可从本地路径或 GitHub 导入主流 DSH 皮肤包，扫描 Web profile 的 `node_modules`，预览、使用、刷新和管理皮肤，并在 Host 端持久化库；本地导入可选择原地引用或托管复制，界面跟随 DSH 中英文。被导入的包需包含 `dsh.bundle`、`skin.json` 和导出 `apply(ctx)` 的 `lib/client.js`。
description.en: My Themes Manager imports mainstream DSH skin packages from local paths or GitHub, scans the Web profile’s `node_modules`, and lets users preview, use, refresh, and manage them from a host-persisted library. Local imports can stay in place or be copied into managed storage, and the UI follows DSH Chinese/English. Imported packages must declare `dsh.bundle`, include `skin.json`, and provide a `lib/client.js` ModuleLoader bundle exporting `apply(ctx)`.

description.zh: Amadeus 主题皮肤将《Steins;Gate 0》/Amadeus 风格带入 DSH Web，使用 Future Gadget Lab 场景背景、Kurisu 立绘、Amadeus 风格对话框与输入区，并在删除会话时触发 Reading Steiner 世界线扰动效果。README 建议使用深色模式。
description.en: An Amadeus (Steins;Gate 0) skin for DSH Web with a Future Gadget Lab backdrop, Kurisu artwork, Amadeus-style conversation and composer surfaces, and a Reading Steiner worldline-distortion effect when sessions are deleted. The README recommends dark mode.

description.zh: 常驻右下角的兔耳少女「小舞」是原创手绘 SVG 角色，会从当前会话真实状态推导待机、思考、工具、等待确认、完成、出错和睡眠七种心情；成功完成时跳起撒花并用 WebAudio 实时合成「做完啦……」，无录音或采样文件。点击可互动、面板可查看工具/会话，首次交互才解锁音频，`prefers-reduced-motion` 会压缩动画。
description.en: Xiaowu is an original hand-drawn SVG rabbit-eared companion in the bottom-right corner. She derives seven moods from the current session: idle, thinking, working, waiting, done, error, and sleep. On a successful completion she jumps with confetti and synthesizes “Done…” in real time with Web Audio—there are no recordings or sampled voice files. Click to interact, inspect the current tool and session in the panel, unlock audio on first interaction, and let `prefers-reduced-motion` shorten the animations.

description.zh: 《崩坏：星穹铁道》流萤「春日手信」同人皮肤：春草绿/萤火双主题、87 个 DSH token、春日橱窗（拱窗、光束、花瓣、萤火）、半透明玻璃面板和可隐藏的左右立绘，并在设置中分别开关皮肤与立绘。仅支持 Web，立绘为 HoYoverse/miHoYo 第三方素材，README 声明按同人指引仅限非商业使用并需署名。
description.en: A fan skin for Firefly's “Spring Missive” outfit from *Honkai: Star Rail*, with spring-grass and firefly palettes across 87 DSH tokens, a spring-window scene with arches, light beams, petals, and fireflies, translucent glass panels, and optional mirrored character art. The skin and artwork have separate settings toggles. Web only; the character art is third-party HoYoverse/miHoYo material and the README limits it to non-commercial fan use with attribution.

description.zh: 启动时铺满播放指定视频，播完 0.3 秒渐隐露出界面；自带一段默认视频装好即用，也可在设置里换成自己的，清空路径即彻底关闭。
description.en: Plays your chosen video over the full screen at startup and fades it out over 0.3 seconds; a default video works out of the box, you can swap in your own, and clearing the path turns it off entirely.

description.zh: 深海终端：蓝色终端框线、消息卡片与代码块；空白会话显示大肥鱼角色欢迎画面，会话状态（思考、工具执行、输出、等待确认）用竖条脉冲提示，底部显示 DSH 进程 CPU 占用。欢迎图、访客来访、底部状态栏、纹理暗角、动效与大肥鱼人设都能单独开关，需配合皮肤管理器使用。
description.en: A terminal-style deep-sea skin for DSH Desktop: blue terminal frames, message cards and code blocks, a large-fish welcome screen, session states shown with vertical pulses and a CPU readout at the bottom. Welcome art, guest visits, status bar, CRT texture, motion and the large-fish persona all have separate switches; the DSH Skin Manager is required for the settings.

description.zh: 把 DSH 的思考块与工具输出分段播放，让视口跟随新内容，并在运行开始时展开、下一条内容出现后收起；另可切换 Claude 配色、字体与单个动态 Logo。
description.en: Replays DSH thinking blocks and tool output in segments, follows new content, expands blocks when work starts, and closes them when the next item appears. Optional layers switch the Claude palette, fonts, and a single animated logo.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的交互式桌宠，按任务、工具调用、上下文占用和活跃会话切换状态表情；支持状态气泡、会话提示、审批/提问交互，以及拖动、折叠和缩放。
description.en: An interactive pet for DeepSeek Harness Web that changes expressions for tasks, tool calls, context usage, and active sessions; it adds status bubbles, session indicators, approval/question interactions, and drag, collapse, and resize controls.

description.zh: 本地音乐、AI 讲书、新闻播报和网络电台播放器，并提供 music_play 工具，让 agent 可以按对话指令播放音乐或启动朗读。
description.en: A player for local music, AI-narrated novels, news broadcasts, and internet radio. Its music_play tool lets an agent start playback or narration from a conversation.

name.zh: DSH Nekojishi VN 视觉小说主题

description.zh: 将 DSH 变成视觉小说舞台：背景、左右人物、悬浮对话流、贴底输入框和随任务状态变化的表情，同时保留原生模型、项目、工具和权限。公开版默认使用原创生成的三张场景与合成音乐，不含游戏角色资源；可在本机导入 Nekojishi 1.06s 资源。当前仅完整验证于 Windows 桌面端 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2，其他系统与版本未完整验证。
description.en: Turns DSH into a visual-novel stage with backgrounds, side characters, a floating dialogue flow, a bottom-anchored composer, and expressions driven by real task states while keeping native models, projects, tools, and permissions. The public build uses three original generated scenes and synthesized music and does not include game character assets; Nekojishi 1.06s resources can be imported locally. Full verification is documented only for Windows Desktop with DSH 0.2.1-rc.2.

description.zh: 把 Anthropic Codex 风格的 `#F8F6F1` 暖白、`#1E1D1B` 墨色和 `#CA7554` 铜色配色注入 DSH Web UI，并配套 DM Sans / JetBrains Mono 字体栈与浅/深两套 token。此条目对应仓库子路径 `plugins/anthropic-theme` 的 `dsh-anthropic-theme` 包；不要把同仓库的 macOS Tauri 桌面壳误写成主题功能。
description.en: Injects an Anthropic Codex-style palette into the DSH Web UI: warm white `#F8F6F1`, ink `#1E1D1B`, copper `#CA7554`, and DM Sans / JetBrains Mono font stacks with light and dark token sets. This entry is the `dsh-anthropic-theme` package at `plugins/anthropic-theme`; the repository's separate macOS Tauri desktop shell is not part of the theme.

description.zh: 滑动变阻器风格皮肤。
description.en: A sliding-variable-resistor-style skin.

description.zh: 将 DSH 的 0–30 推理强度映射为五个马斯克主题阶段，并把推理等级改成紧凑滑块；界面会同步人物、背景和配色，设置中可切回原生外观。
description.en: Maps DSH's 0–30 reasoning-intensity range to five Musk-themed stages and replaces the control with a compact slider. The character, background, and colors follow the selected stage, with a setting to return to the native appearance.

description.zh: 皮肤切换器与自定义壁纸层，支持 --dsw-alias-* 调色板、透明度/模糊控制，并按浏览器持久保存设置。
description.en: A skin switcher and custom wallpaper layer with --dsw-alias-* palettes, opacity and blur controls, and per-browser persistence.

description.zh: 轻量主题切换器，可自动检测已安装皮肤并互斥切换；全部停用时回退官方外观，切换即时生效并跨重启保留。
description.en: A lightweight theme switcher that detects installed skins and switches between them exclusively, falls back to the official appearance when none is active, and persists across restarts.

description.zh: 在 Settings → General → Theme 中提供 Cream、Novel、Calm、Modern Classic 和 Deep Work 五套主题，每套都有浅/深调色板，选择保存为 Host 偏好并可即时切换。通过 `ctx.theme.overrideTokens()` 覆盖约 117 个派生 token，只改变配色；字体、圆角、语法高亮和壁纸仍由 DSH 控制。项目已在 macOS Apple Silicon 的 DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2/0.2.1-rc.2 上验证，Windows/Linux 未验证。
description.en: Adds Cream, Novel, Calm, Modern Classic, and Deep Work to Settings → General → Theme, with a light and dark palette for each. The choice is persisted as a Host preference and switches live. It uses `ctx.theme.overrideTokens()` to derive about 117 tokens while changing colors only; fonts, radii, syntax highlighting, and wallpapers remain DSH-controlled. Verified on macOS Apple Silicon with DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.2; Windows and Linux are unverified.

name.zh: 富士山下 · 黄昏便利店

description.zh: 用一张黄昏富士与便利店照片铺满整个窗口，上面盖一层随设置变化的冷白玻璃；九种材质、四种边缘、漏光与暗角都可调，输入框和面板沿用同一套材质。输入框上方还有 1236 条氛围语句、系统时间与 Open-Meteo 天气，开场是约 4 秒可跳过的显影动画。
description.en: A glass theme built around a dusk Fuji / Lawson photograph that covers the whole window, with nine material finishes, four edge styles, light-leak and vignette controls, and the same material carried onto the composer and panels. A quote bar of 1,236 lines, system time and Open-Meteo weather sit above the composer, and a roughly 4-second opening animation can be skipped.

description.zh: 以 DeepSeek 官网为灵感，深色搭配流体极光、粒子鲸鱼和星座网格，浅色采用蓝色渐变与玻璃面板，随宿主外观切换。
description.en: Inspired by the DeepSeek website, with fluid aurora, a particle whale and a constellation grid in dark mode, blue gradients and glass panels in light mode, and switching tied to the host’s appearance setting.

description.zh: 以锦鲤池塘为意象的 DSH Web 皮肤：墨青池水、波纹纹理、锦鲤橙红点缀，包含“池塘夜色”深色与“宣纸日色”浅色模式。原生 Canvas 2D 鱼群会聚群、随鼠标逃逸并响应点击水波；系统减少动态效果时降为静态，页面隐藏时暂停。它是纯展示层，只覆盖 `--dsw-alias-*` 等设计 token 与部件样式，不注入服务或触达模型请求。
description.en: A koi-pond-inspired DSH Web skin with ink-teal water, ripple textures and koi orange-red accents, offering dark “Pond Night” and light “Rice-Paper Day” modes. Its vanilla Canvas 2D fish school uses flocking, mouse-flee behavior and click ripples; reduced motion falls back to a static render and hidden tabs pause it. It is presentation-only, overriding `--dsw-alias-*` tokens and component styles without injecting services or touching model requests.

description.zh: 设置 → 主题中的主题管理器，内置「森林绿」和「海洋蓝」，支持上传可信的 `__ModuleLoader__.load` 格式 JS 主题，应用 `overrideTokens`、CSS 和 slots UI，并在主题间一键切换。主题文件与选中状态保存到 DSH home 磁盘；上传的 JS 会在页面中直接执行，请只使用可信文件。
description.en: A Settings → Themes manager with built-in Forest Green and Ocean Blue themes. It accepts trusted `__ModuleLoader__.load` JavaScript themes that can apply `overrideTokens`, CSS, and slots UI, and provides one-click switching. Theme files and the selected state are stored on disk in the DSH home; uploaded JavaScript executes directly in the page, so use trusted files only.

description.zh: 非官方《崩坏：星穹铁道》大黑塔同人主题，提供紫黑与晨光双配色、统一玻璃材质、藏镜图库和独立动态待机。
description.en: An unofficial Honkai: Star Rail theme featuring The Herta, with purple-black and morning-light palettes, glass surfaces, an image gallery and a separate animated idle mode.

description.zh: 以白蓝配色、毛玻璃侧栏与输入框重塑 DSH 外观，右侧显示带渐隐处理的鲸鱼娘女仆立绘，并替换新会话与插件页图标；无构建与运行时依赖，卸载后可还原原生界面。代码与美术分别许可。
description.en: A lightweight blue-and-white DSH theme with frosted sidebars and composer, a softly faded whale-maid illustration on the right, and custom new-session and plugin icons. It has no build or runtime dependency and restores the native interface when uninstalled; code and artwork are licensed separately.

description.zh: 用两层全屏、点击穿透 Canvas 构成动态鲸鱼背景：WHALE 轮廓粒子会从散点聚合、空闲呼吸，并沿指针路径留下约 1 秒后合拢的通道；底层叠加 90px 点线网格，指针悬停会放大点阵。主题随 `body[data-ds-dark-theme]` 每帧读取，动画约 30fps，页面隐藏时暂停；全局 CSS 会覆盖整个页面背景且没有设置面板。
description.en: Builds an animated whale background from two full-viewport, click-through canvases. Particles sampled from the WHALE silhouette assemble from scattered points, breathe at idle, and leave a pointer-path channel that closes after about a second; a 90 px dot grid underneath swells around the pointer. It reads `body[data-ds-dark-theme]` every frame, runs at about 30 fps, and pauses when the page is hidden. Its global CSS overrides the whole page background and the package has no settings panel.

description.zh: Web 端的星尘与极光视差开场，衔接同图的浅色主界面壁纸；可更换头像和背景，预览节日效果，并自定义打字机问候语。
description.en: An animated Web welcome screen with stardust, aurora and layered parallax, plus matching light-mode wallpaper, custom portrait and background images, live previews, seasonal effects and a typewriter greeting.

description.zh: 神里绫华主题插件：右侧半透明立绘、输入框右上角可点击的 Q 版头像（语音与文字气泡同步）、樱花与雪花飘落，以及亮/暗双模式的冰蓝配色。安装到 DSH Web 后需重启；README 建议使用深色外观，否则浅色模式可能出现过亮的白底效果。
description.en: A Kamisato Ayaka theme for the DSH Web client with a translucent right-side portrait, a clickable chibi Ayaka at the composer, synced voice and text bubbles, falling sakura and snow, and an icy-blue light/dark palette. Restart DSH Web after installation; the README recommends dark appearance because light mode can become overwhelmingly white.

name.zh: 桑多涅 · 衬线排版补丁

description.zh: 以随包的 Source Serif 4 Variable 为正文主字体，让代码与横幅字号随设置等比缩放，并覆盖皮肤的代码字族；另含表格调整与长会话屏外渲染优化。
description.en: Uses bundled Source Serif 4 Variable for body text, scales code and banner text with the user’s font-size setting, and overrides skin code-font rules; also adjusts tables and defers offscreen message rendering.

name.zh: 时装工坊 · 界面设定

description.zh: DSH Web 主题定制插件，提供 Nous 蓝明暗配色、四套预设、13 色自定义、可调氛围光，以及图片或静音视频背景；支持配色导入导出和跨刷新、重启保存。
description.en: A DSH Web theme customizer with light/dark Nous Blue palettes, four presets, 13 custom colors, adjustable ambient glow, and image or muted-video backgrounds; supports palette import/export and persistence across refreshes and restarts.

description.zh: 移植 YiziMarkdown 设计语言的 19 款主题包，全部提供亮/暗配色并跟随系统；支持自定义主题工作室（从一个主题色派生完整调色板）、自定义 Logo/字样/徽章/新会话标题、品牌尺寸调节和 `/theme` 切换命令。当前 0.5.x 面向 Harness ≥ `v0.1.2-alpha.1` 的 `dsh-client-store` 一代；更老的 rc.5/rc.8 需使用 0.3.x。
description.en: A 19-theme pack porting the YiziMarkdown design language, with light/dark palettes that follow the system. It includes a custom-theme studio that derives a full palette from one accent, custom logo/wordmark/badge/new-session branding, brand-size control, and the `/theme` command. The 0.5.x line targets the `dsh-client-store` generation of Harness ≥ `v0.1.2-alpha.1`; older rc.5/rc.8 builds need the 0.3.x line.

description.zh: 琥珀磷光 CRT 终端皮肤：把 DSH 令牌换成琥珀单色阶，加入磷光泛光、扫描线、曲面暗角、直角与带角标的框选面板，并用 Web Audio 合成点击、悬停、输入、Enter/Backspace 音效。音效默认开启，首次交互后才播放，可用 `Alt` + `Shift` + `M` 静音；无需字体或音频文件。README 以 DSH Web `0.1.5-rc.1`/Desktop `0.1.7-rc.2` 的 Windows 11 为验证范围，其他版本未测。
description.en: An amber-phosphor CRT skin that replaces DSH's token palette with a monochrome amber ramp, adds phosphor bloom, scanlines, a curved-screen vignette, square corners, and boxed panels with corner brackets, and synthesizes click, hover, typing, Enter, and Backspace cues with Web Audio. Sound is on by default but starts only after the first interaction; `Alt` + `Shift` + `M` mutes it. No fonts or audio files are bundled. The README's verification scope is Windows 11 with DSH Web `0.1.5-rc.1` and Desktop `0.1.7-rc.2`; other versions are untested.

description.zh: 绿色 Pip-Boy 磷光主题用 Vault-Tec 角框、方形面板、玻璃高光和稳定的无扫描线画面重塑界面；警告保持琥珀色、错误保持红色，并提供首次交互后启用的 Web Audio 终端提示音。固定证据验证于 Windows 11 的 DSH Web 0.1.5-rc.1 与桌面版 0.1.7-rc.2；这是未获 Bethesda 背书的非商业粉丝主题，且未发布到 npm。
description.en: A green Pip-Boy phosphor treatment with Vault-Tec corner frames, squared panels, a glass sheen, and a stable screen with no scanlines or flicker; warnings stay amber, errors stay red, and synthesized Web Audio cues begin after the first interaction. The README verifies DSH Web 0.1.5-rc.1 and desktop 0.1.7-rc.2 on Windows 11; it is an unofficial, non-commercial fan theme and is not published to npm.

description.zh: QQ2006 皮肤插件，提供 qq2006 主题、body[data-ds-skin] 镜像、全局皮肤表和完整素材。
description.en: QQ2006 skin plugin with the qq2006 theme, a body[data-ds-skin] mirror, a global skin table, and complete assets.

description.zh: 为侧栏、输入框和对话卡片统一添加毛玻璃材质，可选本地图片或循环视频壁纸，并按区域调节效果。
description.en: Apply a consistent frosted-glass material to the sidebar, composer and conversation cards, with optional local image or looping video wallpapers and per-region controls.

description.zh: Claude Code 风格的终端皮肤：暖黑终端界面、陶土橙强调色、等宽字体和终端窗口式标题栏，支持明暗双模式。
description.en: A Claude Code-inspired terminal skin with charcoal surfaces, an amber accent, monospace type, and a terminal-window title bar; it supports light and dark modes.

description.zh: 把 DSH Web 变成纸笔风格的 Cornell 笔记工作区：保留原生对话和轨迹视图，在会话旁加入可折叠 Cornell Brief，用于记录重点、关键词、状态和下一步，并为每个会话提供支持多行编辑的 `MY NOTE` 任务清单。笔记只存浏览器 `localStorage`，不会上传或改写对话；仅显示在对话页，视口小于约 1100px 时自动隐藏。
description.en: Turns DSH Web into a paper-notebook workspace while keeping native conversation and trajectory views. A collapsible Cornell Brief records focus, keywords, state, and next action beside the conversation, and each conversation gets a multiline `MY NOTE` task list with collapsible completed items. Notes stay in browser `localStorage`, are not uploaded or written into DSH messages, appear on conversation pages only, and hide below an approximately 1100px viewport.

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的 QQ 2007 灵感复古即时通信皮肤。
description.en: A QQ 2007-inspired retro messenger skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web 状态文字旁播放两套黑白鲸鱼循环动画：Refined Dive 与 Classic；支持深色主题、84/72/60 像素响应式尺寸、减少动态效果和离线内嵌，后台标签页恢复可见后会立即更新。
description.en: Plays two black-and-white whale loops beside DSH Web status text: Refined Dive and Classic. It supports dark themes, responsive 84/72/60 px sizing, reduced motion, offline embedding, and immediate refresh when a background tab becomes visible.

description.zh: 本地优先的鲸鱼世界把仅限会话 ID、事件序号、事件类型和时间戳的元数据转成可拖动伙伴、20 种可解锁鲸灵、潮汐时间线、个人海湾、收藏、成就和非惩罚远征。支持六套海湾主题、本地 PNG/文本分享和减少动态效果；不读取或导出提示词、输出、代码、路径、工具参数或工具结果。目标版本为 DSH `0.1.2-rc.1`；进度不跨设备同步，鲸群卡片仅支持本地文件导入导出，覆盖层每 5 秒轮询。
description.en: This local-first whale world turns only session ID, event sequence, event type, and timestamp metadata into a draggable companion, 20 unlockable whale spirits, a tide timeline, personal cove, collectibles, achievements, and a non-punitive expedition. It includes six cove themes, local PNG/text sharing, and reduced-motion support; it never reads or exports prompts, outputs, code, paths, tool arguments, or tool results. The target is DSH `0.1.2-rc.1`; progress does not sync across devices, whale-circle cards are local-file only, and the overlay polls every five seconds.

description.zh: 冷启动时播放六幕代码动画（黑幕标识、过曝洗白、暖白档案底板、五步授权、色散故障揭幕），结束后落到自选聊天壁纸；支持导入视频/图片、三段转场和 1~24 幕模板，34 项参数可调。
description.en: Plays a six-act code-drawn boot animation on cold start — black emblem, overexposed flash, warm dossier panel, five-step authorization, glitch reveal — then lands on your own chat wallpaper; import video or images, three transitions and 1–24-act templates, with 34 adjustable options.

name.zh: 一九四五年八月十五日

description.zh: 以陈坚油画《公元一九四五年九月九日九时》（南京受降）作为 DSH Web 对话区底图，另为选中会话和标题栏加入史料风格标记。插件只改展示层，不读会话、凭据或用户文件，不联网，卸载可还原 DOM/CSS；面向 `desktop` profile，README 以 DSH `0.1.7-rc.1` 的实测为兼容依据，油画版权另见 NOTICE。
description.en: This historical skin uses Chen Jian’s painting *The Ninth Hour of September 9, 1945*—the Nanjing surrender—as the DSH Web conversation background, with archival markers for the selected session and title bar. It is presentation-only: it reads no sessions, credentials, or user files, makes no network requests, and restores DOM/CSS on removal. It targets the `desktop` profile; the README documents testing against DSH `0.1.7-rc.1`, and the painting has a separate NOTICE.

description.zh: 稻妻雷电工房是 DSH Web 的非官方雷电将军同人主题：浅色切换樱花花房，深色切换雷暴舞台，配套紫金亚克力对话框、Q 版侧栏图标与可选工作区动图。设置可调透明度、立绘透明度和动效，支持 `prefers-reduced-motion`，还可单独启用「Raiden 雷电将军」Agent 预设；主题默认关闭，仅支持 Web，固定文档要求 DSH `0.1.0-rc.6`+，角色素材仅供主题 UI 展示，请勿单独提取或商用。
description.en: Raiden Inazuma Atelier is an unofficial Raiden Shogun fan theme for DSH Web. Light mode becomes a cherry-blossom conservatory and dark mode an electro stage, with violet-gold acrylic conversation surfaces, chibi sidebar icons, and an optional animated workspace mascot. Settings control opacity, artwork opacity, and motion, with `prefers-reduced-motion` support; a separate “Raiden” agent preset is also available. The theme is off by default, Web-only, documented for DSH `0.1.0-rc.6` and newer, and its character assets are for this UI only—not for separate extraction or commercial use.

description.zh: 塔菲同人主题，提供星夜背景、侧栏水印和 Q 版形象，并搭配粉金亚克力装饰。可分别调整自己的消息气泡、输入框和侧栏边框，不接管原生按钮交互。
description.en: An unofficial Taffy fan theme with night-sky backdrops, sidebar watermarks, chibi artwork, and pink-and-gold acrylic decoration. Customize your message bubbles, composer, and sidebar frames separately without replacing native button interactions.

description.zh: 为 DSH Desktop 提供 Tokyo Night 亮色与暗色主题，包含主题运行时配色、半透明/亚克力面板、材质模糊、遮罩模糊和可搜索的等宽字体选择器；颜色与面板透明度按可读性约束。支持 DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 及以上，0.2.1-rc.2 已验证；README 明确网页端尚未完成真实测试。
description.en: Tokyo Night light and dark themes for DSH Desktop with runtime theme registration, translucent/acrylic panels, material and mask blur, and a searchable monospace-font picker. Surface alpha is guarded for readability. It targets DSH 0.2.0-rc.1+ with DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 verified; the README says the Web profile has not received full real-device testing.

description.zh: Weniger 是一套受迪特·拉姆斯启发的极简主题：暖纸白、发丝线边框、近黑墨色与单一信号橙，采用 0–4px 方角网格和扁平表面；同时重映射明暗两套 token、代码高亮、用户气泡与输入控件，并提供中德双语的十项设计原则面板。项目是非官方致敬作品。
description.en: Weniger is a Dieter Rams-inspired minimalist theme with warm paper whites, hairline borders, near-black ink, one signal-orange accent, a 0–4px squared geometry grid, and flat surfaces. It remaps the token graph in both light and dark modes, including syntax highlighting, user bubbles, and composer controls, and adds a Chinese/German panel quoting the ten principles of good design. It is an unaffiliated homage.

description.zh: 复古麦金塔将 Mac OS 8/9 Platinum 风格带入 DSH Web：铂金灰、Chicago/Geneva/Monaco 字体、CSS 条纹壁纸、浮雕控件、硬阴影和方形滚动条。提供 Platinum/Graphite 两种皮肤，各含 Classic Blue 与 System Teal 高亮，支持可选 Happy Mac 启动屏；选择按浏览器存入 `localStorage`，可逐像素恢复内置外观。
description.en: Retro Macintosh brings Mac OS 8/9 Platinum styling to DSH Web with platinum greys, Chicago/Geneva/Monaco fonts, a CSS pinstripe desktop, beveled controls, hard shadows, and square scrollbars. It offers Platinum and Graphite skins, each with Classic Blue or System Teal accents, plus an optional Happy Mac startup splash. Choices persist in browser `localStorage`, and switching back restores the built-in appearance pixel-identically.

description.zh: 以 Night City 为灵感的主题覆盖黑紫底色、2077 黄（`#FCEE0A`）、霓虹青（`#00E5FF`）和品红，加入切角 HUD 面板、渐隐网格、CRT 扫描线、SVG 故障字标与三套可调光标；还可从 Wallpaper Engine 选择静态、视频帧或动态 WebP 壁纸。目标是 DSH Web `0.2.x`；Wallpaper Engine 与 `ffmpeg` 都是可选的，视频壁纸缺少 `ffmpeg` 时退回封面，部分样式依赖 DSH 内部类名后缀。
description.en: A Night City reskin with near-black purple surfaces, Cyberpunk 2077 yellow (`#FCEE0A`), neon cyan (`#00E5FF`), magenta accents, chamfered HUD panels, a receding grid, CRT scanlines, an SVG-glitch wordmark, and three adjustable cursors. It can also use static covers, extracted video frames, or animated WebP wallpapers from Wallpaper Engine. Targets DSH Web `0.2.x`; Wallpaper Engine and `ffmpeg` are optional, video falls back to a cover without `ffmpeg`, and some styling relies on DSH internal class-name suffixes.

description.zh: 轻拟物与磨砂玻璃主题，提供暖色浅色/深色配色、环境光、颗粒纹理和细腻微交互。
description.en: A neumorphism and glassmorphism theme with warm light/dark palettes, ambient lighting, grain texture, and subtle micro-interactions.

description.zh: 低照度深海配色，以青蓝高光和细描边区分层次；纯 CSS 调整底色、文本、菜单和输入框，不改变原有布局。
description.en: A low-light deep-sea palette with cyan-blue accents and fine borders, restyling backgrounds, text, menus and inputs through CSS without changing the layout.

description.zh: 定时轮换应用背景壁纸，使用交叉淡化过渡；可从本地文件夹读取图片或使用 4 张内置 SVG 渐变，并在设置页调节顺序/随机、透明度、压暗、毛玻璃和文字阴影。
