description.en: Rotate application background wallpapers on a timer with cross-fade transitions. Use images from a local folder or four bundled SVG gradients, and adjust sequential or random order, opacity, dimming, blur and text shadow in Settings.

description.zh: 微信风格皮肤把 DSH Web UI 重排为 Windows 微信观感：左侧功能栏、会话列表、微信式绿/白消息气泡、头像和可拖拽调整高度的输入框，并提供 5 档字号与头像上传。它只作用于浅色模式；深色模式自动回退官方外观，副标题记录在浏览器 `localStorage`，窄屏侧栏收起仍由 DSH 自身控制。
description.en: WeChat Skin gives the DSH Web UI the look of WeChat for Windows: a far-left function rail, conversation list, WeChat-style green and white bubbles, avatars, and a composer whose height can be dragged. It adds five font-size levels and avatar upload. The skin applies only to light mode; dark mode falls back to the official look, subtitles are stored in browser `localStorage`, and narrow-screen sidebar collapse remains DSH behavior.

description.zh: 参考 DeepSeek 官网首页视觉的玻璃主题：流体流动背景、带边缘折射的液态玻璃面板、玻璃侧栏与输入框、磨砂顶栏，以及运行中子代理进度面板，明暗双主题可切。还可开启按北京时间峰谷变色的 DSTT 模式（高峰鲜红、谷时蓝或绿），高峰窗口为工作日 9–12 点与 14–18 点。
description.en: A glass theme built on the DeepSeek homepage look: a fluid particle background, liquid-glass panels with SVG edge refraction, glass sidebar and composer, a frosted header, and a running-subagent progress panel, in light and dark. An optional DSTT mode shifts the brand colour with Beijing-time peak and valley windows (weekdays 9–12 and 14–18).

description.zh: 按 Windows 2000 度量表重塑 DSH Web GUI：经典灰色控件、双色渐变标题栏、1px 立体浮雕、绝对直角和 16px 滚动条；面板可拖动、折叠并切换暗色模式，随包提供点阵字体。全局字号为 11px，头像、状态点和开关滑块也会变成方形；少数依赖宿主哈希类名的细化规则可能在升级后回退。
description.en: Repaints the DSH Web GUI using Windows 2000 metrics: classic gray controls, two-tone gradient title bars, 1px bevels, hard square corners, and a 16px scrollbar. The panel is draggable and collapsible, supports a dark paint, and ships bitmap fonts. Global text drops to 11px, avatars, status dots, and switch knobs also become square, and a few hashed-class refinements may fail after host upgrades.

description.zh: 融合 Material Design 3 与 Fluent 2，支持动态取色、壁纸磨砂、声纹可视化及明暗切换。
description.en: Combines Material Design 3 and Fluent 2 with dynamic colors, frosted wallpaper effects, audio visualization and light/dark switching.

description.zh: 融合 Material 3 与 Fluent 2 的主题：从壁纸派生明暗调色板，提供亚克力/云母磨砂材质、日夜圆形过渡和可调壁纸；另含系统音频声纹可视化、悬浮工具球、元素拾取、右侧多标签面板与可停靠工作台。纯 Web 部署的声纹监听需要 `getDisplayMedia` 授权并共享系统音频；壁纸会压缩为 JPEG dataURL 保存。
description.en: A Material 3 × Fluent 2 theme that derives light and dark palettes from a wallpaper and adds acrylic/mica surfaces, adjustable wallpaper framing, and a circular day/night transition. It also includes system-audio waveform visualization, a floating tool orb, an element picker, a multi-tab right sidebar, and a dockable workspace. On the Web, audio visualization requires `getDisplayMedia` permission and system-audio sharing; wallpapers are stored as compressed JPEG data URLs.

description.zh: 股市行情终端将 DSH Web 变为交易终端，并提供自选跑马灯、实时行情、持仓盈亏、指数快照和可缩放拖拽的日/周/月 K 线图（蜡烛、MA、成交量与十字光标）。支持 A 股、港股、美股、指数、加密货币和外汇，刷新间隔可设为 15/30/60 秒；行情来自腾讯、Binance、Yahoo 与 Frankfurter 聚合。
description.en: A trading-terminal skin and market panel for DSH Web with a watchlist ticker, live quotes, portfolio P/L, index snapshots, and zoomable, pannable day/week/month candlestick charts with MA, volume, and crosshair overlays. It covers A-shares, Hong Kong and US stocks, indices, crypto, and FX; polling can be set to 15/30/60 seconds, using data aggregated from Tencent, Binance, Yahoo, and Frankfurter.

description.zh: 用悬浮水豚气泡显示工作区、会话和回复里程碑，区分完成、失败与取消等结果；可选 Electron 跨窗口置顶、自定义图片和离开页面通知。
description.en: A floating capybara reports workspace/session labels, assistant milestones and distinct completion, failure or cancellation outcomes, with an optional always-on-top Electron companion, custom artwork and away notifications.

description.zh: 质感书房是一套 3D 书房皮肤：奶油墙、浅木家具、第一人称 WASD/空格移动，并可从门外进入体素风世界进行挖掘与放置。WebGL 不可用时回退到内置插画背景；需要安装现有 DSH Web 插件，不会修改官方 `.app`，浅色模式更适合。
description.en: Cozy Study is a 3D study-room skin with cream walls, light-wood furniture, first-person WASD/Space movement, and a voxel-like outdoor area for digging and placing blocks. When WebGL is unavailable it falls back to a built-in illustrated background. It installs as a plugin for an existing DSH Web setup, does not modify the official `.app`, and is recommended with light mode.

description.zh: 一只手绘 SVG 鲸鱼娘会趴在 composer 上沿，眨眼、摇尾、喷水、冒泡泡，并随 DSH 的工作、思考、成功和报错状态切换动作；点击、三连击、拖拽和自动打盹也都有反馈。资源全部本地加载，不发遥测或外部网络请求，偏好保存在 `localStorage` 的 `whale-lap:*` 键中，并支持 `prefers-reduced-motion`。
description.en: A hand-drawn SVG whale girl perches on the composer edge, blinking, swishing her tail, spraying water, and blowing bubbles while reacting to DSH work, thinking, success, and error states. Clicks, triple-clicks, dragging, and automatic naps have their own feedback. Assets load locally with no telemetry or external network calls; preferences use `localStorage` keys under `whale-lap:*`, and `prefers-reduced-motion` is respected.

name.zh: ds-hentai · ExHentai 风格画廊主题

description.zh: 将 DSH Web 包装为深炭色画廊索引界面：Front Page 支持分类筛选、会话搜索、表格/缩略图模式、重命名/分叉/归档与收藏；会话页可选皮肤输入框、搜索坞和原生右侧栏面板。对话内容仍由 DSH 原生渲染，皮肤只替换界面外壳；偏好保存在本机浏览器，支持 DSH `0.0.1-rc.5` 起的版本并已验证到 `0.2.1-rc.2`。
description.en: Wraps DSH Web in a charcoal gallery-index interface: Front Page offers category filters, session search, table/thumbnail modes, rename/fork/archive actions and favorites; the session view can use a skin composer, search dock and native right-sidebar panes. Conversation content remains native to DSH—the skin changes the chrome only—and preferences stay in the local browser. It supports DSH from `0.0.1-rc.5` and has been verified through `0.2.1-rc.2`.

description.zh: 提供流萤主题的立绘、静态与动态壁纸、萤火绿霓虹配色、开屏变身动画、氛围粒子、背景音乐播放器和打字音效；壁纸与音乐可从界面管理。
description.en: A Firefly-themed interface with character art, static and live wallpapers, firefly-green neon colors, a transformation intro animation, ambience particles, a background-music player, and typing sounds; wallpapers and music can be managed in the UI.

description.zh: 可拖拽的鲸鱼娘悬浮桌宠：监视 DeepSeek 账户余额、官方“今日已消费”、当前会话 token 用量与预估花费，并用面板展示近 7 天趋势和逐条提问花费。余额通过官方接口每 30 秒轮询；“今日已消费”需要在 Host 端配置平台凭据，余额查询需要在 Host 端配置余额凭据，会话费用则依据本机 `sessionProjections` 与官方价格计算。
description.en: A draggable whale-maid overlay pet that monitors your DeepSeek balance, official “spent today,” current-session token usage and estimated cost, with a panel for seven-day trends and per-question costs. Balance polling uses the official API every 30 seconds; “spent today” requires a Host-side platform credential, and balance lookup requires a Host-side balance credential, and session costs are calculated locally from `sessionProjections` and official pricing.

description.zh: 以白灰蓝雾色背景、整窗磨砂、悬浮玻璃侧栏与回复气泡呈现 iOS 风格，支持明暗两套配色。
description.en: An iOS-style look with a shared white-grey-blue fog background, whole-window frosting, a floating glass sidebar and reply bubbles, in light and dark palettes.

name.zh: 金铲铲 · 海克斯核心

description.zh: 金铲铲同人外观：浅色是羊皮纸棋盘地图，深色是奥术蓝黑竞技场，背景用内联 SVG 画六边形看台、金色铲影与海克斯晶体。右下角「海克斯核心」面板可换四枚强化符文、三档棋盘纹理、圆润或锐利棱角与氛围光效；「海克斯强化」三选一抽外观卡，共 12 张，本地存图鉴。
description.en: A Golden Spatula fan theme: parchment board map in light mode, arcane blue-black arena in dark mode, with original inline-SVG backdrops. The hextech-core panel switches four accent runes, three board textures, soft or sharp corners and ambience; a three-card augment draft draws from a local 12-card codex with no currency or cooldowns.

description.zh: 将 DSH Web/Desktop 客户端改成 Windows 11 WinUI 3 / Fluent 2 风格：Segoe UI Variable 与 Cascadia 字体、Mica 风格底层、亚克力弹出层、Fluent 圆角、焦点环和语义色。浅暗模式跟随 DSH 外观，Windows 系统强调色可同步；非 Windows 或无法读取注册表时回退到 WinUI 默认蓝。Mica 是页面内的模拟效果，不是系统桌面材质。
description.en: A Windows 11 WinUI 3 / Fluent 2 skin for the DSH Web and Desktop clients, with Segoe UI Variable and Cascadia fonts, a Mica-like canvas, acrylic popups, Fluent corners, focus rings, and semantic colors. Light/dark modes follow DSH appearance, and Windows system accent colors can be synchronized; other environments fall back to WinUI blue. Mica is simulated in the page, not the system desktop material.

description.zh: Odette 冰雪梦幻主题为 DSH 提供深/浅双模式背景、13 个主题 token 的冰蓝/冰紫覆盖、毛玻璃面板与输入框装饰；支持随客户端明暗切换、左下角小兽/侧栏雪花按钮开关，并将状态保存到 `localStorage`。项目声明使用《原神》官方素材的粉丝同人内容，非官方且仅作个人非商业使用。
description.en: Odette is a light/dark DSH skin with icy blue-violet token overrides, frosted panels, and decorative composer assets. It follows the client appearance setting, can be toggled from the lower-left mascot or sidebar snowflake button, and persists its state in `localStorage`. It is an unofficial fan work using official Genshin Impact assets for personal, non-commercial use.

name.zh: 液态玻璃 UI 主题

description.zh: 为 DSH Web 与 Desktop 提供液态玻璃界面：半透明磨砂面板、可调透明度/模糊/色调、SVG 边缘折射、多图轮播或 MP4/WebM 动态壁纸、字体注入和自定义 CSS。设置持久化在 `$DSH_HOME/data/glass-ui/config.json`，可导入/导出 JSON；需要支持 `backdrop-filter` 的 Chrome/Edge 91+。
description.en: A liquid-glass UI theme for DSH Web and Desktop with translucent frosted panels, adjustable opacity/blur/tint, SVG edge refraction, image carousels or MP4/WebM wallpapers, font injection and custom CSS. Settings persist in `$DSH_HOME/data/glass-ui/config.json` with JSON import/export; it requires Chrome/Edge 91+ with `backdrop-filter` support.

description.zh: DBS (DSH BGM service) 是独立于 DET 的 DSH BGM 播放器插件，提供本地音乐库、浮动播放器和由 AI 按任务控制播放。
description.en: DBS (DSH BGM service) is a standalone DSH BGM player plugin, with a local music library, floating player, and AI-driven playback by task.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 背后加入缓慢漂移的极光背景，并将面板改为轻量半透明玻璃；支持多套预设、远程图片、本地上传、深浅色跟随、压暗强度与玻璃通透度实时调节。它不使用 `backdrop-filter` 或实时模糊管线；远程图片会向图片服务暴露用户 IP，本地图片以 data URL 存入 profile，单张上限 4 MB。当前包面向 DSH 0.2.x，DSH 0.1.x 需使用 `dsh-aurora-glass@0.1.0`。
description.en: Adds a slowly drifting aurora background behind the DSH Web UI and lightweight translucent panel surfaces. It supports presets, remote images, local uploads, light/dark adaptation, and live controls for dimming and transparency. It does not use `backdrop-filter` or a real-time blur pipeline; remote images expose the user's IP to the image host, while local images are stored as data URLs in the profile with a 4 MB limit. The current package targets DSH 0.2.x; DSH 0.1.x requires `dsh-aurora-glass@0.1.0`.

description.zh: 像素动态星空主题，提供 Matrix、Sakura、Ocean、Sunset 和 Vapor 五套明暗配色、四套分层文字方案、五款内嵌像素字体（含简体中文）、方角/柔和/圆角预设、像素时钟、旋转星空与流星。所有效果可在设置页调整，减少动态效果时关闭扫描线与动效；不需要网络请求。
description.en: A pixel starfield theme with five light/dark palettes—Matrix, Sakura, Ocean, Sunset, and Vapor—four layered text schemes, five embedded pixel fonts including Simplified Chinese, corner presets, a pixel clock, a rotating starfield, and meteors. Configure everything in the settings tab; reduced-motion mode disables scanlines and motion, and no network requests are needed.

description.zh: Dota 2 The International 2016（TI6）主题，使用深空蓝黑表面、TI6 红飘带和不朽盾金点缀，并在聊天主面板绘制矢量翅膀与星空背景；浅/深模式分别提供 TI Light 与 TI Dark。设置 → TI6 Wings 可开关飘带动画层。
description.en: A Dota 2 The International 2016 (TI6) theme with deep void-navy surfaces, TI6 crimson ribbon accents, Aegis gold, and a vector-wings plus starfield background on the main chat panel. Light and dark modes use TI Light and TI Dark respectively; the ribbon animation can be toggled in Settings → TI6 Wings.

description.zh: VPet 提供五种角色形态与对应配色，可用输入框旁的滑块实时切换；开启「VPet 绑定思考等级」后，松开滑块会选择最近的模型推理档位，关闭绑定则可自由选择全部五种形态。只在支持推理等级且有多个档位的模型上显示绑定滑块；角色图片来自 VPet 项目，代码采用 MIT。
description.en: VPet adds five illustrated character forms with matching palettes, selectable from a slider beside the composer. With “VPet reasoning-level binding” enabled, releasing the slider chooses the nearest model tier; with it disabled, all five forms remain freely selectable. The binding slider is hidden for models without reasoning tiers or with only one tier; the code is MIT, while the character artwork follows VPet’s separate attribution terms.

description.zh: DSH Web 与桌面端的常驻小鲸鱼挂件，显示余额、今日用量、每轮消耗和峰谷状态徽标；附带可编辑泡泡、多套动画素材、提示音与火山 coding plan 额度查询。
description.en: A persistent whale widget for DSH Web and the desktop client that shows balance, today's usage, per-turn cost, and peak/off-peak status; it also offers editable speech bubbles, multiple animation packs, sounds, and Volcengine coding-plan quota lookup.

description.zh: 专为 `@hytime/dsh-thinking-effort` 推理档位控件设计的 CSS 皮肤：把 4px 轨道重绘为蓝紫渐变胶囊，加入星点、2.6 秒流光、着色 chip 和最高档加速效果，并分别适配浅色与深色主题。必须先安装并启用 `@hytime/dsh-thinking-effort`；它只覆盖推理档位控件，不改变全局材质，宿主 DOM 结构变化时可能静默失效，减弱动效时星点和流光会停用。
description.en: A CSS skin for the `@hytime/dsh-thinking-effort` control: it turns the plain 4px track into a blue-to-violet pill with a starfield, a 2.6-second sheen sweep, colored chips, and an accelerated highest-tier treatment, with separate light and dark palettes. `@hytime/dsh-thinking-effort` must be installed and enabled first; this skin only styles the reasoning-tier control, can silently stop matching after upstream DOM changes, and disables stars and sheen under reduced motion.

description.zh: 把 DSH 当前会话的 todo 任务清单搬到常驻悬浮球：显示已完成/总数、进行中任务名和进度环，点击展开完整清单，右键切换胶囊模式，并支持拖拽、历史归档、固定多个会话和上下/左右布局。提供 130 款共享皮肤、字色切换和浅深色跟随；只读同步，不修改官方面板或对话，支持 Desktop 与 Web，零遥测。
description.en: Moves the current DSH todo list into a persistent floating ball that shows completed/total counts, the active task name, and a progress ring. Click to expand the full list, right-click for capsule mode, and use dragging, history archiving, pinned multiple sessions, and stacked or side-by-side layouts. It includes 130 shared skins, text-color controls, light/dark following, Desktop and Web support, read-only synchronization, and no telemetry.

description.zh: 可调毛玻璃 UI 主题，保持 DSH 布局不变，提供 10%–95% 透明度与 4–40px 模糊滑块、自定义字体、图片/视频背景、多图轮播、遮罩、柔和动画和自定义 CSS。还集成网易云音乐播放器（扫码或 Cookie 登录、歌单/搜索/歌词、HTTP/SOCKS 代理或远程 API），配置可导入导出并保存到 `$DSH_HOME/data/glass-ui/config.json`；歌曲直链受版权/VIP 限制，导出配置只包含 URL，不含媒体文件。
description.en: An adjustable frosted-glass UI theme that keeps the DSH layout intact, with 10%–95% opacity and 4–40px blur sliders, custom fonts, image/video backgrounds, multi-image rotation, scrims, soft animation, and custom CSS. It also integrates a NetEase Cloud Music player with QR/Cookie login, playlists, search, lyrics, and HTTP/SOCKS or remote-API routing. Configuration can be imported/exported and is stored in `$DSH_HOME/data/glass-ui/config.json`; song URLs remain subject to copyright/VIP limits, and exports contain URL references rather than media files.

description.zh: 管理、浏览和播放本地媒体库，适配 PC 与移动端，支持滑动刷视频、即时拖拽播放和实时转码。
description.en: Manage, browse, and play a local media library on PC and mobile, with swipe-through video, instant drag-to-play, and real-time transcoding.

description.zh: 第三方 WebUI 增强插件，支持自定义背景、主题颜色、提示词预设、token/上下文显示和手动紧凑模式。
description.en: Third-party WebUI enhancement plugin with custom backgrounds, theme colors, prompt presets, token/context visibility, and manual compact mode.

description.zh: 可拖拽的 DSH 互动宠物会跟随 `typing`、`thinking`、`working`、`done`、`error` 和 `sleep` 状态切换动作，并提供抚摸、喂食、玩耍、心情与亲密度记录。当前内置宠物是 `deepseek-whale` 的 JPG/栅格形象，设置面板可换色、导入自定义定义并通过 `window.dshPet` 管理；旧版手绘 SVG 内置宠物已移除。纯浏览器端运行，不读取 API Key、不上传数据，设置与养成数据保存在本机 `localStorage`。
description.en: A draggable DSH companion that reacts to `typing`, `thinking`, `working`, `done`, `error`, and `sleep`, with petting, feeding, play, mood, and affinity tracking. The current built-in pet is the JPG/raster `deepseek-whale`; the settings studio supports recoloring, custom definitions, and the `window.dshPet` API, while the former hand-drawn SVG built-ins have been removed. It runs entirely in the browser, reads no API keys, uploads nothing, and keeps settings and progression in local `localStorage`.

description.zh: Q 版 SVG 龙猫“绒绒”常驻 DSH Web 右下角，提供待机、开心、睡觉和进食四种姿态，以及喂食、抚摸、玩耍、睡觉/唤醒等养成互动。支持拖拽、大小与透明度调节、闲置隐藏、图鉴和本地持久化；纯 JavaScript、零构建、无第三方运行时依赖。
description.en: A hand-drawn chibi Totoro SVG named Rongrong lives in the lower-right corner of the DSH Web GUI, with idle, happy, sleeping, and eating poses plus feed, pet, play, sleep, and wake interactions. It supports dragging, size and opacity controls, idle hiding, a pose gallery, and local persistence; it is plain JavaScript with no build step or third-party runtime dependencies.

description.zh: Claude Code 风格的 DSH Web 皮肤，以暖炭黑/暖米白表面、陶土橙强调色、等宽终端字体和暖色代码块重塑浏览器界面；令牌覆盖层随亮色、暗色和系统偏好适配，不改变原有交互。它是可自动注册到 profile 的 bundle，卸载后会移除自己的样式层；MIT 许可。
description.en: A Claude Code–inspired DSH Web skin with warm charcoal and cream surfaces, a terracotta accent, monospace terminal typography, and warm-tinted code blocks. Its token layer follows light, dark, and system preferences without changing the original interactions. It is a bundle that auto-registers with the profile and removes its own style layer when uninstalled. MIT licensed.

description.zh: 冷紫与纸白的明暗配色，把灰原哀的立绘、漫画分镜和 APTX 标志放进欢迎区、页头与侧栏，装饰不挡点击。设置 → 通用 → 外观里可切换主题素材、展示强度、工作台标志与减少动态效果，选「无装饰」只留配色和静态字标。
description.en: A cold-purple and paper-white theme that places Haibara artwork, manga panels and an APTX mark in the welcome area, page header and sidebar without blocking clicks. Settings → General → Appearance switches artwork, display intensity, wordmark and reduced motion, and a no-decoration mode keeps only the colours and static wordmark.

description.zh: 墨韵（MoYun）提供五套原创水墨主题：远山孤松、烟雨江南、竹影清风、梅傲霜雪和山水留白；可叠加 PNG/JPG 自定义壁纸，调节模糊、透明度与墨点、雨珠、微光粒子密度。主题基于 DSH `--dsw-*` token，设置和壁纸存入 IndexedDB，支持 8 种语言并可一键还原为 DSH 内置外观。
description.en: MoYun provides five original ink-wash themes: Lonely Pine in the Far Mountains, Misty Jiangnan, Bamboo and Clear Wind, Plum Against Frost and Snow, and Blank Landscape. Users can add PNG/JPG wallpapers and tune blur, opacity, and the density of ink-dot, raindrop, and glint particles. The themes use DSH `--dsw-*` tokens, store settings and wallpapers in IndexedDB, support eight languages, and can be reset to the built-in DSH appearance.

name.zh: 深海鲸蓝 UI 装饰

description.zh: 深海鲸蓝的 DSH Web 装饰层，覆盖亮/暗两套 14 个主题令牌，并加入鲸尾女仆元素、时钟与天气卡片、可折叠硬件状态面板和签名贴纸。背景图不随包提供，可自备；硬件面板显示哪些指标取决于本机，风扇与温度等额外传感器需要 HWiNFO 或 LibreHardwareMonitor。
description.en: A deep-sea whale-blue decoration layer for DSH Web with 14 light/dark theme tokens, whale-tail maid elements, a clock and weather card, a collapsible hardware panel, and a composer signature sticker. No background image is bundled—you supply your own. Hardware metrics depend on the machine; extra fan and temperature readings require HWiNFO or LibreHardwareMonitor.

description.zh: Hello Kitty 粉色主题为 DSH Web UI 提供粉色 alias-token 配色、自定义壁纸以及浅色/深色两套样式，安装后随 Harness 启动自动恢复，不改变聊天、模型或任务功能。壁纸可替换为 `assets/kitty-wallpaper.jpg`，样式刷新即可热更新；部分界面依赖宿主 CSS 选择器，DSH 版本升级后可能需要调整。
description.en: A Hello Kitty pink theme for the DSH Web UI with an alias-token palette, a custom wallpaper, and separate light and dark styling. It restores automatically when Harness starts and does not alter chat, model, or task behavior; replace `assets/kitty-wallpaper.jpg` for a new background, and refresh after CSS changes. Some surfaces depend on host CSS selectors, so a DSH upgrade may require selector adjustments.

description.zh: 让鲸鱼娘常驻 DSH Web 界面，提供 95 个分类动画，并按思考、编码、工具调用、等待和错误等会话状态切换动作；支持点击、拖拽、屏幕漫游、自定义动画与触发规则。
description.en: A floating whale-girl pet for the DSH Web UI with 95 categorized animations that react to thinking, coding, tool calls, waiting and errors; supports click reactions, dragging, screen roaming, custom animations and trigger rules.

description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面端和 Web 端分别设置中英文字体、代码字体、字号与强调色；内置 One Dark Pro、Dracula、Nord、GitHub 和 Catppuccin 五套明暗配色，并覆盖代码块与语法高亮。
description.en: Set separate Latin and Chinese UI/body fonts, a code font, text size, and accent colors on DSH desktop or Web. Includes light/dark palettes for One Dark Pro, Dracula, Nord, GitHub, and Catppuccin, plus code-block and syntax-highlighting coverage.

description.zh: Aqua 玻璃主题把侧栏、顶栏、发送栏及代码块、工具卡、菜单等表面改为磨砂玻璃，配合流体背景、浅深两套色板和可调的 `blur`、`frost`、`radius` 参数。当前没有设置面板，参数通过 `localStorage['dsh-aqua-glass']` 修改；视频壁纸、粒子鲸鱼等功能明确不在范围内，项目采用 AGPL-3.0。
description.en: Aqua Glass turns the sidebar, top bar, composer, code blocks, tool cards, menus, and other surfaces into frosted glass, with a fluid background, light/dark palettes, and runtime `blur`, `frost`, and `radius` controls. There is no settings panel; configure it through `localStorage['dsh-aqua-glass']`. Video wallpapers and the particle whale are explicitly out of scope, and the project is licensed under AGPL-3.0.

description.zh: Codex Theme 将 `codex-theme-v1` 的 80 套预设（浅色 26、深色 54）映射到 DSH `--dsw-*` token，可在插件面板切换浅色、深色或跟随系统，并分别记忆两种配色的选择。还可独立设置 UI 与代码字体/字号，字体下拉只列本机已安装字体；设置保存到 `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml`，支持 macOS 与 Windows 的 DSH Web。
description.en: Codex Theme maps 80 `codex-theme-v1` presets—26 light and 54 dark—onto DSH `--dsw-*` tokens. Its panel switches between Light, Dark, and Follow system and remembers selections per scheme. It also sets UI and code fonts and sizes independently, listing only fonts installed on the machine; settings are stored in `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml`, and the DSH Web client is supported on macOS and Windows.

name.zh: 交叉淡入开场与闲置屏保

description.zh: 以全屏短片替换启动页，片尾交叉溶解进入界面；另可开启闲置屏保，支持视频、图片和动图轮换，以及粒子、下坠或 Glitch 退出效果。
description.en: Replaces the startup page with a full-screen clip that crossfades into the interface. An optional idle screensaver can rotate videos, stills or animated images and exit with particle, gravity-drop or Glitch effects.

description.zh: 可视化调整七个界面区域的背景、透明度、文字与框线，另有可拖动的快捷设置浮窗。配置自动保存在浏览器中，预设可连同图片导出为 .tczp 文件并在其他电脑导入。
description.en: Visually customize backgrounds, transparency, text, and borders across seven interface regions, with a draggable quick-settings panel. Preferences save automatically in the browser, and presets can include images in .tczp files for import on another computer.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web 的「设置 → 通用 → 背景图」中设置整页壁纸，可使用 URL、`data:image/...` 或本地图片，并调节面板不透明度（50–100%）和毛玻璃模糊（0–40px）。设置保存在浏览器 `localStorage`，明暗主题自适应；固定版本只验证 DSH `0.1.0-rc.6` web profile，且样式依赖构建期哈希类名，升级大版本可能需要更新选择器。
description.en: Adds a full-page wallpaper to DSH Web under Settings → General → Background Image. You can use a URL, a `data:image/...` value, or a local image, then tune panel opacity from 50–100% and blur from 0–40px. Settings persist in browser `localStorage` and adapt to light or dark themes; the pinned release was verified only with the DSH `0.1.0-rc.6` web profile, and its CSS targets build-time hashed classes that may need updates after a major DSH upgrade.

description.zh: Nebula 动漫皮肤包内置忍者、樱花、竹林、落日和苍龙五套主题，每套都有独立的浅/深背景与点缀色；右上角“衣服”菜单可换肤，透明度滑杆范围为 0–100%（默认 50%），选择和透明度保存在 `localStorage`。
description.en: Nebula is an anime skin pack with five built-in themes—Ninja, Sakura, Bamboo, Ronin, and Ryujin—each with its own light/dark artwork and accent color. A shirt-icon menu switches skins; its transparency slider ranges from 0–100% (default 50%), with the selection and opacity saved in `localStorage`.

description.zh: 用滚筒洗衣机的动作显示模型输出、工具运行、等待确认与任务完成。提供四套造型和多会话状态，macOS 与 Windows 可使用置顶悬浮窗，并可开启通知与提示音。
description.en: A washing machine animates model output, tool activity, approval waits, and task completion. Includes four designs and multi-session status, with an always-on-top window on macOS and Windows and optional notifications and sounds.

description.zh: 第三方 Dracula 深色主题，覆盖 `--dsw-alias-*` 与 `--shiki-*` 令牌，并在设置 → Themes 中提供主题切换；首次使用默认启用 Dracula，偏好持久化于 `localStorage`。仅提供深色外观。
description.en: A third-party Dracula dark theme that overrides the `--dsw-alias-*` and `--shiki-*` tokens and adds a Settings → Themes switcher. It defaults to Dracula on first use and persists the preference in `localStorage`. Dark mode only.

description.zh: 把 DSH Web 侧边栏改为“会话 / 联系人”双模式：联系人按智能体预设展示名称和状态，可直接打开或新建绑定预设的会话；同时提供 DIY 外观面板、主题色/按钮/聊天文字颜色、按智能体保存的本地图片或图片 URL 壁纸集、渐变预设，以及对话区壁纸轮播。会话行的智能体标签需要额外的 ui-workspace 补丁，其余功能无需该补丁；目标环境为 DSH 0.1.0-rc.5、Node 22+ 和 pnpm 10+，MIT 许可。
description.en: Turns the DSH Web sidebar into Sessions and Contacts modes. Contacts list agent presets with names and status, and can open or create sessions bound to a preset; a DIY panel controls accent, button, and chat-text colours, per-agent wallpaper sets using local images, image URLs, or gradients, and a conversation carousel. The optional ui-workspace patch is only needed for the session-row agent tag; other features work without it. It targets DSH 0.1.0-rc.5 with Node 22+ and pnpm 10+. MIT licensed.

name.zh: Gemini 风格 Material 3 Expressive 主题

description.zh: 将 DSH Web 界面改造成 Google Gemini 风格的 Material 3 Expressive 视觉：71 组明暗主题令牌、Google Sans/Roboto 字体栈、圆角组件、luminous 光晕、动效、点击波纹和渐隐滚动条。它以持久化 client bundle 通过官方扩展点工作，不改宿主源码；但依赖产品 CSS-module 类名片段，上游重构后可能需要更新选择器。
description.en: Restyles the DSH Web UI in a Google Gemini–style Material 3 Expressive look with 71 light/dark token pairs, Google Sans/Roboto font stacks, rounded components, luminous glow, motion, pointer ripples and fading scrollbars. It runs as a persistent client bundle through official extension points without changing host source; its product CSS-module class-hash selectors may need updating after an upstream rebuild.

description.zh: 全局磨砂玻璃主题插件：在任意主题上叠加半透明表面 token 覆盖与全局 backdrop-filter 模糊，同时保留现有浅色或深色偏好。
description.en: Global frosted-glass theme plugin that overlays translucent surface tokens and global backdrop-filter blur on any theme while preserving the existing light or dark preference.

description.zh: 外观与主题插件，支持内置调色板、明色/暗色/跟随系统模式、Open VSX 搜索导入和 VS Code 主题导入，并持久保存主题库。
description.en: An appearance and theme plugin with built-in palettes, light/dark/system modes, Open VSX search and import, VS Code theme import, and a persistent theme library.

description.zh: Prism（棱镜）为 DSH Web 提供可调毛玻璃外观：清透、磨砂或毛绒材质，全局与六个区域的透明度，主题色/背景色，字体和字号，以及流光背景与按明暗模式轮播的图片/GIF 壁纸。设置保存在 `localStorage` 并支持跨标签同步，总开关可恢复原生界面；固定版本要求 DSH `0.1.2-alpha.1` 或更高的 Web profile。
description.en: Prism adds an adjustable glassmorphism layer to the DSH Web GUI: clear, frosted, or velvet materials; global and six-zone opacity controls; theme and backdrop colors; font and size controls; plus an aurora backdrop and light/dark wallpaper rotation for images or GIFs. Settings persist in `localStorage` and sync across tabs, while the master toggle restores the stock UI. The pinned release requires a DSH Web profile at `0.1.2-alpha.1` or later.

description.zh: 提供 Catppuccin、Gruvbox、Everforest、Nord、Dracula 等 16 套配色，在设置页点选切换，部分配色含亮暗版本。当前主题选择不会保留，刷新后需重新选择。
description.en: Choose from 16 palettes, including Catppuccin, Gruvbox, Everforest, Nord, and Dracula, in Settings. Some palettes include light and dark variants. The selection is not persisted and must be reapplied after a page refresh.

name.zh: 精装修 · 主题工作室

description.zh: 在 DSH 里打开可调的主题工作台：25 套预设（10 套原创加 15 套 VS Code 配色），可改强调色、明暗两套底色与面板色，换界面与代码字体，上传壁纸并调整铺放、透明度与模糊，切换实色到通透的面板材质。还能替换侧栏品牌、导入导出 JSON、写自定义 CSS。
description.en: A theme workbench for DSH: 25 presets (10 original plus 15 VS Code palettes), accent and light/dark surface colours, UI and code fonts with local font scanning, wallpapers with fit, opacity, dim, and blur, and four panel materials from solid to clear. It also covers corner radius, borders, grain, animation, sidebar branding, favicon, JSON import/export, and custom CSS.

description.zh: Clawd 是住在 DSH Web GUI 角落的像素宠物，会响应会话和 Agent 状态，可拖动并支持主题。项目要求 DSH `>=0.1.7-rc.1` 与 Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`；主题需另外放入 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-clawd/themes/` 或 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-clawd-themes/`，Clawd 与 Calico 等 `clawd-on-desk` 角色素材不随仓库分发，且项目明确声明为非官方同人作品。
description.en: Clawd is a draggable, themeable pixel pet that lives in the corner of the DSH Web GUI and reacts to session and agent state. It requires DSH `>=0.1.7-rc.1` and Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`; themes must be supplied under `$DSH_HOME/dsh-clawd/themes/` or `$DSH_HOME/dsh-clawd-themes/`. Clawd and Calico artwork from `clawd-on-desk` is not redistributed, and the project is explicitly unofficial fan work.

description.zh: 可切换图片背景的 DSH 皮肤插件，内置 `aurora-dawn`、`dusk-drift`、`ocean-mist` 与 `midnight-bloom` 四张渐变壁纸，也支持从 `~/.dsh/skin-center/wallpapers` 读取自有图片或输入任意 `http(s)` 图片链接。设置 → 皮肤提供启用、压暗（0–90%）和模糊（0–24px）控件，面板会随明暗模式变为半透明毛玻璃；设置写入 `skin-background` 命名空间并拒绝 `javascript:` 等非法图片引用。
description.en: A DSH skin plugin with four built-in gradient wallpapers—`aurora-dawn`, `dusk-drift`, `ocean-mist`, and `midnight-bloom`—plus user images from `~/.dsh/skin-center/wallpapers` or any `http(s)` image URL. Settings → Skin provides enable, dimming (0–90%), and blur (0–24px) controls; surfaces become translucent glass in light and dark modes. Preferences persist in the `skin-background` namespace, with validation that rejects `javascript:` and other invalid image references.

description.zh: 自定义运行状态行的图标、文字、颜色与扫光，可上传图片并调整图标旋转。默认显示旋转太极和红色「少女祈祷中」，原有用时计数保持不变。
description.en: Customize the running-status icon, text, color, and highlight sweep, including uploaded images and rotation controls. Defaults to a spinning taiji symbol and red “Maiden at Prayer” text, while keeping the elapsed-time counter.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 角落提供可交互的 3D 虎鲸桌宠，支持拖拽旋转、右键定位、爱心、弹跳和发送消息时翻跟头；可调整大小、灵敏度与显示文字。可单独安装，也已并入 dsh-ventus-plugins 整合包。
description.en: An interactive 3D orca pet for the corner of the DSH Web GUI, with drag rotation, right-click positioning, hearts, bouncing, and a celebratory flip when a message is sent. Adjust its size, sensitivity, and display text. It is available standalone and in the dsh-ventus-plugins bundle.

description.zh: 在一个设置分区中管理两套配色、壁纸、玻璃材质、动效及会话排版；关闭后恢复原生外观。
description.en: Manage two color palettes, wallpapers, glass effects, animations and conversation typography in one settings section; disable it to restore the native appearance.

description.zh: 在 DSH 原生浅色、深色和跟随系统之外，提供 Nord、Dracula、Catppuccin、Tokyo Night、One Dark、Gruvbox、Solarized、GitHub、Everforest、Kanagawa 与 Rosé Pine 十一个配色家族。预设只改变配色，明暗仍由外观设置控制；选择写入 `theme-presets.config.preset`，跨刷新和重启保留，并覆盖 `--dsw-alias-*` 令牌。
description.en: Adds eleven color families—Nord, Dracula, Catppuccin, Tokyo Night, One Dark, Gruvbox, Solarized, GitHub, Everforest, Kanagawa, and Rosé Pine—on top of DSH’s built-in Light, Dark, and System appearance modes. A preset changes the color family while appearance remains independent; the choice persists in `theme-presets.config.preset` across reloads and restarts, using the `--dsw-alias-*` token surface.

description.zh: 为侧栏每个工作区分配专属色相，并用页面背景 tint 和强度滑杆调整整体底色；10 个 OKLCH 等距色相、6 个背景预设、浅深主题独立令牌和设置页即时生效。还带有 `/ws-colors/api/reclaim` 内存回收状态面板，可查看 DSH/Chrome 内存与守护进程状态；超过 10 个工作区可能复用颜色，非 launchd 托管的回收进程不能自动重启。
description.en: Assigns each sidebar workspace its own hue and adds a page-background tint with a strength slider; it provides ten perceptually spaced OKLCH hues, six background presets, separate light/dark token layers, and live settings. It also exposes a `/ws-colors/api/reclaim` memory-reclaim panel for DSH/Chrome memory and daemon status. More than ten workspaces may reuse colors, and a reclaim process not managed by launchd cannot be restarted automatically.

description.zh: 永雏塔菲（AceTaffy）主题，提供亮暗双主题、场景背景和可选的浮动粒子效果。
description.en: An AceTaffy theme with light and dark palettes, scene backgrounds, and optional floating particles.

description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 暗色模式的 Darksoft 主题，以 `--dsw-alias-label-*` 调低正文的暖灰对比，并为 h1–h6 提供柔和彩色标题；纯 CSS 注入、零运行时依赖，可与其他主题共存。它只作用于 `body[data-ds-dark-theme]`，浅色主题、TUI 和 headless profile 不受支持。
description.en: A Darksoft theme for DSH Web’s dark mode: `--dsw-alias-label-*` overrides soften body text into warm gray, while h1–h6 headings receive restrained colors. It is a zero-dependency CSS injection that can coexist with other theme plugins, but it only targets `body[data-ds-dark-theme]`; Light mode, TUI, and headless profiles are not supported.

description.zh: 草薙宁宁主题提供按本地时间切换的日/夜背景（06:00–18:00 为白天）、可调背景模糊和侧栏透明度、可拖动立绘，以及随 Agent 执行/待机状态变化的动画和日中双语台词。仅供个人测试和非商业同人使用；角色与图片素材不在 MIT 代码授权范围内。
description.en: Nene Theme provides day/night backgrounds that follow local time (06:00–18:00 is daytime), adjustable background blur and sidebar opacity, a draggable character illustration, and animations with Japanese/Chinese lines that react to Agent execution or idle state. It is for personal testing and non-commercial fan use; the character and image assets are outside the MIT code license.

description.zh: 右下角桌宠：把输入、缓存读取、缓存写入、输出四类 token 累加成经验，升级解锁称号阶梯。它会跟着对话在思考、调用工具、工具出错、完成之间换动画，也可以改名、缩放、拖动，或上传自己的精灵图和状态动作映射；悬停拉出轨道坞，还能开一局局域网 P2P 五子棋。
description.en: A corner pet that turns the four token buckets into XP and unlocks a title ladder as your agent works. It switches animations with live thinking, tool and answered status pushed over SSE; rename, resize, drag and upload custom spritesheets, and the hover orbit dock hides a LAN peer-to-peer gomoku board.

description.zh: 学院蓝风格界面，配有可拖动、可抚摸、可同步助手回复的白子桌宠；主机端可读取已配置的凭据查询 DeepSeek 余额，密钥不会进入浏览器。
description.en: An academy-blue interface with a draggable, pettable Shiroko companion that can sync assistant replies; the host can use the configured credential to query the DeepSeek balance without sending it to the browser.

description.zh: 《死亡搁浅》风格的 BB 生命体征主题：以暗色 DS 蓝黑/琥珀线条和亮色冥滩白变体重塑界面，并在输入区上方显示 ECG 走纸；BPM 根据会话快照中的 Agent 思考、工具执行和回合状态实时变化。保留 DeepSeek 鲸鱼品牌蓝，视觉层不拦截交互。
description.en: A Death Stranding–styled BB vital-signs theme with dark DS blue-black and amber styling plus a Beach-white light variant. An ECG monitor strip above the composer updates its BPM from session snapshots of agent thinking, tool execution, and turn activity. DeepSeek whale blue stays intact, and the visual layers remain pointer-transparent.

description.zh: 将 DSH Web 的顶栏、侧栏、输入框、停靠条和会话垫层变为可调磨砂玻璃，支持 Mica/兼容模式、流体或图片/视频壁纸、折射参数和悬停弹性。
description.en: A switchable liquid-glass theme for the DSH Web UI, covering the header, sidebar, composer, docks, and conversation pads with adjustable frosted panes. It offers Mica or compatibility mode, fluid/image/video backdrops, refraction controls, and hover elasticity.

description.zh: “山栖”把真实 DSH Web/Desktop 界面置于手绘山湖场景中：天空按本机时间连续经历晨光、白昼、黄昏与夜晚，星月和萤火在夜间出现；当前对话运行任务时，田间农人进场耕作，结束、取消或出错后离开。支持时间轴/手动预览、浅深色配色、环境微动与完整恢复宿主主题；使用 DSH 公开会话状态，不读取思考正文。
description.en: Shanqi places the real DSH Web/Desktop interface in a hand-drawn mountain-and-lake scene. The sky moves continuously through dawn, day, dusk, and night from local time, with stars, moonlight, and fireflies after dark; a farmer enters to work while the current conversation is running and leaves when it ends, is canceled, or errors. It supports timeline/manual preview, light/dark styling, ambient motion, and full host-theme restoration, using public session state rather than reading thought text.

description.zh: 梁文谷按北京时间的 DeepSeek 高峰/空闲时段提醒：峰前倒计时、到点弹窗，右上角可拖动 HUD 展示阶段、血条和下一事件；白天/月夜主题、九境修仙成长、错过补播、系统通知和合成提示音也可用。每天弹窗最多 6 次，首次使用系统通知需要授权；固定版本已在 DSH 0.1.2-rc.1 上验证，MIT 许可。
description.en: Liangwengu reminds you about DeepSeek’s Beijing-time peak and off-peak periods with pre-peak countdowns and timed pop-ups. A draggable HUD shows the current phase, a health bar, and the next event; it also includes day/moon-night themes, nine cultivation levels, catch-up announcements, system notifications, and synthesized sound cues. Pop-ups are limited to six per day, and system notifications require permission. The fixed version was verified with DSH 0.1.2-rc.1. MIT licensed.

description.zh: 把 DSH Web 的工作区、会话列表、输入区和浮层统一为 NieR:Automata / YoRHa 启发的工业终端：沙色与炭黑配色、直角几何、硬边框、无阴影表面、项目标题、机械导轨、反色视频选中态、32px 网格和纸张纹理，并统一编辑器、菜单、对话框、代码块与语法高亮。保留 DSH 原有交互和浅深色模式，主题令牌覆盖可在主题重绘后继续生效；支持减少动态效果，不依赖运行时 CDN 或图片。它是非官方社区主题，与 Square Enix、PlatinumGames 或 NieR 权利方无隶属关系，也不包含游戏原始素材。MIT 许可。
description.en: Recasts the DSH Web workspace, session list, composer, and overlays as a NieR:Automata/YoRHa-inspired industrial terminal: sand and charcoal palettes, square geometry, hard borders, shadow-free surfaces, project headers, mechanical rails, reverse-video active sessions, a 32px registration grid, and paper texture. Composer, menus, dialogs, code blocks, and syntax highlighting share the same treatment while the original interactions and light/dark modes remain intact. Theme-token overrides survive DSH theme repaints, reduced motion is supported, and the current build has no runtime CDN or image dependencies. This is an unofficial community theme, unaffiliated with Square Enix, PlatinumGames, or NieR rights holders, and it contains no original game assets. MIT licensed.

description.zh: 提供 Nord、Dracula、Catppuccin、Coffee 等 19 款主题，每款都含亮色与暗色配色。可在设置页切换并保存选择，亮暗模式切换时保留所选主题。
description.en: Includes 19 themes such as Nord, Dracula, Catppuccin, and Coffee, each with light and dark palettes. Switch and save the theme in Settings; changing appearance mode keeps the selected theme.

description.zh: deepseek-pet 把用户输入、LLM 回复和工具结果转化为喂食事件：食物从会话中事件发生的位置飞向右下角鲸鱼娘，数量随 token 消耗变化。它包含 5 秒 Combo（经验倍率最高 `×3.0`）、15 秒暴食增益、心情/精力/睡眠、工具技能、Lv.10 一次性进化、多宠物与蛋、成就和每日任务；宠物可摸头、拖动，支持减少动效。状态保存在浏览器 `localStorage` 的 `dsh-pet-plugin/state`，多标签页共享，同一只宠物会按离线时间结算最多 24 小时但不会饿死。插件无需改动 DSH 仓库或重新构建前端，代码按 MIT 许可；安装文档同时说明使用的是 AI 插画/二创素材，相关素材的商业权利不能从代码许可自动推得。
description.en: deepseek-pet turns user messages, LLM replies, and completed tool calls into feeding events: food flies from the event’s location in the conversation to the whale pet in the bottom-right, with the amount tied to token usage. It includes a five-second Combo window with up to a `×3.0` experience multiplier, a 15-second overeating buff, mood/energy/sleep, tool skills, one-time evolution after level 10, multiple pets and eggs, achievements, and daily tasks; the pet can be petted and dragged and supports reduced motion. State lives in browser `localStorage` under `dsh-pet-plugin/state`, is shared across tabs, and catches up for at most 24 hours while offline without starving the pet. It does not require changing the DSH repository or rebuilding the frontend. The code is MIT-licensed, but the README identifies the artwork as AI/fan-made material, so commercial rights for those assets do not follow automatically from the code license.

description.zh: 遵循 Material You / Material 3 的皮肤，以 HCT 算法从种子色生成色调调色板，并使用随包的 Maple Mono NF CN 字体；支持浅/深配色、M3 圆角与动效，并尊重 `prefers-reduced-motion`。仓库已归档，开发已迁移至 `mtaech/melon`；当前固定版本仅随包提供 Regular 字重，Medium/Bold 使用合成或系统字体回退。
description.en: A Material You / Material 3 skin that derives a tonal palette from a seed color with HCT and uses the bundled Maple Mono NF CN typeface. It provides light/dark palettes, M3 shape and motion treatments, and respects `prefers-reduced-motion`. The repository is archived and development moved to `mtaech/melon`; this pinned version bundles only the Regular weight, with Medium/Bold synthesized or falling back to system fonts.

description.zh: 打开新对话或钉住的会话时播放可跳过的全屏视频片头，并可把另一段视频的静帧或最后 3 秒循环片尾作为工作区皮肤；入场动画与工作区壁纸可独立选择，侧边栏和工作区还有分开的透明度、模糊和字色控制。新对话默认每个会话只播一次，钉住的会话每次打开都会播；自动播放先静音，声音和真全屏需要用户手势，安装或升级后还需重启 DSH 并硬刷新。
description.en: Plays a skippable full-frame video intro when a new or pinned conversation opens, and can use a still frame or looping final three seconds from another clip as the workspace skin. Intro and wallpaper selections are independent, with separate sidebar/workspace transparency, blur, and text-color controls. New conversations play once per conversation while pinned conversations replay on every open; autoplay starts muted, sound and true fullscreen require a user gesture, and installation or upgrades require a DSH restart plus a hard refresh.

description.zh: 轻量级 Web UI 外观皮肤：支持壁纸、玻璃质感透明效果和重点色；设置由服务端保存并在多设备间同步，不接管原生明暗模式。
description.en: A lightweight Web UI appearance skin with wallpaper, glass-like transparency, and accent colour. Settings are server-side and work across devices without taking over the native light/dark mode.

description.zh: 以 2005 年门户网站为视觉主题，在侧栏、对话和推理过程中插入可关闭的虚构广告、假游戏与弹窗；提供中文与英文两套素材和设置开关。
description.en: A 2005 web-portal visual theme that inserts dismissible fictional ads, fake games, and pop-ups into the sidebar, conversation, and reasoning flow, with separate Chinese and English content and settings toggles.

description.zh: 打开新对话或钉住的会话时，以铺满窗口的视频播放片头开机动画。可替换为自己的视频，并设置每个会话只播放一次或每次打开都播放。
description.en: Plays a full-window video intro when opening a new conversation or a pinned conversation. Replace it with your own video and choose whether each conversation plays it once or every time it opens.

description.zh: 深空配色、缓慢闪烁的星点和四组淡淡的星座连线构成安静的全屏背景层，使用 `--dsw-*` 主题令牌且不抢指针、不改变布局，并遵循 `prefers-reduced-motion`。这是深色限定主题：启用时会把浅色外观自动改回 Dark；关闭插件即可恢复原始配色和浅色选择。要求 DSH Web `>=0.2.1-rc.2`。
description.en: A quiet frame-wide sky layer with deep-space colors, slowly twinkling stars, and four faint constellation figures; it uses DSH theme tokens, does not capture pointers or shift layout, and honors `prefers-reduced-motion`. It is dark-only: while enabled it forces the appearance back to Dark if Light is selected. Disable the plugin to restore the original palette and Light choice. Requires DSH Web `>=0.2.1-rc.2`.

description.zh: 一扇会随时间流动的插画天空，位于 DSH 工作区之后：根据城市、日期与时区估算日出日落，连续呈现晨光、晚霞、月牙和星光；支持时间轴、四个时间预设、一天播放，以及暂停当前天空作为工作区壁纸。城市、天空浓度和动效偏好仅存本地；不计算月亮轨迹，也不获取实时天气。新安装推荐 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2，已有 0.1.1-rc.2 环境也有运行记录。
description.en: A living illustrated sky behind the DSH workspace: estimate sunrise and sunset from a city, date, and time zone, then move continuously through dawn, sunset, a crescent moon, and stars. Use a timeline, four time presets, or day playback, and pause a moment as the workspace wallpaper. City, sky intensity, and motion preferences stay local; it does not calculate a lunar path or fetch live weather. New installations are recommended to use DSH 0.2.1-rc.2, with existing 0.1.1-rc.2 runs also documented.

description.zh: 将界面改为《你的名字。》电影风格，提供静态或无声循环动态电影壁纸、彗星蓝玻璃拟态、Logo 替换、输入卡与滚动条重绘，并可在两种壁纸形态间切换。
description.en: A Kimi no Na wa film-inspired interface with a static or silent looping movie wallpaper, comet-blue glassmorphism, logo replacement, redesigned composer card and scrollbars, and a switch between the two wallpaper forms.

description.zh: 根据当前会话的模型与推理等级切换四挡强调色、光晕和输入框上方指示条：`deepseek-v4-flash`/`deepseek-v4-pro` 的 `high`/`max` 分别映射为蓝/靛或琥珀/红色档位，并提供可拖动的鲸鱼滑轨。它作为强调层叠加在现有皮肤上；未知或缺失的 `reasoningEffort` 会回落到 `high`，且当前仅匹配上述模型系列。
description.en: A four-level accent, glow, and composer indicator driven by the active session model and reasoning effort. `deepseek-v4-flash` and `deepseek-v4-pro` map their `high`/`max` levels to blue/indigo or amber/red stages, with a draggable whale slider. It layers over the current skin rather than replacing it; unknown or missing `reasoningEffort` falls back to `high`, and only the listed model families are matched.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web 与 0.2 Desktop 下方铺设独立动态壁纸层，支持内置图片、自定义图片/视频和可选的 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸库；可调遮罩、模糊、亮度、安全放大与播放队列，WE 库需配套插件。
description.en: Place an independent animated wallpaper layer beneath DSH Web and the 0.2 Desktop app, using built-in images, custom images or videos, and an optional Wallpaper Engine library. Adjust overlays, blur, brightness, safe zoom, and playback queues; the WE library requires a companion plugin.

description.zh: 可多选上传 GIF、WebP、APNG 和 PNG/JPG/SVG 图片，也可混用 12 色纯色；按 3–120 秒以双图层交叉淡入淡出切换，支持顺序/随机播放、Ken Burns、contain/cover、虚化和主题自适应可读性保护层。资源与设置存入浏览器 IndexedDB，重启和刷新后恢复但不会跨设备同步；单张图片上限 25MB，并遵循 `prefers-reduced-motion`。
description.en: Upload multiple GIF, WebP, APNG, PNG, JPG, or SVG images, mix them with a 12-color solid palette, and cross-fade between layers every 3–120 seconds with sequential or random playback, Ken Burns motion, contain/cover modes, blur, and a theme-adaptive readability scrim. Images and settings live in browser IndexedDB and survive reloads and restarts but do not sync across devices; each image is limited to 25 MB, and `prefers-reduced-motion` is honored.

description.zh: DSH Beautify 是一站式外观包，包含 29 套主题、10 态鲸鱼光标、可互动的主鲸鱼与子代理小鲸鱼、声音控制和自定义皮肤；还可桥接本机 Wallpaper Engine 的 HTML/JS 或视频壁纸，并提供暗化、模糊、边框和玻璃调节。兼容 DSH `>=0.1.6-alpha.2`，不兼容更早的 `0.1.0-rc.8` 契约。
description.en: DSH Beautify is an all-in-one appearance pack with 29 themes, a 10-state whale cursor, interactive main and sub-agent whale pets, sound controls, and custom skins. It can also bridge local Wallpaper Engine HTML/JS or video wallpapers, with dimming, blur, border, and glass controls. It targets DSH `>=0.1.6-alpha.2` and is not compatible with the earlier `0.1.0-rc.8` client contract.

description.zh: 按 Agent 生命周期切换八种逐帧循环动作：一次生成一张 6×8 精灵表，覆盖待命、思考、执行工具、等待确认、完成和出错等状态；内置云朵猫 Momo，也能使用已配置的图片生成服务生成新形象，或导入其他 AI 生成的精灵表而不需要 Key。它只观察状态事件和工具名称，不读取对话正文，位置与设置持久化；最后两行状态暂未接入触发器，也不提供云同步或社区提交。
description.en: Maps Agent lifecycle states to eight looping frame animations: one generation produces a 6×8 sprite sheet for idle, thinking, tool execution, approval waiting, done, error, and reserved states. Cloud-cat Momo is built in; new pets can be generated through a configured image service or imported from another image AI without a key. The plugin observes lifecycle events and tool names rather than conversation text, persists position and settings, and currently leaves the last two state rows untriggered; cloud sync and community submissions are not included.

description.zh: 自适应毛玻璃皮肤允许使用任意图片作为壁纸，并从主色自动生成明暗主题令牌；界面组件使用自适应遮罩、镜面边缘高光和 `backdrop-filter` 玻璃表面。未设置壁纸时会使用渐变玻璃背景，并以 WCAG AA 正文对比度下限维持可读性。
description.en: Adaptive Frosted-Glass Skin accepts any image as a wallpaper and derives light/dark theme tokens from its dominant color. Components use adaptive scrims, mirror-edge highlights, and `backdrop-filter` glass surfaces. Without a wallpaper it supplies a gradient-glass fallback, while a WCAG AA body-contrast floor preserves readability.

description.zh: Catppuccin 主题插件，支持 DSH Web、DSH Desktop 和 dsh-TUI，并可在 Latte、Frappé、Macchiato、Mocha 四种官方配色间切换；另有可选玻璃质感。
description.en: A Catppuccin theme plugin for DSH Web, DSH Desktop, and dsh-TUI, with one-click switching among the four official palettes—Latte, Frappé, Macchiato, and Mocha—plus optional Glassmorphism.

description.zh: 复刻 Claude Code Desktop 的外观与交互，提供 Claude 和 DeepSeek 两套主题，亮暗外观跟随系统。附带随任务状态变化的 Deepy 小鲸鱼，也可换成像素螃蟹或像素鲸娘。
description.en: Recreates the look and interactions of Claude Code Desktop with Claude and DeepSeek themes that follow system appearance. Includes a task-reactive Deepy whale, with pixel crab and pixel whale-girl alternatives.

description.zh: AI 原生插件化音乐播放器，聚合网易云音乐和 QQ 音乐，支持逐字卡拉 OK 歌词、花再（HALO PIXELBAR）音箱歌词同步，以及通过对话控制点歌、进度、音量、队列、收藏、音箱场景和闹钟提醒。
description.en: An AI-native, plugin-based music player that aggregates NetEase Cloud Music and QQ Music, with word-by-word karaoke lyrics, lyrics sync for 花再（HALO PIXELBAR）speakers, and conversation control for song selection, progress, volume, queue, favourites, speaker scenes, and alarm reminders.

description.zh: 提供 7 档背景（网格、纯色、暖光、拉丝、实景、自定义渐变、本地图片）、4 档玻璃材质和一条右缘刻度轨，主色会随背景色温变化，也可手选。刻度按当前已加载的对话轮数等距分布，只表示第几轮，不表示内容长度或完整历史；跨入口偏好同步依赖配套中控台，没有中控台时只在当前入口生效，整体不改 DSH 几何布局。
description.en: Offers seven backgrounds—grid, solid, warm glow, brushed metal, site photo, custom gradient, and local image—plus four glass-material levels and a right-edge rail whose accent color follows the background’s temperature or a manual choice. The rail is evenly spaced by conversation rounds currently loaded, not by content length or total history; cross-entry preference sync requires the companion control plane, otherwise settings stay local to the current entry point, and the skin deliberately makes no geometry changes.

description.zh: 《新世纪福音战士》三套机体主题：初号機/Unit-01、零号機/Unit-00、弐号機/Unit-02；每套覆盖整套 `--dsw-*` 令牌、配套壁纸与侧边栏切换器，并加入警示条纹、HUD 瞄准框、扫描线和蓝图网格。三套均为深色外观，背景使用 wallhaven 同人图，且启用后会强制维持 EVA 机体主题；插件不修改 Harness 源码，素材仅供本地个人 GUI 使用。
description.en: Three Neon Genesis Evangelion unit themes—Unit-01, Unit-00, and Unit-02—with complete `--dsw-*` token sets, per-unit backdrops, and a sidebar switcher. Hazard stripes, HUD brackets, scanlines, and a blueprint grid complete the mecha treatment. All three are dark schemes; the backgrounds use wallhaven fan art, and the plugin enforces one of the EVA themes while enabled. It does not modify Harness source, and the artwork is for local personal GUI use.

description.zh: 一款偏安静的陪伴插件，内置银白龙娘、橙书娘和蓝鲸女仆三套角色，提供久坐、喝水、连续工作和深夜四类提醒、云朵气泡与页面内/独立桌面窗口两种显示方式，也可向同一 Profile 中的原版 `dsh-pet` 发送基础关怀。页面内模式在 macOS 实测；独立 Electron 窗口只支持 macOS arm64 与官方 Electron 43.3.0，Windows/Linux 未验证，角色美术为 CC BY-NC 4.0 非商业素材。
description.en: A deliberately quiet companion with three built-in characters—silver, orange, and blue-whale—plus break, water, long-session, and late-night reminders, cloud bubbles, and either an in-page or standalone desktop display. It can optionally send basic care messages to `dsh-pet` in the same profile. The in-page mode is tested on macOS; the standalone Electron window is limited to macOS arm64 with official Electron 43.3.0, Windows/Linux are unverified, and the character art is CC BY-NC 4.0 non-commercial material.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web 右下角放置会随 Agent 状态变化的桌宠：宿主监听持久化 `session/event`，折叠出 `idle`、`busy`、`thinking`、`streaming`、`tool`、`done`、`error` 七种姿态；浏览器通过 `/pet-mood?sessionId=…` 每 800ms 轮询，并在不可用时用 `useSessions` 快照兜底。桌宠注册到 `shell.overlay`，可拖动、点击触发互动动画；完成时由 Host 播放平台提示音（Windows `System.Media.SoundPlayer`、macOS `afplay`、Linux `ffplay`）。按 DSH `0.1.0-rc.6` 验证，其他版本需自行核对 API；需要 Node ≥20。仓库代码按 MIT 许可，但内置 GIF/PNG 来自公开第三方资源，仅供学习交流，商业使用边界不由 MIT 代码许可覆盖，权利人可要求移除。
description.en: Places an interactive pet in the bottom-right of DSH Web. The host folds persistent `session/event` records into seven poses—`idle`, `busy`, `thinking`, `streaming`, `tool`, `done`, and `error`—while the browser polls `/pet-mood?sessionId=…` every 800ms and falls back to the `useSessions` snapshot if polling is unavailable. The pet registers in `shell.overlay`, can be dragged, and plays interaction animations when clicked; the Host plays a platform-specific completion sound via `System.Media.SoundPlayer` on Windows, `afplay` on macOS, or `ffplay` on Linux. It was verified against DSH `0.1.0-rc.6`; other versions require API checking, and Node ≥20 is required. The repository code is MIT-licensed, but its bundled GIF/PNG artwork comes from public third-party sources for learning and exchange only; that does not grant commercial rights, and rights holders may request removal.

description.zh: 在对话中直接播放视频和音频，播放器显示在回复下方，支持紧凑卡片、Range 流式传输和自动播放。
description.en: Inline video and audio for conversations: the player appears under the reply with compact cards, Range streaming, and auto-play.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 右下角提供会随会话状态变化的鲸鱼悬浮桌宠：空闲、加载、推理、评分、完成和报错时切换动画与气泡，支持点击、悬停、拖拽、位置持久化，以及自定义/Petdex 皮肤源和随机选择。当前 v0.2 艺术层统一使用内联鲸鱼 SVG；外部皮肤的专属像素图和设置页皮肤选择器仍在路线图中。
description.en: A floating whale pet for the lower-right DSH Web UI that changes animations and bubbles for idle, loading, inference, scoring, completion, and error states. It supports clicking, hovering, dragging, persistent positioning, custom or Petdex skin sources, and random selection. In the current v0.2 art layer, all selections render through an inline whale SVG; dedicated pixel art for external skins and a settings-panel picker remain on the roadmap.

description.zh: 内置十一套 DSH 主题配色，并在「设置 → 通用」加一行主题选择器：选中即应用，支持第三方主题注册与选择持久化。
description.en: Ships eleven DSH theme palettes plus a Settings → General theme picker that applies a theme immediately and persists third-party selections.

description.zh: Dracula 主题将官方 Dracula 色板接入 DSH 的内置主题运行时，提供经典 `#282a36` 与 Dracula Soft `#343746` 两种暗色变体，并覆盖界面表面、侧栏、输入框、菜单和 `--shiki-*` 代码高亮；在设置 → 通用一键切换，选择会跨会话保存。DSH Desktop 2.0.4+ 应使用 1.1.0。
description.en: Dracula integrates the official Dracula palette into DSH's built-in theme runtime with two dark variants: classic `#282a36` and Dracula Soft `#343746`. It covers UI surfaces, the sidebar, composer, menus, and `--shiki-*` syntax highlighting; switch it from Settings → General, with the choice persisted across sessions. DSH Desktop 2.0.4+ requires version 1.1.0.

description.zh: Claude 风格皮肤，采用暖黑画布、Anthropic 陶橙点缀和衬线 UI。
description.en: A Claude-style skin with a warm-black canvas, Anthropic clay-orange accents, and serif UI.

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 页面上方添加可切换、可拖拽、可缩小的 Codex 风格桌宠，内置 7 个角色，每个含 12 帧动作，并根据会话的运行、等待确认、完成和空闲摘要切换姿势。选择、位置与启用状态会保存；插件只展示浏览器侧状态，不增加提示词、工具或会话事件，也不打开原生置顶窗口。内置角色素材来自用户提供的参考图，公开再分发前需确认二创和分发授权；源代码 MIT 许可。
description.en: Adds switchable, draggable, and minimizable Codex-style pets above the DeepSeek Harness Web UI. Seven characters are bundled with 12-frame animations, and poses follow the session summary for running, waiting for confirmation, completed, or idle states. The selection, position, and enabled state are persisted; the plugin only presents browser-side status, adds no prompts, tools, or session events, and does not open a native always-on-top window. The bundled character art was generated from user-provided references, so derivative-work and redistribution rights should be confirmed before public redistribution. The source is MIT licensed.

description.zh: 通过新浪 `hq.sinajs.cn` 免登录、免 API key 获取实时 A 股行情，把自选篮平均涨跌映射成奔跑的牛、熊或横盘状态；平均涨幅越接近 20%，速度、跳跃和扬尘越夸张。可拖动宠物、搜索最多 200 个标的、查看组合平均和按涨跌比例排列的行情赛道；数据仅供学习娱乐，不构成投资建议，也不是券商官方产品。
description.en: Uses Sina’s public `hq.sinajs.cn` endpoint—no login or API key—to turn the average move of an A-share watchlist into a running bull, bear, or calm state; as the average approaches a 20% gain, speed, jumps, and dust become more dramatic. The draggable panel supports searching up to 200 symbols, shows the portfolio average, and ranks holdings on a proportional market race track. Data is for study and entertainment, not investment advice, and the plugin is not an official broker or quote-provider product.

description.zh: 面向 DSH Desktop 的深色像素皮肤：蓝紫霓虹、实心面板、直角与像素网格，聊天区中央的银狼装饰会随侧栏收展平移，壁纸宽度可在 640–920 px 间调。设置 → 皮肤里带有皮肤管理器，可预览、切换、导入本地皮肤、恢复默认或卸载。
description.en: A dark pixel skin for DSH Desktop: blue-violet neon, solid panels, square corners, and a pixel grid, with a centred Silver Wolf ornament that shifts as the sidebar collapses; wallpaper width is adjustable from 640 to 920 px. A skin manager in Settings → Skins previews, switches, imports local skins, restores the default, and uninstalls.

description.zh: 右下角鲸鱼挂件专为 API3D（`api3d.cn`）设计，显示站点余额、账号或当前 key 的今日已用、每轮对话消耗和可选额度，并支持自定义点击序列、模块化泡泡、图片、字体、音效、吸附与翻转。站点地址、字段、币种 CNY 和凭据名均已内置，用户只需把 API Key 写入 DSH 凭据服务；这是 API3D 专属版本，不再回退到官方 DeepSeek 余额接口。
description.en: A whale widget built specifically for API3D (`api3d.cn`) that shows site balance, account- or key-scoped daily usage, per-turn cost, and optional quota, with customizable click sequences, modular bubbles, images, fonts, sounds, snapping, and mirroring. The endpoint, fields, CNY currency, and credential name are built in, so the only required setup is an API Key stored through the DSH credential service. This is the API3D-only variant and no longer falls back to the official DeepSeek balance API.

description.zh: Whale3 在 DSH Web UI 顶部加入会水平游动的鲸鱼桌宠，默认座头鲸，可右键循环切换座头鲸、蓝鲸和虎鲸，双击回到第一种。三种鲸鱼有独立轮廓，支持拖拽定位、眨眼、摆尾、喷水和配置页即时生效；安装在用户 profile 中，应用升级后仍保留。
description.en: Whale3 adds a whale pet that swims horizontally across the top of the DSH Web UI. It starts as a humpback; right-click cycles through humpback, blue whale, and orca, while double-click returns to the first. The three whales have distinct silhouettes, with dragging, blinking, tail and spout animation, and an in-plugin configuration page with immediate effect. It lives in the user profile and survives app upgrades.

description.zh: Bilibili 悬浮小窗播放器，支持推荐、热门、排行、搜索、关注 UP 主、自动连播、迷你模式和历史记录持久化。
description.en: A floating Bilibili mini player with recommendations, popular and ranked videos, search, followed UP creators, autoplay, mini mode, and persistent history.

description.zh: 面向 DSH Desktop 的微信风格浅色主题：深色 72px 图标栏、灰色 288px 会话列表、浅绿色用户气泡、绿色发送按钮和紧凑的助手卡片，同时保留搜索、侧栏拖动、代码/表格滚动与附件编辑。已在 Windows 的 DSH Desktop 2.0.17 / Harness UI 0.2.0-rc.2 验证；不发额外网络请求，但少量局部选择器绑定已测 UI 版本，升级后需复核外观。
description.en: A WeChat-inspired light theme for DSH Desktop with a dark 72px icon rail, a gray 288px conversation list, pale-green user bubbles, a green send button, and compact assistant cards while preserving search, sidebar dragging, code/table scrolling, and attachments. Verified on Windows with DSH Desktop 2.0.17 / Harness UI 0.2.0-rc.2; it makes no extra network requests, but a few local selectors target the tested UI version and should be rechecked after upgrades.

description.zh: Canvas 光场启动动画，包含中文清晰度优化、黑幕标识、过曝洗白、档案底板和可交互的访问授权；播放结束后回到原来的界面。它不是界面皮肤。
description.en: A Canvas light-field startup animation with Chinese clarity optimization, blackout mark, overexposure washout, archive panel, and interactive access authorization; it returns to the original interface after playback. It is not an interface skin.

description.zh: 用一份 `preset.json` 的颜色锚点和媒体文件替换整套 `--dsw-*` 配色与背景，支持静态图、`mp4`/`webm` 视频和 `sway`/`drift` CSS 微动，并提供 `/dsh-visual/` 点击切换页；Web profile 与桌面端均有固定证据验证。仓库只附带一张自绘 demo 壁纸，Steam 创意工坊等第三方素材不入库、不受 MIT 覆盖，使用其他预设时需要自行提供素材。
description.en: Uses a single `preset.json` of color anchors plus media to replace the full `--dsw-*` palette and background, supporting still images, `mp4`/`webm` video, `sway`/`drift` CSS motion, and a click-to-switch `/dsh-visual/` page. Fixed evidence verifies both the Web profile and desktop app. The repository ships only one original demo wallpaper; Steam Workshop and other third-party assets are omitted and are not covered by MIT, so other presets require user-supplied media.

description.zh: 自包含的桌面宠物插件，直接订阅 Harness 会话事件，提供帧动画、waiting/thinking/tool/review/done/failed 六阶段气泡、亲密度、每日 token 计量和可选鲸鱼装扮；可直接读取 Codex 的 `pet.json` + `spritesheet.webp`，无需网页宠物依赖。需要可用的 Electron 运行时，且只渲染 sprite2d 图集，会跳过 `live2d`/`frames2d` 宠物；鼠标穿透始终可从设置恢复。
description.en: A self-contained desktop companion that subscribes directly to Harness session events and provides frame animation, waiting/thinking/tool/review/done/failed bubbles, affinity, a daily token meter, and an optional whale decoration without requiring a web pet. It loads Codex `pet.json` + `spritesheet.webp` folders directly, requires an available Electron runtime, and intentionally skips `live2d`/`frames2d` pets because it renders sprite2d atlases; click-through can always be undone from Settings.

description.zh: 桌宠随任务状态切换动作，配套面板显示 Token、费用与缓存命中等统计。还支持历史对话搜索、推理等级切换，以及预算和低余额提醒。
description.en: A task-reactive pet comes with a panel for token usage, costs, and cache statistics. Also supports conversation-history search, reasoning-level controls, and budget and low-balance alerts.

description.zh: Kami 风格的纸媒主题以暖羊皮纸画布、墨蓝强调色、衬线排版、发丝线边框和克制阴影统一浅色/深色界面，并用形状、填充、描边区分发送键的 disabled、idle、running 状态。面向 DSH Web `>=0.1.0-rc.6`，不打包字体而使用系统字体；部分状态选择器依赖宿主类名与结构，未来改版时会回落为原生外观而非修改布局。
description.en: A Kami-inspired editorial theme built around warm parchment, ink-blue accents, serif typography, hairline borders, and restrained shadows in both Light and Dark modes; send-button disabled, idle, and running states are distinguished by shape, fill, and stroke. It targets DSH Web `>=0.1.0-rc.6` and ships no font files, relying on system fonts. Some state selectors depend on host class-name fragments and structure, so future DSH changes may return those elements to the native appearance without altering layout.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web 面板后循环播放静音的 `assets/wallpaper.mp4`，用 scrim 保护文字可读性；开启 `prefers-reduced-motion` 时停用视频并显示 `assets/poster.jpg`，面板本身的样式保持不变。固定证据只验证 DSH Web `>=0.1.0-rc.6` 中的 `0.1.0-rc.6`，视频、海报和截图的角色/商标权利也不包含在代码的 MIT 许可中，项目与 DeepSeek 官方无隶属关系。
description.en: Loops the muted `assets/wallpaper.mp4` behind the DSH Web panels with a scrim for text contrast, while `prefers-reduced-motion` disables the video and shows `assets/poster.jpg`; the panels themselves keep their styling. Fixed evidence verifies only DSH Web `0.1.0-rc.6` within the declared `>=0.1.0-rc.6` range. Rights to the characters/trademarks in the video, poster, and screenshots are separate from the code’s MIT license, and the project is not affiliated with DeepSeek.

description.zh: 在右下角小窗播放 Bilibili 视频，支持原生播放器、弹幕、评论和搜索；agent 需要你时自动暂停提醒，处理完成后从原位置精确续播。
description.en: Plays Bilibili videos in a bottom-right mini window with the native player, danmaku, comments, and search. It pauses and alerts you when the agent needs you, then resumes precisely from the previous position.

description.zh: 主题调色板插件，内置 VSCode Red、Solarized Dark 和 Solarized Light，并在设置 → 插件配置中按浅色/深色外观选择映射；调色板通过 `theme.overrideTokens` 叠加、跟随系统明暗切换并持久化。还提供 `themePalettes` 注册 API 供第三方插件贡献调色板；它不会扩展 Harness 的 Appearance 主题列表，也不修改语法高亮 `tokenColors`。
description.en: A theme-palette plugin with built-in VSCode Red, Solarized Dark, and Solarized Light palettes. Settings → Plugin Configuration maps palettes to light and dark appearances; the selected palette is layered through `theme.overrideTokens`, follows system appearance changes, and persists. A `themePalettes` registration API lets third-party plugins contribute palettes. It does not extend the Harness Appearance picker or modify syntax-highlighting `tokenColors`.

description.zh: 以 WebGL 实现液态透镜折射、水波交互、分层毛玻璃和图片/视频壁纸；支持 Web 与官方桌面版，并提供可调的玻璃、透镜和流体参数。
description.en: Uses WebGL for liquid-lens refraction, interactive ripples, layered glassmorphism, and image/video wallpapers; supports the Web and official desktop client with adjustable glass, lens, and fluid parameters.

description.zh: 这里的 shell 指应用外壳而非侧边栏终端：插件提供约 1.5 秒开场动画、三张内置壁纸、最多 9 张本地自定义图片、浅深主题面板透明度和启动底色，设置页改动即时预览。图片保存在当前浏览器的 IndexedDB，不上传也不跨设备同步；开场动画只在页面加载时播放一次，极端比例会裁切壁纸，Windows/Linux 的桌面透明效果尚未验证。
description.en: Here “shell” means the app shell, not the sidebar terminal. The plugin adds a roughly 1.5-second opening animation, three built-in wallpapers, up to nine local custom images, light/dark panel opacity, and a startup base color with live settings preview. Images stay in the current browser’s IndexedDB, never upload, and do not sync across devices; the intro plays once per page load, extreme aspect ratios crop wallpapers, and desktop transparency on Windows/Linux is unverified.

description.zh: Claude 风格的 WebUI 主题：暖羊皮纸底色、Terracotta 品牌色、全界面 Georgia/中文宋体衬线字体和黄褐调中性灰，覆盖明暗两套主题令牌；代码保持等宽字体，焦点环保留可达性所需的蓝色。纯客户端插件，停用或移除后恢复默认外观。
description.en: A Claude-style Web UI theme with a warm parchment canvas, Terracotta branding, Georgia/Chinese Songti serif typography, and yellow-brown neutrals across light and dark token sets. Code remains monospace, while the blue focus ring is retained for accessibility. It is client-only and restores the default appearance when disabled or removed.

description.zh: Cyber Sand 用深海军蓝半透明面板承载固定的赛博城市背景，以全息立方体青色作为强调色，并覆盖约 30 个 `--dsw-alias-*` 令牌（背景、文字、边框、按钮、滚动条、Markdown 和侧栏）。它会强制 DSH 使用 Dark 外观，属于 Web client 主题；移除插件即可恢复默认深色配色并移除背景层。
description.en: Cyber Sand places a fixed cyber-city background behind translucent deep-navy panels, uses a holographic-cube cyan as its accent, and overrides roughly 30 `--dsw-alias-*` tokens across backgrounds, labels, borders, buttons, scrollbars, Markdown, and the sidebar. It forces DSH onto the Dark appearance and is a Web client theme; removing it restores the default dark palette and removes the background layer.

description.zh: Colorizer 在设置页提供 Ocean Blue、Forest Green、Sunset Orange、Royal Purple 和 Monochrome 五套内置配色，可独立叠加在浅色/深色/跟随系统外观之上，并在浏览器 `localStorage` 中持久化。它不提供自定义主题编辑，代码高亮和滚动条不随配色改变，首次加载前仍会先显示默认主题。
description.en: Colorizer adds five built-in themes—Ocean Blue, Forest Green, Sunset Orange, Royal Purple, and Monochrome—to Settings. They layer independently over the Light, Dark, or System appearance and persist in browser `localStorage`. There is no custom-theme editor; code highlighting and scrollbars are not recolored, and the first paint still uses the default theme before the plugin activates.

description.zh: 已废弃的 DSH Web 皮肤编辑器，仅支持 Web UI，不支持 `0.2.0` 及之后的桌面端。它可创建、预览、管理和分享 `.dshskin` v5 皮肤，编辑浅/深色配色、背景与组件媒体、品牌素材、双语固定文案、自由文本规则和字体，并通过 IndexedDB/localStorage/BroadcastChannel 持久化与同步；导入时会校验资源路径、MIME、大小和 SHA-256。
description.en: A deprecated DSH Web skin editor for Web UI only; it does not support Desktop from `0.2.0` onward. It can create, preview, manage, and share `.dshskin` v5 packages containing light/dark colors, backgrounds and component media, brand assets, bilingual fixed copy, free-text rules, and fonts. Skins persist through IndexedDB/localStorage and BroadcastChannel synchronization, while imports validate resource paths, MIME types, sizes, and SHA-256 hashes.

description.zh: 莫奈壁纸主题将本地图片、图片链接或内置渐变的颜色提取为 Material 3 动态色板，并映射到 DSH 亮/暗主题；提供整窗壁纸、主体/侧栏独立毛玻璃、设置页透视、8 组色板与 8 组渐变壁纸，以及风格、强度、明度和动效控制。仅在插件设置页生效，不改主页面/左侧栏槽位；远程图片受页面 CSP 限制，关闭或卸载后恢复默认界面。
description.en: This Monet wallpaper theme extracts Material 3 dynamic colors from a local image, image URL, or built-in gradient and maps them onto DSH light and dark themes. It provides a full-window wallpaper, independently configurable frosted surfaces for the main area and sidebar, a translucent settings view, eight palette presets, eight gradient wallpapers, and controls for style, intensity, brightness, and motion. It lives only in the plugin settings page, does not occupy the main or sidebar slots, remote images can be blocked by page CSP, and disabling or uninstalling restores the default UI.

description.zh: 一只坐在铁盆里的悬浮小鲸鱼，Agent 工作时摇摆，出错时会被掉落的钢管砸中。可以敲盆、触发找饭互动，也能自备宠物图片、歌曲和音效；未提供音频时保持无声。
description.en: A floating whale in a metal basin sways while the agent works and gets bonked by a falling pipe on errors. Tap the basin to trigger food-seeking interactions, and supply custom images, songs, or effects; without audio files it stays silent.

description.zh: 莱茵生命主题把 DSH Web 对话工作区重组为研究档案终端：浅色为暖纸、浓墨和研究橙，深色为炭黑与青色状态强调，并在设置 → 通用提供开关。主题不读用户数据集或下载模型/外部图片，尊重减少动态效果和窄屏降级；兼容目标为 DSH `0.1.0-rc.5` Web，缺少页面锚点时只跳过装饰，宿主控件与布局保持不变。
description.en: Rhine Lab Theme recasts the DSH Web conversation workspace as a research archive terminal: warm paper, dense ink, and research orange in light mode; charcoal surfaces and cyan state accents in dark mode; and a toggle in Settings → General. It reads no user datasets and downloads no models or external images, respects reduced motion and narrow-screen fallback, and targets DSH `0.1.0-rc.5` Web. Missing page anchors only omit decoration; host controls and layout remain intact.

description.zh: 一次安装即可获得多套由 JSON 定义的全屏主题和侧栏场景，并附带可选的调色选择器、宠物挂件、标题栏心情问候与菜单折叠卡；新增皮肤只需添加 JSON，无需改代码或重新安装插件。
description.en: Install once for a collection of JSON-defined full-screen themes and sidebar scenes, plus optional palette, pet-widget, title-bar greeting, and menu-collapse cards. Add another skin by dropping in JSON—no code change or plugin reinstall required.

description.zh: 以莱茵生命为灵感，提供开屏动画、暖白与暖炭黑配色、切角边框和可选品牌标志，各模块可独立开关。另带任务通知、待办中心、推理强度控制与费用余额面板。
description.en: A Rhine Lab-inspired theme with a startup animation, warm light and dark palettes, chamfered borders, and optional brand marks. Modules can be toggled separately, alongside task notifications, a task center, reasoning controls, and cost and balance panels.

description.zh: 把 DSH Web 界面改成 Codex 风格导航外壳：常驻 56px 图标栏加会话/项目列，会话与输入框保持原样；含插件自有品牌位、合并面板、原生毛玻璃、0.36s 折叠动效、账号菜单和用量面板（tokens、峰值、连续天数、365 天热力图）。
description.en: Codex-style navigation shell for the DSH Web UI: a permanent 56px icon rail plus the session/project column, joined panels, native frosted glass, a 0.36s collapse motion, an account menu and a usage dashboard (tokens, peak, streaks, 365-day heatmap); the conversation and composer stay untouched.

description.zh: codex-ui 将 DSH Web 的窗口边缘、侧栏分界、右栏、输入区、浅深色调色板和设置模态框按 Codex 风格重做；默认可接管模型选择器，提供按提供方分组的模型列表与可拖动、可用 ←/→/Home/End 操作的推理功率轨，关闭 `modelPicker` 后立即交回宿主原生菜单。它还提供 Trajectory 视图的“← 对话”出口，以及主题、强调色、字体、半透明侧栏和对比度配置。设置模态层只使用宿主锚点，不移动或复制宿主节点；主题覆盖默认空值时不产生覆盖，卸载后恢复下层主题。它是社区插件，并非 DeepSeek 官方产品。目标宿主为 DSH `0.1.7-rc.2`、Node ≥22；README 说明最新增量并未全部在真实 `dsh web` 实例上验证，宿主结构不匹配时部分层会告警并跳过。MIT 许可。
description.en: codex-ui restyles DSH Web’s window edges, sidebar dividers, right panel, composer, light/dark palettes, and settings modal to resemble Codex. Its model-picker face B is enabled by default and supplies provider-grouped models plus a draggable reasoning power rail with ←/→/Home/End controls; turning off `modelPicker` hands the seat back to the host’s native menu. It also adds a “← Chat” exit for Trajectory, along with settings for theme, accent, fonts, translucent sidebar, and contrast. The settings layer uses host anchors without moving or cloning host nodes; empty overrides leave the underlying theme untouched, and uninstall removes the layer. This is a community plugin, not an official DeepSeek product. It targets DSH `0.1.7-rc.2` and Node ≥22; the README notes that the newest additions were not all tested in a live `dsh web` instance, and layers warn and skip when host structure does not match. MIT licensed.

description.zh: 《ライムライト・レモネードジャム》主题皮肤：昼夜双主题跟随系统并可手动切换，每个会话首次打开时分配并固定一位角色（共六位），重绘消息、工具行与任务完成卡，背景为 1920×1080 剧情 CG 加分级磨砂。
description.en: LimeLight Lemonade Jam theme with day/night palettes, a character assigned and pinned per conversation (six in total), redrawn messages, tool rows and task cards, and 1920×1080 story CGs as a graded, frosted background.

description.zh: 双端工作台插件，使用官方主题令牌、会话 projection 和公开插件服务构建终末地工业风外观；配套右侧文件、编辑器、浏览器、终端、Git、任务与子代理面板，并读取原生 Goal。
description.en: A dual-platform workbench plugin that uses official theme tokens, session projections, and public plugin services for an Endfield industrial look, with right-side file, editor, browser, terminal, Git, task, and subagent panels, plus the native Goal.

description.zh: 把 DSH Web GUI 换成 MiMo 风格的暖白编辑版面：黑色发丝分隔线、衬线正文、橙色强调色，并提供浅色与深色外壳、可调强调色和顶部滚动字标。
description.en: Reskins the DSH Web GUI in MiMo's warm editorial style with off-white paper, black hairline rules, serif prose, and an orange accent. It includes light and dark shells, an adjustable accent, and an optional scrolling wordmark.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供近黑纸面、薄荷绿强调色、顶部渐变字标状态带，以及 2px 直角和 0.5px 内高光；支持深色、浅色和跟随产品的外壳。
description.en: Reskins the DSH Web GUI with near-black paper, a mint accent, a gradient wordmark status band, 2px corners, and 0.5px inner highlights. Choose dark, light, or follow the product's appearance.

description.zh: 以 Sublime Text 的 Mariana 配色为默认预设，提供 18 个可调色位、9 类 Markdown 正文角色、可保存预设、实时 WCAG 对比度提示，以及明暗模式。可选的 Glass 界面还支持壁纸、生成渐变和程序化等高线背景。
description.en: Uses Sublime Text's Mariana palette as the default and adds 18 adjustable color slots, 9 Markdown prose roles, saved presets, live WCAG contrast warnings, and light/dark modes. Optional Glass UI can layer the theme over a wallpaper, generated gradient, or procedural contour background.

description.zh: 在一个悬浮面板中切换四套预设：樱风（藏青/制服红/奶油粉）、褐东风（青铜/焦褐/仪表金）、潮汐（深青/靛蓝/浪白）和月壤（月岩灰/星蓝/银紫）；每套都有浅色/深色色板，支持 2×2 卡片、数字键 1–4、`Alt + Shift + S` 和恢复原生外观。它只叠加 `--dsw-*` 令牌与装饰 CSS，不改宿主源码；README 的截图来自宿主替身，不是真实 DSH 界面，且与其他令牌皮肤同时启用可能混色。
description.en: Switches among four presets from one floating panel: Sakura Wind (navy, uniform red, cream pink), Bronze East Wind (bronze, burnt brown, instrument gold), Tide (deep teal, indigo, wave white), and Lunar Soil (moon-rock gray, star blue, silver violet). Each has Light and Dark palettes, with 2×2 cards, number keys 1–4, `Alt + Shift + S`, and a restore-native action. It adds `--dsw-*` tokens and decorative CSS without changing host source; the README screenshots use a host substitute rather than real DSH, and concurrent token skins may blend.

description.zh: 壁纸与动态背景中心：浏览/搜索 Alphacoders 热门壁纸，按主题分别保存背景，并支持收藏、历史、自动更换、毛玻璃与遮罩调节；MoeWalls 和 DesktopHut 提供视频壁纸目录，视频需从原站下载后上传本地，插件不做在线流式播放。支持 PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF 与 WebM/MP4，本地上传上限 200MB；依赖访问这些站点及其 CDN，壁纸版权归原作者。
description.en: A wallpaper and live-background center for browsing/searching Alphacoders popular wallpapers, keeping per-theme backgrounds, and managing favorites, history, auto-change, glass blur, and masks. MoeWalls and DesktopHut provide video-wallpaper catalogs; videos must be downloaded from the source site and uploaded locally because the plugin does not stream them online. It accepts PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF and WebM/MP4 with a 200MB local-upload cap; it requires access to those sites and CDNs, and wallpaper rights remain with their authors.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web 的运行中状态行提供轻量个性化：轮换中英文俏皮话、16 种加载图标（小/中/大三档）、颜色预设与主题色匹配、扫光/波浪文字效果、可选用时显示，以及“只显示图标”模式。设置集中在独立页面；零依赖、无需构建和配置文件、不发网络请求，偏好保存在浏览器本地且不修改 DSH 自带包。以 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 及以上为目标，同时识别旧版状态行；MIT 许可。
description.en: Adds lightweight personalisation to the DSH Web running-status line: rotating bilingual quips, 16 loading icons in three sizes, colour presets and theme-colour matching, shimmer or wave text effects, optional elapsed time, and an indicator-only mode. Everything is in its own settings page; there are no dependencies, build or config-file steps, or network requests, and preferences stay in browser storage without modifying stock DSH packages. It targets DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 and newer while recognizing the older status-line shape. MIT licensed.

description.zh: 扫描本机 Wallpaper Engine 已下载的工坊与项目壁纸，在设置页搜索并设为背景。支持图片、静音循环视频和暗化调节；场景与网页壁纸只显示预览图，不进行实时渲染。
description.en: Browse and search locally downloaded Wallpaper Engine workshop and project wallpapers, then use them as backgrounds. Supports images, silent looping videos, and dimming controls; scene and web wallpapers use preview images rather than live rendering.

description.zh: Windows XP Luna 桌面主题，包含多窗口桌面、XP 风格界面、任务栏和 Bliss 壁纸。
description.en: A Windows XP Luna desktop theme with a multi-window desktop, XP chrome, taskbar, and Bliss wallpaper.

description.zh: 提供两套完整的壁纸主题：深色「深空观测站」与浅色「黎明星云」，以白字和柔和阴影保证照片背景上的可读性，并配套 Montserrat + Noto Sans SC 可变字重排版与 74-token 明暗色板。另在设置的模型页提供模型可用性、真实上下文窗口和端点支持的推理档位探测；这些探测会向模型端点发起请求。
description.en: Nebula Core ships two fully designed wallpaper themes—dark Deep-Space Observatory and light Dawn Nebula—with white text and soft shadows for readable over-photo copy, variable-weight Montserrat + Noto Sans SC typography, and a 74-token light/dark palette. It also adds a Model Probe panel that checks which configured models answer, their real context window, and the reasoning levels an endpoint accepts; probing sends requests to those endpoints.

description.zh: 《深空之眼》薇儿丹蒂主题皮肤，以深红导航、婚纱白工作区和柔金骑士细节重绘侧栏、会话顶栏、聊天、输入区、轨迹、设置与终端等区域，并提供亮/暗场景、角色舞台缩放和减少动态效果适配。纯呈现层，不注册服务、不读写模型请求、不上传数据；已在 DSH `0.1.1-rc.2` Web profile 测试，完整皮肤建议一次只启用一套。
description.en: An Aether Gazer Verdandi skin with deep-crimson navigation, a bridal-white workspace, and soft-gold knight details across the sidebar, conversation header, chat, composer, trace view, settings, and terminal surfaces. It provides separate light/dark scenes, a character stage that scales with conversation state, and narrow-window/reduced-motion handling. Presentation-only: it registers no service, reads or modifies no model requests, and uploads no data. It is documented against DSH `0.1.1-rc.2` Web and recommends enabling only one full skin at a time.

description.zh: 明日香红黑暗色与绫波丽白蓝亮色两套主题，配有驾驶员选择开场、角色语音和时钟；系统音乐播放器目前仅支持 macOS。
description.en: Asuka's red-and-black dark theme and Rei Ayanami's white-and-blue light theme, with a pilot-selection intro, character voices and a clock; the system music player currently supports macOS only.

description.zh: 极光主题使用深黑蓝底、电光青强调色、90 颗星组成的星网、极光光晕与细网格背景，并在设置页提供主题开关和动态/静态背景模式。主题关闭后会还原配色、背景和侧栏卡片；仓库同时提供持久化静态双面包与重启即失效的会话级动态 `client.js` 版本。
description.en: Aurora Theme uses deep blue-black surfaces, electric-cyan accents, a 90-star network, aurora glows, and a fine grid, with Settings controls for enabling the theme and choosing animated or static backgrounds. Disabling it restores the palette, background, and sidebar card. The repository provides a persistent static dual-face bundle as well as a session-level dynamic `client.js` form that does not survive a restart.

description.zh: 上传图片作为 DeepSeek Harness Web 的整窗磨砂玻璃主题。
description.en: Upload an image as a full-window frosted-glass theme for DeepSeek Harness Web.

name.zh: What Was That 术语章鱼

description.zh: 在 DSH Web 右下角放置一只小章鱼：当 AI 回复出现词库中的技术术语时显示红色角标，点击即可查看大白话和生活比喻，还能继续请求多轮解释；支持在对话区选词、四种状态形象和解释模型选择。词库优先在本地解释，深入解释只发送选中的词及有限上下文，不发送完整回复。固定版本适配 DSH 0.1.7-rc.2，MIT 许可。
description.en: Puts a small octopus in the bottom-right of DSH Web. When an AI reply contains a technical term from its lexicon, the pet shows a red badge; click it for a plain-language explanation and everyday analogy, then ask for more explanation in several rounds. It also supports selecting a word in the conversation, four pet states, and choosing the explanation model. The local lexicon handles first-pass explanations; deeper explanations send only the selected term and limited context, not the full reply. The fixed version targets DSH 0.1.7-rc.2. MIT licensed.

description.zh: 悬浮鲸鱼卡会跟随当前会话的供应商切换面板：OpenCode Go 显示 5 小时/每周/每月额度百分比与重置倒计时，DeepSeek 账户显示累计消费与余额，官方 API 显示可用状态和余额；支持拖动、详情展开和每 60 秒刷新。凭据只留在 Host，未支持的供应商会隐藏卡片；OpenCode Go 返回的是按模型权重折算的百分比而非美元金额，DeepSeek 官方 API 也不提供历史消费明细。
description.en: A floating whale card follows the current session’s provider: OpenCode Go shows 5-hour, weekly, and monthly quota percentages with reset countdowns; DeepSeek Account shows cumulative spend and balances; and the official API shows availability and balance. It supports dragging, an expanded detail view, and 60-second refreshes. Credentials stay in the Host and unsupported providers hide the card; OpenCode Go supplies weighted percentages rather than dollar amounts, while the official DeepSeek API provides no historical spend detail.

description.zh: Theme Tuner 把强调色、背景、前景、对比度和渐变度调节放到 DSH Web「通用设置 → 外观」下方，复用原生浅色、深色和跟随系统切换。改动通过 `theme.overrideTokens` 实时写入 `--dsw-alias-*`，浅色和深色分别保存，可一键恢复当前主题默认；同一产物兼容 DSH `0.2.x` 的 Config 表单与 `<=0.1.x` 的 settingsScope。
description.en: Theme Tuner places accent, background, foreground, contrast, and gradient controls below DSH Web Settings → General → Appearance, reusing the native Light, Dark, and Follow system switch. Changes are applied live through `theme.overrideTokens` to `--dsw-alias-*`; light and dark settings are stored separately, with a one-click reset to the active theme default. The same build supports the DSH `0.2.x` Config form and the `<=0.1.x` `settingsScope` model.

description.zh: 右下角悬浮 Q 版明日香支持点击台词、拖拽定位和持久化位置；用户提交输入到 Agent 完成输出期间会显示旋转 AT Field 光圈，气泡按空闲/非空闲状态轮换。纯客户端插件，不发网络请求，兼容 0.1.x 与 0.2.0 起的运行时；项目仅从本地目录安装，许可为 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0，禁止商业使用。
description.en: A floating chibi Asuka supports click-to-speak lines, dragging, and persistent positioning. A rotating AT Field appears from submission until the agent finishes, while bubbles cycle between idle and active states. It is a client-only plugin with no network requests and supports 0.1.x and 0.2.0+ runtimes; installation is from a local checkout, and the CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license prohibits commercial use.

name.zh: 天气主题与 FishLogo 鲸鱼宠物

description.zh: 天气主题与 FishLogo 鲸鱼宠物会在打开页面时从 Open-Meteo 获取天气，并通过公网 IP 自动定位（可手动指定城市），据此切换整页配色、雨雪/阳光/闪电等氛围层、季节粒子和天气宠物；右下角 HUD 与聊天卡片还提供详情、科普和声音开关。IP 定位使用 `ipwho.is`→`ipapi.co` 回退链，受代理/VPN 出口和免费服务限额影响；减少动态效果会保留色罩但关闭动画。
description.en: Weather Themes & FishLogo Pet fetches weather from Open-Meteo when the page opens and uses public-IP geolocation, with a manual city override, to switch full-page palettes, rain/snow/sun/lightning ambience, seasonal particles, and a weather pet. Its bottom-right HUD and chat cards expose details, facts, and sound controls. Geolocation falls back from `ipwho.is` to `ipapi.co`, so proxy/VPN egress and free-service limits affect results; reduced motion keeps the color wash but disables animation.

description.zh: 可拖动的悬浮电子木鱼，点击会播放木鱼晃动、木槌动作、声波环和 `+1` 飘字，并按 `YYYY-MM-DD` 记录每日敲击；设置页提供今日/累计/连续天数和近 3、6、12 个月的木色日历热力图。数据写入 `$DSH_HOME/wooden-fish-data.json`，纯本地零网络，位置与显隐状态会保留；当前没有敲击音效，反馈只有视觉动画。
description.en: A draggable floating wooden fish that responds to clicks with a shake, mallet swing, ripple ring, and floating `+1`, while counting knocks in `YYYY-MM-DD` buckets. Settings provides today/total/streak cards and a wood-toned calendar heatmap for 3, 6, or 12 months. Data stays local in `$DSH_HOME/wooden-fish-data.json`, with no network calls; position and visibility persist, but knock sound is not implemented and feedback is visual only.

description.zh: 按 `pendingInteraction`、`running` 和最近活动自动把会话分为“等你回答 / 工作中 / 闲置 / 结束”，点击即可跳转；折叠的工作组还会露出最近活动的成员。状态来自 DSH 的 `useSessions` / `useSessionStatus`，不读会话文件、不解 zstd、也不联网；内置“鲸蓝娘”桌宠和 4 套可热切换皮肤，并支持带上限的工作组共享记忆。内嵌 pet 子目录沿用 Apache-2.0 许可。
