description.en: Automatically groups sessions as Waiting for you, Working, Idle, or Finished from `pendingInteraction`, `running`, and recent activity, with one-click navigation; collapsed workgroups can preview recently active members. It reads DSH’s `useSessions` / `useSessionStatus` state rather than session files, does not decode zstd or use the network, and includes a Whale Girl pet, four hot-swappable skins, and capped shared memory for workgroups. The embedded pet subtree remains Apache-2.0 licensed.

description.zh: 右下角的动画桌宠以气泡显示 3 个实时计数：正在运行、完成但未读、等待你选择（确认 / 计划审查 / 提问）；点击数字可跳转，会话同组多项可连续轮换。它通过 DSH `uiSession.sessionStatus` 事件驱动更新，不轮询、无 host 端行为；只把直接子代理的运行/待交互聚合进统计，子代理完成不会计入“完成未读”。
description.en: An animated bottom-right pet shows three live counts in a bubble: running, completed but unread, and waiting for your choice (approval, plan review, or question). Click a count to open a session; repeated clicks cycle through that group. Updates are event-driven from DSH `uiSession.sessionStatus`, with no polling or host-side behavior; direct child running and pending states are aggregated, but child-agent completion is not counted as unread.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 与桌面版的浮层中显示一只会跟随会话状态切换 GIF 的桌宠；支持点击/双击互动、拖动定位、审批/提问/计划评审提醒、按状态自定义 GIF，并在资源加载失败时使用着色占位动画。
description.en: Adds a desktop pet overlay to the DSH Web UI and desktop app, switching GIFs with the current session state. It supports click/double-click interactions, dragging with a saved relative position, approval/question/plan-review alerts, per-state custom GIFs, and a tinted placeholder when a GIF fails to load.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web 对话右侧打开可调宽度的文档面板，查看本地 Markdown/纯文本文件；支持拖动调整宽度、浅色暖纸/深海军蓝主题、最近文件、每 4 秒自动重读。文件仅由本机 `dsh web` 进程读取，通过同源路由传输，不访问网络或发送遥测；仅在 web profile 生效，要求 Node.js 24+。
description.en: Adds a resizable document rail beside the DSH Web conversation for local Markdown or plain-text files. It offers drag resizing, warm-paper/light and deep-navy/dark themes, recent files and four-second auto-refresh. Files are read by the local `dsh web` process and served over same-origin routes—no network service or telemetry; it runs only in the web profile and requires Node.js 24+.

description.zh: 在液态玻璃与苏联构成主义两套设计语言之间即时切换，并提供个性化面板、可投放的 CSS 皮肤包和“鲸鱼娘”桌宠（7 种表情）。配色以 OKLCH 定义并按 WCAG 校验，卸载可恢复原生界面；桌宠立绘为 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0，禁止商用。
description.en: Switch instantly between Liquid Glass and Soviet Constructivism, with a personalization panel, drop-in CSS skin packs, and a Whale Girl pet with seven expressions. Palettes are defined in OKLCH and checked against WCAG; uninstall restores the native UI. The pet artwork is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and non-commercial.

name.en: The Wandering Earth II Cinematic Theme

description.zh: 以《流浪地球2》为灵感的 DSH Web 主题：深空舱体配色、行星发动机沉底插图、星场 HUD 与 MOSS 眼发送按钮。会话运行时发动机显示蓝色等离子点火，停止后熄火，并提供深色/浅色对应素材；主题令牌叠加层常驻，切换外观或刷新后仍生效。
description.en: A The Wandering Earth II–inspired DSH Web theme with deep-space cabin colors, sunken planet-engine artwork, a starfield HUD and an MOSS-eye send button. The engine shows blue plasma ignition while a session runs and cools to idle when it stops, with dedicated dark/light artwork; its token overlay remains active across appearance changes and page reloads.

description.zh: 运行在 DSH 浮层里的虚拟抽烟互动小组件：点燃、轻吸或长按猛吸、弹烟灰、吐烟圈，并通过燃烧进度和“换烟”完成一轮互动。提供六种氛围主题、可静音的程序化合成音效、可拖动/收起的浮层，并支持 `prefers-reduced-motion`；这是纯虚拟体验，不是吸烟应用。
description.en: A virtual-smoking fidget widget in the DSH overlay: light a cigarette, take a drag or hold to inhale, flick ash, and blow smoke rings as the burn progresses toward a required “switch cigarette” step. It includes six ambient themes, muteable procedurally synthesized sounds, a draggable/collapsible overlay, and `prefers-reduced-motion` support; it is a virtual experience, not a smoking app.

description.zh: 一次安装后，可在 DSH 设置中导入任意 Codex spritesheet 图集，不必为每只宠物编写插件代码。运行时自动识别 v1 `1536×1872`（9 行）与 v2 `1536×2288`（11 行、含 16 个注视帧），支持拖动持久化、悬停挥手、双击跳跃、`idle`/`waiting`/`running`/`review` 姿态和工具名或流式文本进度气泡；也可原地读取 `~/.codex/pets`（可用 `CODEX_HOME` 改目录）以及 `~/.dsh/pets` 中的图集。可选的定期 LLM 总结默认关闭；开启后只自动观察选定会话之后完成的请求，或由用户手动分析历史请求，并会把用户、助手、工具和错误内容的有界摘录发送给所选模型，产生服务商用量或费用。完成、错误和中断提示音可替换，上传音频存放在 `~/.dsh/pets/sounds/`。支持 DSH 0.1.x 与 0.2.0-rc.1+；代码按 MIT 许可，内置示例 `nastya`（娜斯佳）图集按 CC BY-NC 4.0 授权，作为该角色使用时仍受非商业限制。
description.en: Install the runtime once, then import Codex spritesheet atlases from DSH settings without writing a plugin for each pet. It auto-detects v1 atlases at `1536×1872` (9 rows) and v2 atlases at `1536×2288` (11 rows, including 16 look cells), with persistent dragging, hover-to-wave, double-click jumping, `idle`/`waiting`/`running`/`review` poses, and progress bubbles for tool names or streaming text. It can also read `~/.codex/pets` in place (override the directory with `CODEX_HOME`) and use atlases in `~/.dsh/pets`. Optional periodic LLM summaries are off by default; when enabled, automatic summaries cover requests completed after a session is selected, while earlier requests require explicit analysis, and bounded excerpts of user, assistant, tool, and error content are sent to the selected model, incurring that provider’s usage or cost. Completion, error, and interruption sounds can be replaced; uploaded audio is stored under `~/.dsh/pets/sounds/`. It supports DSH 0.1.x and 0.2.0-rc.1+. The code is MIT-licensed, but the bundled `nastya` atlas is CC BY-NC 4.0, so using that character remains non-commercial.

description.zh: 把会话输入框做成模拟仪表质感的液态玻璃：磨砂层、顶部镜面高光、内缘白线、边缘泛光，以及模型思考时上升的三颗气泡；浅深主题过渡为 1.7 秒。仅作用于 Web 客户端，面向 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 及以上的 Chromium/Electron；开启 `prefers-reduced-motion` 时停用动画。
description.en: Turns the composer into analog-instrument-inspired liquid glass with a frosted layer, specular top highlight, inner white line, edge bloom, and three bubbles that rise only while the model is thinking; light/dark transitions take 1.7 seconds. It targets the web client on DSH `0.2.0-rc.2+` in Chromium/Electron, and disables motion under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 中使用为 Visual Studio Code 设计的 .vsix 主题文件。
description.en: Use .vsix theme files designed for Visual Studio Code in the DSH Web UI.

description.zh: 冷调蓝紫暮色主题皮肤：亮/暗模式自动切换背景，侧栏与面板使用轻透纹理和暮靛蓝、雾蓝灰、樱粉等 UI token。它只改展示层，不改布局几何、不注入服务或触达模型请求；素材内嵌在 client bundle，卸载可还原。许可为 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0，禁止商业使用。
description.en: A cool blue-violet twilight skin with light/dark background variants, translucent textured sidebar and panels, and UI tokens in dusk indigo, mist blue-gray and sakura pink. It stays in the presentation layer—no layout geometry changes, service injection or model requests—and embeds its assets in the client bundle for reversible unload. Licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for non-commercial use.

description.zh: 参考《明日方舟：终末地》官网视觉的工业编辑主题：奶油纸底、墨黑文字、信号黄与武陵青强调色，支持直角/圆角、磨砂表面、等高线背景与中央散景、鼠标轨迹、启动动画和音频通知。它是仅作用于客户端的非官方同人改版，不修改 DSH 源码；改版代码和参数由 AI 生成，可能存在未知问题。
description.en: An industrial-editorial theme inspired by the Arknights: Endfield website: cream paper, ink text, signal yellow and Wuling cyan accents, with square/rounded forms, frosted surfaces, contour backgrounds with center defocus, pointer trails, a launch animation, and audio notifications. It is an unofficial client-only fan fork that does not modify DSH source; the revision’s code and parameter changes were generated by AI and may contain unknown issues.

name.zh: Deep diving 鲸鱼娘动作皮肤

description.zh: 为 DSH Web 的“Deep diving…”状态行提供蓝色鲸鱼娘动画：默认 `whale-maid` 含 8 种透明动作，每段 100 帧、10fps，可在同一轮求索中按 10–60 秒轮换，也可固定单个动作；另保留 `whale`、`dafeiyu`、`catgirl` 和 `mermaid` 皮肤。设置支持 14–96px 尺寸、起始动作和中英文状态文案，减少动态效果时会停用动画；素材随包分发，但鲸鱼娘图片禁止商业使用。
description.en: Animated blue whale-maid skins for the DSH Web “Deep diving…” status row. The default `whale-maid` provides eight transparent 100-frame animations at 10 fps, rotating every 10–60 seconds within one turn or looping a single action; `whale`, `dafeiyu`, `catgirl` and `mermaid` skins remain available. Settings cover 14–96px size, starting action and localized status text, and reduced motion disables animation; the bundled whale-maid artwork is open-source-use only and prohibited for commercial use.

description.zh: 面向皮肤作者的非官方主题集合与起步工具：提供 Event Horizon、Cyber Sakura、Obsidian Gold、Digital Rain 四套主题，原生 Settings 选择器、持久化选择、明暗 token，以及仅作用于首条消息前 Hero 区的响应式 WebP 艺术图，并支持可逆清理。固定版本目标为 DSH `0.1.1-rc.2`，预览版插件 API 可能变化。
description.en: An unofficial theme collection and starter kit for skin authors with Event Horizon, Cyber Sakura, Obsidian Gold and Digital Rain, a native Settings selector, persistent choices, light/dark tokens, responsive WebP artwork scoped to the pre-conversation Hero area, and reversible cleanup. The fixed release targets DSH `0.1.1-rc.2`; preview-version plugin APIs may change.

description.zh: 把 DSH 会话界面重排为电子表格工作簿：功能区管理文件、会话和运行选项，消息、工具、轨迹和输入区映射到单元格，工作簿标签用于切换多会话。
description.en: Reorganizes the DSH session UI as a spreadsheet workbook: a ribbon manages files, sessions, and run options; messages, tools, trajectories, and input map to cells; workbook tabs switch between sessions.

description.zh: 鲸鱼娘皮肤系列中的深海女仆工坊主题。
description.en: The Abyssal Maid Atelier theme in the Whale Girl skin series.

description.zh: 虎鲸链路皮肤，采用珍珠白机械舱、黑曜虎鲸操作员与电蓝链路信号，包含亮暗双场景、直角 UI、状态角色和动态定价信号。
description.en: An ORCA LINK skin with a pearl-white mechanical cabin, obsidian orca operator, and electric-blue link signals, including light and dark scenes, angular UI, status characters, and dynamic pricing signals.

name.zh: 皮肤与 Token 用量面板

description.zh: 为 DSH Desktop/Web 提供“深海夜航”和“暖纸日光”两套皮肤、5 套内置摄影背景，以及可递归扫描本地文件夹的图片轮播（可选子目录、间隔、暂停和下一张）。设置页还按会话显示官方 `tokenUsage` 投影中的计费输入、输出、缓存命中率和总量；不复制提示词、回复或工具内容，也不发起外部网络请求。安装/构建要求 Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`。
description.en: Provides two skins—Deep-Sea Night Flight and Warm Paper Daylight—five bundled photo backgrounds, and a local image rotator that can recurse through folders with subfolder selection, interval control, pause, and next-image actions. Its settings page also shows per-session billed input, output, cache-hit rate, and total tokens from the official `tokenUsage` projection; it does not copy prompts, responses, or tool content, and makes no external network requests. Installation/building requires Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`.

description.zh: 本地壁纸玻璃皮肤允许在设置 → 背景图输入本地图片路径（≤8MB），将壁纸放在 DSH Web 窗口下方并把侧栏、对话框变为半透明玻璃；浅/深主题自适应，路径保存于 `localStorage`，重启自动恢复，图片只在本机传输且不联网。
description.en: A local-wallpaper glass skin for DSH Web: enter a local image path (up to 8 MB) in Settings → Background Image, place it behind the window, and make the sidebar and dialogs translucent. It adapts to light/dark themes, stores the path in `localStorage`, restores it after restart, and keeps the image local without network upload.

description.zh: 面向 DSH 皮肤作者的浏览器内开发工具：浏览 169 项官方 `--dsw-*` token，实时编辑 light/dark 值并预览，保存为持久化 override 或注册为可选主题，导出 JSON；另有 7 套光谱预设和 ≤5MB 的本地背景上传。目标兼容 DSH `0.1.7-alpha.2`–`0.1.7-rc.2`，不是普通用户换肤器。
description.en: An in-browser development tool for DSH skin authors: browse 169 official `--dsw-*` tokens, edit light/dark values with live previews, save overrides or register a selectable theme, and export JSON. It also provides seven spectrum presets and local background uploads up to 5 MB. It targets DSH `0.1.7-alpha.2` through `0.1.7-rc.2`; it is an authoring tool, not a general-purpose skin switcher.

name.zh: DSH 潮汐液态玻璃皮肤

description.zh: 潮汐液态玻璃皮肤以极光潮汐、深海焦散和 SVG 海浪动画铺设背景，把对话、侧栏、设置、消息气泡和输入卡变为可调液态玻璃；左侧工作区可拖动/折叠，Q 版鲸鱼娘可拖动并打开四区域调节面板。玻璃参数保存在 `localStorage`，主题偏好写入 `settings.yaml`；支持 `prefers-reduced-motion`，卸载后清理 DOM 并恢复官方界面。
description.en: Tide is a liquid-glass skin with an aurora-tide backdrop, deep-sea caustics, and animated SVG waves. It turns chat, sidebar, settings, message bubbles, and the composer into tunable glass; the left workspace is draggable/collapsible, and a draggable Q-version whale-girl opens four-region tuning controls. Glass parameters persist in `localStorage`, while the theme preference is written to `settings.yaml`; `prefers-reduced-motion` is honored, and unloading cleans up the DOM and restores the official UI.

description.zh: 启动时播放「逐笔线稿 → 睁眼 → 标识拼装」的守岸人影片，片尾消散聚合为无缝循环的全屏背景；侧边栏面板可换成自己的图片或视频（上限 120 MB，只存本机 IndexedDB），并调透明度、压暗和模糊。
description.en: On launch it plays a Shorekeeper intro — line art drawn stroke by stroke, eyes opening, then the Black Shores emblem assembling — and hands over to a seamless looping full-screen background. A sidebar panel swaps in your own image or video (up to 120 MB, kept in local IndexedDB) and adjusts opacity, dimming and blur.

description.zh: 将短片设为静音循环背景，并用另一段视频播放可跳过的有声开场。支持更换素材、分别开关两种效果，以及实时调整界面透明度；浏览器限制自动播放时，开场会退回静音。
description.en: Use a silent looping video as the background and a separate video as a skippable intro with sound. Replace media, toggle each effect, and adjust interface opacity live; the intro falls back to mute when browser autoplay rules require it.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 右下角固定显示会轻微浮动的动画猫咪 GIF；长按 450ms 可拖动，位置保存在浏览器 `localStorage`，并可配置大小、显隐和无障碍文案。图片加载失败时会自动隐藏，不影响页面。
description.en: Pins a gently floating Salary Cat GIF to the bottom-right of the DSH Web UI. Hold for 450 ms to drag it; its position is saved in browser `localStorage`, and size, visibility, and accessibility text are configurable. A failed image load hides the pet without affecting the page.

description.zh: 在界面下铺设海洋场景，包含鱼群、鲸鱼、鲨鱼、水母、海带和沉船；鼠标移动会激起水波，配色随明暗主题切换。
description.en: An ocean scene beneath the interface, with schools of fish, whales, sharks, jellyfish, kelp and a sunken ship. Pointer movement creates ripples, and the palette follows the light or dark theme.

description.zh: 把 Web GUI 换成《烈焰升腾》新左派「长征 / Loji」AI 路线的终端：纯黑底、磷光红字符、红色数据雨与 CRT 扫描线，四套部门预设各带徽记、配色和背景纹样；纯视觉插件，不注册工具、不发网络请求。
description.en: Turns the Web GUI into the terminal of The Fire Rises' New Left “Long March / Loji” AI route: pure black with phosphor-red glyphs, red data rain and CRT scanlines, plus four department presets each with its own emblem, palette and background pattern. It is purely visual: no tools registered, no network requests.

description.zh: 用「哦鲸鲸」替换智能体团队面板成员行的状态图标和子代理下拉中的状态点，并在会话头部增加供主会话与子代理共用的跑道。成员行、子代理列表和标题栏跑道可分别开关；跑道会读取名册与会话状态。
description.en: Replaces Agent Team member-row status icons and subagent-dropdown status dots with “ohjingjing” whales, and adds a shared runway in the session header for the lead session and its subagents. The member-row skin, subagent list, and header runway can be toggled independently; the runway follows the roster and session state.

description.zh: 背景设置插件：扫描本地图库并提供缩略图选择、随机背景、缩放/裁切/定位、透明度与高斯模糊调节，以及 cover/contain/fill 显示模式和多图交叉淡化轮播。
description.en: A background-settings plugin that scans a local image folder and provides thumbnail selection, random backgrounds, scale/crop/position controls, opacity and Gaussian blur, cover/contain/fill modes, and cross-fade rotation.

description.zh: 复刻 DeepSeek Chat 蓝鲸配色的皮肤，亮色和深色模式跟随系统外观。
description.en: A skin recreating the Blue Whale color scheme from DeepSeek Chat, with light and dark modes following the system appearance.

description.zh: 按 Agent 工作、思考、等待审批、出错和完成切换精灵动画，支持多宠物注册、拖拽互动及独立桌面窗口；配套从图片或视频导入或生成宠物，并可浏览、下载和安装社区宠物。
description.en: Switches sprite animations for agent work, thinking, approval waits, errors and completion, with multi-pet registration, dragging and an independent desktop window. Companion tools can create or import pets from images or video, and browse, download and install community pets.

description.zh: DSH Web 右下角的像素风悬浮桌宠：根据会话状态在空闲、工作、等待授权、提问、完成、失败和断开之间切换，使用 8×8 状态图集与逐帧时长。支持拖拽奔跑、空闲双击挥手、状态气泡、光晕和 60–200px 尺寸设置；许可证为 BSD-3-Clause。
description.en: A pixel-art floating pet for the DSH Web GUI. It switches among idle, working, authorization, question, done, failed, and disconnected moods from session activity, using an 8×8 sprite sheet with per-frame timing. It supports drag-to-run, a double-click wave, status bubbles, glow, and 60–200px sizing; BSD-3-Clause licensed.

description.zh: 把 DSH Web 界面改成 Minecraft 像素风：21 种方块纹理可切换并可导入/管理自定义纹理，支持纹理尺寸、像素字体、灰色浮雕按钮、漂浮方块粒子和点击音效。还内置 16 首 Minecraft 原声与本地音乐文件夹播放器；本地音乐和纹理不上传，插件为非官方作品且与 Mojang 无关。
description.en: Turns the DSH Web interface into a Minecraft-inspired pixel workspace with 21 switchable block textures, custom texture import/management, adjustable texture size, pixel fonts, embossed gray buttons, floating block particles, and click sounds. It also includes 16 Minecraft tracks and a local-folder music player; local textures and music are not uploaded, and the plugin is unofficial and unaffiliated with Mojang.

description.zh: 一只会随 DSH 工作状态陪伴的桌宠：待机时安静互动，工具运行时抱起笔记本并保持安静；支持拖拽、养成、成就、小游戏与跨端存档，默认无遥测且不发起外部请求。
description.en: A desktop pet that follows DSH work states: it interacts quietly while idle, picks up a laptop and stays quiet when tools run, and supports dragging, progression, achievements, mini-games, and cross-device saves. No telemetry or external requests by default.

description.zh: FreeStyle 主题工作室，支持四轴主题建模、真实组件预览、12 套预设、图片取色与一键生成、分享码、119 个主题令牌，以及跨重启持久化。
description.en: FreeStyle theme studio with four-axis theme modeling, live previews using real components, 12 presets, image/color extraction and one-line generation, share codes, 119 theme tokens, and persistent themes.

description.zh: 米黄色主题提供温暖的奶油白/米黄浅色界面，以纸张卡片、玻璃浮层、木质侧栏和纸张代码页组成视觉层，适合长时间 AI 编程阅读；基于 DSH `--dsw-alias-*` token 和稳定 DOM 钩子，只改视觉，不改业务逻辑。
description.en: A warm cream-and-beige light theme for DSH, with paper-like cards, glass overlays, a wood sidebar, and paper-style code pages designed for long coding sessions. It uses DSH `--dsw-alias-*` tokens and stable DOM hooks, changing the visual layer without touching application logic.

description.zh: Veneer 是可视化换肤编辑器：从侧栏「编辑」面板调整 12 个背景面、图片裁切与透明度、字体、文字颜色、圆角/边框/阴影，并提供 8 套模板、JSON 导入/导出和基于 Harness 模型的 AI 主题生成。主题优先保存到 DSH Host Settings，并以浏览器 `localStorage` 作兼容快照；跨机器导入时图片引用可能失效，AI 生成功能仍取决于模型、凭据和网络可用性。
description.en: Veneer is a visual reskin editor. Its sidebar editor adjusts 12 background surfaces, image cropping and opacity, fonts, text colors, corner radii, borders, and shadows; it also includes eight templates, JSON import/export, and AI theme generation through the Harness model runtime. Themes are stored primarily in DSH Host Settings with a browser `localStorage` compatibility snapshot. Imported image references may fail across machines, and AI generation depends on model, credential, and network availability.

description.zh: 一个面板管理主题、背景与氛围灯：内置深夜蓝、护眼绿、赛博朋克和纸墨白，提供梦幻渐变与本地图片背景、可调透明度的毛玻璃，以及 7 色可选、1–10 秒可调速的环绕流动氛围灯；设置会自动保存并恢复。
description.en: One panel for themes, backgrounds, and ambient lighting: it includes Midnight Blue, Eye-Friendly Green, Cyberpunk, and Paper-and-Ink themes, dreamy gradients and local-image backgrounds, adjustable frosted glass, and a circulating ambient-light effect with seven colors and a 1–10 second speed range. Settings save and restore automatically.

description.zh: 从 DSH 侧栏打开壁纸抽屉，选择系统预设、纯色、渐变、图片或视频背景；支持缩放定位、适配模式、毛玻璃、亮暗文字方案，以及由模型调用的 bg_apply 工具。本地媒体保存在本机。
description.en: Open a wallpaper drawer from the DSH sidebar and choose system presets, solid colors, gradients, images, or videos. Adjust zoom and position, fit modes, glass effects, and light/dark text schemes, or let the model use the bg_apply tool. Media stays on the local machine.

description.zh: ASCII 终端风主题：等宽字体、方框制表符界面与硬阴影，内置 19 套调色板（含 auto / host）和 cozy、compact、dense 三档密度；状态行显示 agent 状态、步数、tok/s 与上下文用量，空会话用 ascii.rest 的字符画，作者在 DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 上实测。
description.en: An ASCII terminal take on the UI: monospace type, box-drawing chrome and hard shadows, with 19 palettes (including auto and host) and cozy/compact/dense densities; a vim-style status line tracks agent state, steps, tok/s and context, empty sessions show ascii.rest art, and it was tested on DSH 0.2.1-rc.3.

description.zh: Claude Style 以 Anthropic 暖调编辑风为灵感，提供暖象牙 `#FAF9F5` / 暖黑 `#141413` 双画布、陶烬橙 `#D97757` 强调色、衬线标题、无衬线界面、等宽标签、发丝线边框与胶囊 CTA，并为 Markdown 提供编辑部式排版。跟随 DSH 原生明暗主题；同一时间只能启用一个皮肤。
description.en: Claude Style takes inspiration from Anthropic’s warm editorial look, with an ivory `#FAF9F5` / warm-black `#141413` canvas, a clay-ember `#D97757` accent, serif headlines, sans-serif UI, monospaced labels, hairline borders, pill CTAs, and editorial Markdown styling. It follows the native DSH light/dark theme, and only one skin can be active at a time.

description.zh: 把 Web 界面换成《原神》芙宁娜／枫丹风格：三套皮肤（雨夜枫丹、水镜鸢尾、沙龙独处）可切换，另有壁纸层、毛玻璃表面、主题化启动屏和设置区内嵌面板。
description.en: Turns the DSH Web UI into a Fontaine / Furina theme with three switchable skins (Fontaine Nocturne, Hydro Iris, Salon Solitude), a wallpaper layer, translucent glass surfaces, a themed startup splash and an in-settings theme panel.

description.zh: 非官方《鸣潮》清宵同人 DSH Web 皮肤，采用冰蓝、青碧、月白与玄夜蓝配色，支持可替换背景、开屏动画、毛玻璃面板、粒子装饰和可选人格库。
description.en: An unofficial Wuthering Waves Qingxiao fan skin for DSH Web, using ice-blue, jade, moon-white, and dark-blue palettes with swappable backgrounds, an intro animation, frosted panels, optional particles, and a persona library.

description.zh: 深海近黑底的玻璃拟态皮肤，以单一生物荧光光源和发丝线分层构成；可组合 4 种底色、5 种强调色、3 档圆角密度、3 档极光强度和颗粒开关，共 360 种组合。需要 `@dsh-eac/ui-skin-loader >=1.2.0` 提供皮肤发现、切换和持久化；README 也记录了无控制台时的独立模式。适配 DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0` 和 Node `>=24`。
description.en: A near-black deep-sea glassmorphism skin built around one bioluminescent light source and hairline layering. Combine four base colors, five accents, three corner densities, three aurora levels, and film grain for 360 combinations. It requires `@dsh-eac/ui-skin-loader >=1.2.0` for skin discovery, switching, and persistence; the README also documents a standalone mode without the console. It targets DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0` and requires Node `>=24`.

description.zh: 以罗德岛终端为灵感的 DSH 皮肤：直角切角、黑色发丝线、警示黄条、四角登记标记和全屏细网格，提供浅色纸面与暗色作战终端两套底色。它面向 `dsh.ecosystem.ui-skin-loader/v1` 的托管发现、切换与持久化；README 描述了未安装控制台时的自立模式，但 manifest 也提示缺少 `uiSkinLoader` 可能让皮肤处于等待状态。
description.en: A Rhodes Island terminal-style DSH skin with square cut corners, black hairlines, warning-yellow bars, corner registration marks, and a full-screen fine grid. It is designed for managed discovery, switching, and persistence through `dsh.ecosystem.ui-skin-loader/v1`; the README documents a standalone mode without the skin console, while the manifest warns that a missing `uiSkinLoader` may leave the skin pending.

description.zh: 工业终端风格的 DSH 皮肤：直角切角、黑色发丝线、黄黑警示条、四角登记标记和 DIN 技术字；提供跟随应用的纸面/终端亮暗底、3 种强调色、3 档圆角与纹理/硬投影开关，共 216 种组合。需要 `@dsh-eac/ui-skin-loader >=1.2.0` 提供皮肤发现、切换和持久化；适配 DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`、Node `>=24`。
description.en: An industrial-terminal DSH skin with square cuts, black hairlines, yellow-and-black warning bars, corner registration marks, and DIN technical type. It offers app-following Paper and Terminal light/dark bases, three accents, three corner-radius options, and texture/hard-shadow controls for 216 combinations. It requires `@dsh-eac/ui-skin-loader >=1.2.0` for skin discovery, switching, and persistence; it targets DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0` and Node `>=24`.

description.zh: 把工作空间呈现为可游玩的 Minecraft 风格体素世界，可移动、挖掘和放置方块。运行中的会话化作带状态牌的小狗，模型和推理强度对应装备与附魔，同时保留原生对话和审批功能。
description.en: Explore a playable Minecraft-inspired voxel workspace with movement, mining, and block placement. Running sessions appear as dogs with progress signs, while models and reasoning levels become equipment and enchantments. Native chat and approval controls remain available.

description.zh: DPH 终末地主题以冷黑工业界面、荧光黄色状态信号、切角面板和响应式布局重塑 DSH Web，并在输入框旁提供待机、输入、思考/执行三套 24 帧角色动画。首页可打开官网消息抽屉，读取公开公告接口的 6 条内容并缓存 5 分钟；仅支持 Web profile，不上传会话或输入内容，窄屏会隐藏角色动画和消息抽屉，角色素材另有授权边界。
description.en: DPH Endfield Theme reshapes DSH Web with a cold-black industrial interface, fluorescent-yellow state signals, chamfered panels, and responsive layout, plus three 24-frame mascot animations for idle, typing, and thinking/execution beside the composer. The home page can open a news drawer that reads six items from the public Endfield news API and caches them for five minutes. It supports only the Web profile, does not upload sessions or input, hides the mascot and drawer on narrow screens, and has separate rights boundaries for character assets.

description.zh: DSH 皮肤管理器提供可拖动的鲸鱼按钮：左键恢复官方外观，右键列出检测到的已安装皮肤并互斥切换，按钮位置和当前选择保存在 `localStorage`。它是纯客户端展示工具，不修改插件安装状态或模型请求；只识别符合 `dsh-client-ui-skin-<id>` 命名约定的皮肤，列表显示名使用包名 id。
description.en: DSH Skin Manager provides a draggable whale button: left-click restores the official look, while right-click lists detected installed skins and switches them exclusively. The button position and current choice are stored in `localStorage`. It is a client-side presentation utility that does not change plugin installation state or model requests; it recognizes the `dsh-client-ui-skin-<id>` naming convention and displays package IDs as names.

description.zh: 苹果风液态玻璃材质：输入卡、侧栏控件、模型选择器和发送键各自独立开关玻璃效果，强度 0–100% 可调；输入框上沿有蓝色流光，打字时暂停。顶部深海蓝玻璃胶囊展开后显示会话标题、模式、时间与余额，开场是一颗可跳过的旋转粒子地球。
description.en: An Apple-style liquid-glass material for the composer, sidebar controls, model picker and send button, each with its own switch and a 0–100% intensity slider; a blue edge glow freezes while you type. A deep-navy glass island expands to show the conversation title, mode, time, balance and settings, and the opening is a skippable rotating particle Earth.

description.zh: 将技术档案式版面延伸到主界面，采用暖白或暗色底板、细线机框、等宽读数和准星罗盘。可与配套开机动画衔接装配，也能单独使用，并支持橙、红、蓝强调色。
description.en: A technical-dossier interface with warm light or dark panels, fine-line framing, monospaced readouts, and crosshair compasses. It can assemble seamlessly from the companion startup animation or run on its own, with orange, red, or blue accents.

description.zh: 提供 16 个仅使用本地资源的动态萌宠模板；悬停或点击会按 Harness 当前中英文语言随机问候，并支持选择角色、左右停靠、大小、暂停、隐藏和快速隐藏。会跟随 DSH 的明暗主题与中英文设置，并尊重减少动效偏好。
description.en: Adds 16 local-only animated pet companions. Hover or click one for a short random greeting in the current Harness language; choose the character, dock it left or right, set its size, pause or hide it, and use the quick-hide control. It follows DSH light/dark and Chinese/English settings and respects reduced-motion preferences.

description.zh: 在设置 → 皮肤工作室里切换 10 套内置皮肤，或用「自定义画布」做一套全局外观：上传不超过 5 MB 的本地背景图，选浅色或深色基底，分别调背景、表面、强调与文字颜色，再缩放、移动或拖动焦点为图片取景。图片与配色只保存在本机并即时应用到整个界面。
description.en: Ten built-in skins can be switched from Settings → Skin Studio, or build one global look in Custom Canvas: upload a local background image up to 5 MB, choose a light or dark base, set background, surface, accent, and text colours individually, and zoom, pan, or drag a focal point to frame the image. Images and palettes stay on the device and apply instantly across the interface.

description.zh: Cyberpunk 2077 / 夜之城主题，包含 CRT 扫描线、Kiroshi 锁定、打字机音效、Relic 故障效果和彩蛋。
description.en: A Cyberpunk 2077 / Night City theme with CRT scanlines, Kiroshi lock-on, typewriter SFX, Relic glitches, and easter eggs.

description.zh: AMP 电台播放器，支持实时可视化、台站搜索和收藏。
description.en: AMP radio player with a live visualizer, station search, and favourites.

description.zh: 以 VirtuaReal 虚拟主播轴伊Joi 为主题的双衣装界面：Joi·Flowers 与 Joi·Library 各自提供浅/深配色、角色与鲸鱼娘装饰；可在换装卡中切换，也可回到原生外观。
description.en: A two-outfit interface theme based on VirtuaReal VTuber Joi: Joi·Flowers and Joi·Library each have their own light/dark palette, character art, and whale-girl decorations; switch outfits from the wardrobe or return to the native look.

description.zh: 外观自定义插件：主题调色、背景图片、透明度与模糊，以及毛玻璃效果。
description.en: Appearance customization plugin with theme colors, background images, opacity and blur, and a glass effect.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供 9 套外观（含鲸吟·蓝幻、雾蓝·极简、素白·明亮、樱绯·粉、青岚·碧、琥珀·金、紫罗兰、翡翠·绿和原生界面），支持每套独立壁纸与面板/对话区/工作区/文件区/阅读区五组透明度滑块。右下角 ◆ 胶囊可即时关闭并恢复原生 UI；固定证据显示目标基座为 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.0-rc.6`，Node 24/Windows，macOS/Linux 未测。
description.en: A DSH Web beauty layer with nine looks—Whale Song Blue Fantasy, Mist Blue Minimal, Plain White Light, Sakura Pink, Cyan Mist, Amber Gold, Violet, Emerald Green and Native UI—plus per-skin wallpapers and five independent transparency sliders for the panel, conversation, workspace, files and reading regions. A bottom-right ◆ pill toggles it off and restores the stock UI; the fixed repo targets `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.0-rc.6` on Node 24/Windows, with macOS/Linux untested.

description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 的音频/视频预览播放器，支持原生播放和带 Range 定位的流式媒体路由。
description.en: Audio/video preview viewer for dsh-better-sidebar with native playback and a Range-seeking streaming route.

description.zh: 独立的纯 CSS 主题，只提供金紫液态玻璃、金色输入文字、代码配色、助手几何标记、工作台卡片和阅读排版；不含游戏背景、角色、视频、音频或外部媒体。支持主题配色、专注模式和减少动态效果；推理滑块样式只适配已安装的兼容选择器，已在 Windows / Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` 验证，运行要求 Node `>=22.19`。
description.en: An independent CSS-only theme providing gold-violet liquid glass, gold input text, code colors, geometric assistant marks, workbench cards, and reading typography. It includes no game backgrounds, characters, video, audio, or external media. It supports palette controls, focus mode, and reduced motion; reasoning-slider styling only applies when a compatible selector plugin is already installed. Verified on Windows / Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`; the package requires Node `>=22.19`.

description.zh: GirlsBangCry 主题将 DSH Web 换成深海宫殿与黑粉蕾丝风格：右下角轮播 14 名成员立绘和群像底幕，左侧也可显示/切换立绘，并支持导入自定义背景与立绘。设置可调轮播间隔、背景压暗、模糊和主色，内置 Subaru GIF；浅色/深色背景随主题切换。仓库标注 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0，角色立绘由使用者提供，公开再发布前需自行确认授权。
description.en: GirlsBangCry gives DSH Web an underwater-palace backdrop and pink-and-black lace styling. A lower-right stage rotates 14 character illustrations over a group backdrop; a second portrait can appear beside the composer, and custom portraits or backdrops can be imported. Settings cover rotation, dimming, blur, and accent color, with a bundled Subaru GIF and separate light/dark assets. The repository is marked CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, while the user-supplied character art requires an authorization check before redistribution.

description.zh: 收录 MyGO!!!!! 五位成员的 Live2D 看板娘：高松燈、千早愛音、要楽奈、長崎そよ、椎名立希，每角色多套换装合计 74 套；支持拖拽移动、视线跟随、换装与拍照，模型本地同源加载、零网络请求。
description.en: A Live2D mascot set featuring all five MyGO!!!!! members — Takamatsu Tomori, Chihaya Anon, Kaname Raana, Nagasaki Soyo and Shiina Taki — with 74 outfits in total; drag to move, mouse-follow gaze, outfit switching and photo capture, with models loaded locally and no network requests.

description.zh: 珍珠白粉色亮色与深紫暗色配色，搭配昔涟 Live2D 桌宠、粉紫粒子和渐变背景；桌宠动作随会话状态变化。
description.en: Pearl-white and pink light colors and a deep-purple dark palette, with a Cyrene Live2D companion, pink-purple particles and gradient backgrounds. Companion animations follow session activity.

description.zh: 芙宁娜主题皮肤，采用水蓝、藏青、冰白与神之眼金色配色，配有微信/QQ 式聊天气泡、双形态焦点模式、自适应壁纸亮度和液态流动动效。
description.en: A Furina-themed skin with aqua blue, navy, ice white, and Vision gold accents, WeChat/QQ-style chat bubbles, dual focus modes, adaptive wallpaper brightness, and liquid-flow motion effects.

description.zh: 真希波·UNIT-08 是面向 DSH Web 的非官方同人皮肤，以烟紫黑、玫红、荧光黄绿和暖象牙为主色，欢迎页展示角色与光学准星；进入对话后立绘会退让并降低透明度与饱和度。它覆盖明暗模式、设置、菜单、终端和消息等表面，支持窄屏与 `prefers-reduced-motion`，素材内嵌且运行时不依赖远程图片；作品与《新世纪福音战士》权利方无关联。
description.en: Mari Makinami · UNIT-08 is an unofficial DSH Web fan skin built around smoked plum, vivid magenta, acid green, and warm ivory. Full-height artwork and optical reticles appear on the welcome screen, then move aside and fade/desaturate during conversations. It covers light and dark treatments for settings, menus, terminal and message surfaces, supports narrow layouts and `prefers-reduced-motion`, and embeds its artwork without a remote runtime dependency. It is not affiliated with the Evangelion rights holders.

description.zh: 仅针对 DSH Web 深色主题的轻量文字调校：降低过亮的正文与加粗文字颜色，把 `<strong>` 字重从 600 放宽到 500，并减轻 h1–h4 标题字重。纯客户端、无运行时依赖；新增配置层后需重启一次，之后保存后刷新即可，浅色主题不受影响。
description.en: A lightweight text-tuning layer for the DSH Web dark theme: it dims overly bright body and bold text, changes `<strong>` from weight 600 to 500, and relaxes h1–h4 heading weights. It is client-only with no runtime dependencies; installing a new config layer needs one restart, after which edits apply on refresh. The light theme is unaffected.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 的插件设置页中调整界面字体、代码字体和 24 套调色板；配色会覆盖主题令牌与 Markdown 样式并立即保存到当前 profile，还会修复宽表格的 hover 抖动。已在 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 实测兼容。
description.en: Configure UI and code fonts plus 24 color palettes from the DSH Web GUI's plugin settings page. Palette choices override theme tokens and Markdown styling, save to the current profile immediately, and also fix wide-table hover jitter. Tested with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2.

description.zh: 面向 DSH 0.2.2-alpha.3 Web 的蓝色主题基础包，提供新会话浅/深色样式、设置导航图标和统一开关外观，并可与 dafy-whale-theme 协同显示；停用后恢复原始界面。
description.en: A blue-theme foundation for the DSH 0.2.2-alpha.3 Web client. It styles the new-session view in light and dark modes, adds settings-navigation icons and themed switches, and can coordinate with dafy-whale-theme; disabling it restores the original interface.

description.zh: EchoCat Prettier 只重组浏览器里的回复展示，不改提示词、模型参数、原文、顺序或复制内容。提供 15 套视觉风格、9 套排版、独立配色、每条回复 2–8 个 emoji 和 1–4 张主题表情包；长回复会自动暂停持续动画、复杂毛玻璃和跨栏排版以减少卡顿与裁切。表情包网络请求仅发送表情包、短主题和情绪，无 API Key、遥测或账号系统。
description.en: EchoCat Prettier only reorganizes how replies are displayed in the browser; it does not change prompts, model parameters, source text, order, or copied content. It offers 15 visual styles, nine layouts, independent palettes, 2–8 emoji and 1–4 themed stickers per reply, and pauses persistent motion, complex glass, and cross-column layouts for long replies to reduce jank and clipping. Sticker requests send only the sticker, a short topic, and an emotion; no API key, telemetry, or account system is required.

description.zh: 把 Taffy 表情挂在 DSH Web 右下角，随输入、思考、工具执行、审批、错误、完成和休眠等状态自动切换；支持拖动、互动菜单、大小/透明度及鼠标穿透设置。
description.en: Pins a Taffy mood mascot in the bottom-right of DSH Web and switches expressions for typing, thinking, tool runs, approvals, errors, completion, and sleep. Includes dragging, an interaction menu, size/opacity controls, and click-through.

description.zh: Nord 配色覆盖 132 个设计 token，提供独立设置页、可选界面/代码字体和输入框下方的 DeepSeek 余额读数及明细面板，并修复宽 Markdown 表格的悬停抖动。字体设置仅在 DSH `<0.2.1` 由插件接管；支持的宿主为 `0.1.7`、`0.2.0`、`0.2.1` 系列，`<=0.1.5` 不支持，余额读数需要在 Host 端配置相应凭据。
description.en: Nord theme for DSH with 132 design-token overrides, its own settings page, optional interface/code fonts, a DeepSeek balance readout with detail panel below the composer, and a fix for jittering wide Markdown tables. The plugin owns font settings only on DSH `<0.2.1`; supported hosts are the `0.1.7`, `0.2.0`, and `0.2.1` lines, while `<=0.1.5` is unsupported. The balance readout requires a Host-side balance credential.

description.zh: 像 Word 一样在设置中即时调整界面与代码字体、字号、字重、颜色和版式；支持中西文字体分开设置、Windows 已安装字体读取，以及内置的 STIX2Text 和 Latin Modern Mono Light。配置自动保存到 `~/.dsh`，不会修改系统字体。
description.en: A Word-like settings editor for DSH typography: change UI and code fonts, sizes, weights, colors, and layout with immediate WYSIWYG updates and auto-save. It supports separate CJK and Latin font choices, reads installed Windows fonts, and bundles STIX2Text and Latin Modern Mono Light without modifying system fonts; settings are stored in `~/.dsh`.

description.zh: V CYBER 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供七套可切换赛博风格：NEON、日落公路、梦核、紫夜极光、银翼千禧、蓝调夜曲和 TACTICAL 红蓝作战面板。主题含 CRT/扫光/渐变描边、会话状态框体与主题色胶囊，支持实时热替换、减少动效和持久化；关闭时不替换或禁用官方插件。需要 DSH ≥0.1.2-rc.1，MIT 许可。
description.en: V CYBER gives DeepSeek Harness Web seven switchable cyber styles: NEON, Sunset Drive, Dream Core, Neon Violet, Y2K Chrome, Blue Nocturne, and the red/blue TACTICAL operations panel. The themes add CRT and streaming effects, gradient borders, session-status frames, and theme-colour pills, with hot swapping, reduced-motion support, and persistence. The plugin does not replace or disable official plugins, and its layers can be turned off. It requires DSH 0.1.2-rc.1 or newer. MIT licensed.

description.zh: Glassic Mist 在默认浅色皮肤上叠加雾蓝蒙版、74 秒缓慢漂移的白色云雾和覆盖菜单、Modal、设置面板、输入框等表面的毛玻璃效果。设置页提供启用开关和 10%–100% 浓度滑块，也可用 `/misttheme` 切换；默认主题不被替换，`prefers-reduced-motion` 会停用云雾动画，且该主题注册为浅色 `mist-blue`。
description.en: Glassic Mist overlays the default light skin with a mist-blue veil, slowly drifting white clouds on a 74-second cycle, and frosted-glass surfaces across menus, modals, Settings, and the composer. Settings provides an enable switch and a 10%–100% intensity slider, and `/misttheme` can toggle it. The default theme is not replaced, `prefers-reduced-motion` disables the cloud animation, and the registered `mist-blue` theme is light-only.

description.zh: 右下角常驻桌宠，可拖拽、投喂、玩耍，并随任务和会话状态切换动画；可选的会话记忆只写入本机文件，不进入模型上下文或上传网络。
description.en: A persistent bottom-right desktop pet that can be dragged, fed, and played with, changing animations with task and session states; optional session memory is written only to a local file and never enters model context or gets uploaded.

description.zh: 为 `read`、`bash` 和 `pwsh` 工具输出提供 VS Code Dark+ 风格的分层语法高亮：按文件扩展名或内容识别 JSON/代码，无法识别的表格和日志保持原样，并显示退出码状态条。工具卡片可在设置中默认折叠，运行中或出错时自动展开；纯前端处理，不改写会话、不调用模型、零 token 开销。
description.en: Adds VS Code Dark+ layered syntax highlighting to `read`, `bash` and `pwsh` tool output. It detects JSON or code from file extensions/content, leaves unrecognized tables and logs plain, and shows an exit-code chip. Tool cards can collapse by default in Settings but auto-expand while running or on errors; rendering is frontend-only, so it does not rewrite sessions or call the model and adds zero token overhead.

description.zh: 一套非官方的 Claude 风格 DSH Web 主题：暖纸色 `#F5F3EE`、陶土橙强调色 `#DA7756`、Noto Serif SC 界面字体和 Cascadia Mono 代码字体；与 Anthropic、DeepSeek 均无关联。
description.en: An unofficial Claude-inspired DSH Web theme with warm paper `#F5F3EE`, a clay-orange accent `#DA7756`, Noto Serif SC for the UI, and Cascadia Mono for code. It is not affiliated with Anthropic or DeepSeek.

description.zh: 在设置 → 皮肤中使用本地图片、图片 URL 或本地文件夹作为全屏背景，支持顺序/随机轮播（随机一轮内不重复）、图片适合度、暗化、模糊与表面透出调节；明暗主题自动适配，设置和轮播进度可跨刷新/重启恢复。支持 PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF/BMP；文件夹扫描与路径读取需要宿主半区。
description.en: Use local images, image URLs, or a local folder as a full-screen background from Settings → Skin. It supports sequential or random slideshows without repeats within a random round, fit modes, darkening, blur, and surface translucency, with light/dark adaptation and persistence across refreshes and restarts. Supports PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF/BMP; folder scanning and path-based access require the host half.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供象牙白、墨色、淡玫瑰与古金配色，配合整页背景图、毛玻璃面板、飘落花瓣、黑冠徽记和可跳过的开屏动画；明暗模式跟随宿主外观设置。背景图、侧栏立绘和开屏素材需用户自备，缺少素材时会自动降级。
description.en: A DSH Web theme in ivory, ink, pale rose, and antique gold, with a full-page background, frosted-glass panels, falling petals, a black-crown emblem, and a skippable opening animation. Light and dark follow the host appearance setting. Backgrounds, sidebar artwork, and opening assets are user-supplied; missing assets fall back automatically.

description.zh: 以《鸣潮》爱弥斯为灵感的粉白主题皮肤：樱花粉与纯白渐变，深色模式加入粉紫霓虹和青色点缀，内置角色背景图，配合半透明面板、悬停粉光与粉色滚动条；提供浅色/深色两套配色。
description.en: An Aemeath-inspired skin with cherry-pink and white gradients, pink-violet neon with cyan accents in dark mode, a bundled character backdrop, translucent panels, pink hover glow, and pink scrollbars across light and dark variants.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web 角落显示套餐用量、账户余额或今日 token；支持 OpenCode Go、Command Code 和 DeepSeek 官方 API，角色可拖动、缩放，并在用量跨过阈值时提醒。
description.en: A DSH Web corner pet that shows plan usage, account balance, or today's tokens. It supports OpenCode Go, Command Code, and the official DeepSeek API, with dragging, zooming, and threshold reminders.

description.zh: 提供 15 套莫兰迪/OKLCH 配色（主菜单精选 12 套）、明暗自适应、磨砂玻璃面板和低强度动效；作者声明明暗主色均达到 WCAG AA，零运行时依赖。
description.en: Offers 15 Morandi/OKLCH palettes, with 12 featured in the main menu, adaptive light and dark variants, frosted-glass panels, and restrained motion; the author states that the main colors meet WCAG AA and runtime dependencies are zero.

description.zh: 鲸鱼娘会随 DSH 工作状态陪伴：工作时捧碗进食，回合结束收碗，出错时露出屑表情，点击可挥手或比心；待机包含呼吸、飘发和眨眼动画。
description.en: A whale-girl work companion for DSH: she eats from a bowl while work runs, puts it away when the turn ends, gives a smug reaction on errors, and waves or makes a heart when clicked; idle includes breathing, flowing hair and blinking.

description.zh: 按音频目录组织场景的白噪音播放器，支持 AI 后台下载氛围音、顺序/随机/单曲循环/间歇四种播放模式，以及按时长或指定时刻的睡眠定时器。
description.en: A directory-driven white-noise player with AI background downloads for ambient sounds, sequential, shuffle, single-track loop, and interval modes, plus sleep timers by duration or specified time.

description.zh: 把对话区变成透明的字符雨画布，支持黑客帝国英文数字、道法修仙篆体和甲骨卜辞三种模式，七种配色与独立金边发光；可让 agent 流式 token 原文混入雨柱，按活跃度调节雨速，并调透明度、速度、密度、字号、范围和注音。修仙模式内嵌 LXGW 霞鹜篆书（OFL-1.1），甲骨字形来自 CC BY 4.0 数据集；支持 `prefers-reduced-motion`，双击可清屏，固定 README 记录的验证宿主为 DSH `0.1.7-rc.2`。
description.en: A transparent canvas of digital rain over the conversation, with Matrix-style letters and numbers, Taoist seal-script, or oracle-bone modes; seven color schemes and an independent gold-edge glow. Agent streaming tokens can enter the rain, intensity can follow activity, and opacity, speed, density, font size, region, and zhuyin labels are adjustable. The seal-script mode embeds LXGW Seal Script under OFL-1.1; oracle glyphs come from a CC BY 4.0 dataset. It honors `prefers-reduced-motion`, double-click clears the canvas, and the fixed README records DSH `0.1.7-rc.2` as the verified host.

description.zh: 为 DSHD 提供 7 套内置皮肤：深蓝默认、午夜、冷杉、暖纸、紫罗兰、卡通和可爱，并保留一个置灰的 `custom` 预留槽位。可在设置中即时预览、应用或取消，放大预览使用真实 `--dsw-alias-*` token，选择持久化到 `skin-pack.skin`；皮肤只覆盖 UI token，不改代码块高亮。没有特权设置 API 的远程浏览器中，换肤仅在当前进程生效。
description.en: A DSHD skin pack with seven built-in looks—DeepSeek default, Midnight, Nord, Sepia, Violet, Cartoon and Cute—plus a disabled `custom` placeholder. Preview, apply or cancel skins from Settings, inspect an enlarged preview rendered with real `--dsw-alias-*` tokens, and persist the choice in `skin-pack.skin`; the skins change UI tokens, not code-block highlighting. In remote browsers without the privileged settings API, changes remain process-local.

name.zh: 率土之滨 · 铁血水墨

description.zh: 纯客户端皮肤，把 DSH Web 做成暗色“铁血战场”和亮色“水墨古风”两套场景：约 115 个 `--dsw-*` token、宋体系衬线字体、宣纸/墨染纹理、青铜滚动条、回纹角饰和印玺装饰，自动跟随系统浅色/深色偏好。装饰与纹理由 SVG/CSS 代码生成，不含第三方图片或游戏资源。
description.en: A client-only DSH Web skin with two scenes: dark Ironblood Battlefield and light Ink-Wash Ancient style. It covers about 115 `--dsw-*` tokens and adds Song-style serif text, xuan-paper/ink textures, bronze scrollbars, key-fret corner ornaments, and a seal, following the system light/dark preference. All decorations and textures are generated as SVG/CSS; no third-party images or game assets are shipped.

description.zh: 从本地 `images/` 目录读取 JPG/JPEG/PNG/WebP/GIF/AVIF，默认每 5 分钟轮播一张全屏背景，并叠加默认 35% 黑色蒙版；复制新图后下一轮即可出现。可用 `DSH_SKIN_IMAGES_DIR`、`DSH_SKIN_ROTATE_MS` 和 `DSH_SKIN_OVERLAY_OPACITY` 配置目录、间隔和蒙版；仓库不内置背景图，且需要 Web profile 的 host 半提供本地文件路由。
description.en: Rotates local JPG/JPEG/PNG/WebP/GIF/AVIF files from `images/` into a full-screen background, every five minutes by default, with a 35% black overlay for readability; new files appear on the next cycle. Configure the folder, interval, and overlay with `DSH_SKIN_IMAGES_DIR`, `DSH_SKIN_ROTATE_MS`, and `DSH_SKIN_OVERLAY_OPACITY`. No wallpapers are bundled, and the Web-profile host half must expose the local-file route.

description.zh: 在界面角落养一头《牛来》的小牛：平时呼吸、眨眼、踱步、打盹和气泡唠叨，agent 任务完成时蹦出来喊「妈~~妈~~」并同步嘴型；含九款皮肤、事件绑定与 WebAudio 合成叫声。
description.en: A little NiuLai calf living in the corner of the Web UI — breathing, blinking, pacing, dozing and chattering in bubbles, then popping up to shout “Ma~ma~” with synced mouth when an agent task completes; nine skins, event binding and WebAudio-synthesized calls.

description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏中预览音频和视频，通过经过认证的 HTTP Range 路由传输，远程浏览器可播放并拖动定位大文件，无需打开 Host 上的原生应用。
description.en: Preview audio and video in the DSH right sidebar through an authenticated HTTP Range route, allowing remote browsers to play and seek large files without opening a native app on the host.

description.zh: 把 DeepSeek 像素鲸作为 DSH Web 的右下角浮层桌宠，并按会话状态切换悬停、工作、受惊、庆祝、喝咖啡和睡眠等反应。图形以 40×31 网格像素化为单个带 CSS keyframes 的 SVG，不使用 GIF、APNG 或脚本。
description.en: Adds Seek, a pixelated DeepSeek whale, as a bottom-right overlay pet for DSH Web. It reacts to session states with idle, working, startled, celebration, coffee, and sleep animations. Each state is a single SVG with its own CSS keyframes—no GIF, APNG, or script.

description.zh: 页面角落漂着一只蓝紫绿渐变的半透明鲸鱼，点击打开可拖动、最小化的临时聊天窗；默认跟随 Harness 会话模型，也可配置任意 OpenAI 兼容端点，支持逐 token 流式输出、复制和清空。聊天不会写入 DSH 会话历史，插件内可清空；自定义模式的 API Key 只保存在浏览器 `localStorage`，只发送到你配置的端点。
description.en: A translucent blue–purple–green whale drifts at the edge of the page; click it to open a draggable, minimizable temporary chat window. It follows the Harness session model by default, or can use an OpenAI-compatible endpoint with streamed output, copy, and clear controls. Chats never enter DSH session history and can be cleared in the plugin; in custom mode the API key stays in browser `localStorage` and is sent only to the endpoint you configure.

description.zh: 为桌面版提供银河、层峦、黑洞等十种动态场景，支持导入图片和视频壁纸，并分别调节侧栏、对话区及输入区等区域的不透明度。
description.en: Ten animated desktop background scenes, including a galaxy, layered mountains and a black hole, plus imported image or video wallpapers and separate opacity controls for interface regions.

description.zh: 打开页面先满屏播放约 3.6 秒超新星序列：170–380 条拖尾光线向中心汇聚，核心白热过载，爆闪后 430 块碎片与冲击波散开，DEEPSEEK/HARNESS 字标砸出，再拉伸成超空间光线淡出。四角 HUD 显示时间码、节点哈希与版本号，点击或按 Esc 可跳过。
description.en: Plays a full-viewport supernova sequence of about 3.6 seconds on page load: hundreds of light trails converge, the core goes white-hot and detonates, the DEEPSEEK / HARNESS wordmark slams in, then everything stretches into hyperspace. A four-corner HUD shows timecode, node hash and version; click or press Esc to skip.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web 中提供可拖拽、可折叠、可隐藏的网易云音乐浮窗，支持单曲/歌单/专辑浏览、搜索、同步歌词与翻译、播放队列、扫码或 Cookie 登录，以及侧栏迷你模式。播放队列、进度、音量和播放模式保存在浏览器 `localStorage`；需要访问 `music.163.com`，部分歌曲受版权或会员限制，收藏功能也可能受网易云风控影响。登录 Cookie 只用于请求 `music.163.com`，不会发送给其他第三方。
description.en: Adds a draggable, collapsible, and hideable NetEase Cloud Music window to DSH Web, with song, playlist, and album browsing, search, synchronized lyrics and translations, a playback queue, QR-code or Cookie login, and a sidebar mini-player. The queue, progress, volume, and playback mode are stored in browser `localStorage`. It needs access to `music.163.com`; some tracks are limited by copyright or membership, and favorites may be affected by NetEase risk controls. Login Cookies are used only for requests to `music.163.com`, not sent to other third parties.

description.zh: 把 Web 界面换成「爱丽丝与彼岸」风格的配色与装饰：60 多个设计令牌一起换，侧栏、气泡、按钮、代码块与滚动条同步变色，右侧叠一层低透明度立绘。右下角角色面板列 12 个头像，点头像换主题色和立绘；面板可拖动、收起，也能关掉背景立绘。
description.en: An Alice Nation-inspired theme that repaints more than 60 design tokens together — sidebar, bubbles, buttons, code blocks and scrollbars — and adds a low-opacity character portrait on the right. A corner panel offers 12 avatars; picking one swaps the accent colour and artwork, and the panel can be dragged or collapsed, or the portrait turned off.

description.zh: 设置里的样式工作台提供实时 CSS 编辑器、点选元素生成样式、163 个 `--dsw-*` 设计令牌的明暗值编辑、字号/密度/圆角/内容宽度/气泡圆角滑杆，以及 7 套预设和 JSON 导入导出。配置权威副本写入 `$DSH_HOME/custom-style.json`，不收集数据、不发起外部网络请求；它不注册主题，可与其他主题共存，但覆盖同一 token 时后加载者优先。
description.en: A settings-based style workbench with a live CSS editor, click-to-style element picker, light/dark editing for 163 `--dsw-*` design tokens, sliders for type scale, density, corner radius, content width, and bubble radius, plus seven presets with JSON import/export. The authoritative copy is stored in `$DSH_HOME/custom-style.json`; it collects nothing and makes no external network requests. It registers no theme and can coexist with other themes, but the later override wins when both change the same token.

description.zh: 纸质主题以 Claude Code 为灵感，使用奶油纸背景、暖墨色文字、陶土色强调、衬线 CJK 字体和暖色代码块，并把“纸质”加入浅色/深色/跟随系统同一组外观选择。选择会写入 `localStorage`，卸载后内置外观行恢复；README 以 DSH `0.1.0-rc.6` 验证为依据。
description.en: Paper Theme is inspired by Claude Code, with a cream-paper background, warm-ink text, terracotta accents, serif CJK typography, and warm code blocks. It adds Paper alongside Light, Dark, and System in the Appearance choices. The selection is stored in `localStorage`, the native Appearance row returns after uninstall, and the README documents validation against DSH `0.1.0-rc.6`.

description.zh: 绿色黑底的 Matrix/赛博朋克主题，覆盖背景、文字、按钮、代码高亮、滚动条、弹窗和侧栏等设计令牌；加入可在减少动态效果时自动关闭的矩阵雨、CRT 扫描线、银河星空、太阳系、透视战斗机与右下角虚拟人动效。纯浏览器端、无外部依赖、无网络请求和持久化。
description.en: A green-on-black Matrix/cyberpunk theme that overrides design tokens for backgrounds, text, buttons, syntax highlighting, scrollbars, dialogs, and the sidebar. It adds Matrix rain, CRT scanlines, a galaxy, a solar system, a perspective fighter jet, and a lower-right virtual avatar, with motion disabled under reduced-motion preferences. It is browser-only, has no external dependencies, and makes no network requests or persistent storage.

description.zh: 提供可跳过的全屏开机动画，内置视频、壁纸、语音与两只可拖动桌宠，也支持上传自己的素材。视频音轨和独立开机音频可分别开关，应用就绪后动画会淡出。
description.en: A skippable full-screen startup animation with bundled videos, wallpapers, voice clips, and two draggable pets, plus custom uploads. Video sound and separate startup audio have independent switches, and the animation fades out when the application is ready.

description.zh: 在侧边栏“设置”触发器上方加入 DeepSeek API 余额卡片，读取官方 `GET /user/balance`，展示 `total_balance`、`topped_up_balance` 与 `granted_balance`，以及更新时间和基于卡片加载以来余额差的近似期间用量。默认每 60 秒自动刷新，也可手动刷新；刷新失败会保留上次成功值，`total_balance` 不高于 `lowBalanceThreshold`（默认 `5`）时显示低余额警告。Host 端读取已配置的凭据并只返回归一化数字，密钥不会发送到浏览器。该接口是预付费余额模型，不提供真正的“总配额/已用”字段。MIT 许可。
description.en: Adds a balance card above the sidebar Settings trigger. It reads DeepSeek’s official `GET /user/balance` endpoint and shows `total_balance`, the `topped_up_balance`/`granted_balance` breakdown, last-update time, and an approximate usage delta from when the card loaded. It refreshes every 60 seconds or manually, warns when `total_balance` is at or below `lowBalanceThreshold` (default `5`), and keeps the last good snapshot after a failed refresh. The host reads the configured credential and returns only normalized numbers; the credential never reaches the browser. The API is prepaid credit, not a true total/used quota. MIT licensed.

name.zh: DSH Black Hole 黑洞主题

description.zh: 在 DSH 原生外观选择器中加入可切换的 Black Hole 主题：保留 DSH Dark 调色板，只在新会话 Hero 区渲染 WebGPU 黑洞背景，Light/Dark/System 仍由宿主管理。动态层目标 60 FPS，仅在桌面宽屏、WebGPU 可用且未启用减少动态效果时运行；其他环境保留纯深色背景，离开新会话页会释放 GPU 资源。
description.en: Adds a switchable Black Hole option to DSH’s native appearance selector. It keeps the DSH Dark palette and renders a WebGPU black-hole background only in the New Session Hero, while Light/Dark/System remain host-managed. The animated layer targets 60 FPS and runs only on a wide desktop with WebGPU available and reduced motion off; other environments keep a plain dark background, and leaving New Session releases GPU resources.

description.zh: 高自由度的磨砂玻璃主题，可调节玻璃模糊度、磨砂度和流体或自定义壁纸背景；关闭后即可恢复原生界面。
description.en: A highly configurable frosted-glass theme with adjustable blur, frosting, and fluid or custom wallpaper backgrounds; disable it to return to the native interface.

description.zh: 可深度定制的主题面板，提供 Aurora、Midnight、Sakura、Forest、Amber 与 Mono 六套预设，支持明暗模式、分区毛玻璃/浮雕/霓虹样式、图片或渐变背景、四区透明度、字体/阴影/动效以及免 F12 的分区自定义 CSS；配置保存到可导入/导出的 `config.json`。本地路径图片受扩展名与 8 MiB 限制，背景风格层会自动切换到深色模式，部分分区选择器依赖 DSH 版本的 CSS 类名。
description.en: A deeply customizable theme panel with six presets—Aurora, Midnight, Sakura, Forest, Amber, and Mono—plus light/dark modes, per-area glass/embossed/neon styles, image or gradient backgrounds, four-zone opacity, fonts, shadows, motion, and per-area custom CSS without opening DevTools. Settings are stored in importable/exportable `config.json`; path-based images have an extension allowlist and an 8 MiB limit, background style layers switch to dark mode automatically, and some area selectors depend on DSH CSS class names.

description.zh: 在宽度不超过 1023px 时启用覆盖式侧栏抽屉、滑动手势与安全区适配，提供对话轮次导航和 PWA 主屏幕安装支持。
description.en: Adds overlay navigation drawers, swipe gestures and safe-area handling at widths up to 1023px, with conversation-turn navigation and PWA home-screen installation.

description.zh: 在 DSH 里开一间酒馆：用七块面板捏出 SillyTavern V2/V3 角色卡，也能导入 JSON 或 PNG 角色卡，每个角色独立上下文，可接 OpenAI 兼容接口。支持 1–12 人队伍（各自提示词与模型）、带系统判定的跑团冒险、世界书、六套面板主题与社区扩展。
description.en: Opens a tavern inside DSH: build SillyTavern V2/V3 character cards from seven visual modules, import JSON or PNG cards, and chat with each character in its own context on either the DSH model or a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint. It also covers parties of 1–12 with per-member prompts and models, dice-and-check RPG adventures with story outlines, world books, six panel themes, and community extensions.

description.zh: 把外部 `δ-me13` 技能套件接入 DSH 的 13 席黄金裔工作流：每席拥有独立会话、配色/壁纸与角色贴纸，并可在总览工作台派发任务、全席征询和人工确认移交。技能正文从 `skillRoots` 只读加载，插件包不内置 `SKILL.md` 等技能内容；视觉素材可来自带图发布包或本地 `assetsRoot`。固定包支持 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`/`0.2.1-rc.3`。
description.en: Connects the external `δ-me13` skill suite to a 13-seat Chrysos Heirs workflow in DSH: each seat gets its own sessions, palette/wallpaper and character stickers, while the workbench supports dispatch, all-seat consultation and user-confirmed handoffs. Skill text is read read-only from `skillRoots`—the package does not include `SKILL.md` or the rest of the skill suite—while artwork can come from the with-assets release package or a local `assetsRoot`. The fixed package targets DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.3`.

description.zh: 以灵梦与博丽神社为主题的皮肤，包含昼夜神社背景、灵梦立绘、画框侧边栏与输入框，以及纸白透明界面。
description.en: A Reimu and Hakurei Shrine skin with day-and-night shrine backgrounds, Reimu artwork, framed sidebar and input box, and a paper-white translucent interface.

description.zh: 本地音乐播放器，按文件夹组织树形歌单并直接流式播放，零 token 消耗。
description.en: A local music player with folder-based tree playlists, direct streaming playback, and zero token consumption.

description.zh: 在聊天记录中自动将本地或在线的音频、视频和图片路径渲染为内联媒体预览组件。
description.en: Automatically renders local or online audio, video, and image paths as inline media previews in the conversation.

description.zh: 把 DSH Web 左下角原生 Cordis Plugin 面板替换为纯 CSS 乐高砖视图，展示当前会话运行的动态插件（`dyn/*`）。每块砖保留运行、停止、删除、批准/拒绝等生命周期操作，支持按插件 ID 搜索、运行计数、四套主题、中英和明暗适配；静态 `cordis.yml` Loader 插件不在列表中，且项目与 LEGO Group 无关联。
description.en: Replaces the DSH Web Cordis Plugin panel with a pure-CSS Lego-brick view of dynamic plugins running in the current session (`dyn/*`). Each brick keeps lifecycle actions such as run, stop, remove and approve/decline, with plugin-ID search, a running count, four themes, i18n and light/dark token support. Static Loader plugins from `cordis.yml` are not listed, and the project is not affiliated with the LEGO Group.

description.zh: 纯黑背景与高对比 `#00ff41` 绿色强调的 DSH Web 黑客终端皮肤：全站直角、等宽字体、对话与输入区全宽，并为 Gecko/Blink/WebKit 提供统一的 8px 绿黑滚动条。无扫描线覆盖，面向 OLED；插件仅在客户端覆盖主题 token 并注入 CSS，卸载时移除。
description.en: A hacker-terminal skin for DSH Web with a pure-black background and high-contrast `#00ff41` accents, square corners, a monospace stack, full-width conversation/composer areas, and uniform 8px green-on-black scrollbars across Gecko, Blink, and WebKit. It uses no scanline overlay and is OLED-friendly; the plugin only overrides client-side theme tokens and CSS, which are removed on teardown.

description.zh: 支持本地与网易云音乐播放，可通过 Cookie 解锁 VIP 歌曲；提供 Agent 控制播放、自定义播放器 CSS，以及队列结束后通知 AI 挑选新歌。
description.en: Plays local music and NetEase Cloud Music, with VIP-song access via Cookie; includes Agent playback control, custom player CSS, and AI notification to choose new songs when the queue ends.

description.zh: 为 DSH 提供暖纸、豆绿和暖灰三套背景配色，保留原生布局与组件；支持跟随浅色、深色或系统外观，并在同一来源的多个窗口间同步选择。
description.en: Three background palettes—Warm Paper, Sage Green, and Warm Grey—keep DSH's native layout and components intact. The selection follows light, dark, or system appearance and syncs across windows on the same origin.

description.zh: 高级配色在设置页新增“配色”行，内置 Tokyo Night、Nord、Catppuccin Mocha、Everforest、Rosé Pine、Ayu Mirage、Catppuccin Latte 和 Paper Gold 八套方案，并支持输入名称、明暗、底色与强调色导入自定义配色。完整令牌覆盖背景、边框、按钮、文字、代码块、侧栏和滚动条；选择与导入方案持久化，点击“默认”可回到原有明暗偏好。需要组合树中的 `ui-theme`，基于 dsh `^0.1.0-rc.6` 构建。
description.en: Premium Palettes adds a Palette row in Settings with eight built-ins—Tokyo Night, Nord, Catppuccin Mocha, Everforest, Rosé Pine, Ayu Mirage, Catppuccin Latte, and Paper Gold—and an import dialog for custom palettes defined by name, scheme, background, and accent. Full token maps cover backgrounds, borders, buttons, text, code surfaces, the sidebar, and scrollbars. Choices and imports persist, while Default restores the prior appearance preference. It requires `ui-theme` in the composition and is built against dsh `^0.1.0-rc.6`.

description.zh: 暗色专用的资产型皮肤，以循环视频为背景：蓝发少女、青色数据雨和悬浮全息仪表盘，面板使用薄玻璃与 1px 冷蓝细线；支持 `skin.json` v2、完整 token 重映射和补丁样式。视频背景约 25.46 秒循环，皮肤不使用 `backdrop-filter` 以保持画面清晰；许可证 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0（需署名、非商业、相同方式共享），且最亮画面下输入占位符对比度可能低于 4.5:1。
description.en: A dark-only asset skin built around a looping video: a blue-haired girl, cyan data rain, and a floating holographic instrument panel with thin glass surfaces and 1px cold-blue lines. It ships a v2 `skin.json`, a full token remap, and selector patches; the video loops at about 25.46 seconds. It avoids `backdrop-filter` to preserve sharp footage. Licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0—attribution, non-commercial use, and share-alike required—and the composer placeholder can fall below 4.5:1 over the brightest footage.

description.zh: 边对话边听歌的音乐播放器，提供可自由拖动的折叠/展开悬浮窗口，通过 Meting API 等解析源接入网易云音乐，并支持歌单导入和按歌名或歌手搜索导入单曲。
description.en: A music player for listening while chatting, with collapsible or expanded draggable floating windows, NetEase Cloud Music access through sources such as Meting API, playlist import, and single-track import by title or artist.

description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供壁纸与可选的 Liquid Glass 液态玻璃叠加层。
description.en: Wallpaper with an optional Liquid Glass overlay for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.

description.zh: 《孤独摇滚！》风格的 DSH Web 极简深色主题：后藤独粉强调色、暖紫背景与内嵌壁纸，覆盖 `--dsw-alias-*`/`--dsw-specific-*` token，并在设置中提供“原始主题 ↔ 孤独摇滚主题”开关。选择持久化在 `localStorage`，壁纸自包含可离线使用；需要 DSH `0.1.0-rc.6` 或更新版本，纯客户端插件。
description.en: A minimalist dark DSH Web theme inspired by Bocchi the Rock!, with Gotoh Hitori pink accents, warm-purple backgrounds and an embedded wallpaper. It overrides `--dsw-alias-*`/`--dsw-specific-*` tokens and adds a Settings toggle between the original and Bocchi themes. The choice persists in `localStorage`, the wallpaper is embedded for offline use, and the pure client plugin requires DSH `0.1.0-rc.6` or newer.

name.zh: 千夏 · 绝区零外观主题

description.zh: 《绝区零》千夏（Sunna）同人外观主题，提供“立绘”和“影画”两套主题，均有浅色/深色形态；右下角画板可调 5 个图层、内容底色透明度、背景主视觉和启动动画时长，并可拖动 Q 版挂件、选择 7 种表情。已在 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 验证；素材按 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 发布，非官方且非商业。
description.en: A fan-made ZZZ Sunna appearance theme with Portrait and Overlay variants, each in light and dark forms. The bottom-right palette board controls five layers, content-surface opacity, background artwork, and intro-animation duration; the draggable chibi companion includes seven expressions. Verified on DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`; CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, unofficial and non-commercial.

description.zh: 一套非官方的太空歌剧风 DSH Web 暗色主题：深空背景、霓虹 HUD、黑洞吸积盘、行星轨道、扫描器、彗星轨迹、能量束和遥测面板，并为发送消息加入超空间风格效果。使用通用科幻元素，不包含或复刻特定作品的标志、角色或舰船设计；支持 `prefers-reduced-motion`。
description.en: An unofficial space-opera dark skin for DSH Web with deep-space layers, neon HUD chrome, a black-hole accretion disk, planetary orbits, scanner UI, comet trails, energy beams, and a telemetry panel, plus a hyperspace-style send effect. It uses generic sci-fi language rather than logos, characters, ships, or other protected designs from a specific franchise, and respects `prefers-reduced-motion`.

description.zh: 纯客户端液态玻璃样式，给助手消息、会话/插件/任务侧栏行和桌面标题栏菜单添加半透明底板、圆角和阴影；用户自己的消息气泡明确排除。可通过 `--aris-glass-alpha` 与 `--aris-glass-blur` 调整透明度和模糊；不支持 `backdrop-filter` 或启用减少透明度时退回不透明主题底色，并在检测到壁纸插件的侧栏玻璃时主动让位。面向 DSH `0.2.0-rc` Web 结构。
description.en: A client-only liquid-glass layer for assistant messages, session/plugin/task rows in the sidebar, and desktop title-bar menus, adding translucent surfaces, rounded corners, and shadows while explicitly leaving user bubbles untouched. Tune it with `--aris-glass-alpha` and `--aris-glass-blur`; browsers without `backdrop-filter` or with reduced transparency fall back to opaque theme surfaces, and the sidebar layer yields to the wallpaper plugin’s glass mode. Targets the DSH `0.2.0-rc` Web structure.

description.zh: 五套定制配色（青蓝、素白、靛紫、墨青、终端），每套都成对定义浅色与深色；界面叠两层独立水印——固定的女仆立绘与 21 张可切换表情图，浓淡可调。终端配色下代码块是纯黑面板、金琥珀关键字，并重着色 9 类语法标记，取自 Windows Terminal 的 Campbell 配色。
description.en: Five custom palettes (blue, paper white, indigo, ink teal, terminal), each defined for light and dark, plus two independent watermark layers: a fixed maid illustration and 21 switchable stickers with intensity control. The terminal palette repaints nine Shiki token types with Windows Terminal's Campbell scheme and gives code a pure-black panel.

description.zh: 追踪 DSH 会话中的 `write`/`edit` 工具调用，在“审查”标签页展示带语法高亮的 side-by-side diff；支持按会话或最新轮次查看、子代理变更聚合、SSE 实时更新，以及撤回单个修改或整份文件。只读审查配一键撤回，不需要外部编辑器，原生产物预览不受影响。
description.en: Tracks `write`/`edit` tool calls in DSH sessions and shows syntax-highlighted side-by-side diffs in a Review tab. View a session or the latest turn, aggregate subagent changes into the parent session, receive SSE updates, and revert one change or an entire file. It is read-only review plus one-click revert, needs no external editor, and leaves native produced-file previews untouched.

description.zh: 管理壁纸与半透明面板主题，可从本机、文件夹或 ZIP 导入 Codex-Skins，并用文字、图片或视频辅助生成主题。支持静态与动态背景、可见度调节、重命名和导出。
description.en: Manage wallpaper and translucent-panel themes, import Codex-Skins from local installations, folders, or ZIP files, and generate themes using text with optional images or video. Supports static and animated backgrounds, visibility controls, renaming, and export.

description.zh: C-137 皮肤提供 28 张 Rick and Morty 目录海报、自定义场景、霓虹外观，以及 Rick、Morty 和传送枪叠加宠物；可在皮肤行调节透明度、管理最多 12 张自定义场景，并拖动角色进入传送门互动。需要 DeepSeek Harness `0.2.x`（已在 `0.2.0-rc.2` 验证），不是官方产品。
description.en: The C-137 skin provides 28 Rick and Morty catalog posters, custom scenes, neon chrome, and Rick, Morty, and portal-gun overlay pets. Its skin row supports opacity control and up to 12 custom scenes, while the pets can be dragged into the portal for interactions. It requires DeepSeek Harness `0.2.x` (verified on `0.2.0-rc.2`) and is unofficial.

description.zh: 面向 DSH Desktop/Web 的主题定制器：可分别调节背景、侧栏、聊天卡片、输入框、品牌强调色、代码块和文字/边框颜色；亚克力玻璃支持 0–40px 模糊、10%–100% 不透明度和 100%–220% 饱和度，并可单独控制侧栏、聊天卡片和输入框。还支持循环 MP4/WebM 与静态图片壁纸、内置动态壁纸和命名预设，右下角浮动调色按钮会在闲置后隐藏。
description.en: A DSH Desktop/Web theme customizer with separate controls for the base, sidebar, chat cards, composer, brand accent, code blocks, text, and borders. Its acrylic glass layer supports 0–40px blur, 10%–100% opacity, and 100%–220% saturation, with independent sidebar, chat-card, and composer toggles. It also supports looping MP4/WebM or static-image wallpapers, built-in live wallpapers, named presets, and a bottom-right palette button that hides after inactivity.

description.zh: Windows 桌宠可搭配六款人物与五种信息卡，显示 DeepSeek 余额、Codex 额度和本机用量统计。内置订阅账号管理，账号轮换与预热需单独授权，默认不开启。
description.en: A Windows pet with six character designs and five card styles displays DeepSeek balances, Codex quotas, and local usage statistics. Includes subscription-account management; account rotation and warm-up require separate opt-in authorization and are off by default.

name.zh: 550C 开机动画与 UEG 授权界面

description.zh: 提供约 4 秒或 17 秒的 550C 开机片头和可交互 UEG 访问授权界面，支持两套主题、点击/Enter 推进、Esc 跳过，以及本地导入片头音乐和二维码；片头与 UEG 界面互斥。
description.en: Provides a roughly 4-second or 17-second 550C intro and an interactive UEG access screen with two themes, click/Enter progression, Esc to skip, and local intro-music and QR-code imports; the intro and UEG screen are mutually exclusive.

description.zh: 把 DSH 界面换成 550C 控制台外观，提供琥珀、绿、青、白四套磷光配色，以及可开关的扫描线、暗角、等宽字体和机器读数栏；设置可实时生效并记住选择。
description.en: Recasts the DSH interface as a 550C console with amber, green, cyan, and white phosphor schemes, optional scan lines and vignette, monospace text, and readout rails. Settings apply live and persist locally.

description.zh: 住在 DeepSeek Harness Web 右下角的蓝发鲸鱼女仆桌宠，按开工、工作轮播和收工庆祝展示动画；可显示任务用时、Token 消耗和费用，并提供会话/单轮费用、北京时区趋势、余额、天气、喂食和设置面板。
description.en: A blue-haired whale-girl pet that lives in the lower-right of DeepSeek Harness Web and animates startup, work cycles, and completion celebrations; it shows task duration, token usage, and cost, with session/turn cost pills, Beijing-time trends, balance, weather, feeding, and settings panels.

description.zh: 以 Marathon 风格的大色块、硬边界和工业排版重做 DSH 外观，提供工作区色条、调色盘联动动效、每日 token 活动图与随机 Max 效果，支持 Windows 和 macOS。
description.en: Recasts DSH in a Marathon-inspired industrial style with block colors, hard edges, workspace color bars, palette-driven motion, a daily token activity chart, and randomized Max effects. Supports Windows and macOS.

description.zh: 官网风格主题把 deepseek.com 的视觉语言带入 DSH：新会话页的 WebGL2 流体渐变背景、鼠标交互点阵网格、可被打散并回正的粒子鱼 LOGO、标题聚光灯和磨砂玻璃，并随 `color-scheme` 自动适配浅/深色。它是纯客户端注入，依赖 WebGL2、Canvas 2D 与 `backdrop-filter`，且没有设置页开关；项目声明非官方。
description.en: This site-inspired theme brings deepseek.com's visual language into DSH with a WebGL2 fluid gradient backdrop on the new-session page, a mouse-reactive dot grid, a particle-fish logo that can scatter and reform, a title spotlight, and frosted glass that follows `color-scheme` for light/dark modes. It is a client-only injection requiring WebGL2, Canvas 2D, and `backdrop-filter`; there is no settings toggle, and the project is unofficial.

description.zh: 宋律 · Songgrid 把宋代美学与瑞士国际主义设计结合为 DSH Web 主题：4pt 间距阶、2/4px 圆角、中文 `Noto Serif SC` 宋体与拉丁无衬线分工，并提供 `song-grid-xuanzhi`（宣纸浅色）、`song-grid-yemo`（夜墨深色）和 `system` 跟随系统三种选择。汝窑天青 `#3A7284`（对宣纸对比度 4.91:1，WCAG AA）承担按钮、焦点、选中态和链接；窑铜 `#9A6B50` 只用于引用和标记等编辑性强调。主题通过 design token 覆盖，不改宿主源码；需要 DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2`，DSH `0.1.5-rc.2` 应改装 `dsh-theme-songgrid@0.1.0`。设置写回宿主的跨浏览器持久化依赖 loopback 地址（`localhost`/`127.x`/`::1`），其他入口只能依赖浏览器本地镜像；与 DeepSeek 官方无隶属关系。MIT 许可。
description.en: Songgrid combines Song-dynasty aesthetics with Swiss International Style for DSH Web: a 4pt spacing scale, 2/4px radii, `Noto Serif SC` for Chinese headings, and a separate sans-serif face for Latin text. It offers `song-grid-xuanzhi` (rice-paper light), `song-grid-yemo` (night-ink dark), and `system` follow-host variants. Ru celadon `#3A7284` carries buttons, focus, selection, and links with 4.91:1 contrast on paper (WCAG AA); kiln copper `#9A6B50` is reserved for editorial accents such as blockquotes and markers. The theme overrides design tokens without patching host source. It requires DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2`; DSH `0.1.5-rc.2` users should install `dsh-theme-songgrid@0.1.0`. Cross-browser persistence through the host requires a loopback URL (`localhost`, `127.x`, or `::1`); other entry points rely on the browser-local mirror. It is not affiliated with DeepSeek. MIT licensed.

description.zh: 把 DSH Web UI 设计成一间玻璃工作室：三层材质阶梯、按面积分档的模糊、放大的正文阅读标尺，以及氛围/专注与清透/标准/沉静场景。壁纸是唯一可变输入，可导入 JPEG、PNG 或 WebP（上限 32MB）；设置页提供钩子自检和可导出的 JSON 报告。
description.en: Turns the DSH Web UI into a glass studio with a three-level material ladder, area-based blur tiers, a larger reading scale, and ambience/focus plus clear/standard/quiet scene modes. The wallpaper is the only variable input; JPEG, PNG, and WebP imports are accepted up to 32 MB, and the settings page includes hook checks with an exportable JSON report.

description.zh: 用本地图片、视频或 12 套随浅深主题变化的渐变预设替换 DSH Web 背景，并调节清晰度、背景/界面/对话栏透明度、亮度、对比度、饱和度、缩放、位置、遮罩、铺放方式和动效；玻璃模式还能让侧栏、卡片和浮层半透明。媒体只存浏览器 IndexedDB，设置写入 localStorage，不联网、不读取聊天内容；支持减少动态效果和关闭视频自动播放。
description.en: Customize the DSH Web background with a local image, video, or one of 12 gradients that each adapt to light and dark themes. Adjust clarity, background/UI/composer opacity, brightness, contrast, saturation, zoom, position, veil, fit mode, and motion; glass mode makes the sidebar, cards, and popovers translucent. Media stays in browser IndexedDB and settings in localStorage; the plugin makes no network requests, never reads chat content, honors reduced motion, and can disable video autoplay.

description.zh: 主题选择器在设置页统一管理应用主题与已安装主题插件，同一时间只保留一个主题生效，并通过 dsh-market API 自动禁用其他主题、持久化选择和每 6 秒同步状态。它依赖 `dshmarket` 的安装清单与 HTTP API；对无法被市场分类的 `git+https://` 皮肤会按仓库地址补充分类，并在 `use-skin` 被拒绝时回退到手动互斥切换。
description.en: Theme Picker adds a Settings page for app themes and installed theme plugins, keeping only one active at a time. It uses the dsh-market API to disable other themes, persist the choice, and refresh state every six seconds. It requires `dshmarket`’s installed list and HTTP API; skins installed from unclassified `git+https://` specs are supplemented by repository URL, with manual exclusive switching as a fallback when `use-skin` is rejected.

description.zh: 本地优先的陪伴插件「鲸灵」：记得你允许她记住的事，陪你整理思路，不会擅自执行操作；含可审阅的记忆、受限预设与可选的 Windows 桌面伙伴。
description.en: Jingling is a local-first companion that remembers only what you allow, helps you sort out thoughts, and never acts on its own, with reviewable memory, a restricted preset and an optional Windows desktop sidecar.

description.zh: 把 DSH 的推理强度下拉框换成可吸附的呼吸滑块，在 Off / Low / Medium / High / Max 间切换；面板提供液态玻璃、9 种主题色、Canvas 动效、流速/亮度/音量三轴调校、吸附音效、游标图标和 JSON 配置分享。可随时关闭并恢复原生下拉框；插件零网络请求、不读写用户文件，配置保存在浏览器本地。MIT 许可。
description.en: Replaces DSH’s reasoning-effort dropdown with a magnetic, breathing slider for Off / Low / Medium / High / Max. The panel adds liquid glass, nine theme colours, Canvas effects, speed/brightness/volume tuning, snap sounds, cursor icons, and JSON configuration sharing. You can turn it off and restore the native dropdown at any time; the plugin makes no network requests and does not read or write user files, while its configuration stays in browser storage. MIT licensed.

description.zh: 住在窗口里的小鲸鱼伙伴：随工作、等待、庆祝、出错、休息和睡眠六种状态切换贴纸，可拖动、缩放、隐藏与恢复，可只看当前会话或全部会话，任务完成时同步提醒。
description.en: A little whale buddy living inside the window that switches between six states — working, waiting, celebrating, error, resting and sleeping — and can be dragged, resized, hidden and restored, scoped to the current or all sessions with completion sync.

description.zh: 打开 DSH、新对话或钉住的会话时，把视频片头铺满整个窗口播放；带播放控制、触发规则、按星期与时段自动换片、片库管理，以及中英双语界面。
description.en: Plays video intros full-frame when DSH opens, a new conversation starts or a pinned session is used, with playback controls, trigger rules, day/time-based clips, clip library management and a bilingual UI.

description.zh: 为输入框、弹窗、菜单、卡片、代码块、任务面板和右侧栏统一使用按浅色/深色分别调校的半透明玻璃材质，带顶部高光、边缘反光和背景模糊。设置 → 通用 → 外观提供总开关，关闭后精确恢复原生外观；适用于 DSH Desktop/Electron 与 `dsh web` 的 0.2.x，不联网、不读取会话或凭据，只写插件自己的 localStorage。
description.en: Applies one translucent glass material—tuned separately for light and dark—to the composer, dialogs, menus, cards, code blocks, task panels, and right sidebar, with top highlights, edge reflections, and background blur. A switch under Settings → General → Appearance restores the stock UI exactly when off. Works on the DSH Desktop/Electron app and `dsh web` for DSH 0.2.x; it makes no network requests, reads no sessions or credentials, and writes only its own localStorage.

description.zh: 以主题画廊为首个模块的 DSH 定制 UI 套件，当前提供 23 套一键切换的主题，包括品牌风格适配与原创方案。每套主题约含 110 个 `--dsw-*` token，覆盖背景、边框、按钮、交互态、Markdown、侧栏、气泡、浮层、阴影与字体栈。
description.en: A DSH custom-UI suite whose current first module is a one-click theme gallery with 23 themes, including brand-style adaptations and original palettes. Each theme maps roughly 110 `--dsw-*` tokens across backgrounds, borders, buttons, interaction states, Markdown, the sidebar, bubbles, overlays, shadows, and font stacks.

description.zh: 把 DeepSeek 使用历史整理成日、7 天、月、年四种视图：年度热力图、工作区/会话时间线、按任务合并的日视图 Gantt 轴，以及可拖拽的主界面统计卡片。支持点击时间段直达实际会话，并展示活跃时长、会话数、轮次、工具调用和 token；provider 上报时 token 精确，否则为启发式估算。
description.en: Organizes DeepSeek usage history into Day, 7-day, Month, and Year views: a yearly heatmap, workspace/session timelines, a task-merged daily Gantt axis, and draggable main-interface statistic cards. Click a time segment to open the actual conversation, and inspect active time, sessions, turns, tool calls, and tokens; token accounting is exact when the provider reports usage and heuristic otherwise.

description.zh: 参考《明日方舟：终末地》官网风格，采用奶油纸底、墨黑文字、信号黄/武陵青强调色和直角工业编辑风；设置支持背景、动效、音频通知与额度胶囊等开关。
description.en: Inspired by the Arknights: Endfield website, this theme uses a cream-paper base, ink-black text, signal-yellow and Wuling-cyan accents, and a sharp-corner editorial style; settings cover the background, motion, audio notices, and balance capsule.

description.zh: 以星云壁纸为底、根据壁纸种子色实时取色的深色 DSH 主题，叠加液态玻璃，并覆盖启动屏、关于页、插件页和背景设置；可用本地图片/视频替换壁纸，文件只写入 `~/.dsh/star-wallpaper/`。支持 DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0` 的完整适配，旧版本退回基础模式；随包的《崩坏：星穹铁道》/DeepSeek 资源有各自版权限制，商业或再分发前需替换为已获授权素材。
description.en: A dark DSH theme built around a nebula wallpaper whose seed color drives the palette, with liquid-glass surfaces and skins for the boot screen, About, Plugins, and background settings. You can replace the wallpaper with a local image or video; files stay under `~/.dsh/star-wallpaper/`. Full support targets DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0`; older versions fall back to a basic mode. Bundled Honkai: Star Rail and DeepSeek assets carry separate rights restrictions, so replace them with licensed material before commercial use or redistribution.

description.zh: 可配置的界面扩展，支持壁纸与毛玻璃外观、强调色、快捷键、用量面板、历史条、Markdown 渲染和入场动效；功能可按模块选择，默认不改变原生界面。
description.en: A configurable UI extension with wallpaper and frosted-glass styling, accent colors, shortcuts, a usage panel, a history strip, Markdown rendering, and entrance motion; features can be selected by module and are off by default.

description.zh: DeepSeek Palenight 主题以深靛 Palenight 配色覆盖深色模式，以暖米灰与青绿色强调覆盖浅色模式，约 100 个主题变量涵盖表面、菜单、文字、代码块和滚动条。推荐的持久化 dsh bundle 会随宿主重启保留；仓库中的旧动态 Cordis 形态已弃用，重启即失效。
description.en: DeepSeek Palenight applies indigo Palenight colors to dark mode and warm parchment neutrals with teal accents to light mode, covering about 100 theme variables across surfaces, menus, text, code blocks, and scrollbars. The recommended persistent dsh bundle survives host restarts; the repository’s deprecated dynamic Cordis form is reference-only and is lost on restart.

description.zh: 可选的赛博编辑风格深色主题包，提供 Acid Noir、Acid Noir Signal 和 Default appearance 三个选项；通过官方设置集成管理主题，安装不会强制切换，停用/卸载会移除主题、样式和监听器。只使用稳定的 `--dsw-*`/语义钩子，不修改 Harness 文件、不加载网络字体、图片、音频或游戏素材；适配 DSH `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`。
description.en: A selectable cyber-editorial dark theme bundle with Acid Noir, Acid Noir Signal, and Default appearance. It integrates with official Settings, does not switch themes on installation, and removes its themes, stylesheet, and listeners when disabled or uninstalled. It relies on stable `--dsw-*` and semantic hooks, never patches Harness files, and ships no network fonts, images, audio, game assets, or external runtime resources; its package targets DSH `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`.

description.zh: 可选的新粗野主义/波普艺术主题包，强调“外部大胆、中心安静”：侧栏、选中态、Composer、Goal 和转场使用强几何与高对比色，会话正文、Markdown、终端、diff 和流式内容保持克制。提供 Cutout Clash、Night Cutout、Pop Signal 与 Default appearance，动效可选完整转场、跟随系统或关闭；不含外部字体、图片、音频、网络素材、游戏标志或角色素材，适配 DSH `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`。
description.en: A selectable neo-brutalist/pop-art theme built around loud edge, calm center: the sidebar, selection, Composer, Goal surfaces, and transitions carry expressive geometry, while conversation text, Markdown, terminals, diffs, and streaming content stay quiet. It provides Cutout Clash, Night Cutout, Pop Signal, and Default appearance, with Full motion, Follow system, or Motion off. No external fonts, images, audio, network assets, game marks, or character assets are included; the package targets DSH `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`.

description.zh: 提供暖纸 Warm Paper、柔褐书页 Old Book、茶褐 Tea Brown、橄榄静绿 Quiet Olive 和雾蓝 Mist Blue 五套低蓝光配色，覆盖 DSH 语义 token，并热切生效、零布局改动、卸载可还原。支持 macOS/Windows 的浅深主题；只改颜色与材质，不改原生布局，持久化使用 localStorage，需 DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.2`。
description.en: Five low-blue-light palettes—Warm Paper, Old Book, Tea Brown, Quiet Olive, and Mist Blue—override DSH semantic tokens with hot switching, no layout changes, and clean restoration on uninstall. It supports light/dark themes on macOS and Windows; only colors and material tokens change, while native layout stays intact. Preferences use localStorage rather than the Host Settings API, and the package requires DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.2`.

description.zh: 跑在 Windows 桌面上的大肥鱼：独立透明置顶窗口不占网页界面，监听会话状态切换 91 个透明动画，支持语音唤醒/闲聊、番茄钟、喂食、吐槽与简单任务执行。
description.en: A big fish that runs on the Windows desktop in a separate transparent always-on-top window, switching among 91 animations from real session state, with voice wake/chat, pomodoro, feeding, roasts and simple task runs.

description.zh: 在浏览器里实时渲染 Wallpaper Engine 的 scene 壁纸（three.js + Rust/WASM 粒子），也播放视频、web 与图片壁纸，无需后台运行 Wallpaper Engine。面板可调遮罩、模糊、画面适配与音量，支持收藏、隐藏、自动轮播和开机动画。
description.en: Renders Wallpaper Engine scene wallpapers in the browser in real time (three.js + Rust/WASM particles) and also plays video, web and image wallpapers, with no Wallpaper Engine runtime needed. Controls cover overlay opacity, blur, fit mode, sound, a 0.5× render scale, favourites, hiding, auto-rotation, per-wallpaper properties and an optional boot animation.

description.zh: 网易云音乐播放器，在侧栏中播放已登录用户的喜欢歌曲，并支持搜索和在线播放。
description.en: A NetEase Cloud Music player in the sidebar for playing the logged-in user's liked songs, with search and online playback.

description.zh: 在半透明侧栏弹窗中浏览、预览、下载和删除生成的图片与视频。
description.en: Browse, preview, download, and delete generated images and videos in a semi-transparent sidebar popup.

description.zh: 在 DSH Web 的“设置 → 通用设置”加入 One Dark Pro 开关，将整个界面切换为 VS Code One Dark Pro 暗色配色。通过官方 `ctx.theme` 注册并叠加 token 覆盖，启用状态保存到浏览器 `localStorage`，关闭时恢复此前的浅色/深色/跟随系统偏好，并支持多标签页同步。
description.en: Adds a One Dark Pro toggle under DSH Web Settings → General, switching the interface to the classic VS Code One Dark Pro dark palette. It registers through the official `ctx.theme` service and applies a token override; the enabled state is stored in browser `localStorage`, previous light/dark/system preference is restored when disabled, and changes sync across tabs.

description.zh: 鲸鱼娘伴侣结合任务进展、峰谷调度、费用与余额面板及互动养成；提供 130 段动画、可选 Electron 桌面模式（预览）、位置与大小设置，以及多语言界面。
description.en: A whale-girl companion combining task progress, peak/off-peak scheduling, cost and balance panels, and pet interactions. Includes 130 animation clips, an optional Electron desktop preview, position and size controls, and multiple languages.

description.zh: 护眼模式在 DSH Web「设置 → 常规 → 外观」下加入开关，以豆沙绿 `#CCE8CF` 为浅色基准，并为深色模式提供暖绿黑底；会重映射包括输入框、按钮、气泡、菜单和代码块在内的 89 个颜色 token。开关状态保存在 `localStorage`，覆盖浅色、深色和跟随系统；固定版本依赖 DSH 的主题/slot 接口，升级大版本后可能需要停用或更新插件。
description.en: Adds an Eye Care switch under DSH Web Settings → General → Appearance. The light palette is anchored to the bean-paste green `#CCE8CF`, while dark mode uses a warm green-black surface; 89 color tokens cover the composer, buttons, bubbles, menus, code blocks, and other UI layers. The switch persists in `localStorage` and works over light, dark, or system appearance. The pinned release depends on DSH theme/slot interfaces, so a major DSH upgrade may require disabling or updating the plugin.

description.zh: ui-song-theme 通过可撤销的 `ThemeRuntime.overrideTokens()` 层提供宋式浅色与深色主题，同时保留用户的 `light`、`dark` 或 `system` 偏好。浅色使用绢纸表面、暖墨文字、植物灰绿色交互色和朱砂错误态；深色使用松墨绿黑表面与低饱和淡玉强调色，标题优先使用系统已安装的宋体/CJK 衬线，正文仍用 Harness 无衬线字体栈，并统一宿主残留的蓝色选中态和浏览器焦点轮廓。卸载时只移除自己的 token 层并恢复下方主题。兼容 DeepSeek Harness UI theme `>=0.1.0-rc.6 <0.2.0`；系统字体可用性会影响字形度量，仓库不捆绑字体文件。MIT 许可。
description.en: ui-song-theme contributes a reversible `ThemeRuntime.overrideTokens()` layer for Song-inspired light and dark palettes while preserving the user’s `light`, `dark`, or `system` preference.
