Light mode uses silk-paper surfaces, warm-ink text, botanical gray-green interactions, and cinnabar errors; dark mode uses pine-ink green-black surfaces with a restrained pale-jade accent. Headings prefer installed Song and CJK serif fonts, body text keeps the Harness sans-serif stack, and legacy blue selections plus the browser focus outline are brought into the same botanical family. Unloading removes only this token layer and restores the theme below it. It supports DeepSeek Harness UI theme `>=0.1.0-rc.6 <0.2.0`; system-font availability affects exact glyph metrics, and no font files are bundled. MIT licensed.

description.zh: 在侧栏底部提供「主题与壁纸」面板：上传本机图片，分别为浅色/深色设置壁纸，管理图库和 6 套渐变预设，并调节各界面的磨砂材质。支持整窗铺满或浮窗布局、1/3/6/12/24 小时自动轮换；壁纸存储在本机。
description.en: Adds a Theme & Wallpaper panel to the sidebar footer for uploading local images, assigning separate light/dark wallpapers, managing a gallery and six gradient presets, and tuning frosted surfaces. It supports full-bleed or floating-card layouts and 1/3/6/12/24-hour rotation; wallpapers are stored locally.

description.zh: 面向 DSH Web/桌面端的动画鲸鱼桌宠，按会话与连接状态切换待机、休眠、思考、工作、查找、执行命令、验证、等待、成功和错误等动作，并支持拖动、摸头、戳一戳和碰尾巴。可在设置中调大小、气泡和动效，右下角鲸鱼按钮可即时启停；固定支持 Windows 10/11 x64，插件不读取密钥、不截图、不发遥测，也不新增监听端口。
description.en: An animated whale companion for the DSH Web/desktop UI that switches among idle, sleeping, thinking, working, searching, commanding, testing, waiting, success, and error states from session and connection activity. It supports dragging, head pats, pokes, and tail touches; size, bubbles, and motion are configurable, and the bottom-right whale button toggles it. The packaged helper targets Windows 10/11 x64; it reads no keys, captures no screenshots, sends no telemetry, and opens no extra listening port.

description.zh: 鲸鱼女仆纸面主题，提供亮暗配色、海洋插画、手绘边框、装饰素材与常驻桌宠。
description.en: A whale-maid paper-style theme with light and dark palettes, ocean illustrations, hand-drawn borders, decorative assets, and a persistent desktop pet.

description.zh: THE MACHINE HUD 以深蓝黑和机器青重绘界面，叠加等宽字体、网格与扫描线，并在右下角提供接入真实会话遥测的悬浮面板：Agent 运行时雷达、工具成功/错误率、上下文窗口占用、解码 tok/s 和真实工具事件流。皮肤设计为仅深色，并在卸载后还原官方外观。
description.en: THE MACHINE HUD repaints the interface in deep blue-black and machine cyan, with monospace typography, grid, and scanline atmosphere. Its bottom-right floating panel uses live session telemetry for a running-state radar, tool success/error rates, context-window occupancy, decoded tok/s, and the session’s real tool-event stream. The skin is dark-only by design and restores the official look on uninstall.

description.zh: 首页同款背景，包含深海流体、点线网格和数字鲸鱼，并提供深浅双主题。
description.en: The homepage-style background features deep-sea fluid effects, a point-and-line grid, and a digital whale in light and dark themes.

description.zh: 让标签页图标、侧栏标志与首页形象随会话状态播放 bloub 动画，可自定义表情、形状、颜色和文字。另带 macOS 与 Windows 桌面入口，复用当前网页后端。
description.en: Animate tab icons, sidebar branding, and the home-page avatar with bloub reactions to session activity. Customize expressions, shapes, colors, and text, and create macOS or Windows desktop entries that share the existing web backend.

description.zh: 可在原版蓝鲸与“鲸鱼娘 · 抱饭碗”之间切换的余额桌宠：点击后从官方 `/user/balance` 读取可用、充值和赠送余额，按币种展示并默认每 15 秒刷新；支持拖动、键盘操作、减少动态效果和失败保留上次结果。v1.4 增加按 API Key 分开的 7 日观测、余额增减、低余额与完成提醒、主题预设和最近历史，但不估算可核验的逐轮费用，也不能把余额下降归因到当前会话；余额查询在 Host 端读取已配置凭据并仅请求官方余额接口，凭据不保存在插件文件。
description.en: A balance pet that switches between the original DeepSeek whale and Whale Girl · Holding a Rice Bowl. Clicking it reads available, topped-up, and bonus balances from the official `/user/balance` endpoint, separates currencies, and refreshes every 15 seconds by default; it supports dragging, keyboard controls, reduced motion, and retaining the last result after a failed refresh. v1.4 adds per-API-key seven-day observations, balance increases/decreases, low-balance and completion reminders, and theme presets, but it does not estimate verifiable per-turn cost or attribute a balance drop to the current session. The balance check reads a configured Host-side credential and requests only the official balance service; the credential is not stored in the plugin files.

description.zh: 在对话正文中将本地图片和视频绝对路径自动内联为图片或可播放视频，并附带可点击的本地地址行。
description.en: Automatically inlines local image and video absolute paths in chat as images or playable videos, with a clickable local address line below each item.

name.zh: Theme Asuka // 02 明日香学园主题

description.zh: 非官方的 DSH Web 明暗外观主题：学校蓝、缎带红、暖纸色与第三东京市夜色，配合三张按本地时间段切换的壁纸和液态玻璃表面。设置中可切换 Off、On the Way to School、Noon Classroom、Tokyo-3 Night，并调节壁纸透明度/模糊和动效；目标兼容 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`，WebGPU 不可用时回退到 SVG/磨砂效果，当前固定版本的 Ubuntu/WSL 与真实模型流未复测。
description.en: An unofficial light/dark DSH Web appearance theme built from school blue, ribbon red, warm paper and Tokyo-3 night tones, with three wallpapers that switch by local time and liquid-glass surfaces. Settings offer Off, On the Way to School, Noon Classroom and Tokyo-3 Night plus wallpaper opacity/blur and motion controls; it targets DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`, falls back to SVG/frosted effects when WebGPU is unavailable, and the fixed release was not rechecked on Ubuntu/WSL or with real model streaming.

description.zh: DSH Icon Theme 为设置导航和侧边栏操作自动分配统一图标，并允许逐项手动覆盖；它发现实时 `settings.section` 与 `sidebar.footer.action`，内置 50 个 Fluent UI 16 Regular 图标和 dsh-market 单色图标，选择按稳定键保存，卸载/热重载可恢复宿主 SVG。兼容 DSH `>=0.1.0-rc.6 <0.2.0`。
description.en: DSH Icon Theme assigns coherent icons to Settings and sidebar actions, with per-target overrides. It discovers live `settings.section` and `sidebar.footer.action` contributions, ships 50 Fluent UI 16 Regular glyphs plus the dsh-market monochrome glyph, persists choices by stable key, and restores host SVGs on unload or hot reload. It targets DSH `>=0.1.0-rc.6 <0.2.0`.

description.zh: Zaimokuza 动态壁纸主题库内置「黑烟」「游侠客」「上官婉儿」「水墨侠客」「正是修行时」五套主题：图片场景以轻量 Three.js 动画重建，水墨侠客使用 1080p 循环视频，其余主题带开屏与淡入背景。可在「通用设置 → Zaimokuza主题」切换并实时调节背景透明度，支持明暗玻璃 token、页面隐藏暂停与 `prefers-reduced-motion`；素材来自 Wallpaper Engine。
description.en: Zaimokuza is an animated-wallpaper theme library with five built-ins: Black Smoke, Wandering Swordswoman, Shangguan Wan'er, Ink Swordsman, and Cultivation Time. Image-based Wallpaper Engine scenes are rebuilt as lightweight Three.js animations; Ink Swordsman uses a 1080p looping video, while the others include an intro and fade into the background. Switch themes and tune background opacity in General Settings → Zaimokuza Theme; light/dark glass tokens, hidden-page pausing, and `prefers-reduced-motion` are supported.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供四套配色预设（默认、深海蓝、暖沙、松石绿）和整页背景图：图片在浏览器内压缩后用于侧栏与主区，文字上方自动加可读遮罩。设置保存在浏览器本地，可在“设置 → UI设置”中一键重置；4.0.0 起只保留配色与背景功能，不再提供卡片布局引擎。已在 DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 与 0.2.0-rc.1 验证，MIT 许可。
description.en: Adds four colour presets—Default, Deep Sea Blue, Warm Sand, and Turquoise—to DSH Web, plus a full-page background image. Imported images are compressed in the browser, shown behind both the sidebar and main area, and covered with a readability veil. Settings stay in browser storage and can be reset from Settings → UI Settings; since 4.0.0 the plugin only handles colours and backgrounds and no longer provides the card-layout engine. It was verified with DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 and 0.2.0-rc.1. MIT licensed.

description.zh: 柔和的樱色午后视觉小说风格皮肤，为 DSH Web 的浅色与深色模式分别叠加粉彩配色，并加入 18 片半透明飘落花瓣与边缘柔光晕。会话头部提供花瓣开关，设置 → General 提供整套皮肤总开关；两项状态保存在 `localStorage`，停用或卸载会清理皮肤层并恢复默认外观。
description.en: A soft visual-novel skin with pastel palettes for both DSH Web light and dark modes, plus an overlay of 18 translucent falling petals and a faint edge vignette. The session header includes a petal toggle, while Settings → General adds a master switch; both persist in `localStorage`, and disabling or uninstalling removes the skin layers and restores the default appearance.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 加入黑蓝暗调主题和会话区助理形象，支持静图与无缝循环片段、按文件名自动发现并切换形象，以及常驻呼吸/眨眼和点击或低频触发的动作。形象素材需放入 `assets/looks/`；卸载后还原界面，且不会替换 DSH 侧栏品牌位。
description.en: Adds a black-and-blue dark theme and an assistant character layer to the DSH Web GUI, with still images, seamless loops, filename-based discovery and switching, quiet breathe/blink idle states, and click or low-frequency actions. Character assets must be placed in `assets/looks/`; uninstall restores the UI and leaves DSH's sidebar branding in place.

description.zh: DSH Diorama 是角色舞台皮肤，提供“雪乃·暖阳日常”和“隐秘年代志”两套角色主题，每套含双角色立绘与表情贴纸；可在装饰看板中拖动、缩放、旋转并调节透明度，上传自定义素材，还能将素材与布局导入/导出为可分享 JSON 包。选择和装饰配置保存于 `localStorage`。
description.en: DSH Diorama is a character-stage skin with two themes—Yukino: Warm Daily and Occult Chronicle—each with dual character sprites and sticker sheets. Its decoration board supports dragging, resizing, rotating, opacity, and anchor controls; you can upload custom assets and import/export shareable JSON packs containing assets and layout. Skin and decoration settings persist in `localStorage`.

description.zh: 右下角桌面宠物插件，提供 5 状态 × 32 帧的精灵图动画，并根据 Agent 的思考、工作和完成状态切换动作；支持拖拽定位、闹钟、番茄钟、便签、久坐/喝水提醒，以及可更换皮肤和预览。设置保存在浏览器 `localStorage`；默认皮肤素材来自用户提供并经 AI 处理的图片，使用时需自行确认素材权利。
description.en: A floating desktop pet with 5 state animations of 32 frames each, reacting to agent thinking, work, and completion. It adds draggable placement, alarms, a Pomodoro timer, notes, sedentary/hydration reminders, and selectable skins with previews. Settings live in browser `localStorage`; the default skin uses user-provided images processed with AI, so users should verify their rights to the assets.

description.zh: 页面角落的 Q 版战地医护桌宠，按每轮页面观察到的输入/输出 token 播报用量，并按实际使用天数从新兵成长到医护队长。它还提供本机统计、7/30 天趋势、每日任务、13 枚勋章、久坐/喝水提醒、四套换装和可拖拽吸边；数据只存浏览器 `localStorage`，不联网、不读凭据、不查余额或显示金额。统计仅覆盖页面打开期间观察到的用量，提醒依赖前台标签页。
description.en: A chibi field-medic pet that sits in the page corner, reports input/output token usage observed after each turn, and grows from recruit to medic captain by actual days of use. It also provides local totals, 7/30-day trends, daily goals, 13 badges, sit/water reminders, four outfit themes, and drag-to-edge positioning. Data stays in browser `localStorage`: it makes no network requests, reads no credentials, checks no balance, and shows no money; statistics cover only usage observed while the page is open, and reminders depend on a foreground tab.

description.zh: 住在 DSH 里的 AI 搭子：独立聊天列表、私信式气泡和连续发送；同一角色共享近期对话与可检索历史，新建聊天也能接话。可以用一句话创建、改期和取消提醒，把明确委托交给后台的 DSH Agent 执行并带回结果，还能改称呼、表达方式和双方气泡颜色；多个角色各自保存聊天与记忆。
description.en: An expressive assistant that lives inside DSH. It has its own chat list with DM-style bubbles and consecutive sending, shared memory across chats, natural-language reminders created and rescheduled in conversation, and background work handed to DSH agents with results brought back; character names, tone and bubble colours are adjustable.

description.zh: 为 dsh-better-sidebar 提供视频文件预览，在侧栏中以内嵌 <video> 播放器打开 .mp4、.webm、.mov、.mkv 和 .avi 文件，并支持拖动进度条。
description.en: A video-file preview for dsh-better-sidebar that opens .mp4, .webm, .mov, .mkv, and .avi files in an inline <video> player with a draggable progress bar.

name.en: Blue Whale Leaping from the Sea

description.zh: DeepSeek 蓝鲸主题，采用官方渐变和跃出海面的鲸鱼艺术。
description.en: DeepSeek blue-whale theme with the official gradient and leaping-whale art.

description.zh: 米白纸面与墨黑机箱的硬科幻控制台：纸色正文区、墨黑侧栏（悬停反相为纸白）、墨黑代码舱与操作员消息块、零圆角发丝边框，屏幕边框、四角括号和左右刻度尺组成 HUD。侧栏下方有一条实时思考字幕，逐字打出当前会话最后一段推理文本；授权弹窗改成屏幕居中的墨黑对话框。
description.en: An off-white paper and ink hard-sci-fi console: paper canvas, ink sidebar with inverted hover, ink code decks and operator messages, zero radii and hairline borders, plus a bezel HUD with corner brackets and rulers. A live reasoning ticker in the sidebar types out the session's latest reasoning text, and approvals open in a centred ink dialog.

description.zh: DSH Pixel UI 提供九套像素 RPG 风格主题：木屋、羊皮纸、暖阳、终端绿、全息、南瓜灯、便签本、云石和秘银；覆盖宿主 token、控件、滚动条和 SVG 光标，后五套素材主题使用内联 9-slice PNG。主题选择可在宿主文件与 `localStorage` 间持久化，支持 DSH Desktop，设为「现代默认」即可退出；目标兼容 DSH `0.1.0-rc.6` 至 `0.2.x`，并在 `prefers-reduced-motion` 下关闭动效。
description.en: DSH Pixel UI provides nine pixel-RPG themes: Wood Cabin, Parchment, Warm Sun, Terminal Green, Hologram, Pumpkin, Paper Note, Marble, and Mithril. It restyles host tokens, controls, scrollbars, and the SVG cursor; the latter five material themes use inlined 9-slice PNG assets. Theme selection persists in the host file with a `localStorage` mirror, supports DSH Desktop, and can be exited by choosing Modern Default. The target range is DSH `0.1.0-rc.6` through `0.2.x`, with motion disabled under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

description.zh: 以爱心开关解锁的七夕互动彩蛋合集：粉/玫瑰主题、祝福横幅、Canvas 爱心与星光背景，输入 `520` 触发 10 条告白弹幕，输入 `情书` 或 `loveletter` 从 100 句文案库生成可改写、收藏和换句的情书。还能把情书绘制成 1080×1440 分享卡片，提供 5 套配色并支持下载/复制；必须先开启氛围换肤，暗号才会生效。
description.en: A Qixi interaction bundle unlocked by a heart toggle: pink/rose styling, a blessing banner, and a Canvas background of floating hearts and starlight. Enter `520` for 10 confession lines, or `情书`/`loveletter` for a rewriteable, savable love letter drawn from a 100-line library. Love letters can become 1080×1440 share cards in five color sets for download or copying; the theme must be enabled before either code works.

description.zh: 一个插件注册六套文房色板：玄墨、玄墨·暗、宣纸、宣纸·暗、沧海、青瓷，每套从五个手调颜色展开出约 30 个 --dsw-* 令牌（表面、描边、文字、diff、选区等）。在设置 → 插件市场 → 主题 → 已注册色板里切换，立即生效并在刷新后保留，首次安装会落到最接近的明暗变体。
description.en: One plugin registers six Wenfang palettes — Xuanmo, Xuanmo Dimmed, Xuanzhi, Xuanzhi Dimmed, Canghai, and Qingci — each derived from five hand-tuned colours into about 30 --dsw-* tokens for surfaces, borders, text, diffs, and selection. Switch them in Settings → Plugin Market → Themes → registered palettes; changes apply instantly, survive reloads, and fall back to the closest light/dark variant on first install.

description.zh: 面向 Windows 桌面的透明置顶奶龙桌宠，随 DeepSeek Harness 启动并提供 13 组动作、定时自动表演和点击展开的动作面板。动作来自 74 帧精灵图集，不重绘或凭空生成；Windows 安装器在必要时会准备 Electron，安装后需要重启 Harness。
description.en: A transparent, always-on-top Nailong desktop pet for Windows that starts with DeepSeek Harness, offers 13 action groups, scheduled performances, and a click-open action panel. Its animations use a 74-frame sprite sheet rather than newly drawn or invented frames; the Windows installer may prepare Electron when needed, and installation requires restarting Harness.

name.zh: 天魔命曲 DSH 皮肤

description.zh: 《弹丸论破：天魔命曲》主题皮肤使用同人游戏素材打造全屏 DSH Web 外观：自定义光标、全屏壁纸、梯形侧栏、对话输入条、动态底部数据走马灯、发送按钮、运行轮盘和新会话按钮。数据条会在智能体更新节点时保持动画相位，悬停时暂停；项目使用公开 DOM 钩子，游戏素材按单独许可发布，属于非官方同人作品。
description.en: An Angels & Demon Fate Symphony skin for DSH Web built from fan-game assets, with a custom cursor, full-screen wallpaper, trapezoid sidebar, composer bar, animated bottom data ticker, send button, running spinner, and new-session button. The ticker keeps its animation phase when agent updates rebuild nodes and pauses on hover; it uses public DOM hooks, and the game assets follow a separate license. It is unofficial fan work.

name.zh: 光污染 RGB 流光皮肤

description.zh: 独立的 RGB 光效层，可单独使用，也可作为 `dsh-angelsanddemon-fatesumphony-skin` 的伴生层；为输入框、侧栏、会话头部、Hero 标题和新会话按钮添加 CSS/WebGL 辉光。待机和聚焦为蓝色，智能体运行时环绕变色，会话自然完成时变绿（主动点击停止不会触发）；WebGL2 不可用时回退到 WebGL1/CSS，并遵循 `prefers-reduced-motion`。
description.en: An independent RGB glow layer that can run alone or accompany `dsh-angelsanddemon-fatesumphony-skin`, adding CSS/WebGL light around the composer, sidebar, session header, hero title, and new-session button. Idle and focused states glow blue, agent activity cycles through RGB, and a naturally completed session turns green; clicking Stop does not trigger the green state. WebGL2 falls back to WebGL1/CSS, and `prefers-reduced-motion` is respected.

description.zh: 仅限 Windows，需安装本机网易云音乐客户端；提供迷你播放条、液态玻璃卡片和黑胶视图，使用本机客户端自动登录，支持 VIP 曲目播放及客户端播放同步。
description.en: Windows-only NetEase Cloud Music player requiring the local client; provides a mini bar, liquid glass card, vinyl view, automatic login through the local client, VIP playback, and client playback sync.

description.zh: 重映射 174 个 --dsw-* 令牌，表面、文字、边框、代码块、滚动条与状态色由同一套调色板推导；插画只铺对话列，侧栏和设置页保持实底。浅色/深色/跟随系统三态成对提交，不改写偏好；「设置 → 皮肤管理」可实时调模糊、表面与气泡透明度、壁纸遮罩、壁纸模糊和聚焦光晕七项参数。
description.en: A whale-girl skin that remaps all 174 --dsw-* tokens from one palette, with the illustration behind the conversation column only. Light, dark and system-following palettes are submitted pairwise without overriding your appearance preference, and seven live parameters in Settings → Skin Manager cover frosted blur, surface and bubble opacity, wallpaper scrim, wallpaper blur and the focus glow.

description.zh: 以《逃离塔科夫》主界面为灵感的主题：四段可拖拽取景的 15 秒循环动态背景（窄屏或减少动态时自动停用）、Beta 警告横幅、四类场景提示音与 BGM 浮窗，另有可拖动、点击播放随机 Scav 语音的 Altyn 桌宠和塔科夫风状态行文案。
description.en: A theme modeled on the Escape from Tarkov main menu with four 15-second looping backgrounds you can reframe by dragging (auto-disabled on narrow screens or with reduced motion), a Beta warning banner, sounds for four session events, a BGM dock, a draggable Altyn helmet pet with random Scav voice lines, and Tarkov-flavored status text.

description.zh: 舒缓的 Catppuccin 粉彩主题，提供 Latte、Frappé、Macchiato 和 Mocha 四套皮肤。
description.en: A soothing Catppuccin pastel theme with four skins: Latte, Frappé, Macchiato, and Mocha.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供可组合的字体系统：内置 JetBrains Mono + Inter、Fira Code + IBM Plex Sans、Cascadia Code 三套 OFL 字体预设，离线随包分发；可在设置中导入自定义 `woff2` 字体，并通过 `ctx.fonts` 注册表供其他插件扩展。内置字体为 Latin 子集，中文会回退到系统字体；自定义导入仅接受可跨域访问的 HTTP(S) `woff2` 直链。
description.en: A composable font system for DSH Web with three offline OFL presets—JetBrains Mono + Inter, Fira Code + IBM Plex Sans, and Cascadia Code. Import custom `woff2` fonts from Settings, and let other plugins extend the `ctx.fonts` registry. Bundled fonts are Latin subsets, so CJK falls back to system fonts; custom imports accept only CORS-accessible HTTP(S) `woff2` URLs.

description.zh: Solarized 与 Selenized 主题：将四套忠实色板注册到主题运行时，并提供设置选择项和规范的代码块语法配色。
description.en: Solarized and Selenized themes with four faithful palettes registered in the theme runtime, a Settings picker row, and canonical code-block syntax colors.

description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中增加「外观」页，提供 Codex 风格蓝灰预设、跟随系统/浅色/深色模式、自定义颜色、字体字号、侧栏模糊、动效和对比度控制；设置保存在当前桌面应用的本地浏览器存储中。它是社区插件，并非官方 Codex 或 DeepSeek 产品；目前仅在 macOS 的 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 上验证，Windows 实机效果尚未验证。
description.en: Adds an Appearance page to DSH with a Codex-inspired blue-gray preset, system/light/dark modes, custom colors, typography, sidebar blur, motion, and contrast controls. Settings stay in the current desktop app's local browser storage. This is an independent community plugin, not an official Codex or DeepSeek product; installation and the settings UI were verified on macOS with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2, while Windows runtime behavior remains unverified.

description.zh: 以 DreamSkin 配色和鲸鱼娘插画构成亮色主题，壁纸衬在轻纸面之后。可实时调节玻璃、壁纸和对话纸面透明度；仅提供亮色外观，插画采用 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 许可。
description.en: A light-only theme pairing the DreamSkin palette with whale-girl artwork behind a translucent paper layer. Adjust glass, wallpaper, and conversation-paper transparency live. The artwork is licensed under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

name.zh: 多宠物与 Live2D 伴侣

description.zh: 支持精灵图与 Live2D 的多宠物伴侣，随思考、工具调用、完成和失败切换动画。可为宠物命名、拖动、摸头与喂食，并记录亲密度；还可安装自定义宠物和台词包。
description.en: A multi-pet companion supporting sprites and Live2D, with animations for thinking, tool activity, completion, and failure. Name, drag, pet, and feed companions, build affinity, and install custom pets and dialogue packs.

description.zh: 主题、全局字体、@ 文件引用、项目文件树与 Markdown 预览工作台。
description.en: A workspace for themes, global typography, @file mentions, a project file tree, and Markdown preview.

description.zh: Ivory for DSH 用暖中性色覆盖浅色与深色界面，兼顾桌面和移动端，并提供阅读/复制控制、响应式文件与插件管理、内置安全 Markdown 预览（始终可看源码、链接仅 HTTP(S)）和 WCAG AA/强制颜色/减少动态效果支持。插件无网络、遥测、文件系统或进程访问，仅保存两个浏览器本地偏好；已针对 DSH Web `0.2.1-rc.1` 与 Desktop `0.2.1-rc.2` 验证，其他版本可回退到令牌级主题。
description.en: Ivory for DSH applies warm neutrals to light and dark modes across desktop and mobile, with reading and copy controls, responsive file and plugin management, a bounded safe Markdown preview with source view and HTTP(S)-only links, and WCAG AA, forced-colors, and reduced-motion support. It makes no network, telemetry, filesystem, or process access and stores only two browser-local preferences. It is verified against DSH Web `0.2.1-rc.1` and Desktop `0.2.1-rc.2`; other hosts can fall back to token-level theming.

description.zh: 为 DSH Desktop 提供 Claude Code Desktop 风格的浅深色界面，含模型与思考强度选择器、像素鲸鱼互动、附件与输入框优化、上下文分解和用量卡片；面向 macOS 与 Windows。
description.en: A Claude Code Desktop-style light/dark interface for DSH Desktop, with model and effort pickers, an interactive pixel whale, attachment and composer refinements, context breakdowns, and usage cards. Targets macOS and Windows.

description.zh: 泡泡猫蓝白玻璃拟态主题，提供「淡雅」与「蓝色」两种风格，并可在云母卡片模式与兼容模式之间切换。可选 WebGL2 流体背景或图片/视频壁纸，调节模糊、磨砂、亮度、装饰与中英文字体；猫爪、小鱼、泡泡和星光装饰均可控制。当前 `0.3.4` 已移除背景音乐播放器、上传入口及内置曲目，目标 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`。
description.en: A blue-and-white glassmorphism theme with PaoPao Cat styling, two looks—Elegant and Blue—and a choice between Mica-card and compatibility modes. Choose a WebGL2 fluid background or an image/video wallpaper, then tune blur, frosting, brightness, decorations, and Chinese/English fonts. Cat paws, fish, bubbles, and starlight are configurable. Version `0.3.4` removed the background-music player, upload flow, and bundled tracks; it targets DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`.

description.zh: 《犹格索托斯的庭院》特莉波卡（Tlipoca）GAL 视觉小说皮肤，以深紫与鎏金哥特界面、琉璃金饰对话框和 Cinzel / ZCOOL XiaoWei / Noto Serif SC 字体打造沉浸式阅读场景。内置 7 套表情差分，会随情感标签、文件/终端/`web_search` 工具状态切换；还提供任务横条详情、3 个场景、可持久化自定义背景和对话历史抽屉。
description.en: A Tlipoca GAL visual-novel skin inspired by Yog-Sothoth's Yard, with a dark-purple and gold gothic interface, jeweled glass dialogue boxes, and Cinzel, ZCOOL XiaoWei, and Noto Serif SC typography. Seven character-expression variants react to emotion labels and file, terminal, or `web_search` tool states. It also adds detailed task bars, three scenes, a locally persistent custom background, and a conversation-history drawer.

description.zh: DSH 动漫皮肤管理器提供经典、亚丝娜、明日香、加藤惠、远坂凛和阿尔托莉雅六套皮肤，并配套浮动 `☰` 菜单、按工作区分组的会话列表、皮肤切换弹窗和主题化 UI 覆盖；选择通过 cookie 与 `localStorage` 持久化。它是 plain Cordis 插件，不应加入 `dsh.profile.bundles`；会话菜单不提供删除操作。
description.en: A browser-side manager for six skins—Classic, Asuna, Asuka, Megumi Kato, Rin Tohsaka, and Artoria—with a floating `☰` menu, workspace-grouped session list, skin picker, and theme-aware UI overrides. The selection persists through a host cookie with a localStorage fallback. It is a plain Cordis plugin, not a `dsh.bundle`; do not add it to `dsh.profile.bundles`. The session menu does not provide deletion.

description.zh: Rick and Morty for dsh 提供三套主题（Lab Coat、Meeseeks Blue、C-137 Portal）和六种可切换桌宠，桌宠会对开始工作、完成、出错、等待确认/提问与空闲作出不同反应。支持拖动、点击/连击、五级熟悉度、任务称号和冒险日志，全部台词与界面双语；偏好与存档仅在浏览器 `localStorage`，角色图片为非商业同人素材，不在 MIT 代码许可范围内。
description.en: Rick and Morty for dsh provides three themes—Lab Coat, Meeseeks Blue, and C-137 Portal—and six switchable pets that react differently when work starts, completes, errors, waits for approval or a question, and idles. Pets support dragging, clicking and combos, five familiarity levels, task titles, and an adventure log; all lines and labels are bilingual. Preferences and saves stay in browser `localStorage`, while the character images are non-commercial fan assets outside the MIT code grant.

description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供蜘蛛侠红蓝主题皮肤：覆盖官方设计 token，加入蛛网纹理、蜘蛛标识和场景化工作区，并用 WebGL2 流体效果在蜘蛛战衣与真人 Peter Parker 图层之间随鼠标显现。皮肤可与同仓库的漫威桌宠运行时独立组合；当前英雄内容为蜘蛛侠，素材随包提供且不依赖外部服务。
description.en: A Spider-Man skin for the DSH Web UI with red-and-blue design-token overrides, web textures, Spider-Man branding and scene-styled workspace surfaces. A WebGL2 fluid background reveals Peter Parker through the suit as the pointer moves. It can be combined independently with the repository’s Marvel pet runtime; Spider-Man is the current hero, and bundled assets run without an external service.

description.zh: 提供 4 套预设配色与自定义配色，并分别为浅色/深色重建色阶；通过 OKLCH 色域处理和真实承载面上的对比度求解，调节文字色调、侧栏深度、Markdown 强调、滚动条与开关颜色。支持高对比度、配置导入导出和 4 种界面语言，使用 `ctx.theme.overrideTokens` 叠加颜色，不改宿主源码或外观偏好。
description.en: Provides four preset palettes plus a custom palette, with independent light and dark ramps. OKLCH gamut handling and contrast solving on the actual host surfaces drive controls for text tint, sidebar depth, Markdown emphasis, scrollbars, and switches. It also supports high contrast, configuration import/export, and four UI languages, applying colors through `ctx.theme.overrideTokens` without patching host source or changing the appearance preference.

description.zh: 一只住在 DSH Web 界面的可定制猫咪桌宠：支持 `idle.png` 静态图或 `idle-N.png` 序列帧、拖拽定位、番茄专注/休息计时、按专注分钟累计 XP，以及逐级解锁“托托的 30 个事实”。设置可调大小、动画速度和像素渲染，文案随中英文界面切换并遵循 `prefers-reduced-motion`；外观仅识别带透明通道的 PNG，未提供图片时不会显示。仅在 DSH web profile 生效，已在 Chromium（Chrome/Edge）验证。
description.en: A customizable cat pet for the DSH Web UI: use `idle.png` for a still or `idle-N.png` frames for animation, drag it around, run Pomodoro focus/break sessions, earn XP by focus minutes, and unlock 30 facts about Toto by level. Settings cover size, animation speed and pixel rendering; labels follow zh/en and the pet honors `prefers-reduced-motion`. Appearance detection accepts transparent PNG files only, and Toto stays hidden when no image is supplied. It runs in the DSH web profile and has been verified on Chromium (Chrome/Edge).

description.zh: 「海盐晨雾」与「潮汐夜航」两套海岸线配色主题：浅色使用暖象牙沙、海玻璃青与浮木墨色，深色使用深蓝绿、月光海玻璃与暖铜状态点。主题只通过官方 `ThemeRuntime` 的 107 个 `--dsw-alias-*` token 覆盖，跟随 DSH 的浅色/深色/跟随系统设置，不注入壁纸、不改布局、不写设置；禁用或热重载会撤回覆盖层。需要 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` 及以上。
description.en: A coastal palette with two scenes: Salt & Timber for light mode, using warm ivory sand, sea-glass teal, and driftwood ink; and Twilight Cove for dark mode, using deep blue-green, moonlit sea glass, and warm copper status points. It only overrides the official `ThemeRuntime` layer across 107 `--dsw-alias-*` tokens, follows DSH Light/Dark/Follow System appearance, and adds no wallpaper, layout changes, or settings writes. Disabling or hot-reloading retracts the layer; DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` or newer is required.

description.zh: 复旦校园主题的桌面插件：可拖动的深蓝金边额度卡显示余额、今日消耗、24 小时走势和天气，点开是含充值/赠送构成、峰谷倒计时与降雨详情的看板。另有六张校园水彩壁纸可调不透明度、模糊与遮罩；侧栏「知行台」把日程、项目与学习内容保存在本机。
description.en: A Fudan-campus desktop plugin: a draggable navy-and-gold status card shows balance, today's spend, a 24-hour curve and local weather, and expands into a dashboard with top-up/gift breakdown, peak/off-peak countdown and rain details. Six watercolour campus wallpapers have opacity, blur and scrim controls, and a local Zhixing workspace (知行台) keeps schedules, projects and study notes inside the DSH profile.
